chapters.html:
Phainon could confidently say he had never in his life felt like this.

With adrenaline pumping through his veins so loudly that he could barely even hear the clashing of metal around him - his eyes focusing on the man just a few feet away grinning wickedly right back at him. And Phainon.. Oh how he wanted to match that man’s energy, feeling more alive than he ever had before as that enemy charged forward at him.

It was obvious who this man was, with those blazing golden horns and tail that burned into a fiery red at the end of his scales - looking more dazzling than anything Phainon had ever seen in this world. All while he had such sharp looking clawed gauntlets on, outstretched and cruel looking as they tried to land a punch into Phainon - or perhaps they were attempting to claw a hole in his stomach.

Whatever it was, he couldn’t help but feel entranced as he moved his greatsword against and against to blow those blows - breathing so loudly as he panting with the sparks of their fight flying around them. 

Even with Phainon being so much taller than this man, he still felt the danger that was oozing off of him in waves - the aura and intensity of a man that utterly wanted him dead.

.. And Phainon wanted to drown in it.

He wanted to bask in the way that crown prince seemed to be so alive on the battlefield, he wanted to make their duel last forever as he blocked yet another blow from those heavy gauntlets - feeling the breath leave his lungs over how had those fists were against his sword, a strike that drove a chatter up Phainon’s arms and to his skull.

And it only excited him more and more, finding himself wagging his tail without much of a second thought while he blinked a stare at that man who was breathing heavily - yet never slowing. Never stopping, never allowing Phainon to catch his breath fully while in the heat of their battle - only continuing his onslaught to try to claim Phainon’s life.

Phainon found himself struggling to breathe for many different reasons outside of that, however, moving his feet back the slightest bit to try to gain a moment. Just a moment to speak to that dragon, one that matched him so well - one that was so furious seeming and ferocious that Phainon for once felt fear running through his veins.

A fear that he could actually lose his life to this man, and that.. That was thrilling as those golden eyes flickered up towards his head with a snarl on his lips - making Phainon’s mind blank.

“You’re.. Mydeimos, correct?” Phainon dared to ask in between his sword being caught in one of those demonic gauntlets again - feeling his stomach drop in the way that exhilarated him like nothing before it. 

“Focus on surviving,” That clawed man growled in reply, not missing a single beat to try to strike into Phainon’s side as he yanked his sword free - only to laugh as he side stepped a little, doing his best to dodge that dragon’s hatred towards him currently.

Phainon couldn’t help but to grin over it, “Ah! And if I survive this, will I be told the name of the royalty who is fighting before me?”

That man paused for a second - all before tilting his head a little, just enough to send blond locks of hair scattering across his forehead as he blinked at Phainon in such a cute way that Phainon knew his tail was wagging even harder. Feeling himself growing desperate to see what kind of cute emotions and expression this man had when he wasn’t out of battle, as well.

“You speak as if you do not have a brain,” That man hissed, making Phainon hum a little as he sucked in a deep breath, moving to block that lunging dragon’s claw once more, feeling his sword stall mid slash as that shorter man caught it so easily, “How many with dragon blood on the battlefield do you often find, crown prince of Aedes Elysiae?”

Phainon couldn’t help it.

He felt his heart skip a beat at that as that man easily parried his attack with a whip of his tail against the ground - as if he were angry about it all but Phainon..

Phainon felt himself smiling smugly at that man, “You know who I am?”

“.. You’re as overgrown as the rumors say, but you don’t seem to have a brain to make up for it.”

Phainon felt himself pursing his lips a little bitterly over those words - pouting, really, but he couldn’t help it! He wanted to make a good impression on that man as he moved forward to attack this time, his sword feeling as light as ever with his good mood - making his beam a smile to that dragon blooded man once more. 

“Oh? Am I supposed to instantly know the name of every beautiful person I meet?” Phainon asked with a little laugh, watching the way those keen almost slitted appearing eyes looked at him - all before flickering away to seemingly focus on something else.

.. Phainon wasn’t sure what the emotion he was feeling was, but he was certain of one thing. He preferred those stunning eyes to stay on him, and only him.

“Hmph,” That man growled after a moment - moving his eyes back to Phainon before tilting his head a little once more to take in the sight of Phainon, “If that is how you feel, I’m sure you’ve many more suitors willing to give you their name at home.”

.. Suitors?

Truthfully, Phainon did have a lot of those, there were so many people desiring his hand in marriage that he found it amusing, really. And incredibly boring, how was he supposed to find any of them interesting enough to mate with them for life when none of them gave him anything to go off of?

‘I like long walks on the beach’, how original - Aedes Elysiae isn’t anywhere near the beach, what the hell was he supposed to do with that in general!?

“Ah..” Phainon hummed over his own thoughts, finding himself shaking his head slowly, “None as stunning as you are.”

That seemed to be the wrong answer as that beautiful flaming man lunged at him again with such a guttural noise hanging in the air from him - one that made Phainon laugh a little in reply, already moving to continue their passionate dance by parrying those quickly thrown fists. Every single hit still felt like they were intentionally trying to break Phainon’s bones one by one, and yet..

.. Phainon almost felt like he would let the man if he got to look at that giddy and manic looking grin on his face while he did so. 

“Hey! Was that the wrong thing to say? You’re growling at me!” Phainon asked innocently, feeling a bit smug over how that man seemed to be focused on him so much currently. Only for that man to skid a few feet away from their last head-to-head, taking a moment to sigh rather loudly. 

So dramatically that Phainon couldn’t help but feel his lips quivering a little in amusement towards his enemy, his tail swaying a bit too happily behind him - but he didn’t mind. Not as he watched that way that man seemed to be fighting down the urge to snarl and growl at him. So feisty in his rage that it only worked to thrill Phainon more and more. 

“This is a battlefield, have you no shame?” That blazing man hissed out his words - borderline spitting them at Phainon’s feet and Phainon.. Phainon felt his own tail wagging more and more over that, enamored by the rage this stranger had towards him in such an odd way that he felt almost jittery. 

“None!” Phainon beamed out, unable to help himself but to give that dragon blooded man his full attention, “I’m Phainon of Aedes Elysiae, it’s an honor to meet you.”

“.. Right.”

Phainon could feel his own tail drooping this  time around as that man instead merely made a mad dash towards him again. One bent on slaying Phainon and claiming victory for himself..

.. But that wasn’t the issue here! Phainon desperately wanted to know who he was fighting, as well!

“Don’t just go back to fighting me! What is your n-” Phainon found himself choking out those words over the blaring sound of a horn - one that made him jerk his head upwards in a daze. 

That wasn’t Aedes Elysiae’s, was it Styxia’s? Or - 

Phainon found himself sucking in such a harsh breath, feeling a sinking filling forming in the pit of his stomach over how quickly that man was leaving him there alone. Leaving the scene as quickly as possible even when the battle was still raging on - making Phainon stand there rather dumbfoundedly as he stared after the sight of that man. 

He could feel the way his body slugged a little bit - his muscles feeling tired and burning in his veins all while he felt more depressed than anything that his enemy had left him here alone.

.. Without a good bye, as well.. It felt so cruel as Phainon cocked his head a little - blinking over the sight of most of the Kremnoans fleeing and that.. That was odd.

“Lord Phainon,” Phainon had to flick his eyes boredly to the side at that, feeling the dullness in his life returning to his bones now that he was left with his thoughts here. His eyes languidly found their way to the footman who was speaking to him - blinking down as he craned his head a little.

.. That dragon with the curved ram horns had been a rather nice height, tall for a normal man, and tall for someone with dragonblood - yet still not as tall as Phainon. That was fine though, something about it only made Phainon hum in his thoughts as he resisted the urge to look at where that dragon blooded man had run off to.

Though, with all of the Kremnoans now leaving.. Phainon had to assume this battlefield had been won by their alliance, and not the Kremnoans. 

“This battle is won, Lord Phainon. The Kremnoan king has surrendered,” Those words should have been music to his ears - and in a way, they were. His heart felt lighter knowing the war that had been on-going his entire life would be meeting its end soon,  truly. 

Yet.. A piece of him had some regrets that made him swayed a little as he moved to put away his sword - sighing heavily as he flicked his eyes back to where that dragon had scurried off to.

.. Was he not going to be able to have another fight with him anytime soon? 

────────────── 

Phainon couldn’t help himself as he sat there with his tail idly swinging behind him - unable to fathom how jittery he felt as he blinked up at that dragon who sat merely a few feet away. Almost close enough to touch, almost close enough to smell, and it was driving Phainon absolutely insane that he couldn’t.

He had to sit there as a rigid prince, acting like he wasn’t endlessly bothered by the fellow prince just a bit away. 

It felt like a mockery, really, to show a dragon the thing they wanted to keep for themself the most - yet to tell them they weren’t allowed to act on those instincts. Instead he had to sit there properly and not speak a word during this meeting to them - not while his father was deep in discussion alongside their allies.. 

It was enough to make Phainon want to lay his head on the table in front of him and weep, and still he was not allowed to do even that. 

“Cas,” Phainon started instead as he leaned to the side a little - enough to be closer to Castorice and able to whisper to her, all while his eyes never left that familiar man that made him struggle to focus, “Who is the golden dragon beside their queen?”

There was no way to confuse him with anyone else, not when that man had left such an impression on Phainon like no one else ever had. His image was scarred into Phainon’s core, and it left his stomach yearning for something he had never felt in his entire life before. A desperation that was eating into him as he tried to focus on his mundane normal tasks throughout life, all while he kept wondering about that dragon blooded man that had punched fear into his core.

Fear, and undoubtedly yet worryingly, lust. 

“Her son,” Castorice supplied, though she gave a little sigh as Phainon scratched a nail across the smooth wooden table in front of him nervously, “Truthfully, I’m.. Not sure what his name is. They’ve been rather quiet with sharing details about him.”

.. She also didn’t know his name?

That was enough to make Phainon slink down into his chair a little, huffing out a sigh as he tried to figure out why his damned name was so hard to figure out all while Phainon tapped his fingers against the table idly. Gritting his sharp teeth a little as he tried to conjure up a way to speak to that man again.

He would do anything to have his name.. And him in general, but a name would be a wonderful starting point for Phainon to work from. 

“Darn,” Phainon huffed as he slouched a little, not caring what anyone else thought of him when that golden eyed man wasn’t paying him any mind anyway, “I was rather looking forward to having a third person to bother while we sit at these meetings.”

That excuse however earned a quiet laugh from Castorice at his side, “.. He does not appear pleased to be here at the slightest, Lord Phainon..”

Phainon found himself gnawing into his tongue a little over that - his mind studying the way he really did not seem very happy. There was such a thin frown on his lips as he seemed to be staring at King Kephale, a frown that made Phainon rather.. Unsettled..

An emotion he couldn’t place a name to, really, when he considered he wasn’t sure if he was unsettled due to that man being mad at his father; or if he was just.. Unhappy that the dragon seemed unhappy in general. 

.. He would like to spar with him again if that would make that dragon come to life like he once had. 

“No,” Phainon conceded, blinking away his thoughts as he huffed a little sigh over how doomed he was, “He doesn’t.”

“Are you alright today? You seem a bit.. Dazed?” Castorice asked without missing a single beat of the conversation - making Phainon look at her a bit slowly, languidly as he tried to resist the urge to pout, all before turning his head back to that man. Something about keeping his eyes off of him drove Phainon insane, as if that dragon was the center of his universe now. 

“I merely..” Phainon trailed off - trying to figure out what he could possibly say to her that didn’t make him appear as insane as he already felt, “Hate these meetings.”

“We’ve never had the royalty of Castrum Kremnos attend in either of our lifetimes.. It’s a bit.. Stiff, feeling.” Castorice agreed, not seeming to notice anything was off and that was enough to make Phainon scratch his nails on that table idly - his eyes dipping to watch his scaled claws scrape it coldly. A horrible noise, but Castorice hadn’t raised any complaints yet - and the council men were never fond of complaining about Phainon in general. 

“He should have sat near us,” Phainon found himself absentmindedly muttering, unable to help himself as he looked to that man again - merely sitting silently beside his mother without saying a word. King Eurypon and King Kephale seemed to be speaking the most, all while the rest of the Kremnoan family sat at that round table in the middle of the room silently.

A cursed room, really, what kind of royal sacred grounds was it to make rows of tables and chairs to watch those in the middle - all while being so hard to hear? It made no sense to Phainon, but at the least he didn’t think he was missing out on that man speaking today. 

“Hmm?” Castorice hummed, making him not even look away - merely blinking his eyes as he moved to cross his legs, staring at the way that dragon had half his body exposed yet again.

“To speak with us,” Phainon mumbled as if it made the most sense in the world,  “He looks to be around our age, he should be talking with us.. After all, we will all be the leaders of our own kingdoms one day.”

“Mm.. Perhaps he is shy,” Castorice offered, and that was enough to make Phainon whine out a little - whimpering over the way that prince wasn’t even looking at them at all. He was still absorbed into that conversation that didn’t involve him at all apparently, watching the rulers speak amongst each other and dragging a sigh from Phainon’s mouth.

He would love to make that man the center of the conversation, let alone let him into the conversation and speak to begin with. 

But the idea of him being shy seemed a little bit humorous considering the way he had spoken with such confidence in their fight - a stern voice that demanded respect and Phainon was more than a little capable of giving him what he demanded and more.. If he was just allowed to, at the very least. 

“He looks more angry than shy,” Phainon huffed out as he moved his eyes to look at his own hand that was dragging a claw down the table still - staring at the translucent colors in his white scales that seemed to flicker between a dazzling array of colors and yet..

None were as breathtaking as the scales that man had on his own tail and horns - the mess of scales that crept up the sides of his face and onto his cheekbones beautifully. He looked as if he were truly on fire, and Phainon found his stomach burning with the sensation of desire every time he stared at him. 

He wanted those eyes to look at him so direly, and yet.. They were wholly ignoring him as it was. 

“He can be mad and shy…” Castorice countered easily, making Phainon click his tongue at the thought as he instead found his own eyes flitting away swiftly - staring at his father who was now nodding and standing from his chair. A man of golden hair who seemed to shine like the sun, even with his scales that matched Phainon’s own - though in a darker hue, almost.

Due to Phainon somehow having more dragon blood in his veins, apparently. He instead was more albino, more eerie and praised as being a beacon of ‘innocence’ and ‘prosperity’ for their people with how much dragon’s blood was in heart and bloodstream. As if somehow, he was a lucky and divine thing, that he of all people was a good sign.

.. But really, it just meant to Phainon that he was much bigger than other dragons, towering at least a head taller than most of them - even that golden burning one he was fond of now. 

That was quite the dire thing in itself, something about how ‘it would be hard to find a mate that could endure sexual relations with him’ or whatnot. But Phainon.. Phainon had to move his eyes back to that prince - blinking over how well toned he was even from the distance away they were.. He could probably endure Phainon’s egg laying, if anyone could.. 

“King Kephale,” Castorice greeted after a moment, making Phainon snap his eyes back to his quickly approaching father - copying Castorice to stand up and bow to him politely.

.. They were in public with a reputation to uphold, anyway. 

“.. May I have a moment to speak with my son alone?”

That.. Was never a good thing, and Phainon had to resist gnawing into his tongue as he heard Castorice walking away immediately after another curtsy given silently and respectfully. That clacking of her heels moving away was enough to make Phainon look up once more, blinking into those eerie golden eyes - much lighter than the amber ones that other dragon seemed to have. 

“Father,” Phainon nodded curtly, doing his best to bite down his desire to look at that Kremnoan prince, to try to see if he was watching Phainon and his father speak. To know if he had that gaze on him again, sizing him up for battle and thinking of ways to tear Phainon’s flesh from his own body and that.. That thought made Phainon want to trill happily in his excitement towards it. 

“While the negotiations of signing a peace treaty with Kremnos have been.. Somewhat agreed on, there remain a few key issues that Queen Polyxia and I would prefer to have lead into longer discussions,” Kephale began to explain, making his mind burrow out of his thoughts one way or another as he looked at his father - tilting his head the slightest bit over this line of discussion,  “I’ll not go into details here, but there is something I need to ask of you.”

“Yes?” Phainon asked, but it wasn’t as if he could ever deny his father - not when he looked up to him so much and had no desire in his heart to ever fail that man.

That was why he was pretty sure he didn’t even hear the next question his father asked correctly. 

“How.. How well would you get fair with another young male dragon-blood?”

.. Young male..?

Like himself?

Like that prince that he was yearning and lusting over? Surely that wasn’t what Kephale was asking about, right? Surely there was something else..

Phainon fully was tilting his head now, unable to help himself as he slowly blinked at his father in a slight daze, “.. Pardon?”

“Their son, Mydeimos, has agreed to come as a sort of peace offering that they mean well,” Kephale explained with a quiet hum as he moved to languidly rub at his own chin - ruffling with the stubble there a bit, “I’m unsure if it is some sort of trickery from their royalties, thus I would prefer if you could keep a good watch on him.”

.. Mydeimos.

That was a name Phainon didn’t know, a name that he couldn’t recognize and yet, it belonged to a prince undoubtedly, meaning.. That blond and red haired man, the dragon blooded royalty that wouldn’t answer him on the battlefield - that was Mydeimos. 

“M.. Mydeimos?” Phainon found himself echoing out, still in a slight state of shock over how this was actually unfolding now. 

“Indeed, the golden and red dragon sitting beside Queen Gorgo,” Kephale turned to the side a little, as if to let Phainon take a look at that dragon once more who was in fact sitting there primly and looking at his mother as she spoke to him with a rather worried expression on her face, “That is Mydeimos Kremnos.”

.. Mydeimos Kremnos.

That was the true name of the man who had given Phainon a reason to feel terror for the first time in so long on the battlefield. The man who had seemed to want to see his blood gushing onto the floors and his innards torn from his chest.

The name of the man who Phainon felt his tail wagging over happily every single time he had to look at him - eyes gazing at how beautiful he looked, even now. His eyes were only able to take in the way Mydeimos looked so endlessly beautiful - even as he sat there looking as proper as possible during such a serious conversation unfolding it seemed.

“I.. I believe I can get along swimmingly with him, father.” Phainon nodded as he spoke - just a quick one, and right to the point. 

He could absolutely handle it and get along with the dragon named Mydeimos Kremnos, in fact, he could easily say he wanted to do more than just get along with him. He would love to intimately get to know him, and perhaps he was a little insane for already feeling that way - but he didn’t view that as a bad thing either. 

“.. Phainon,” His father spoke in a rather quiet tone, one that made Phainon blink a few times as he tried to figure out what the issue was - he sounded almost.. Worried? “I do not believe I have ever seen your tail sway back and forth like this.”

Phainon had to look over his shoulder at that, watching his rather long tail happily swaying back and forth lowly behind him as he stood in front of his chair. Making his blink a few times as the sight before he turned to look back at his father once more with a rather forced smile. Trying his best to look as if his words were believable as Kephale stared him down incredulously. 

“Forgive me, the idea of finally ending this war has.. Excited me,” Phainon offered that explanation, it was true, really. 

He was eager to have this war finally over when it had consumed most of his life - they had always been at war with the kingdom of Kremnos, everyone had. And a piece of Phainon was so painfully eager to end that level of suffering while he still could, and yet..

.. He knew his tail was wagging due to that dragon being offered to their kingdom, some sort of war trophy it seemed - branded as something else, assurance that their agreement would be fully discussed, but anyone could see it for what it was. Even Phainon who felt so thrilled over this and excited to meet that man, he knew so painfully well that Mydeimos was a prisoner with a fancy title attached to him.

Kephale let out a rather loud sigh at that - one that made his shoulders sag before shaking his head slowly, “That’s.. A bit unlike you to allow your instincts to overcome you so easily, but I share the sentiment.”

Phainon found himself unable to reply to that - merely blinking at his father while trying to stop the happy sway of his tail that he could feel still happening.

He truly.. Had never lost himself to his instincts so easily, he had been taught to be refined and proper and now.. He found himself wanting to purr over that prince and coil his tail around him, he wanted to preen him and chip one of his scales free to keep from himself when they became loose.. He was.. Much too eager to talk to Mydeimos more.

.. How was he supposed to ever stop the way his tail was reflecting his inner feelings of joy?

“I will bring him over to you and Princess Castorice now, have him sit on the other side of her,” Kephale spoke in the lull of discussion, clearly finding Phainon’s words enough as he turned away swiftly - walking away without another word and that..

That was the cue for Castorice to quickly return to Phainon’s side, seeming a bit more eager than she was before. 

“Yes..” Phainon found himself a little bit unwilling to listen to the latter half of that - he wasn’t a danger to Mydeimos, and they didn’t need space between each other.. Phainon could behave!

“Did.. He say that grumpy dragon was coming over to join us?” Castorice asked though, making him jerk his head a little out of his thoughts to beam a little smug smile her way - feeling giddy over the answer he had to give to her. 

“Yep!”

Phainon practically purred that word as he immediately moved to the front of the table - no longer able to stay seated or waiting behind the table as his eyes moved to watch his father speaking with Mydeimos. A chat that Phainon wished he could hear, but it wasn’t very important, not as those golden eyes flicked to him and back to Kephale.

Just the briefest moment of eye contact was enough to send a shiver down Phainon’s spine and to his tailtip, enough to make his tail wag even more and he felt the urge to wring his hands nervously. He had.. Never been so anxious before, this wanting, and now he had to simply wait a few more moments before meeting Mydeimos formally. To meet the man who had stolen his heart many days ago on the battlefield and then left him.

“Why are you rounding the table..?” Castorice asked, making him huff a little as he moved to stand in front of their table - glancing at her for just a mere moment before snapping his eyes back on that prince again. Almost scared that he could possibly miss Mydeimos looking at him again.. 

“I’m eager,” Phainon confessed in a voice that he knew was drenched in joy, one that was shaking as he spoke his words sloppily,  “I want to meet him nice and close..”

“L-Lord Phainon, your.. Your tail is wagging..?”

Phainon didn’t pay Castorice’s words any mind - how could he as he saw that fiery dragon standing up and giving a small formal bow to Kephale. Only to move his eyes back to Phainon, and then to dip down to Castorice behind Phainon and that.. Phainon was ashamed to say he had to resist the urge to step in front of her. To keep those eyes on himself, though, it didn’t matter.

Not as Mydeimos instead began to move towards them - pausing a little, a few feet away from Phainon as he seemed almost.. Unsure of what was about to happen between the three of them sitting in this area alone. 

“I was instructed to come over to here,” Mydeimos explained in that silky smooth voice - more honey coated and entrancing than when he had spoken with a snarl on the battlefield. Soothing and enamoring in a way that made it even more impossible for Phainon’s tail to stop its wagging as he looked at Mydeimos doing another, sweet little bow towards them both, “Pleasure to meet you, Princess Castorice.. Prince Phainon..”

“Mydeimos,” Phainon breathed out in reply - not able to hold himself back and feeling almost ashamed of how desperate and needy he sounded to his own ears. Though, that much was to be expected since he felt more and more desperate to meet this man anyway - feeling like he was a fish out of water with how dry his mouth was.

Only, Mydeimos blinked at him rather slowly, “.. Yes?”

“That’s your name.. The name I wanted to hear and learn so desperately on the battlefield that you refused to give me,” Phainon purred out, not really caring how insane he sounded to anyone else as he stepped closer to that man. Drinking in the way that prince only rigidly stood there staring at him - all while Phainon took his time to come closer to him, “Mydeimos, Mydeimos, Mydeimos..”

Close enough to where Mydeimos’s head had to tilt up to look him in the eyes - looking less than amused over it, but Phainon couldn’t help himself from enjoying it. His tail assuredly gave away that emotion as well as he stared right back at Mydeimos. 

“You’re so stiff, do you want me to massage you?” Phainon asked as he tilted his head a little, looking at the way Mydeimos seemed to be more than a little ‘stiff’. As if he was on guard, but that was a silly emotion, really.. 

Phainon would love to fight against him once more, but he was plenty sure he had no desire to harm this man - if anything, he felt the urge to nuzzle their heads together like mates would do. The urge to hold his hand and help him clean between his scales, the desire to trill for him and help him settle into a slumber..

And it wasn’t hard to guess why that made Mydei have such a sinking feeling in his gut, even if he tried to ignore it in favor of looking as stoic as possible in this conversation. Only moving to follow Kephale as that older dragon opened the carriage door for him quite politely.

An action that made Mydei say his ‘thank you’ under his breath as he passed him by, yet he couldn’t shake the feeling that something was still waiting to happen. Especially as that man filled out the carriage the rest of the way on the opposite seat across from him, making Mydei stare in his nervousness now. 

.. At least if it had been Phainon, he would have felt less studied by that golden stare latching onto him as the carriage began to roll into motion with the sounds of hooves on the ground. 

“I hope he did not say anything too unsavory,” Kephale sighed out, a teasing smile on his lips that read like a father who truly loved his son, “Phainon tries to be polite, but I fear he is quite overeager sometimes.”

There was a lot that was questionable about Kephale’s appearance; namely how different he looked from Phainon.

His hair was a much brighter golden color, a dazzling one that made Mydei consider the man to be more of the sun than the snow like his son’s. His eyes read as if they were a deep gold; Mydei’s favorite color, yet that lacked any depth within them. Cold, almost, as they stared at Mydei in such a way that made Mydei feel as if he must have some type of issue with his mother who Mydei reflected in looks easily. 

.. It was enough to make Mydei raise his hand to his braid and twirl it anxiously; “.. He said nothing of consequence.”

“That’s good to hear,” Kephale replied without missing a beat, sighing a little in a dramatic way that made it to where Mydei could hear it even against the muffled sounds of horses carrying them alone,  “I believe you understood most of the rules being set in place for you from your father, correct?”

Of course Mydei understood them; he just was unsure how deep they truly went and if this was about to actually be his own personal hell unfolding. A trap laid for whoever they got their hands on, he didn’t even think he would be shocked if they actually began to torture him in some sort of fashion. 

At least that would make sense. This.. This sort of deal they had struck made Mydei feel as if he were a bit silly, but he would carry out his task regardless of his personal feelings. 

“Yes sir,” Mydei forced himself to say with a curt nod to that man who had easily noticeable crows feet at his eyes when he smiled.

A man who seemed to smile often was someone Mydei wished he could trust, but there was still something so hollow in his expression that made him feel unsettled. Too much so, really, he felt as if he should start wiggling under that gaze and how sharp it was. 

.. Who exactly was studying who here? Mydei almost felt like this was some sort of test, yet he had no idea what he could possibly do to pass it either.. 

“You are to work in the kingdom as if you are staff, no harm will come to you, we merely wish for this war to come to an end,” Kephale clarified, sounding less warm and excited, more like the king Mydei had been hearing the rest of the night had finally broken free to be stern with an enemy prince,  “I hope you do not resent me for this.”

“I will not resent you, I hope for an amiable outcome as well,” Mydei felt the way he meant those words - but something was making him hesitant from believing himself fully as he blinked at that king in the dim lighting from the window of their carriage. Unable to shake that burrowing feeling that the king was already on edge around him, and Mydei.. Really didn’t know why that was. 

He had no intention of making the situation worse for any of his people - nor was he going to try to make a stand when it was himself alone. He would never dabble in poisons to try to get ahead, and his mother had told him sternly to get along with the royals of Aedes Elysiae..

.. He really had no idea what to make out of any of his thoughts.

“I’m glad to hear it, perhaps you may even enjoy your time in our kingdom and be able to see it from our side,” Kephale sighed out as he seemed to relax a little into his bench, his head turning to look out that small window idly. Giving Mydei a clear view of that broken horn at the side of his head; a war scar of some kind, and Mydei felt like it was most likely rude in the Aedes Elysiae traditions to stare at it, even if it wasn’t in Kremnoan.

.. He had to listen to his instincts and look away from those white horns, doing his best to ignore the way he didn’t think those matched his son’s, either. But what did Mydei know about genetics? Not much, honestly. 

Mydei had to huff a small laugh over Kephale’s words however, ignoring that broken curved horn that ran backwards from his head now as his own eyes looked at anything but that, “.. My opinion will do nothing to sway my father.” 

“You underestimate a parent’s love for their child,” Kephale almost wistfully told him, as if those words were a pain for him to come to terms with as he slid his eyes back to Mydei. Offering him a little simper smile to go with those words that seemed to carry more weight than Mydei could comprehend.

.. Was Phainon really that much of a handful to make this king seem this depressed? What was Mydei getting himself into by agreeing to be a prisoner..?

“I underestimate nothing, King Kephale. My father loves me, I know this, but my father has a goal all the same,” Mydei huffed out as he tried to remain sounding as respectful as possible - all while biting back the itch of annoyance creeping into his mind.

That only did enough to make Kephale study him heavily, staring him down with such a weight of silence that Mydei almost felt uncomfortable the longer it went on.

“I see,” Kephale said after a long while - all before straightening himself out as if he had remembered suddenly what position both of them were in, “Well! I do hope you enjoy your stay here, Mydeimos!”

“Thank you, I hope I do as well.”

Mydei meant those words, of course he did. It wasn’t as if he was hoping he suffered his entire time in Aedes Elysiae - he wanted to genuinely learn about this land he had no real idea about. 

He had read about it in a few books, but their kingdoms had been at war for decades - all he knew about them were the rumors that moved from kingdom to kingdom. The rumors of their giant prince with too much dragon blood in his veins was.. Obviously true, but Mydei found himself wanting to see the other rumors for himself.

The rows of grain that made it appear as if their kingdom were set ablaze in the evening sun - golden and stunning in a way no other kingdom had been able to captivate and match its beauty. Dazzling with rather polite people everywhere, and Mydei had to believe that may be true - Phainon seemed polite for now, even if a bit.. Eager to know more about Mydei and his intimate topics.

.. It wasn’t as if Mydei could have said anything about that, he had no idea how Aedes Elysiae traditions worked - maybe those were just normal first meeting questions and Phainon was being as normal as could be.. 

“You will be staying in our guest bedrooms, do make sure to make yourself at home,” Kephale told him after a moment, making Mydei bite his tongue a little.

To be told he was here to be staff and help do chores as well as work, while putting him in a guest room.. It felt backhanded in a way that he couldn’t properly fathom - as if he was being mocked over his status while paraded around as a prize at the same time. 

“Thank you,” Mydei replied regardless of his own thoughts, not wanting to sound unthankful because.. He was quite thankful that he was getting somewhat decent treatment. 

They could have kept him in their stockades, if anything - he had no right to complain, and he absolutely would not complain. He merely.. Found the entire situation suspicious on so many different variables for some reason.

“You will have to wear our attire, I hope that is not too offensive to you,” Kephale told him with a nod curtly, and that.. That may have been when Mydei wanted to complain the most in his life, actually.

Just the mere thought of putting on constricting princely attire like all those other kingdoms wore made his chest feel tighter.

.. Or maybe that was just because that would be happening to him tomorrow when he put more fabric on himself and covered up all of his skin like they did instead of having half of his body exposed. 

“.. I will endure,” Mydei grumbled out, but for one in his life he really wasn’t sure if he would - he could manage most things but the idea of going about his life in their stuffy and tight clothes had him considering this could be how he dies soon. 

“Right, thank you for that as well,” Kephale said once more, and at this point Mydei was coming to terms that the father son duo appeared to enjoy yapping as Kephale only began to speak once more, “You seem quite young for how mature you are, how old are you?”

His age.

Right.. That was how far apart their kingdoms were; they were not even aware of how old their crown princes were. Mydei had no idea of Phainon’s age, and Phainon had no idea of his. And Mydei had no earthly guess for Castorice, she seemed much too mature and polite.. If he had to assume, Phainon must have been a few years younger than him with how he acts with his instincts giving in and his tail wagging so much. 

“Twenty-four,” Mydei replied, huffing a little over his thoughts as he braced himself to hear that giant prince was still in his teens somehow. 

“Wow.. Only five years younger than my son.. How many suitors do you have lined up? To be honest, I’m not very aware of mating in the Kremnoan culture due to the war..”

.. Five?

Five years younger?

Was Mydei actually hearing that right? That giant dog-like man who was wagging his tail at Mydei all day and asking him such asinine questions.. Was five years older than him?

.. A hag had been asking him those types of questions?

“.. I have no suitors lined up, my parents are quite..” Mydei trailed off with his words, still finding himself struggling to believe that the oversized man was older than him in reality, “Desperate to make sure I find the correct person.”

That really was an understatement considering how much his mother had been worried about finding him a decent mate. An argument that was on-going with his parents if he needed to marry for the sake of their people as a sort of peace offering, or if he should marry for love - and Mydei never knew how to convince his mother he was fine marrying whoever.

His life did not nearly amount to as much worth as their entire kingdom’s lives did. 

“I see.. My son is in quite the predicament as well, I do hope you two will get along,” Kephale sighed out in a rather distracted tone, and considering Phainon’s age.. And probably his size, it wasn’t hard to figure out why Kephale was struggling to find a suitor for his son.

“I will do my best,” Mydei told him in a mute little promise, he would do his best to get along with Phainon - that much was true. But if that man hated him this much already to try to mock and infuriate Mydei in public, he doubted there was much to be done.

If anything, he would just try to swallow down Phainon’s malice towards him bitterly and continue on in his life as a prisoner in their kingdom. 

“We will arrive there shortly, you may rest if you desire,” Kephale told him in a voice that now sounded more like a caring father - a thing that didn’t quite fit in for his talk happening with Mydei right now. Not when he had just felt like he was being heavily interrogated.. 

“I’m fine,” Mydei mumbled, though he did drop his eyes to the floor of the carriage. 

“Very well,” And that was where the conversation fizzled out as Mydei found himself merely sitting there waiting for his new life to begin. Every bump only added to his stress as he stared idly at the way Kephale’s tail seemed scarred, battleworn, and yet thumping on the bench - as if he was anxious for some reason.

.. Mydei found that a bit odd considering this was his proposition in the first place, and yet he couldn’t bite that feeling down. It was as if the king was less than desiring to actually be going through with this. And that.. That was worrying for Mydei who was now his prisoner as he looked even further down to his gauntlets blankly. 

Mydei wasn’t even sure how long he let himself be lost in his own thoughts before that carriage slowed to a halt - an action that made him resist the urge to look out the window. It was nighttime, anyway.

Though, the door opened without much of a wait - eager guards pulling it open and waiting for one of the men to leave the carriage.

“After you,” Kephale spoke in his smooth and commanding tone once more - cold and daunting and clearly, he wanted to keep an eye on Mydei now that his son wasn’t here to protect his back from Mydei attacking him while leaving their vehicle, as if Mydei would even do that.

But it was fine, Mydei could do as that king pleased - he had already sold his mind to that idea for a while, anyway. 

Mydei had to huff a little as he stood unceremoniously and moved out of that carriage - not shocked at all as guards moved to study his every move, he was a prisoner anyway. He almost thought it was odd that Kephale had not taken a bodyguard or two into the ride with Mydei.. Or perhaps it was due to the fact Mydei visibly had no weapons on him.

His gauntlets, sure, but only that prince had seen him actually in combat using them - so he most likely thought Mydei had no self defense, let alone a weapon to best him. 

.. Not that it mattered, Mydei had no plans to attack anyone while he was here.

“Mydeimos! I missed you so dearly, how was the trip?”

Alright, he may have plans to attack one person if this keeps up..

“I suppose I will entrust you to my son, then,” Kephale hummed out as he strode past Mydei - only making him surrender more and more to his fate of that giant oversized dog sniffing at him,  “Phainon, Do see that our guest is well taken care of.”

“Of course, I will handle him with the utmost of care, father,” Phainon hummed out, and Mydei..

Those words were enough to make Mydei freeze a little as he stepped out of the way enough to let Kephale easily pass - his eyes moving to find their way to Phainon who.. Was looking much too excited to be near Mydei - his tail lashing back and forth. Wide blue eyes only looked at Mydei expectantly - seeming much too eager..

“What do you wish to see first, Mydeimos? Perhaps the gardens? The water ways? The bathing hall is quite comfortable for long soaks on your scales..” Phainon was practically purring out his words, moving again to inspect Mydei a little - just enough to irk Mydei as that man slowly walked around him like some kind of predator. Staring downwards at Mydei keenly, all while Mydei felt the burn of guards staring at this display incredulously. 

.. Mydei couldn’t help but feel a little mocked by that, as if this man thought he was here to be pampered or something - but there was no reality in which that was the case. Not when Phainon knew he was a prisoner, just like everyone else knew that. Such a big open secret to where Mydei slowly came to terms with it.

This was a way to embarrass him. To make him say out loud around the guards on that dirt path leading up to the Aedes Elysiae castle that he was here to work. Not to be treated like royalty or anything more, he was just another maid and was to be treated as such by their crown prince like he was now. 

“.. The kitchen,” Mydei growled, accepting his role of being made into a fool by this man - his eyes moving to look at that castle for once now that he had stated such a thing. 

“The.. Kitchen?” Phainon on the other hand echoed out - sounding as if he was in utter disbelief that that was where Mydei wanted to go - but that was fine. Phainon probably hadn’t expected him to concede so quickly, to roll over and expose his weak spots for the prince to jab at.

But they had already lost the war - what more could Phainon do to a man who was his prisoner?

Mydei only dropped his gaze from those heavy marble walls, noting how beautiful they looked all before looking at that prince boredly - not wanting to read into the way he seemed almost depressed and pouty when Mydei’s eyes landed on him, “I am to be working with the maids in my daily life here, to do that, I will need to know where to go.”

“You..” Phainon quietly started, sounding more and more baffled to where Mydei had to blink upwards at that dragon - staring at how his horns almost matched his father’s in the way they curved backwards, only his had no scarring or broken pieces on it, “You’re going to be put to work?”

“Yes,” Mydei answered flatly, blinking at the way the golden light of the castle was now spilling onto them as Kephale went on ahead - not caring for whatever conversation Mydei had with his son it seemed. And it wasn’t as if they were alone, there seemed to be.. Almost more guards here than guards who went with Kephale, really. 

Though, that made sense.. Mydei was the biggest threat here, and he was still outside. 

More than that, Phainon seemed to be actively wilting in front of him - looking more and more like a depressed puppy who was told no to treats as Mydei stared at him, “I thought we could.. Bond more.. Spend more time together daily..”

“I will be working while I live here, not wasting resources,” Mydei told him sternly, moving to cross his hands over his chest as he oddly.. Felt like he was scolding a young child, not talking to another crown prince who.. Also was older and bigger than himself. 

“But..” Phainon looked more and more defeated as his eyes seemed to search Mydei - looking for any signs of weakness but Mydei could offer him nothing as he blinked up at that man, “Okay, okay, come on..”

Mydei watched that dragon turn on his heel at that, still looking as if he was drooping and borderline melting the more steps he took. And Mydei found himself huffing out a little exhale of laughter through his nose over the sight of it, “.. You look more than a little disappointed.”

“No! I’m so excited to be by your side,” Phainon spoke so quickly as he spun around - making Mydei’s feet pause their steps as he blinked at that man and how he appeared to be beaming once more, as if this was somehow the best day of his life all while Mydei had no idea what to make of him. At all.

At the least, Mydei forced himself to nod all while still walking - a bit baffled by how Phainon blatantly seemed to be trying to stay beside him.

.. But this was supposed to be Phainon leading him to his room for his stay. How the hell was he supposed to know where to go?!

“Right.” Mydei grumbled out with his own thoughts as he found himself blinking and taking in the sights in front of him. If anything, Aedes Elysiae’s castle wasn’t as grand as Castrum Kremnos’s. It appeared much more modest in comparison - still fond of the gold it seemed, as any good castle flaunting their style would. 

The trim seemed to be painted in a golden color, making Mydei’s mind if it was real gold, or just a pigment they were deciding to use. Regardless, it didn’t seem to matter as that overgrown dragon leaned a little to seemingly block his view.

All while still wearing much too big of a smile on his lips - one that made Mydei’s eyes idly dip away to take note of the guards following much too closely behind. It made sense they were wary and protective of their prince, but it didn’t quite add up with how Phainon was practically pressing up against Mydei while they walked.. 

Even as they entered that castle, Mydei found himself almost worried that Phainon’s tail was going to wrap around his own with how he seemed to almost be leaning on him and swaying his tail dangerously close to him. Mydei really wasn’t sure if he would be able to keep from elbowing the man if he over stepped in such a way, and that may be why he’s put down today.

“Really, I am! Besides, aren’t you swooning to be at my side, as well? I’ve been called quite the charmer.” Phainon purred out, and Mydei.. Could understand how people would see that - Mydei himself couldn’t see it due to the fact he knew very well this man was bullying him in an odd way.

That Phainon was trying to push his buttons to see him squirm and suffer, and Mydei had to do his best for his kingdom to not give into such a foolish ploy from that prince.

“I’ll do my best to stay strong,” Was what Mydei grumbled out instead, facing his head to the front to instead stare at the blue carpet with golden trim - noting how beautiful it was, and yet his mind still found this to be eerie.

Those great pillars lining the walls were beautiful, but the looks he was getting from the guards were almost too harsh in a sense. His mind was trying to write it off as him being a foreign prince in foreign lands with foreign this and foreign that, but he just.. Couldn’t. 

It looked as if they were ready to gut him alive, as if they were wishing he would die on the spot as he walked with Phainon, and Mydei could see the way their knuckles were turning white from how hard they were gripping their weapons watching him.

.. Kremnoan reputation must be something horrible, huh? 

“Wah.. No need for that! You can fold as quickly as you want for me!” Phainon whined out at his side regardless of Mydei’s own mounting dread in his bones. Not seeming as blatant about his hatred for Mydei and choosing the route to mock him so loudly as they walked, all before Phainon turned to the side roughly. 

Obviously, leading Mydei off somewhere and Mydei had to take a moment to debate following after that man or not - sniffing the air a little at the scent of bread lingering in it before moving after him. This was the way to the kitchen, then? 

“I refuse,” Mydei sighed as he moved to join at Phainon’s side once more - not that he preferred that, he would have rather have followed behind the crown prince instead of beside him.

He was not someone of similar power in this land, and the sneers from people as they walked those grand marble halls lit up with braziers and lanterns were.. Most likely due to himself being too cocky.

Too eager and standing beside their prince when they felt he was lesser, and Mydei found himself slowing his pace with his thoughts, doing his best to fall behind that prince.

.. Only for Phainon to copy, his tail wagging all the same as he seemed so painfully keen on making everyone’s ire toward him as horrible as possible. It was enough to make Mydei sigh a little under his breath, giving in and accepting that this prince wanted him to suffer the entire time he was here. 

“Very well, my mission of making you adore me continues..” Phainon chirped out as he paused his steps, cocking his head to the side with his tail still noisy wagging behind him as he waited for Mydei, “Anyway, look here!”

.. Look here?

Mydei found himself leaning a little into the arched doorway Phainon was standing in front of, his eyes searching for a kitchen but instead he found himself blinking at that sight. The blatant lack of cooking was one thing, but that area was full of life and Mydei found himself sighing over it.

He had been duped. 

“What is this?” Mydei foolishly asked - sliding his eyes to meet Phainon’s who only seemed as eager as possible to answer him. Turning on his heels with a hum as he tried to take Mydei with him into the garden, pausing and waiting for Mydei to catch up and Mydei.. Didn’t want to.

He wanted to go to the kitchens, and yet, he couldn’t say no - there were too many guards, too many eyes, too many whispers already being had. He was just a fool caught in Phainon’s game and all he could do was swallow and continue to let Phainon claim his victories against him, again and again until that prince felt better about their battle on the warfront it seemed. 

“The gardens, it’s rather beautiful in the daytime, perhaps tomorrow you should allow me to take you here instead,” Phainon answered with a hum, appearing happier now that Mydei was languidly moving to join Phainon's side again. 

“Tomorrow I will begin working,” Mydei explained once more, unable to stop himself from biting his tongue as he walked alongside Phainon - eyes moving across the rows of hedges and wildlife. But it all was useless to him. He would never have time to come and relax here, he would become just a maid and servant to this man tomorrow.

And that would be when his true suffering began, correct? This was merely the warm up on Phainon’s behalf, a slight mockery by show of what Mydeimos should and would never fully experience for himself. A grand and lavish royal garden that was enclosed by four walls on each side with so many flowers.

This was not a place for a servant to be at; he was trespassing currently and it made his stomach feel almost.. Unwell. Sickening, really. 

Phainon only hummed at Mydei’s words however, wholly unaware of the inner turmoil Mydei was battling, “Ah.. I’m sure they would let you explore the kingdom with their crown prince!”

“Where is the kitchen?” Mydei didn’t even wait for that man to say anything else - instead he was growling out his words to try to get it through this man’s head of what he wanted. Watching the way blue eyes darted to him innocently, face dropping a little all before he seemed to recover.

A smile on his lips as he moved a hand to rub at the top of his head - laughing a little sheepishly as if this was a mistake on his half and he was simply so very innocent in it all. 

“Right, ah, silly me.. I’m forgetful, come this way,” Phainon purred out in a tone that Mydei was growing to know as ‘I’m lying but you literally are powerless to stop me’ more or less, “This is our collection of roses, I’m quite fond of this area of the gardens.. You can sit at this table anytime you would like with a drink as well, it’s soothing out here.”

Phainon spoke those words as they did in fact walk up to a lone garden table - a pair of chairs at it that looked weathered, yet loved. Well worn to tell you the ages that they had been sitting there, and Phainon only dragged a lazy finger down the glass table’s top idly. 

Mydei almost felt like he was interrupting something as he waited for that man to move on - blinking slowly, “The kitchen, Prince Phainon.”

Phainon’s head sank a little over that, a dramatic little sigh before he clicked his tongue. A quiet noise of annoyance, but Mydei was a little shocked he even got that - this man had seemed so.. Deadset on being as smiley as possible around him that the annoyance or whatever that was felt.. Terrifying in a way.

Only for Phainon to jerk his head up again, smiling as if nothing had even happened just before, “This way, this way..”

Mydei huffed a little as that man looked at him a little expectantly while they walked, as if to silently try to convince Mydei to walk in like with him. Though, it’s not like that mattered as Phainon seemed more than just a bit willing to match his pace no matter what Mydei did - as if he absolutely could not let Mydei worm away from him.

Mydei was doing his best to look at anything but Phainon, at the changing scenery, at the walls, and the building and how much labor went into it.. Only for Phainon to begin to hum softly at his side; a soft tune that sounded much too sweet, too full of emotion for Mydei’s mind to not latch onto it and feel.. Confused. 

Almost as if he was singing a lullaby that felt too heavy for Mydei’s ears - as if he wasn’t supposed to be hearing something so endearing and personal from the man that was so bent on making fun of him.

Yet, Mydei did his best to ignore it, removing those soft hums in favor of noting the layout of the castle for his own sake later.. Not that it mattered, not when Phainon seemed bent on taking him anywhere but where Mydei actually wanted to go. That much was evident as they walked into a new room. One that.. Mydei felt a little bit sorrowful that he was going to have to ignore. 

“This,” Phainon began, spinning a little as they walked into that large room with a happy grin on his lips just like always, “Is the library! We’ve got a lot of literature that you may not have in Kremnos.”

Mydei’s eyes couldn’t help but to roam the shelves that reached up to the ceiling - feeling his hands twitch a little in his own curiosity to see all that was written in this hoard of knowledge. All before he blinked a little at those words, processing them as he slowly brought his gaze back down to stare blankly at Phainon.

“.. What are you implying?” Mydei knew he was bristling now, unable to stop the twitch in his upper lip as he tried to resist snarling angrily at this man. His neck was burning as he knew those guards against the doorway were watching his every move. 

.. All he could do was endure and let this man bully him and his people. 

“What? Nothing! I just meant.. Different kingdoms have different things, you know..?” Phainon much too innocently said - tilting his head a little and looking almost nervous. But Mydei wasn’t buying that at all, shaking his head disapprovingly before tearing his eyes away from those books.

He had no idea what rumors about Kremnoans were spread throughout the years, but he wouldn’t be shocked if they had spread rumors of them being illiterate of all things. It was enough to make Mydei feel his blood boil over how he couldn’t defend his people at all. 

“Hmph,” Mydei huffed, moving to cross his arms - namely to keep himself from clenching his fists and looking much too obviously angry, “Where is the kitchen?”

Phainon once again seemed to deflate a little, his tail pausing its wagging as he stared downward at Mydei - looking as if he was doing his best to read deeper into Mydei’s own mind.

But Mydei only glared right back at him, feeling more tired than anything else now. 

Phainon sighed after a few moments, closing his eyes before opening with new found energy and practically beaming at Mydei again as he quickly began to step away, “Follow me, follow me..”

Though, Phainon paused a little - enough to make sure Mydei was in fact following him before his tail began its odd wagging again. A feature Mydei had.. Never known a dragon to do. Was there something wrong with him? Genuinely? 

“Can I trust you to even actually take me there?” Mydei inquired as he languidly moved with that dragon beside him. Feeling himself give way to a sigh as well as his eyes looked at how mad the guards of this palace were with him no matter where he went.

This was his new life, then? Being an outcast to this degree? Hated no matter where he went and living in a den full of people who would love to see him dead and decaying?

He would endure it, but.. It felt a little disheartening deep down as he faced his head to the front - finally comprehending the days ahead that were going to be terribly lonely, if anything. No friends, only enemies wanting him to fail and suffer, no one to speak to that he could trust.

.. He was a rat caught in a trap waiting to be discarded, that much was certain. 

“Yes! Of course you can trust me, Mydeimos.. I would never hurt you.”

Those words were.. Even more odd to make Mydei bite into his tongue a little as they walked - doing his best to ignore whatever that meant. Mydei hadn’t even.. Brought up being harmed by Phainon, but it was always reassuring to know Phainon himself had been thinking about hurting Mydei.

That was telling more than anything to make Mydei exhale quietly, “.. I wasn’t particularly afraid of being harmed by you, but now I’m wondering if I should be..”

Phainon laughed over that - silky smooth and alluring in a way that made Mydei’s head hurt a little when he tried to think about why he thought that about the dragon who wanted to see him suffer. Such a kind sounding laugh that it was disarming to remember Phainon had been spending his entire day trying to mock Mydei’s existence.. 

“You can trust me, Mydeimos,” Phainon purred out as he gave Mydei a sweet smile while walking, only to have his eyes twinkle a bit as he spoke, “I mean that, okay?”

.. Right.

Mydei had to look away from him over that - scoffing a little at how unbelievable those words were when Phainon had been doing the opposite all night. There was no earthly way that man didn’t want to see Mydei suffer slowly, and that Phainon himself was going to make sure he did. It would be idiotic of Mydei to actually believe a word out of that overgrown lizard’s mouth. 

Mydei almost regretted how much he was zoning out that man suddenly, especially as Phainon opened that door and nodded his head to the side - motioning Mydei in first.

And that was enough to make Mydei sigh a little in relief as he stepped into an area somewhat familiar. Empty of people, but familiar in the sense that it was a kitchen none the less.

“This is the main kitchen area,” Phainon said from behind him - following him into the kitchen and that was perhaps the first time they were alone. Most likely due to dinner already being passed so the staff was gone for the day in the kitchen and what guards would stay in the kitchen all day?

Mydei found himself ignoring whatever derailing thoughts he had to instead look at the rows of shelves idly - well stocked and the entire area seemed pristine. 

“It’s.. Pristine,” Mydei hummed out, unsure of what else to say as he awkwardly stood there with that dragon behind him lurking. Waiting to know what more he had to say and Mydei just.. Felt more vulnerable than he had before.

He didn’t care for the idea of this man learning more about Mydei and abusing it, using it to mock him in some way later on in life. Instead, he only stood there motionlessly, and stiffly looking at the room. 

“.. Do you want to look at it? You.. You said you enjoyed cooking, right? I don’t mind you getting a closer look, and I’m sure no one else would mind it either,” Phainon asked as he remained behind Mydei - his voice dripping in sweetness as if he was doing his best to make Mydei feel comfortable.

Only, Mydei felt his hands twitching over that; “I’ll look when I’m at work tomorrow.”

He didn’t feel like he could actually look at it, not when he was being watched so sternly by the dragon who was obviously wagging his tail behind Mydei as if he were hunting him. So eager with his instincts that he couldn’t even hold it in. 

“Ah but I..” Phainon trailed off - letting out a little pathetic noise of dissatisfaction that made Mydei blink a little over the noises that the dragon was mumbling out behind him, “I won’t be there.. Your eyes seemed to light up in here..”

.. His eyes? Could Phainon even see that from his angle? Mydei didn’t dare look up, that much was for certain as he slowly turned around to see that man assuredly very close to him, and very much so peering down at him. 

“.. What nonsense are you babbling about?” Mydei hissed out before shaking his head a little. This dragon was undoubtedly going to be the biggest headache of his life - he knew that much now. 

“It’s..” Phainon trailed off but Mydei could only find himself turning just a little to look at Phainon - staring at that dragon dully as he looked almost as if he was doing his utmost to figure out what to say.

“I’m ready to retire to my room,” Mydei spoke before letting that man conjure up what more he wanted to say. Whatever it was, Mydei wasn’t sure he wanted to hear it at all. 

Though, Phainon seemed less than convinced as he, regardless, did lead Mydei out of the kitchen - all before pausing his steps, “Really? So quickly? We could perhaps talk a walk around the area some more? The outer walls you haven’t seen, or.. Mm..”

“I’m fine,” Mydei growled out as he matched that man - almost halting in the hallway and feeling so painfully awkward under the stares of anger from everyone around him. He was used to ire and rage when he went places - it didn’t help that he currently stood out like a sore thumb either, instead he felt himself growing a bit tired of it already.

.. Surely they would get tired of it too, depending on how long he stayed here. Hopefully. 

“Hm..” Phainon on the other hand hummed out, moving a little to put a hand on his hip as he seemed to be heavily in thought with himself. A thing that Mydei was already coming to terms with was not a good thing, all before Phainon’s expression brightened rather dramatically, “Come with me!”

The sway of Phainon’s tail as he turned made Mydei sigh a little, moving to follow Phainon - which in turn always made Phainon slow his pace to fall beside Mydei as if they were actually equals as crown princes. As if he wasn’t dragging Mydei around to show the places he would never have free time to visit in a blatant attempt of mockery. 

“.. I have a feeling you are not leading me to my guest quarters for my stay,” Mydei mumbled out, feeling a bit more tired than he ever would have expected as he dropped his eyes to look at the gauntlets still on his hands.

At least if anything went too poorly, he could have his gauntlets waiting for him in his quarters.

.. Whenever the hell he got to his quarters, that is. 

“You would be correct!” Phainon chirped out, sounding so happy as he laughed a little - wholly unaware of the way Mydei felt his face tightening, creasing into a heavy frown at the sound of that laughter. So openly making fun of the way Mydei was completely at his mercy that it was beyond baffling to him. 

“.. And where are you kidnapping me to this time, you scoundrel?" Mydei asked, all while he was still following Phainon, though - that question made Phainon laugh so light-heartedly. As if he was genuinely having the time of his life as he looked at Mydei with a twinkle in his eyes - lips curling into a wide smile so gleefully. 

“If I were a scoundrel, I would show you to my own bedroom! We’re going somewhere better,” Phainon purred out, and Mydei could feel the way he was trying to have a seductive voice - as if he wanted to make sure to disarm Mydei. 

“.. The standards for being ‘better’ sound quite low,” Mydei growled out, not willing to take that bait as he instead followed that man through those halls - still feeling every single guard staring him down as if he were wronging them somehow by being near Phainon.

Were they really that territorial over their prince? The man could fight, Mydei knew that from meeting him on the battlefield - so all of those guards watching him like hounds barely made sense to him.

“You wound me,” Phainon hummed out too happily, almost bumping their shoulders together as he let out a rather dramatic sigh, “This is a place more intimate and beautiful.”

.. Intimate and beautiful? Mydei found his mind a bit intrigued as he continued to walk with that crown prince, doing his best to ignore the way Phainon almost seemed to purposefully try to get closer to him. If walking in a straight line was a royal test, Phainon would absolutely fail from what Mydei was seeing of him. 

Mydei could only focus on those hands that seemed to be forming into fists as they walked before relaxing, only to repeat the action multiple times. 

Anxiety, maybe? Mydei couldn’t wrap his mind around why that would be as he tried to focus his gaze forward, opting to ignore the way Phainon’s hands were rather.. Beautiful in an eerie way. Longer claws than normal and more scales than any other royalty with dragon blood he had ever met, but Mydei had to suppose that was the overflowing amount of dragon blood in the prince. 

.. Maybe his height was due to that as well, Mydei decided before clicking his tongue idly over his thoughts. Still hearing that man’s tail happily wagging as they both walked insanely. 

All until they entered a rather big room, one that made Mydei’s feet pause as soon as they stepped an inch in there - blinking at the sight and sounds now flooding his senses. That, and the amount of people now looking at them.

Nude.

“Phainon,” Mydei growled out over the sounds of water and whispers, growling as Phainon slowly turned to look at Mydei - a smile on his lips just as he always had one there. Looking as innocently as he could while towering a head over Mydei - making him cock his head a little to look down at Mydei. 

“Yes, Mydeimos?”

“.. Are these the public baths?”

“Correct! And the spa and sauna area, anyone is welcome here, but dragonblood are especially pampered!” Phainon chirped out, seeming much too happy with his words - too eager and Mydei honestly couldn’t believe this man. Acting as if Mydei would ever be pampered here when he was a war prisoner. If anything, he fully expected to be sectioned off to bathing alone in a much less.. Lavish looking area. Hidden from others who actually lived here, and judging from the stares they were getting due to him existing.. That was probably a safe bet.

Mydei had to drag his eyes away from those giant basins of steaming water and people gossiping, tearing his eyes away from this place that seemed much too comfortable for the reasons why he was here. 

Only to look at Phainon dully, “.. May I see my room now?”

Phainon rather obviously looked distressed at that, looking to the baths and back to Mydei - as if he was silently trying to plead with Mydei to give the baths a chance. ‘Right now. With him.’

And Mydei only lowered his eyes into a glare - staring ceaselessly at that prince to silently tell him ‘Nikador’s taint, no’.

“Very well,” Phainon seemed to finally understand Mydei - sighing and drooping his head a little like a pouty child as his tail followed suit, “But I promise you’ll be back, especially with me!”

.. Why the hell would they ever bathe together? That made zero sense to Mydei from the perspective of a captive, blinking at that fellow crown prince who was slowly coming back to life as if he hadn’t just been withering a moment ago.

“.. I would prefer to bathe alone.” Mydei grumbled as they began to move out of that large area - no longer willing to hear the whispers of the people there. 

.. He really couldn’t tell anymore if this prince was trying to be respectful, or disrespectful by always walking beside him now. But whatever it was, Mydei wished he would go back to walking behind him like he had when Kephale was with them. 

“You’re saying that now, but I think you and I would have a wonderful talk here!” Phainon laughed out, and something in the way he said it made Mydei almost believe him - almost. If not for the fact this all still felt.. Humiliating and humbling at the same time - as if this man was mocking him in the most cruel of ways. 

“You’re deranged,” Mydei informed Phainon, looking to his side at that man who didn’t seem to care at all - instead still having a smile that shined like the sun on his lips as they walked. 

“So mean! That’s alright, I’ve all the time in the world,” Phainon spoke those words as if he was truly promising Mydei something - and something about it made Mydei shiver just a little in mute disgust.. 

Though, Phainon didn’t seem to notice as he hummed softly,  “Are you sure you wouldn’t like a nicer room? The guest rooms are rather spacious, but I could request something more for you.”

“I don’t need anything lavish.” Mydei countered instantly as they walked - not enjoying where this was going as he stared ahead - doing his best to ignore everything. He would just have to explore in his own free time when this dragon was not glued to his side.

.. He really should have asked for Kephale to show him to his room, but there was no way he could have asked that without appearing suspicious. What a situation he was in. 

Phainon tutted over that, a quiet thing as if he were amused by that, “Ah but.. You deserve it, don’t you? You’re a prince!”

Mydei had to look at Phainon with that being said to him - feeling his mind blank over the way that giant dragon man only gave him such a sweet smile. One that only made Mydei tighten his lips into a frown, “.. I’m a war prisoner more than anything here, you comprehend that, correct?”

Phainon looked at him with a rather blank look - an odd one that seemed devoid of emotion before he slowly looked away. For once, showing some sort of emotion other than joy as he looked more and more irked the longer he thought of Mydei’s words, “.. I don’t like the idea of calling you a prisoner, Mydeimos.”

“You can call it what you like, but denying the truth of it is foolish,” Mydei refuted instantly, snorting derisively as he walked with that dragon - not caring to look at Phainon who seemed to be staring him down now. As if he couldn’t look away. 

“Maybe I should take you elsewhere instead to get your mind off of that..” Phainon spoke as if he were deep in thought - and that was enough to make Mydei finally sigh out over.

It just wanted to go into his room and be alone, just for a while. For whatever privacy he was allowed in this place, if he was even allowed that; he wouldn’t be shocked to see someone else sharing his room either. 

“.. You may continue to mock me as you wish, but your malice will get you nowhere,” Mydei muttered as they walked, only, Phainon abruptly stopped at that. As if Mydei had pressed some sort of button to hit his brakes on the entire conversation - slowly dragging his eyes to look at that prince who was now a few feet away.

.. Looking like a wet dog as well, teary-eyed and looking almost like a neglected twenty-nine year old hamster Mydei would see in passing on the roads of Kremnos. And he never liked wondering why the hamsters were on the streets of Kremnos in the first place..

“Mock you? Malice?” Phainon echoed out all before tilting his head to the side - sending how white locks of hair spilling over his face in a new position, and Mydei only had to blink over that. 

“What else am I to take a man for that will not listen to my wishes?” 

Mydei was genuinely asking, because he had no idea what to make of this prince that seemed bent on wasting his time and making Mydei seem like a fool - dragging him around because he knew that Mydei had no other option.

Yet, those words only worked to make Phainon look even more pathetic - pouting even harder it seemed as his mood continued to drop rapidly, as if this was absolutely the worst news he had ever been told. 

And Mydei only stood there waiting to hear what that prince had to say; whatever excuse it was, Mydei wasn’t sure he had enough patience left for these games to be able to buy into it. 

“Mydeimos, I wasn’t.. Right, right! Okay! Let’s get you to your guest quarters, okay? That’s what you wanted?” Phainon asked, all while seeming to try to recover his smile that Mydei had come to know.

A wobbly thing now, as if he was finally wavering just the tiniest of bits upon learning how Mydei was currently feeling about it all. It was enough to make Mydei resist the urge to snort again, not wanting more ire than he already had earned for one day. 

“Yes,” Mydei answered flatly, and Phainon at that was nodding extensively - almost like he was in a slight panic now as he tried to ‘repair’ this. Though, Mydei still only had to assume it was some sort of act for Phainon’s own amusement. Especially with how guards were still following them around - looking so disapproving of Mydei’s entire existence.

“This way, this way..” Phainon seemed to whimper out as he nodded over that - quickly picking up the pace once more (while predictably staying at Mydei’s side). 

And the walk was more silent than it had ever been - no longer was that tail of Phainon’s swishing back and forth. Now it was dully dragging behind him like any other normal dragon’s would. It wasn’t just that - Phainon looked more nervous now than he had been, gaze solemn and appearing like he was distracting heavily. 

.. Mydei really couldn’t understand this prince. Was this not truly just some sort of game to him?

Only, Phainon led him down a long stretching corridor - just to stop at the very first painted-white wooden door. Looking more than a little nervous as he looked between it and Mydei. 

“This is your room I believe,” Phainon explained in a tone that sounded more sad than anything - like he was still pouting over Mydei snapping at him.

And that was a good display, really, for his goals of making Mydei appear worse to the guards who had been following them both all day. Practically scowling at Mydei as he pushed it out of his mind continuously. 

“Are you sure you don’t.. Want something? Some food sent to you? Treats to try and see your favorite in my kingdom? More blankets and pillows? I don’t mind personally getting anything you want,” Phainon said as he looked more and more nervous - and it really didn’t fit a man who was wearing something so elegant, dipped in blue and white with gold trimming. A dazzling outfit, all while looking sopping wet and depressed over Mydei being blunt with him. 

“.. There’s no need to trouble yourself.” Mydei forced himself to say, trying his best to stay level as he moved towards that door to slowly open it - turning a little as Phainon only continued to try to talk to him. 

“You could never trouble me! I can do it easily, have some faith in me. I would actually be pleased to get you something!” Phainon chirped out, but Mydei could only slide his eyes to the guards waiting behind Phainon - staring Mydei down and making sure he didn’t make any sudden moves. 

“I’m going to bed,” Mydei flatly told him, devoid of emotions and doing his best to give nothing away. 

Being harassed was going to be his daily life; he needed to get used to this much, this would be nothing compared to the labor they would force him through soon enough assuredly.

But Phainon only continued to speak at that, looking more and more antsy as Mydei entered that bedroom - once more turning to stare at Phainon dully, “Ah, more pillows then? Some softer blankets for the night?”

“Good night, Prince Phainon,” Mydei sighed out as he instead closed that door - only hearing an odd sad trilling noise from that dragon on the other side. It sounded as if Mydei had just yanked his  tail or eaten his favorite snack right in front of him. Whatever the case, Mydei was not buying the act at all. 

“.. Good night, Mydeimos!”

Mydei didn’t waste a single moment before moving to lock that door - only to find his hand swerving over how there.. There was no lock.

Right.
