He was a prisoner here, no matter what that prince was saying, every act had ulterior motives behind him - to work his walls down and try to persuade him and his father. To turn him into a tool for their kingdom to abuse easily, and that prince’s thinly veiled malice would never work on him. 

The worst of it was how that prince was still outside his door; still waiting there and listening to Mydei with the door between them. It was painfully obvious, considering how giant that dragon was.. He wasn’t exactly the most quiet of men when he walked or weirdly wagged his tail happily for whatever reason. 

Mydei found himself moving away from that door regardless, sighing a little as he moved to fully inspect this room. 

Small and quaint, really. Empty, mostly, but there was a stack of clothes already laid out for him on a spare chair - a chair that made him huff a little as he moved the clothes off of it and instead propped the chair under the door handle to jam it closed for a little bit of peace of mind. Just the tiniest of bits before he paused to listen, to try to tell if that man was still lurking outside - all before returning to that bed. 

This kingdom certainly liked white and gold, even the intricate bedframe was painted with those colors, all for the bed covers on that small bed to be a vibrant blue. Just a solid blue cover with nothing to speak about and one pillow, a bed made for one in a rather small room.. If anything, Mydei had to question if this really was a ‘guest’ quarters at all.

Regardless, it wasn’t as if he could speak poorly on it - he was merely this kingdom’s prisoner, nothing more, and he certainly hadn’t been expected to be treated like royalty or anything. He knew fully well he was here to work and labor, to slave away waiting for the days to pass and turn to months until he was freed.

His existence was now nothing more than a toy to play with for the kingdom of Aedes Elysiae, and all he could do was act as if he wasn’t aware and continue living here.

.. And for the betterment of all Kremnoans, he was fine to be treated as if he were a failure by that overgrown prince.

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.html:
“Mydeimos!” Phainon moved to his feet in a mad scramble, nearly knocking himself over on his own tail as he moved with the opening of that door he had been keenly standing outside of, “How are you today? Ah, you’re stunning in that..”

Phainon couldn’t help those last few words from falling so freely from his lips - feeling his tail wag just a tiny bit as he glanced up and down Mydeimos in a studying fashion now.

It was Aedes Elysiae workers attire, that much was obvious - but the colors of blue and white looked rather dashing on Mydeimos, a mix of colors that made Phainon’s heart sing as his eyes looked at how tight that shirt seemed to be on him. Straining around his biceps, all while the lace trim was embedded with sparks of gold. Just enough to say this person worked at the castle, but against Mydeimos’s arms Phainon felt stunned.

.. Though, he did desperately wish to change his attire, to put him in the finest silk and scurry him away like all dragons preferred to do with their treasures. He was worth more than the scratchy linen he was now wearing, and Phainon had to resist the urge to whimper over it. At least Mydeimos didn’t seem to mind it - instead his golden eyes creased and looked to the side at the wall. 

“.. How long were you waiting outside my door?” Mydeimos inquired in a tired sounding tone, an edge of sleep still slurring into his words and Phainon was pretty sure his heart skipped a beat over it. 

Especially as Mydeimos yawned - letting his teeth be on full display as he moved to stretch along with it. Sharp teeth, but not nearly as sharp as Phainon’s - most likely not adapted for Phainon’s own diet, but that was fine! Mydeimos didn’t need to eat his diet! He was perfect the way he already was with blunt teeth and tiredness making him rub at his eyes idly. 

Phainon had to laugh at that, shaking his head a little as he fully knew why Mydeimos was getting at; “That’s not important!” 

“You brought a chair to wait outside.. I think it’s a little important,” Mydeimos pointed out with a tired lilt hanging onto his words. And Phainon had to resist the urge to beg that dragon to go back to sleep - sniffing the air a little over how Mydeimos hadn’t really slept in much.

.. If it were up to Phainon, Phainon would stay in bed until the late afternoon, not getting up at this time of day already.

Phainon felt himself fighting back a laugh over Mydeimos’s growls anyway, he didn’t know how to tell Mydeimos that he hadn’t even brought that chair here. He was perfectly content to sleep on the ground with his tail pressed against the wall, and yet a guard had worriedly brought him one and some pillows.

He appreciated the kindness! But he also hadn’t minded sitting there and staying guard on the floor for Mydeimos, either. As long as Mydeimos was safe in this kingdom he was wary of, Phainon felt more at peace in his own mind..

“Nonsense! Are you ready to begin your day?” Phainon chirped out as he moved to straighten out his own clothing - making sure his tassels hanging off his golden shoulder pads were still looking impressive enough to catch Mydeimos’s eyes. 

He hadn’t bathed nearly long enough last night and the staff helping him seemed a little depressed by it, upset over the way he was aching to crawl away from them and back to Mydeimos’s door as soon as possible. Rambling something to him about ‘having wet hair isn’t good for him’ and whatnot, but Phainon didn’t mind letting it air dry! 

Instead, now he kept moving to try to keep his fluff under control - trying to comb through it idly with one hand as his eyes only took in that dazzling prince more and more. The way he still had that braid at the side of his head - perfectly crafted to where Phainon had to wonder how nimble and deft Mydeimos’s fingers were to be able to tie a braid with such precision. Not a hair out of place..

Though, Mydeimos himself only moved his gaze a little to blink out the window on the side of the arching guest room corridor; “.. Why did no one wake me?”

.. Well.

Quite honestly, Phainon could answer that - people had come to wake Mydeimos and train him for his day, yet they all seemed to swerve and leave when Phainon told him he would handle Mydeimos for today. That he would take him around and make sure he got to where he needed to go - whenever Mydeimos wanted to go there, of course!

“Wake you? For what?” Phainon innocently asked, giving up on his own hair to instead remain admiring Mydeimos’s own hair that seemed to be ruffled in such a perfect way. Fluffed up so cutely, all while looking as if he meant for that to be happening, styled and feathered for 

Mydeimos only languidly blinked at him over that, “.. Work?”

“Hmm,” Phainon hummed before moving his index finger to tap at the bottom of his lip - absentmindedly acting as if he had no clue why no one would want to come wake this dragon he had been sitting on guard for all night, “Curious.. I’m not sure! Maybe they want our guest to be well rested!”

“I..” Mydeimos trailed off as Phainon moved his own hands to be politely cupped together in front of him, gleefully beaming at Mydeimos still so dreadfully innocently, “Did you do something?”

.. Do something? Well of course not, all Phainon had done was loyally sit outside of Mydeimos’s door to make sure no one bothered him all night long; Phainon didn’t consider that as ‘doing’ much of anything except for being a good.. Suitor. 

“Me? No.. Why would I do something? Anyway, you wanted to work in the kitchen, right?” Phainon purred out as he immediately turned, doing his best not to messily knock over his chair with his tail this time as he kept his smile on his lips towards Mydeimos - doing his best to seem friendly towards that prince who.. Had told him his real feelings last night.

That Phainon had been making a mockery of him and his desires by accident, refusing to listen to him and accidentally making Mydeimos assume the worst about him..

.. Thinking on it again made him feel nauseous - his mind racing to try to think of ways to make it up to Mydeimos, all while doing his best to seem normal right now. To seem like he wasn’t stressed out of his mind with his heart aching over Mydeimos already seeming standoffish. As if Phainon last night had been too much, so much that Mydeimos didn’t want to put up with him anymore.. 

Surely not, surely Phainon could still fix this.. Right? Surely.. Surely…

“That.. Was never discussed, I was merely informed I will be apart of the staff and working under you,” Mydeimos explained, looking as if he was a bit baffled by this line of questioning - obviously not expecting to be asked a question like that, nor to be given a choice in where he should work.

But Phainon’s mind was still struggling over the phrasing being used there - trying his best to swallow down his excitement over how Mydeimos.. Had not meant ‘under you’ like that. 

“Under me..? Ah, but you’re a crown prince like me, Mydeimos! You’re not.. Under me, not yet at least,” Phainon informed him as Mydeimos immediately moved to come with him - joining Phainon side by side and that made Phainon fight the urge to purr a little. 

To be so happy and swoon over how sweet Mydeimos was.. He was angry at Phainon, assuming he meant the worst last night - yet he was still able to give Phainon a second chance to redeem himself. A chance Phainon would not squander this time around. 

But Mydeimos only cocked his head to the side a little as they walked - making Phainon struggle not to trip over his feet with how cute Mydeimos looked when his head was innocently showing his confusion and blinking upwards at Phainon; “What?”

“I’ll take you to the kitchen now, okay? No wrong directions or anything! You just probably don’t remember, right? Last night was probably a lot for you!” Phainon happily chirped, only beaming even more to that man who was seemingly unimpressed by it. Straightening his head out before pursing his lips a little - just the tiniest of bits as if he was trying to keep himself from being snarky towards Phainon. 

“.. Right,” Mydeimos huffed out instead, though it was quieter than normal - making it seem like he was doing his best not to snarl at Phainon, but that.. Was cute, in a way. A thing that made Phainon’s heart beat so loudly in his ears like the drums of war had so many times in his life - deafening him as his desire to see Mydeimos be defiant and aggressive was so full of yearning in Phainon’s bones.

He liked it.

He liked the way Mydeimos seemed less than thrilled, he liked the way he wasn’t flopping over and surrendering to Phainon like anyone else would in Aedes Elysiae - Phainon liked that a lot. 

“Not to worry, you’ll have fun here,” Phainon cooed out, unable to help himself from dropping his voice a little - praying that it was soothing to the dragon who seemed a little perturbed currently, “I’ll see to it personally!”

“Okay,” Mydeimos flatly replied - not seeming convinced at all by Phainon’s words, but he was promising this. 

Phainon himself would make sure of it, if anything. 

“Don’t sound so depressed! I mean it! You’ll have a good time here and.. Make a lot of memories!” Phainon told him, already moving to bump his arm into Mydeimos’s shoulder with a laugh fluttering out of him over the way Mydeimos easily side-stepped his gentle touch.

Clearly, not keen on being touched by Phainon - but something about it only made Phainon’s instincts purr amusedly. As if he was pleased by the idea of Mydeimos making him chase that man to show him his affections; to hunt and fight for Mydeimos’s eyes to remain on him.. A fun game that Phainon was more than a little eager to play with Mydeimos. Finding his own tail swishing at the thought of it already.

“Right,” Mydeimos still didn’t sound any different - if anything, he had a slight edge to his words. Blatantly annoyed, but acting like he wasn’t as they continued on their walk together. 

“I’ll help you, if you want, I know all the fun places in this kingdom, after all.” Phainon told him without missing a beat - idly feeling himself anxiously balling his hands into fists at his side. 

He had always done that, some sort of nervous habit when his guards were watching him much too closely - too judgemental of anyone near him. Too choking in their grip as they wanted to protect him, but Phainon didn’t need protection from this guest. Even if Mydeimos came at him snarling and wielding his gauntlets for a fight - Phainon would be giddy to welcome him with open arms. 

“I am not allowed outside the castle,” Mydeimos rigidly told him as they walked those halls together - making Phainon’s feet pause completely, halting his steps to look at Mydeimos who.. Only stopped with him - looking wholly unimpressed all the while. 

“Huh?” Phainon asked, very intelligently, mind you. 

That simple word was enough to make Mydeimos completely turn and face him - blinking dully upwards at Phainon as if this entire conversation was tiring. All before he moved to cross his hands over his chest - for once making Phainon blink over the sight of those red tipped claws, sharp, but not nearly as deadly as Phainon’s. 

Those were beautiful, really, Phainon could barely understand why Mydeimos ever hid them - feeling his mind in a slight daze as he forced himself to look away from them. Tearing his eyes upwards and staring at Mydeimos in the eyes while feeling himself sweat under that heavy golden gaze. 

“Prince Phainon, respectfully, I am your prisoner and nothing else. I am not allowed outside of the castle walls by order of King Kephale,” Mydeimos explained, easily making Phainon’s attention span snap back to reality as he tried to puzzle together why that would be said to Mydeimos.

“.. My father said that?”

“Yes,” Mydeimos once more boredly confirmed that - as if he couldn’t even believe Phainon was confused by it, and Phainon.. Almost felt like he should wilt a little, feel depressed over it, but he couldn’t. 

“All the more reason you should come outside with me! He wouldn’t be angry if I was there with you!” Phainon chirped out instead, always eager for a chance to spend more time with that man.

Well, ‘always’ only really counted for the week that he had actually known Mydeimos.. But it had been a marvelous week of yearning, mark his words!

Mydeimos however clicked his tongue in dissatisfaction, moving his eyes to look at the wall and Phainon.. Still found himself giddy to see even those sorts of emotions from Mydeimos.

All for Mydeimos to sigh, “.. I can see the outside wheat fields perfectly fine from the corridor windows.”

Something about that was.. More than a little depressing to be sure, and were words that made Phainon wiggle a little under Mydeimos’s studying gaze awkwardly.  “.. Mydeimos, staying cooped up inside the entire time you’re here sounds dreary. I would love to show you around my kingdom personally..”

“I would prefer to be shown to the kitchen,” Mydeimos grumbled out, and Phainon wasn’t sure whether to laugh or cry over that. All before turning on his heels with a nod to Mydeimos - choking down whatever emotions he felt before leading Mydeimos off again. 

He couldn’t have a repeat of last night, after all, instead feeling a whine die in his throat as he watched that fellow prince return to being in line with Phainon. Taking up his spot rightfully with Phainon and making Phainon feel his own tail happily begin to sway at how good it felt to have someone walk beside him. Not behind him and worshipping his every movement, but someone who seemed like if he was behind Phainon - he would be glaring harshly at him. 

“Right.. I’m going, I’m going..” Phainon sighed out as they walked, less thrilled to get to their destination because Mydeimos would assuredly busy himself to avoid talking to Phainon.

A thought that made Phainon’s instincts curl in his mind, delighting over the thrill of the chase, all while being a little dejected that the dragon blooded man he wanted for a man was so hissy at him.. 

Though, there was another thing on Phainon’s mind as he moved his gaze to look at that fiery man more - staring at those horns that were golden at the base only to bleed into a burnt red. Matching his tail and the scales on it, but there was something missing from him today. Gone was the pretty golden jewelry that had been wrapped around his tail - delicately staying in place and adding to the overall beauty of Mydeimos easily..

“Where is your jewelry?” Phainon asked curiously, blinking over how that prince seemed to have not wanted to wear it today - watching the way Mydeimos’s eyebrow raised inquisitively before his gaze moved to meet Phainon’s while they walked. 

“It is not appropriate for me to wear such a thing anymore,” Mydeimos flatly replied, appearing less than amused over being asked this - and Phainon felt himself gnawing at his own tongue languidly. Doing his best not to actually saw off his forked tongue, all while watching the way Mydeimos was blatantly unhappy with saying those words.

.. He must really like jewelry, was that it?

Phainon found himself humming a little as they walked, moving his energy to try to conjure up reasons for Mydeimos to instead just walk the kingdom with him instead of work. Yet, that man was deadset on this and would be angry if Phainon didn’t take him where he desired. There truly was no winning in this situation.

“You can wear your jewelry if you would like,” Phainon said after a moment of just the clacking of his heeled boots on the floor - not at all rivaled by Mydeimos’s silent flat ones to his side. “You look dashing in it.”

Mydeimos only quietly huffed an exhale through his nose - not an annoyed thing, but something else. A layer of amusement clouding it as he sighed with those words, “Wearing golden jewels and chains while working? I will pass on making myself into more of a hindrance than needed.”

Hindrance.. That was an interesting word that made Phainon click his tongue a little - his eyes moving to look over his shoulder idly at the guards who were still following behind them both. Stalking his every move and making sure that foreign prince did nothing to harm him. 

.. Annoying, it was so painfully annoying how those guards were more of a hindrance than Mydeimos could ever be in his life, yet he had to endure it all. 

Their conversation only lulled as Phainon looked back to the front - dully moving towards the kitchen with every step and feeling his tail starting to drag on the floor behind him. He couldn’t help it, once Mydeimos was there, he would have to enjoy his company from afar.. Watch him from the doorway or something, though, Phainon doubted the staff would allow him to stand there for long.

.. They would assuredly give him a chair to sit down on instead.

That was his last thought as he moved towards that door he had brought Mydeimos to last night - one that now was singing with the voices of people working and talking amongst themselves. The heavy aroma of bread, eggs, and whatever else they seemed to be cooking assaulted Phainon’s senses immediately. 

Phainon huffed a little as he opened that door with the palm of his hand - pressing it easily to blink at the view of so many people turning to look at their prince with a new air of silence overwhelming him. All before immediately bowing to him politely, sweetly really - but Phainon had other plans as he looked at the horde of workers trying to ready breakfast. 

“Hello there! How are you all today?” Phainon chirped out as he moved into the kitchen, unable to help himself but immediately moved to position himself behind Mydeimos. Not wasting a single precious second before finding his way to shadow over that dragon - feeling himself keen just a tiny bit over how Mydeimos didn’t even follow him with his eyes.

As if he wasn’t in danger around Phainon at all, as if he already didn’t need to have his guard up when the larger, more bloodthirsty dragon was around him. Though.. It wasn’t as if Mydeimos knew of that bloodthirst, regardless. That probably added to Phainon’s innocence, in a way.. 

“We are good, Lord Phainon,” They all singed out instantly, without missing a beat, almost in an eerie way - but Phainon didn’t mind that, instead lowering his head just a little, enough to sniff at Mydeimos’s hair and pray he didn’t notice.

Strawberry..? That was unmistakably strawberries, but Phainon’s mind couldn’t process why that man smelled so sweet, instead blinking a little as he raised his eyes. Doing his best to hold himself back from glaring at those people. 

“Good, good.. This is Mydeimos.. He’ll be.. Working here for a bit, so please treat him well for me!” Phainon purred out, unable to stop the wag in his tail as he happily introduced Mydeimos before circling him again - an odd habit Phainon could help but do as he tried to look the dragon up and down.

Fondly looking at those tattoos under his eye just above a sparse few scales there so sweetly - Phainon found himself endlessly charmed by the closer looks he got at Mydeimos. Even if those fierce shimmering golden eyes were staring at him as if they were wondering how to catch him on fire if given a chance to. 

“Ah, Mydeimos,” Phainon couldn’t help but to drop his voice seductively now, hoping Mydeimos could tell that voice was reserved for him - and only him, “You’ll tell me if you have any problems, right? I’ll fix it for you.”

Those words only worked to make Mydeimos give him such an odd look - one that easily read ‘What in Nikador’s taint are you on about?’ while not saying that vocally at all. 

“.. I’ll be fine,” Were the words Mydeimos grumbled out regardless, already moving to go past Phainon instead, clearly over their conversation with the sets of eyes watching them both. 

“Nn.. Okay! But I would still love to hear about your day later if you get a chance!” Phainon purred out all before watching Mydeimos move away from him. An action that made Phainon’s hands twitch at his side - aching to reach out and pull that man close and growl towards the others who he was nearing instead.

.. A desire he couldn’t act out on, instead standing there with his hands anxiously forming into fists again and again as he watched some of the staff begin speaking to Mydeimos quietly. Too quietly.

Phainon wanted to listen and be able to know what Mydeimos was saying to them, he wanted to know so badly - and instead he could only stand off to the side and watch. Phainon didn’t even know how long he was standing there before the predicted happened - making him tilt his gaze a little to blink away from Mydeimos being shown around the pantries.

Instead, Phainon had to move his attention to the new person who was very obviously nervous as they approached - an older man it seemed, one that refused to look Phainon in the eyes as he spoke as well. 

“My.. Lord? Do you desire something?”

Did he desire something? That question was humorous, really, making him drag his eyes back up to the fat tail that Mydeimos had - watching the subtle sway of it as he stood there looking pensive. Thinking and memorizing whatever he was being told as he earnestly gave someone his attention politely.

.. It was enough to make Phainon feel jealous of that woman he was talking to - staring at her for a moment before looking back to the man speaking to him languidly. 

“Honestly? Yes, but it’s nothing you could give me,” Phainon mused a little boredly - sighing over his own thoughts as his jealously threatened to swallow him whole, “I’m just here to.. Watch what I want for today.”

That only served to make the staff more visibly nervous, choking out a shallow little laugh as he nodded his head - as if he understood at all what Phainon was saying.

Though it didn’t matter, Phainon’s attention was distracted by that tail of Mydeimos’s. Phainon’s own tail was on the thinner side, longer than Mydeimos's, whose own tail was plump. Fat at the base and barely tapering out in such a cute fashion that Phainon found himself staring at the soft looking golden underbelly over it - curious of what that part of Mydeimos felt like.. 

And yet that staff member only spoke again to jar Phainon’s thoughts back to him, “R..Right, are you sure we cannot make you something? Breakfast was already served to you, correct? Are you still peckish?”

“I’m fine,” Phainon boredly replied - watching the way that only seemed to make that servant even more terrified. His emotions flickering through every range possible all before aggressively nodding his head as if he was coming to terms with something. 

“I.. I’ll get you a chair then! Please excuse me!”

Phainon had to huff a little over that, shaking his head as that man quickly bowed at a speed that made Phainon a little worried he would snap his own neck or get whiplash due to it. Not that he could have helped anyway - they never would have allowed him to as they instead ran off to acquire a chair for him. Easily drawing out a sigh from Phainon as he moved to place a hand on his hip and watch Mydeimos.

.. Oddly, he seemed rather.. Content kneading dough - looking as if he even had a small smile on his face when Phainon was lucky enough to be able to glance it through Mydeimos’s hair rarely. 

“Your chair, your highness..” 

Phainon had to jerk his head to the side - watching as that man hurriedly moved to put a rather comfortable wooden chair down for him. The plush of the seating and head rest being such a deep blue that Phainon found himself almost a bit sad - he was growing rather fond of the color red lately.. 

“Thank you,” Phainon hummed out regardless, leisurely moving to sit down on that chair since well.. He didn’t want to ignore the sweet gesture, huffing a little now that he was giving his legs a rest. Not that he needed one, but he knew he would be here for hours, anyway. 

“A-Anytime, is there.. Anything else you desire?”

Phainon had to slowly drag his eyes up to that staff member - blinking at the way his attire matched Mydeimos’s, yet that man was refusing to look at Phainon now. Refusing to look at his prince who was now below him, refusing to ever ‘look down’ upon Phainon..

“Time alone with my thoughts,” Phainon murmured, unable to stop the way he was thinking of how Mydeimos would have looked at him regardless of that - seeming like the type of man to keep eye contact in conversations politely. 

“Very well! Please excuse me!”

Phainon scoffed a little over that - moving to lean more into the plush of the chair against the wall idly as he crossed his arms over his chest. Feeling his own tail lash back and forth as he merely sat there and watched.

He watched the way Mydeimos seemed to be more vibrant here, almost like the way he came to life on the battlefield and grinned in combat - eyes twinkling as he earnestly worked on his cooking alongside the other chefs. All while seeming like he was genuinely happy here. 

It was enchanting in a way, so enchanting that Phainon found himself baffled as Mydeimos came near him after what felt like mere moments - yet a piece of him knew it had been hours of staring and admiring that beautiful dragon. Watching his body hypnotically move all while he seemed to be enjoying himself; the perfect kind of mate who seemed ideal to bear children for Phainon.

.. And now he was walking towards Phainon, all to turn and open that door - leaving.

Leaving Phainon without a word and making Phainon choke a little over how swiftly he had to scramble to his feet in a mad dash after his beloved. Not wanting Mydeimos to get away that easily as a whine left his lips, not even caring about the clattering of the chair behind him as he practically bolted out of it and slapped it to the ground with his tail.

The stares didn’t matter either from the rest of the staff - all he needed to do now was speak to Mydeimos again. 

“Mydeimos,” Phainon purred out already, hurrying his steps after that dragon - his eyes watching that fiery tail swing a little as Mydeimos quickly walked. Too quickly, almost as if he were trying to avoid being spoken to, “Where are you hurrying off to?”

“.. My bedroom,” Mydeimos answered without looking pleased at all as Phainon joined at his side - making Phainon’s tail sway immediately over how sweet Mydeimos truly was.. 

“Ah, for what? It’s rather early in the day to retire..” Phainon innocently asked - feeling so very thankful that Mydeimos was allowing him to walk with him. Enjoying the time they had together as he blinked and looked to the right as  they walked those corridors - a piece of him hoping to take Mydeimos into that garden and have a lovely meal together alone.. 

He would get whatever food Mydeimos wanted, if it meant he was able to sit across from him and see how that man ate. Would he be messy eating? Or would he be prim and polite, proper and upstanding like normal royalty? 

.. Even those questions were interesting to Phainon as he continued to hum a little - flitting his eyes over the garden’s greenery idly with his thoughts. 

Only, Mydeimos made an odd little snorting noise at his side, “.. To retire.”

Right.. That was enough to make Phainon drag his eyes away from that garden and the arching open windows that lined the marble walls to allow the scenery in. Sighing a little as he struggled to understand why Mydeimos would be retiring so soon, giving that dragon all of his attention with a smile firmly on his lips. 

“Ah.. Did.. You have a good day? Were there any issues? I want to hear about it.” Phainon informed him in a silky smooth purr, earnestly desiring to hear out anything Mydeimos wanted to tell him.

Just for Mydeimos to give him such an egregious look - full of disbelief and almost a level of mockery as his eyes seemed to twitch a little; “Weren’t you watching all day long?”

Those words were enough to make Phainon blush, to feel the cheeks on his face burning as he realized Mydeimos was so very aware that he had been there.. That Mydeimos had taken note of him existing nearby him and chose to ignore him..

.. The idea of being ignored almost hurt, but it was thrilling in its own way as well, making Phainon chuckle a bit lowly, just the tiniest bit to stop himself from sounding manic with how excited he felt over being ignored. He shouldn’t, and yet he yearned for more of those raw emotions so desperately that it made his soul ache. 

“That’s.. Well, just because I was watching doesn’t mean I could hear it!” Phainon countered with a wave of his hand, watching the way Mydeimos was keenly staring him down - watching his every single move and studying him. As if making sure Phainon was well behaved, or perhaps it was something more. 

“Do you not have better things to do with your time?” Mydeimos growled out, and that still only worked to make Phainon’s heart swell as he came to the realization he really liked this.

Whatever this attitude of Mydeimos’s was, whatever the snarkiness was, he really was enjoying it playing out. He wanted more and more of it, just to sate his desire one day of making that dragon blooded prince hush up and become tame beneath him..

“Better than you? No,” Phainon smoothly replied with his own thoughts, coming to terms that he would have to wait to be able to tame that fiery man beside him, “Though.. Tomorrow I do have some.. Meetings I have to attend, will you be okay alone?”

He hated saying that.

He hated knowing that he would have to not see Mydeimos much tomorrow, that he would have to be enduring his day with the knowledge that Mydeimos was in his home without him. That Mydeimos would be meeting new people all while not under the eyes of Phainon.. The thought drove him to near insanity as he silently clicked his tongue over his thoughts.

Head facing the front as he walked with Mydeimos, not daring to look at that dragon for fear of making Mydeimos think his heavy frown was towards him.. 

“I can complete my duties of work, sleep, eat, and repeat perfectly fine,” Mydeimos rivaled that warning easily, making Phainon sigh a little.

Perhaps he should be less worried about Mydeimos replacing him, and more worried about the fact Mydeimos seemed to want to hide away until his stay at Aedes Elysiae ended eventually.

.. Ended.

Right, this would end one day, wouldn’t it? Phainon almost felt his feet pause as he slowly realized that this crown prince would be sent home, that Mydeimos was here on a timer.

.. Phainon needed to make Mydeimos his before that timer ran out. 

“That sounds..” Phainon hummed out over his thoughts, looking up at the roofing a bit dully as he thought of Mydeimos's words and his own newfound terror over that prince slipping away from him, “Less than ideal..”

“It suits me perfectly,” Mydeimos countered without missing a beat, making Phainon ditch his own thoughts with a quiet huff of laughter.

To chase down the man who was snarling at him, growling and bristling when he was near Phainon.. To pin him down after the tides of war had made Mydeimos easily steal Phainon’s heart away and keep it from himself.. Having a countdown on how fast Phainon had to move to make sure Mydeimos fell in love with him just as deeply as Phainon already adored him did sound like it suited Mydeimos. 

A whirlwind of love and affections that Phainon himself didn’t comprehend, but he certainly had no desire to let go of him either. Instead sinking his fangs and claws in as deep as he could as if Mydeimos was prey to keep a grip on him if he had to. 

“So.. What will you be doing in your quarters.. For hours?” Phainon asked as he dragged his eyes back down, slowly moving them to look at Mydeimos innocently. Taking in the sight of the way that prince didn’t seem to notice how much Phainon’s tail was wagging in his own thoughts of hunting Mydeimos down, or well.. Perhaps he was simply too polite to actually say anything about it.

Whatever it was, Phainon appreciated it from his perfect and ideal mate!

Mydeimos seemed to not care about it, instead pressing out a quiet sigh at the side of Phainon, “.. Does it matter? I’m fine with being alone everyday.”

Alone everyday was an issue, of course it was, because Phainon would love to be with Mydeimos! There was no reason he had to be alone, not when Phainon was more than a little willing to be trapped in that room with him for hours - he wouldn’t even mind being silent if that's what Mydeimos wanted! He just.. Would be happy to be around Mydeimos, anyway..

“Everyday? You’re going to hide in your room everyday instead of.. Anything else?” Phainon asked as they continued walking - feeling less and less desiring to actually reach their destination as the time passed. Every second was an inch closer to Mydeimos escaping him for another day - making his hunt last longer and for once, Phainon wasn’t feeling too patient with his prey. 

.. Even if he would wait for eternity, if that man demanded it. 

“Yes,” Mydeimos flatly replied, not explaining an inch further.

But that could never satiate Phainon’s desire for knowledge; “You don’t uh.. Want to take a nice bath to relax, at least? I could go with you? We could get a private room..?”

“I bathe in my own bedroom,” Mydeimos once again roughly replied, not giving Phainon anything to work with really, but Phainon found himself creasing his lips into a line at that. Eyes dropping to look at the tiles on the floor that were so beautifully intricate; and a perfect distraction as he struggled to figure out how to word how deeply he wanted to befriend that dragon beside him. 

“.. Ah,” Phainon said after a few moments, blinking up again and to Mydeimos at his side who seemed more keen on ignoring his gaze, “Isn’t that.. There’s no decent bath in there though, it’s merely a bucket. Surely that’s not comfortable for you?”

“It’s fine,” Mydeimos really didn’t seem like he wanted to talk about this - sounding more and more tired and Phainon almost felt nervous that he was being too pushy, swallowing a little. 

He couldn’t stop himself from pushing the topic further, “The water is only cold from there, though?”

“It’s fine,” That blonde haired dragon repeatedly, making Phainon roll his bottom jaw a little from side to side, trying his best to figure out how the hell to combat this man’s thought process. 

“Mydeimos.. I’ll get.. Worried about your health if you keep bathing in the cold!”

“Bathing in the cold is good for you,” Mydeimos instantly jabbed right back, not missing a single second and making Phainon almost trip over his own feet at that. 

“Huh, really?”

He really had no idea, considering the fact people had always helped him bathe and preen his scales - rubbing under them for him politely and making sure he was spotless. He had never once considered a cold bath.. That sounded like it would be rather miserable, so why would he ever ask for that?

“Yes.”

Phainon found himself blinking forward - waiting for Mydeimos to consider what he was saying, all before slowly moving his gaze to look at that man, feeling a little stunned over the way Mydeimos had fallen into a silence, “You’re not going to explain how?”

“No.”

Somehow, Phainon expected that much - sighing wistfully as he walked beside Mydeimos. Though that didn’t last long as they both moved into that now familiar corridor - feeling his stomach hang over the way Mydeimos would be leaving him now.

His eyes moved to look at that man who had copied Phainon - pausing his steps in that empty hallway just as Phainon did, “But Mydeimos, even if that’s true, your hair is quite long! What if it being cold and wet gets you sick?”

Mydeimos hummed over that, moving his clawed hands up to his braid idly - twirling the little golden cuff at the edge of it before tilting his head a little, “.. Should I cut it?”

Dear god. That was not what Phainon wanted at all, feeling himself choke a little over those words - doing his best not to whimper at the thought of that pretty shoulder length hair being cut away due to him. 

If Mydeimos wanted to cut it out of his own desire; that was fine! But the idea of Mydeimos cutting it just because Phainon had brought it up it could make him sick.. His head felt dizzy when he even considered that happening for too long. 

“Let’s not be rash here..” Phainon choked out, doing his best to sound like he wasn’t borderline ready to sob over his own thoughts, “Anyway! We could go find you some books to read in your room first, doesn’t that sound nice? You enjoy books, don’t you? You seemed to brighten up when we walked into our library.”

“I’m not a citizen of Aedes Elysiae,” Mydeimos looked at him with that idea - not an excited look, not one that matched the brightness of wonder that touched his expression when he had first entered that library. Instead, it was a dull and bored look as Mydeimos dropped his hands from his braid. 

“.. Y.. Yes?” Phainon questioningly agreed, not sure if he was missing something because he.. Certainly knew that?

Though, Phainon would love to help him with that - a quick marriage and some children would solve his ‘not a citizen’ issue instantly. Especially with their crown prince who had every desire in his body to dote on that snappy dragonkin. 

“I can not borrow any books,” Mydeimos explained in a tired tone, his eyes already moving to his door as if he was plotting his escape - all while looking.. Sullen. Saddened by his own words he was saying, and that was enough to make Phainon’s mind run rampant trying to riddle out how to help Mydeimos feel better, all while trying to understand this topic at all. 

“What?” Phainon intelligently managed to ask, blinking widely as Mydeimos’s eyes moved back onto him - glancing upwards a little and looking just as baffled as Phainon felt. As if he didn’t even comprehend why Phainon was confused on this topic at all. 

“I am not an actual resident, I cannot obtain any books and take them with me.” Mydeimos explained in a tired tone, sounding more and more like this topic was more than a little upsetting to him - even if he was trying to hide it, it was much too obvious how much it bothered him. 

“W.. Who told you that? I’ll go with you! Let’s go get some together, okay?” Phainon tried to laugh a little, trying to force himself to sound upbeat as he tilted his head to the side - doing his best to motion to Mydeimos that they should get going to the library.

Only Mydeimos did not budge at all, instead he still looked so sorrowful - looking to his own room once more and walking past Phainon. Leaving Phainon standing there and feeling foolish as he watched that man go - spinning on his own heels to keep his eyes focused on the man of his affections with a little whine bubbling into his throat.

One that he had to fight the urge to release as Mydeimos placed a hand on his doorknob before looking at Phainon, as if it would kill him to be disrespectful and not give Phainon his attention when speaking to him; “The other staff informed me of this fact. I will be retiring to my room now.”

“M-Mydeimos, I’ll go get them for you, then. What genres do you like?” Phainon asked, unable to help  the way he knew his tail was lying on the floor behind him - useless and sad, just like how he currently felt as he seemed to be failing to comfort that dragon whose attention he wanted so badly.

And with his own words, Mydeimos seemed to study him harshly - taking him in heavily before tutting quietly over his own thoughts. 

“None, do not bother yourself with it. Good night, Prince Phainon,” Mydeimos spoke as he opened that door only to enter that room and leave Phainon alone in the hallway. Alone, and resisting the urge to whine as that door started to close without Mydeimos looking at him one last time. 

“I.. Good night, Mydeimos..” Phainon whimpered out, unable to stop himself from sounding a little pathetic as that door closed on him once again.

Phainon had to move to place a hand on his chin over that - humming a bit quietly under his breath as his eyes stared at that closed door. All before beginning to tap his foot slightly in his annoyance, feeling more and more miffed that he couldn’t do anything with Mydeimos, it seemed.

He was a fellow crown prince, but the more Phainon spoke to him; the more it felt like Mydeimos was valuing himself as so much less due to being stuck in Aedes Elysiae. It was frustrating beyond belief, only compounded by the fact the castle rules themself were treating him as less. 

That was infuriating considering it felt like the regulations of his own kingdom were keeping him from spending any quality time with that man. Making the prince work for them, and then hide away until the next day..? The thought made Phainon’s stomach drop every time he thought about how Mydeimos had said that as if it meant nothing.

So sold on that idea that nothing else was even possible, even declining to go at least get him something to do while he hid away because he.. Wasn’t allowed to do that either. 

Phainon wanted to bang his head on the door and whimper over how insufferable the entire situation was to him - it felt like every time he tried to speak to Mydeimos, he only found new ways to make that dragon feel even worse. For the first time seeing Mydeimos actually look.. Sad over something, and it was some dumb rule Phainon didn’t even know existed twelve minutes ago.

.. What was worse had to be the fact Phainon knew the library would let Mydeimos get any book he desired if Phainon was with him. That they would look the other way and let that foreign prince enjoy himself, but Mydeimos had already resigned himself to being unable to and refused to even go with Phainon.

This felt like some insane type of torture, a hell meant for Phainon specifically as he tried to figure out how to befriend Mydeimos yet the world was against them getting along.

It was enough to make Phainon sigh painfully dramatically - shoulders sinking with his deep exhale as he now turned towards the library, sullen and stalking away with his tail dragging on the polished floors behind him.

At the very least, he could pick out some books for Mydeimos to enjoy and leave them outside his door for him..
