Mydei really wasn’t sure what he expected when he woke up the next day - sighing dramatically as he crawled out of his bed only to tilt his eyes to that jewelry he had left on the nightstand. An intricate little wooden thing that had such elegant carvings etched into it - all while also being dipped in gold for a nice finish.

Beautiful, yet his own golden tail jewelry only added to it - an accessory he didn’t feel like he could wear here. Not when he was a prisoner, it wasn’t exactly right of him to flaunt gold when he didn’t think the staff would be very alright with seeing it.

But whatever the case, he had to drag himself out of bed with a heavy yawn - pricking his ears a little to see if he could hear that crown prince outside his door. He had easily heard Phainon shuffling about out there yesterday, yet now, it was eerily silent - and still no one had woken Mydei up for his job.

.. It was almost as if they didn’t even truly care when he was there or not, just that it was to keep him busy while he was trapped here or something.

Whatever the case, Mydei swung his feet out of bed and felt his tail dragging against the floor a bit lazily as he walked over to that small personal washroom area - sighing as he moved to wash up without much delay. At least he could take his time awakening if no one was there waiting on him hand and foot, not servants offering to bathe him or fretting over his braid - just himself washing his face and doing his own hair before changing into his attire. 

His eyes moving to that nightstand once more before moving to put that jewelry away in the nightstand slowly - blinking downwards over his gauntlets he had been allowed to keep with a wistful sigh. It wasn’t as if he would be able to spar with anyone here, it felt like a waste to have them lingering around in his dressers but what else could he do? 

He snapped the drawer closed before moving out of that room with fingers combing through his hair lazily - he had always given up on brushing it because it would fluff out no matter what he did. A waste of effort, though.. He found himself pausing as he entered that hallway - his eyes staring at that.. Somewhat empty chair.

There was no white haired man who seemed to glow like the sun (annoyingly), instead, Phainon had been replaced by a pile of books. All regional, it seemed, all having to do with things around Aedes Elysiae, and Mydei found himself dropping his hands to his waist over that. A piece of him aching to reach out and flip through one, but he had a job to do. There was no time for him to dilly dally here..

Those were the thoughts that made him turn away and start that quick walk to the kitchen - zoning out a bit over the way the guards lining the halls were.. Much more sparse now. Not even seeming to care overly about Mydei’s existence, truly making him realize they only thought he was a danger when he was near their crown prince.

.. Whatever, it’s not like he minded that as his eyes roamed the halls more now that he was without that prince. His eyes moved to the left to look at the squared in garden that seemed more overgrown than he had thought - as if people were slacking on tending to it sadly, and Mydei moved a little at that. 

His feet brought him to one of the arched open spaced windows to look at that garden blankly as his finger tips caressed the marble while he walked. It was odd to see such a beautiful space so.. Empty, not a soul was in there as the morning dew seemed to heavily linger on the leaves still - various plants lining the walls and rows of the garden.

But Mydei had no time for that, he had been brought to the kitchen to work so that was what he would do as he moved towards that familiar door - ignoring the heavy scents of something sweet lingering in the air as he opened it. 

That was enough for all of the staff to turn a little, looking almost as nervous as they had the first time as they seemed to take in the sight of Mydei, all before merely one of them spoke out.

“Hello Mydeimos, are you here to work again today?” A girl on the far right asked, making Mydei nod curtly to her - vaguely aware that she had been speaking to him much more.. Timidly yesterday, but now she seemed almost jaded. Sharp in her words. 

“Yes,” Mydei replied regardless of whatever emotion was in the lilt of her voice - blinking over the way she was motioning him over with her hand a little. 

A motion that he followed through with as all of the other staff members returned to their work with whispers floating in the air so easily. Whispers that Mydei had fully expected, and now was opting to ignore as he moved to be beside that woman. 

“Is the crown prince not with you today?” She asked innocently, at least, it was an attempt to be innocent as Mydei could hear the tinge of worry in her voice. Clearly, he was praying the answer was no as they both stood there, all with Mydei falling in line beside her at the counter - blinking a little over how she wasn’t working. 

She obviously was wanting a little bit of gossip first. 

“No,” Mydei flatly answered, feeling a sigh bubbling up in his throat over the way he didn’t know why people were now just assuming Phainon would be with him - that man was the crown prince, not a dog that had picked Mydei as his master. 

“.. I see,” She hummed after a moment, sounding a little bit amused over that answer, “Is he fond of you?”

..?

What kind of questioning was that?

“.. No,” Mydei sighed out, thinking of how that man seemed to.. Well.. Mydei found himself puzzling over that question for once. His mind only stalling when he remembered those books at his door - his interactions with Phainon had been.. Odd, assuredly, but were they really that malicious?

.. Mydei had no idea.

“Interesting..” She seemed to be endlessly enjoying this, as if she knew something Mydei didn’t before nodding her head a little, “Go ahead and wash up, then. I assume you’re fine working on kneading the dough again today for us?”

“Of course,” Mydei mumbled as he turned away from her - sighing a little as he moved to that sink to well.. Wash his hands idly - his mind continuously rolling back to how they most likely assumed this was all he was good for. 

A prince with muscles in the kitchen must be clueless and needing to be coddled, that was most likely their thought process and it made Mydei sigh just a bit - bitterly thinking about how he could easily help with baking more than just physical labor.. But he was just supposed to do as they say.

He couldn’t complain, not as he dried off his hands - flicking water off of his fingers before moving to that same spot they had him yesterday. 

The same rhythm of kneading into dough - only now it honestly was a bit more relaxing considering the way there wasn’t a crown prince staring him down for hours. Watching his every move and making Mydei try his best to ignore it.. 

Though, Mydei’s ears did prick a little to listen to the woman who had just given him instructions behind him. A bit rude to do so, but what else was he supposed to do besides listen to the idle kingdom gossip when he was doomed to press into dough again and again.. 

“.. Was he scoping out a meal then?” 

That was a question that made Mydei sniff a little, unsure of whatever they were talking about. 

“Who knows.. I suppose we should prepare for his.. Unique diet requirements.”

Ah. 

Was it still about their crown prince being here for so long yesterday? Mydei had to hum a little over his own thoughts, a bit idly curious if Phainon was lactose intolerant or something.. The idea was a bit funny to consider, seeing as that man was.. Giant, and yet he could be taken down by a little milk and cheese?

“Hello there!” Those two words were enough to make Mydei languidly move his eyes upwards and to his right as he stood before that counter - his eyes taking in the sight of.. A dragon blood. A woman who looked.. Very small for someone who had curved little horns at the side of her head and two twirly pigtails at the sides of her head.

Cute.

That was the word he would describe someone like that, finding himself blinking at her a little as she beamed him a dazzling smile. A foreign thing here that Mydei hadn’t received from anyone while in Aedes Elysiae minus Phainon himself.

She only kept that smile dancing on her lips however, “You must be Lord Mydeimos, correct?”

“.. Hello, you are?” Mydei asked, a bit curious as he continued kneading his hands into that dough without much of a second thought - blinking at the way she seemed so very excited to speak to him. 

“Hyacine! It’s an honor to meet you,” Hyacine chirped out, swaying a little and Mydei had to stop himself from watching the way her hair moved with the movement. His eyes dropped a little to take note of how little her tail was.. This was a royal person, assuredly, but not very deeply. 

Mydei couldn’t help himself but to ask for more information;“Of?”

Hyacine tilted her head a little - just a tiny bit, yet her smile still remained, “Technically? Aquila. But semi-permanently? Aedes Elysiae.”

Mydei had to blink over that; Aquila, to his knowledge, was about the same as Kremnos. A kingdom that had been fighting for many years and refusing to join in the treaty still - perhaps now that Kremnos had fallen, Aquila would follow suit.

But as it stood.. Mydei had to stare her down over that, “.. Are you not royalty?”

“Well.. A bit,” Hyacine waved her hand dismissively, moving it immediately after to grasp at her own little curved horns - barely past being sprouts at the sides of her head with sharp tipped ears, “It’s not really too important, but I was the fourth princess in line, anyway.”

Mydei couldn’t help but to look at how even those horns matched her bubbly personality, pink and the base and white at the ends - a bit odd compared to the rest of her, but besides that.. Her fingers weren't dipped in colors like a dragon blooded person normally was, instead, she seemed to be lacking a lot of the scales that Mydei had. No scales on her face.. Small horns and tail.. 

“That’s noticeable by your size,” Mydei mumbled, coming to an understanding that she must be truly lacking in the field of dragon blood - probably knocking her down a few pegs in the tiers for ‘royalty’. 

A silly system, yet it was so blatant that you couldn’t easily hide who those blessed with draconic blood were, not when they all had those tails and horns.. Even if the blood was thin in their veins, they still bore those features. 

“You.. Yes.. Yes I suppose it is!” Hyacine nodded, humming with a smile still on her lips warmly that Mydei couldn’t help but feel a little bit safer around her - as if that smile was melting away the ice protecting himself this past day easily,  “Regardless, it’s nice to meet you! It’s refreshing to have someone else here who is understanding of my position.”

Those words made Mydei tilt his own head though, “Position?”

“To be trapped here just like me, you know?” Hyacine hummed, moving a little to slide a cutting board over - one that Mydei found himself staring at to take note of the red juice on it. Some he assumed was tomato, only for his eyes to continue watching her hands move to slide a little basket of strawberries over as well and a bowl for them.

.. Were they making deserts today? 

“There’s a lot of secrets hiding in this kingdom. Mydeimos..” Hyacine teased in a light-hearted voice, all while moving to start dicing up strawberries lazily with her knife. An action that Mydei had to blink over with how much she actually had already done - only moving to continue her actions again and again.

But that wasn’t all as Mydei blinked his eyes towards her - trying his best to understand why Hyacine’s volume had dropped as well with this topic; “.. Why are you whispering?”

“Haven’t you noticed it? The way they all stare at you?” She asked instantly, looking at Mydei rather innocently and making him snap his mouth tightly - rolling his jaw and feeling an ounce of irritation creeping up his spine as he dared to look away from her. Not at all missing the way eyes snapped away from him - so blatantly staring at him and whispering when he wasn’t looking at them.

“.. I assumed it was due to where I have come from,” Mydei admitted as he dropped his eyes to her again, feeling himself knitting his brows as he tried to return to focusing on his dough.

.. Was it that noticeable? That even this new person he was meeting had taken note of it and found it interesting? 

“Sure! Maybe!” Hyacine chirped to his side in her same sing-song voice, a sweet tone that made Mydei feel his eyes wander back to her,  “It’s just a little spooky here!”

Spooky..?

Was that the right word for Aedes Elysiae? He really couldn’t say considering he had been here for barely a long time at all, if anything, it seemed like a beautiful castle.. Not kingdom, since he couldn’t see that - but visually the castle was pretty.

.. The people were another topic, he supposed, none of them seemed very keen to speak to him outside of Hyacine, who also didn’t live here, and Phainon who.. Was their crown prince and Mydei still wasn’t sold on that man having any emotions for Mydei outside of malicious ones in his heart. 

Mydei exhaled over it - turning his gaze back to his dough as he absentmindedly massaged it down, “.. How long have you been here?”

“A few months,” Hyacine replied instantly, “But it’s a great place! Really! If you can ignore the whispers..”

.. Was he even going to get a straight answer from this woman? He was beginning to doubt it, but it didn’t matter considering the way he was biting her bait every single time - blinking his eyes and darting them to her again. Doing his best to ignore the way her tail was swinging behind her - a tail of truth that easily told Mydei she knew exactly that Mydei would ask about it. 

“.. Whispers?” And so he did. 

Her eyes snapped upwards to him - looking painfully playful, “Surely you’ve heard them.. I’m still not sure what’s going on here, and I don’t know if I want to find out!”

“.. Not really,” Mydei confessed, he had only been here for a day and honestly.. The whispers only started today - he had felt their eyes on him all day yesterday, sure, but the whispers and chattering about him was.. Very new and off putting. Eerie, in a way. 

“Mm.. Maybe it’s because you’re always around the crown prince..” Hyacine mumbled out as she dropped her eyes back to what she was doing - massacring strawberries while seeming a little lost in her own thoughts. 

But that only made Mydei exhale a snort of a laugh, “‘Always’? I’ve been here only a day.”

That was enough for Hyacine to move her free hand - pointing at him sharply, “One day is still technically ‘always’, Lord Mydeimos! Words move fast when it’s about their prince..”

She trailed off, all before looking back to her task at hand and seeming more and more distracted. But Mydei couldn’t let her stop there, raising a brow over the way she seemed to have more to say but she had to make sure Mydei was sold on it.

And sold he was, “.. And what is the word?”

“That he’s really interested in you. For what? You tell me, Mr. Prince,” Hyacine rivaled immediately, leaning a little on the counter as she turned slightly to look Mydei more in the eyes. An action that had Mydei dumbfounded as he tried to figure out what the hell she was even going on about now.

“I hear he slept outside your door one night..” Hyacine hummed out, sounding as if this topic was very, very interesting to her,  “What’s all that about?”

That.. Was something Mydei didn’t even know how to answer, honestly. He himself had no idea why Phainon had done that. A piece of him assumed it was to make sure he behaved and wasn’t sent to somehow poison Kephale or something. Yet, Phainon had seemed so.. Excited when Mydei woke up it really made no sense in his mind. 

Mydei had to try to ignore that topic for that reason, “.. I’m more interested in the reasons why this kingdom is ‘spooky’?”

Though, Hyacine only laughed a little at that question. Or at Mydei’s evasion of answering her question as she went back to working on her butchering of strawberries, “Isn’t it more fun for you to find out for yourself? Mr. Mydeimos, does the crown prince like you?”

.. So neither of them were going to answer questions right now, huh?

“Like me?” Mydei inquired with a huff, unable to even think of the answer for himself, really.

Only, Hyacine made it worse by clarifying it; “Like like you?”

.. Love?

She was asking if that giant crown prince had a crush on Mydei? That was enough for him to fight back a laugh of pure disbelief. As if anything Phainon had done could be read as ‘love’ or ‘affectionate’ in any sense, making Mydei click his tongue as he thought on it more and more. 

“.. No, I don’t think he likes me much at all. We met on the battlefield and I believe he holds some.. Type of grudge with me,” Mydei explained darkly, thinking of how Phainon must still be irked that he didn’t claim a victory on the battlefield. That Mydei had fled at the sound of their wardrums forfeiting this battle and recalling him - an anger of a warrior perturbed neither had a clear outcome.

Winner or loser, Phainon was angry they still didn’t have an answer to who between them was stronger - that much was certain in Mydei’s mind. 

But Hyacine was clueless to all of that, “Grudge?”

“When we formally met, he immediately asked me many things about if I’m willing to be a clutch mother, and when I had my heats as a form of mockery,” Mydei tiredly told her, feeling himself knitting his brows as he explained those confusing questions Phainon had asked to try to gain ire from Mydei.

A foolish attempt considering Mydei felt no shame in being the one to bear a clutch if fate turned out to be that way - for Kremnos he didn’t mind at all, and if he fell in love and that was his fate as well.. He failed to see any shame in such a thing. 

“.. Riiight.. Mockery..” Hyacine nodded slowly - as if fully unbelieving of his words, “Just curious again, what else did he ask you?”

Mydei found his eye twitching at that,“.. Favorite food and if it changes when I’m nesting. And if I nest.”

Hyacine moved a little - just a tiny bit to be able to look Mydei in the eyes. Her expression looked as if she couldn’t believe what she was hearing at all, staring at Mydei like he had personally offended her.

All before she slowly shook her head in a nod - so painfully slow that Mydei almost was worried for her neck, “Wow, these are all really good questions for Prince Phainon to be asking you for no specific reason at all!”

“I found them to be rather odd,” Mydei huffed in a countering tone - not feeling fond towards those questions at all. Especially since Phainon had been the one asking them and he seemed so excited for Mydei’s answers that Mydei couldn’t help but assume something odd was afoot.

“No, yeah.. I’m sure you did king,” Hyacine nodded - still as slow as a turtle. 

“I am no king yet,” Mydei corrected her, only for Hyacine to close her eyes - pursing her lips a little as she looked like she was about to laugh over that before she turned away again. Nodding just once quickly. 

“No, yeah, that’s also my bad,” Hyacine conceded with a little giggle bubbling out of her regardless, “Anyway, ignoring your.. Ongoing situation with the crown prince, how are you liking Aedes Elysiae?”

“I.. Do not know, I’m not allowed to do much,” Mydei confessed, thinking only of how he had hid in his room yesterday to avoid that crown prince making a mockery anymore of him for the day. Desperate to escape those eyes that looked at him in such.. An odd way.

As if he were sizing Mydei up for something, all while having almost a glaze that read like Phainon was hungering for something from him. A bizarre gaze that sent shivers down Mydei’s spine when he focused on it for too long, and all Mydei could do was attempt to not pay it any mind. 

“Mm.. No, I don’t believe that!” 

Mydei found himself blinking at the stone wall before moving his eyes to look at Hyacine slowly; “Pardon?”

“That crown prince probably would allow you to do as you please! He has to keep an eye on his enemy y’know.. Letting you relax and hoping you put your guard down..” Hyacine seemed to ramble off a little - shaking her head as she seemed more and more focused on chopping up those strawberries again. 

“.. All the more reason to stay in my room,” Mydei found himself grumbling out as he tried to copy - going back to his work instead of thinking about that damnedable prince at all. All he did was make Mydei feel more and more stressed to where he could feel his tail languidly laying on the floor behind him the more he thought of how trapped he was currently. 

Hyacine made an odd noise beside him at that though; “I was joking! I was hoping it would do the opposite!”

Mydei barely looked at her over that - instead hearing the snapping of her knife against the cutting board as she continued to attack those strawberries ruthlessly.

Enough to make Mydei swallow a little; “He did give me some books to read..”

“‘He’?” Hyacine asked so dreadfully innocently, letting Mydei know she already knew who Mydei meant. 

“The crown prince,” Mydei sighed out anyway - forfeiting to her a little in this battle. 

“Right.. Your enemy who has a grudge against you.. You should read them somewhere nice and try to relax, you must be stressed over everything! It’s bad for you!” Hyacine chidded to him, and out of his peripheral vision he could see the way she was waving her knife a little as she spoke. Sighing with her own words as she did so.

“.. I did like the garden he showed me,” Mydei confessed yet again - feeling his skin burn with embarrassment for some reason as if admitting that Phainon had taken him to decent places was him surrendering to him.

Yet, that only made Hyacine lean forward abruptly, staring at Mydei with owl wide eyes over that; “He let you in his garden?”

Ah.

Mydei had to blink over that, quickly coming to terms that something about what he said was considered odd to Hyacie - and he had a sneaking suspicion what, given what she had said. 

“.. His garden?” Mydei echoed out, staring at the way she leaned back again - her lips moving a bit before she gave a shy little laugh. 

“Erm..” She started, only to trail off slowly, “Well! It’s kind of off limits for most people.. So..”

“I see, he’s setting me up to be executed,” Mydei nodded at those words, able to connect the dots easily and instantly now that he had been warned it’s off limits. Only to hear a quiet squeaking noise come from Hyacine over that. 

“Okay, goodness me. Okay, a lot to unpack there,” Hyacine quietly mumbled out, all before seeming to move on from the topic anyway, “But let’s entertain the idea that maybe, just maybe, he wanted you in his garden.”

Mydei couldn’t help the egregious look he immediately gave to Hyacine - tilting his head to look at her while furrowing his brows together. His lips pulled into such a hard frown that he couldn’t even blame her for the way her head jerked back a little when their eyes met. 

“Don’t look at me like that! He’s given you books personally from him, and has taken you into that garden.. I don’t think he has nearly as big of a grudge against you as you’re assuming, Mydeimos.” Hyacine shook her head as she said those words with such a heavy sigh leaving her chest - one that made Mydei drop his gaze again.

His eyes only stared at his hands, “Mydei.”

“Mydei?” 

“You may call me Mydei,” Mydei told her as he returned to kneading that dough - idly thinking of how he probably needed some flour, but it didn’t matter right now. He could ask for some after his chat with Hyacine ended.

“Wow.. You can call me Hyacine!” Hyacine chirped so very happily at that.

And Mydei.. Found his mouth opening and closing a few times, trying to process that a little; “.. Isn’t that what you already told me to call you?”

“Yeah, sorry, I don’t have a shorter nickname,” Hyacine confessed with a shrug of her shoulders, making Mydei huff a quiet little laugh over that as his eyes returned to his work. Staring at it dully as silence now veiled the both of them outside of the whispers of other people working in the kitchen as well. 

But Mydei couldn’t keep her words out of his mind about it all - instead feeling himself swallow as he tried to think deeper about Phainon’s actions. Inherently.. There was nothing evil about them, nothing that was truly imbued with deep malice - he could have been playing with Mydei in some odd way Mydei just wasn’t aware of.

It was enough to make him sigh, “.. Do you truly believe I’m overthinking his hatred for me?”

That made Hyacine look at him again, pausing her own task to hum over that question in mute amusement. 

“Mydei, if you’re worried, you can keep him at an arm’s length, but.. I do think he means well with you,” Hyacine told him in a sweet one - soft and gentle, one that was clearly her meaning her best,  “He sounds overly friendly towards you, not someone trying to end your life.”

.. Overly friendly? Was that how he could explain away how invasive Phainon had been when they had formerly met for the first time? Was that him being.. Friendly? 

“Besides, he would never do that and ruin the treaty they’ve worked decades to try to earn with Castrum Kremnos..” Hyacine absentmindedly added, making Mydei quirk his jaw a little to the side - unable to argue that point at all, “I don’t think your parents would easily forgive Aedes Elysiae killing their only son; letting them take you was.. A lot of trust on their part already.”

“That.. Does make sense,” Mydei conceded with a heavy sigh on his lips - truly failing to find a reason why Phainon would so gleefully try to get Mydei killed. If anything, he would be seeking to embarrass Mydei, but murder or execution most likely was not in Phainon’s mind. At least, not yet.. 

“Doesn’t it? So do me a favor and enjoy that garden for me?” Hyacine asked, though that only made Mydei look at her with a brief expression of confusion with those words. 

“Are you not allowed in it?”

“I’ve never even spoken to the crown prince, Mydei!” Hyacine confessed as she laughed a little, smiling at Mydei as if that was an obvious thing - but Mydei.. Couldn’t find himself understanding that if Hyacine was royalty as well why was she ignored by him? Considering how closely Phainon had been sticking to Mydei.. It was baffling to him. 

Hyacine didn’t seem to notice his hesitation however, only smiling fondly before speaking again;  “Please, enjoy the garden for me.”

“.. Alright,” Mydei conceded, shaking his head a bit all before looking at just how many strawberries Hyacine had been chopping - a piece of him fearing that this poor kingdom would have a drought of that fruit for the next few months if she continued this path;  “Why are you dicing up so many strawberries, anyway?”

“Oh! The crown prince said he smelled something that made him really want to eat strawberries, so we’ve been making an array of foods for him containing them today!” Hyacine chirped out, seeming much too happy and that made Mydei  blink a little over those words. 

“.. Smelled something?”

Mydei was pretty sure he had been around that man most of the day before, and he couldn’t remember something like that. Or perhaps that crown prince really had left when Mydei went into his bedroom - he was pretty sure Phainon had stalked around his room the first night he was here. But that could have been a one off thing as well, he supposed. 

“No one knows, he seemed like he was in a daze or trance when he mumbled about it. Weirdly, his tail was wagging like a dog too,” Hyacine explained, sounding as if she was a little amused by the memory.

Though, Mydei found himself creasing his brows as he mushed his hands into that ball of dough again - feeling as if he was going to end up over kneading it at this rate and needed a new batch. Yet, he was much too fixated on this topic right now, curiosity biting into his bones as he tried to understand why that latter half was worth mentioning. 

“.. Is it odd for his tail to be wagging?” Mydei found himself innocently asking - brows remaining knitted as he flitted his eyes to her a little. 

Watching the way she bubbled into a small laugh, seeming to find that question funny in some odd way, “It never wags.”

“Oh,” Mydei said, feeling a bit dumbfounded by those words - blinking at her before turning his head back to what he was doing - he was.. Pretty sure that man’s tail had been wagging every single time they spoke or were together but maybe it was just for some odd reason.

.. Weird.

Whatever the case was with Phainon’s tail aside, the sun only continued to go down while they worked, up until Hyacine was dismissed - said her goodbyes, and hissed something about Mydei needing to go to the garden. A thing that made him sigh a little, but he would obey and follow her directions as he later was dismissed all the same.

Feeling more and more idiotic that his entire day was spent kneading dough - as if yesterday when they had shown him around the kitchen was just a show they put on for Phainon since he was watching. 

.. Either way, he now was on his way back to his room with a heavy heart and boredom seeping into his bones. He wouldn’t have minded it if they had given him something to do, but the only thing keeping his sanity had been Hyacine talking to him all day and arguably gossiping with him about people in the kingdom.

At least he had made one friend, a thought that was bringing him a bit of solace as he stalked his way back to that guest corridor with a yawn on his lips. 

Ah.

Mydei’s steps paused in the hallway, staring at the way that chair was now empty - gone were the books Phainon had apparently left for him and instead was merely the lonesome chair against the wall beside his door. Really, he should have expected that much considering he.. Was not a citizen, he was not allowed to ‘borrow’ books.

.. That would assuredly make his afternoon in the garden much more boring - yet he sighed as he moved towards his guest bedroom anyway, moving into there to wash up a little. All to pause as the way the books were now neatly placed on his nightstand - waiting for him inside his dimly lit room that drew out a heavy sigh from his chest.

Moving idly to look through them all with a blank state of mind.. ‘Festive Culinary Guide’? Was that for Aedes Elysiae traditions? Though.. He had to pick out a different one, one that looked a bit more worn out - beaten up as if loved through the tests of time as Mydei’s fingers touched the soft feeling cover.

His fingers moving over the text on the front ‘Aedes Elysiae Farmer’s Almanac’? Why on earth was that such a .. Well used book? Regardless of the answer, Mydei found himself drawn to that one - sighing as he took it and immediately left that small room once again. His fingers only continued to run over the battered front of it. Humming a little as he continued to glance at it between his own fingers.

All before his feet found their own way back to that garden entrance, feeling his own nerves spike a little over how he.. Was he truly allowed in here, or had that crown prince been lying to him? Whatever the case, he sighed a little over how he had told Hyacine he would do this before stepping into that garden again.

Immediately moving deeper to pray no one noticed the foreign prince moving into that apparently and allegedly forbidden garden. Every step made him feel a bit more nervous, as if he could trigger a trap at any moment as his fingers continuously moved to grip onto that book - his mind stalling again and again to figure out why it was so well used all before he paused a little.

His eyes caught on a spot that was so very appealing looking - not that table Phainon had picked out before, but something else. A spot of sunshine right beneath a tree that looked much too appealing, as if it were calling out to him in specific and making his feet move. 

Sunshine always felt the best on his scales, and if he was going to be executed for being in this garden, at the very least he could enjoy it while he was here.. That was precisely why he moved into that sun without much of a second thought and plopped down, making himself comfortable against that soft feeling grass.

Fingers brushing on it before moving to open that book with a little sigh leaving his lips as he opened it. 

“Heed the wisdom of Oronyx: The land never betrays the hands that tend it, just as time never forsakes those who wait.”

Oronyx.

That was the original dragon who roamed this area, correct? The one that gave the Aedes Elysiae royalty their blood? Right.. Mydei had to flip a bit more, looking at those words on the pages with a slow nod every time he flipped to another new page to see what exactly was inscribed there.

He.. Couldn’t read Elysian. 

For whatever reason, the title and text on the first page was in the common tongue, but this.. Mydei had no idea what the hell he was reading - and that was enough to make him purse his lips, sighing heavily as he realized that Phainon had been absolutely messing with him. There was no way he could have ever learned Elysian when they had been at war all their lives.

The bastard. 

Mydei sighed as he closed that book and discarded it gently to the side of him, instead opting to close his eyes and merely enjoy the sunshine as it poured onto his skin freely. Though.. He couldn’t fight the way it ate at his mind and made him so tired - lulling him into leaning back against that bark and fully enjoying it.

.. Though, he wasn’t really sure when he fell asleep, or how long it even took him to fall asleep in the warmth of the sun cradling him. All he knew was he had assuredly fallen asleep, and he didn’t mind that - napping in the sun was one of the best things you could do in your spare time, at least, that’s what Mydei had to tell himself.

Especially as someone seemed to have found him during his naptime. 

“I expected you to be more guarded while you slept..” Mydei could feel himself twitching over that, over such a softly spoken voice that he was pretty sure he was dreaming such a thing. 

“And to not be such a heavy sleeper..”

A ghost of a touch followed those words - so gentle in its wake that Mydei wasn’t sure he was imagining fingers brushing his hair off his face or not. So kindly moving his hair out of his face as if he were so fragile that the slightest mistouch of those fingers would shatter him to pieces. 

Those words didn’t stop even though the gentle touches did, humming a little in such a soothing way that Mydei felt his own tail thump against the tail a little. Doing his best to fall back into his slumber all while they continued to speak, “Let’s get you to bed now, alright, beautiful?”

.. Bed? Mydei was already in bed.. He didn’t want to get up and walk to wherever this person was wanting him to go - he was much too comfortable right here..

 “You’ll get cold out here, after all..” 

Mydei felt himself growling a little in his throat as arms seemed to wrap around him easily - lifting him as if he weighed nothing and it almost was enough to rouse him from his state of slipping between consciousness and back into unconscious repeatedly. 

Almost, if not for the way whoever this person was hadn’t been so warm - so deeply warm that Mydei could feel himself trying to get closer to them while being carried. His own head trying to nuzzle into their chest to feel that warmth on his own skin while he was held so gently.

Though, that seemed to have an odd affect on the other person - making Mydei hear a quiet little rumble in their chest or throat as if they were purring in delight. Happiness over Mydei trying to be closer.. That felt foolish to him, and yet, he still couldn’t bring himself to open his eyes. Finding his own peace in letting this person carry him since.. He couldn’t gauge any danger from them - not when they were holding onto Mydei so tightly; as if he were something to be treasured and held closely. 

If anything, Mydei found himself rolling into a ball when the carrying seemed to stop - mourning the sudden lack of warmth and the rumbles that had been so soothing to his ears. The deep purrs of someone who seemed to have been so pleased with Mydei currently - only to find softness enveloping him easily.

.. That was enough to make Mydei jerk upwards in his bed - blinking to try to see whoever had been so sweet and tender to him, only to find no one there. His room was pitch black, and his door was shut as if no one had ever been there, and for some reason.. 

Mydei found himself a little sorrowful over that.

Chapter Notes

lowkey i decided to post all the chapters i already have. so uhhh. onto chapter 6

Phainon couldn’t help but lean down a little, his footsteps silent as he walked those halls - no longer wearing his loud boots in favor of being quiet as he followed behind Mydeimos. His eyes keenly watching him before that dragon sighed so painfully loudly - turning a little to look at him and force Phainon to straighten up a little. 

Beaming a smile to him with wide eyes, waiting to hear what Mydeimos would say to him since he had apparently noticed Phainon was behind him.

“If you’re going to stalk someone, you should work on quieting your tail,” Mydeimos growled out - seeming less than pleased over it, but as always, Phainon found that absolutely thrilling as he cocked his head to the side a little innocently. Blinking, wide, confused eyes at Mydeimos with those words. 

“Hmm?” Phainon hummed out in response, trying his best to understand what Mydeimos meant by his tail. Moving his head a little to look over his shoulder at it with a blank stare as he tried to process what the issue was with it. 

“You wag it dreadfully loudly,” Mydeimos growled out, making Phainon slowly return his gaze to him - feeling a quiet little laugh bubble in his chest as he gave Mydeimos a toothy grin. Light-hearted over how he really had noticed that it was a little noisy, he just hadn’t minded it at all.

“Oh! My mistake,” Phainon chirped, fully aware of how unconvincing he must seem due to the thin frown on Mydeimos’s lips over that, “How are you today, Mydeimos? Did you enjoy any of the books I picked out for you?”

Mydeimos appeared to let out such a deep chested sigh - letting his shoulders sag a little as he closed his eyes before moving to cross his arms over his chest. A movement Phainon keenly watched as his tail only continued to incessantly wag behind him - no use trying to hush it up when Mydeimos was already speaking to him now, anyway! 

Just for Mydeimos to open his eyes after a moment, giving Phainon a rather blatant once-over from head to toe before focusing on his face with such a dull expression on his features, “.. Hello, Prince Phainon. I am fine, thank you, I hope you are doing well.”

“I’m doing great now! About the books?” Phainon instantly asked, eager to hear the review on them since he hadn’t seen Mydeimos in a few hours - painful hours, really. A span of time that had made him go insane yesterday at his scheduled meetings when he kept thinking on how that beautiful dragon was in his home..

.. Unfair! He wanted to spend more time with Mydeimos, though.. He had enjoyed carrying Mydeimos off to bed. Feeling that man snuggle into his chest a little while he carried him - only to start purring.. Those were such precious memories that Phainon couldn’t let himself linger on for too long.

He knew he would start trilling or purring if his mind kept thinking of them - and he didn’t want to explain to Mydeimos that it had been him to carry him to bed. Not when Mydeimos had never opened his eyes during it and probably would have thrown a fit and fought Phainon over it if he had been a bit more conscious and not in a slumber.

Thus.. It was merely a cute little memory for Phainon to cherish and cling to his pillow and trill over when he got back to his room again - just like he had done last night while thrashing around thinking about how sweet Mydeimos was when sleepy. 

Though, Mydeimos currently only looked to be scowling - as if this topic was annoying him, “.. I could not read them.”

.. Well that certainly wasn’t the type of reply Phainon had been looking forward to! He could feel the way his tail abruptly stopped and drooped to the floor a little, trying his best to understand what Mydeimos was meaning when he most certainly had found him in the garden asleep with a book beside him..

“Huh?” Phainon asked in a quiet little voice, feeling himself shaking a little in his boots as he tried to comprehend what Mydeimos was growling at him. 

“They’re written in Elysian. I assumed you did that on purpose so I returned them,” Mydeimos huffed as he turned away - striding already a few feet as Phainon instantly moved after him. His own speed was a bit faster to try to get to the bottom of this chat before Mydeimos hid away in his room again. 

“W.. On purpose?” Phainon asked, leaning forward a little to look Mydeimos in the eyes as they walked - looking at the way those golden eyes seemed less than enthused. As if he was really wishing the word on Phainon for this foolish blunder, and Phainon couldn’t even blame him, why hadn’t he considered Mydeimos couldn’t read Elysian?!

“They appeared a bit irked over the fact I had stolen their princes books, so I believe you accomplished what you desired,” Mydeimos muttered out a bit darkly, annoyed and appearing more than a little perturbed. 

And not in the way Phainon had been enjoying seeing from him, instead, he felt himself swallowing so painfully hard as he fought the desire to whine and whimper. His mind racing to try to figure out how to make this better for Mydeimos who had assuredly been made a fool of by accident.

“What? No no, I’ll get you some books in our common language, is that okay?” Phainon offered in a worried tone, moving to wring his wrists a little as they walked - not at all caring for how his tail was dragging behind himself as they neared that damnedable guest room, “I can even translate them for you if you want! Ah, I don’t.. Know much Kremnoan either, but I can try if you like!”

Mydeimos only made such a loud exhaling noise over that, sounding more than merely a little tired at the idea of all of that, “.. I do not need them translated to Kremnoan,”

“Ah, okay. Just the common tongue, then? I can get started in my free time tonight!” Phainon immediately offered, unable to help himself as they turned into that familiar hallway - feeling his mind curse whoever assigned Mydeimos to the first bedroom and allowed the fellow crown prince to already arrive at his room.

Awful, this all was awful and all he had wanted to do was make Mydeimos happy! 

“That’s.. I’m fine with new books, Prince Phainon.. Or none at all,” Mydeimos mumbled as he paused his feet in front of his door - eyes crawling back up to meet Phainon’s worried gaze. His own amber flaked eyes looked so.. Disorientated in an odd sense, as if he couldn’t decide what emotion to currently put on display. 

Brows knitted together as he tried to keep eye contact with Phainon, appearing as if he were studying Phainon more than anything with a hand on his own bedroom door to open it. 

“I’ll get you new ones in the meantime, and translate the old ones!” Phainon nodded, finding no issues in adding that to his to-do list. It was such a minor thing that Phainon really didn’t mind! Not if it meant making Mydeimos happy, and having him return to his garden again.. Phainon would trade anything for one of those moments of gentleness shared together through carrying him.. 

“That’s.. Have a good day, Prince Phainon,” Mydeimos sighed as he turned away, sounding a little unconvinced as he pushed his bedroom door open, only to shut it closed behind him. 

“You too, Mydeimos!” Phainon happily chirped out as he stared at that white door - a thing he was becoming moderately used to before sighing a little as he turned to walk away. 

Thankfully, he did still have the Aedes Elysiae Farmer’s Almanac that Mydeimos had left in the garden yesterday - his hands were full of a dragon who had a fat tail so he couldn’t have easily picked it up and Mydeimos. Instead, he had to return later and grab the book - humming now as he moved to his bedroom.

At the least.. He could begin to translate it for Mydeimos.

Even as he opened the door to his much too lavish bedroom - it just felt horribly empty now, as if it was missing any true heart to it. Silken sheets, the finest wools to keep him warm, family paintings and intricate carvings lining the walls.

.. Yet there was no Mydeimos, that dragon was so far away when Phainon was here that he felt almost uncomfortable. Aching in his bones as he moved to his white desk that was a mess of papers he needed to read through at the corner of his room - though he opted to ignore them a bit more. Instead picking up that familiar book Mydeimos had tried to read before moving to his bed with a heavy sigh in the middle of the room.

Sitting on the edge while putting a hand up to his face.

.. He had never translated something before, but he had better get started, huh?

────────────── 

Phainon had made this a habit now - standing there at the side of his own garden peering into it. Studying the burning dragon that was lazily in his garden reading today, just like Mydeimos had done for several days now. Just a few, but it was enough to make Phainon feel his tail giving away his emotions easily - his eyes never moving from Mydeimos and only rarely did they make eye contact.

Every day he watches Mydeimos, and merely waits for him to be done reading - all before Mydeimos fell into a napping state every single time.

Adorable.

Mydeimos was endlessly adorable as Phainon sat there leaning over the wall with his head in his hand - elbow propped up to keep his head up as he stared at him. Keen to never miss anything - not the way Mydeimos’s hair feathered a little over his face in the cool breeze the garden rarely got while he slept. Or the way the tip of his tail moved back and forth like an angry lion’s while he was slumbering.

Phainon found it all so very amusing and cute to himself as he stared, watching and waiting - always ready to carry Mydeimos back to his room if he slept just a little too late into the day. He was willing to do anything for that man, even if it meant staying a bit away for Mydeimos’s own peace of mind while he read.

That didn’t matter, not when every day he got to walk Mydeimos back to his room with a giddy little jog to catch up to him and walk beside him; “Did you enjoy that book, Mydeimos?”

It was the first book Phainon had finished translating, granted, he had spent most of his free time on that for Mydeimos - but he didn’t mind! So long as Mydeimos was happy with it, he found himself easily able to feel joy in it as well. 

“.. When I first picked it out from the set, I did not expect it to truly be a guide to farming based on the months,” Mydeimos confessed as they leisurely walked - a bit slower than Mydeimos used to walk, as if he too wanted this chat to continue, “Considering how well worn out it was..”

Phainon had to chuckle a little over that, that old book was an iconic read - though Mydeimos most likely had just.. Skipped over most things involving the dragon he didn’t worship and its heritage. Or probably assumed those silly rituals in the book were gone and past, none the wiser to the reality around him.. 

“We were originally a farming kingdom, after all,” Phainon hummed with his own thoughts, not bothering at all to go into details about the rituals in that book involving Oronyx and their kin if Mydeimos wasn’t going to bother asking, “We still are, but we’ve become much more than that over the decades.”

‘More’.

Phainon didn’t dare explain that either, not when Mydeimos considered himself to be a ‘prisoner’ to this kingdom; it would have to wait for another day.. 

Mydei huffed a little over that, his hand moving to his braid to twirl it as they walked - a habit he seemed to have that Phainon felt so dreadfully fond of, “.. That much is apparent, yes.”

“What book do you want to read next? I can translate another for you if you want, or we can go to the library together?” Phainon couldn’t help the way his tail started to wag over the latter, so eager to take Mydeimos into the library and watch him go through the shelves with wonder and whimsy in his heart and expression.

Just like he had looked when he had first walked into there - seeming so innocently impressed by their library, only to have still never gone back to it even though Phainon continued pestering him about it. He was practically begging for Mydeimos to go in there and pick out his own books, yet that dragon seemed so wholly unconvinced by the idea.. 

“Is the Festive Culinary Guide about only Aedes Elysiae, or other kingdoms as well?” Mydeimos asked, and that made Phainon snort a little as he watched Mydeimos’s hand drop his braid lazily. Giving up on it in favor of looking at Phainon curiously due to the laugh Phainon was fighting back as they walked. 

“Mydeimos, I will be honest,” Phainon began, feeling himself also at war with a smile that wanted to burn itself into his lips. 

Though, Mydeimos was completely unaware, innocent and only raising his brows over it; “Hmm?”

“That’s.. That’s just a cookbook,” Phainon explained, huffing a little - he had thought it would be just an idle little read for a man who enjoyed cooking, but it was obvious Mydeimos was wanting something with a little bit more depth. 

“Oh,” Mydeimos flatly stated as he blinked his eyes - looking as if he hadn’t expected that at all and Phainon really couldn’t blame him,  “What book do you suggest, then?”

Ah.. Well.. Phainon was assuredly not going to give him something with more depth if that was what he wanted. His own tastes were a bit odd, he knew that much, it was why he had struggled with books for Mydeimos.. But to ask him what he suggested.. 

“I like the Golden Scapegoat’s Mutterings,” Phainon confessed with a little laugh - unable to keep himself from laughing at himself in this instance. 

Though, Mydeimos only tutted a little over the suggestion, “.. Isn’t that the rambles of an insane man people read to their children at night?”

So even Kremnos had that book? That was curious, but Phainon had to hum a little over the words Mydeimos had just said. 

“Children? Who in their right mind would read that to their children?” Phainon asked, but judging from the sharp edged glare he received from Mydeimos - that was a mistake that made him choke a little. All before whimpering just a tiny inaudible amount, trying his best to remain sane as Mydeimos looked so annoyed at him. 

Phainon almost had to whine over how much he enjoyed that glare still - one that was so painfully irked with Phainon and wasn’t afraid to show it. 

All before Mydeimos clicked his tongue loudly, his tail lashing a little before he spoke; “.. My father?”

Well, that’s scary. But it wasn’t like Phainon could say that - instead gnawing at his tongue the tiniest of bits over how foolish he felt with that hissed out statement. Not because he was in the wrong, but because why the hell was Eurypon reading something like that to his son!?

“Oh! My apologies..” Phainon forced himself to say all while feeling his hands sweat a little as Mydeimos turned away from him again - walking once more back to his room with Phainon following behind him with a whine dying in his throat. Moving immediately to join beside Mydeimos with his tail drooping a little over knowing their time is running out again.

“You’re lucky my father is not here,” Mydeimos snarled at him between his own steps walking - making Phainon’s heart skip a beat over how angry he sounded as they turned into that familiar hallway yet again, “I’ll give it a reread tomorrow and see how foolish your taste is.”

Phainon couldn’t help but to laugh a little at that as he smiled over the idea of Mydeimos growling at him yet conceding to try what he was suggesting, “I look forward to it! Good night, Mydeimos.”

Mydeimos paused a little at that, turning to look at Phainon as if he had something more to say - all before sighing a little, “.. Good night, Prince Phainon.” 

And with that, Mydeimos opened that door solely to disappear inside of it once more. 

Phainon tutted a little over that door being closed again on him - staring at that white wood before looking to that chair he still had been sleeping on even though the staff continuously kept begging for him to go to bed. How could he when Mydeimos’s door didn’t even lock? He wanted that man to stay safe, and he was the only option.

At least, that's what Phainon told himself time and time again as he began to pace a little back and forth in front of Mydeimos’s door - doing his best to stay silent so that he could sleep peacefully. All while he found himself combing through his hair, anxiously fixing and messing it up again. 

He adored this.

His days of watching Mydeimos from afar and savoring these moments, he loved it so very much - and yet he always felt greedy at the end of it. Having his inner instincts rile up and rear their ugly heads over how he should be crawling into bed with Mydeimos and keeping him safe using his own body as a shield. 

Yet he wasn’t allowed to, Mydeimos didn’t want him in there.. 

It was frustrating, he wanted to take his time with Mydeimos - getting to know him and making sure Mydeimos wanted it just as much as he did (if at all possible), all while he had no idea if he was even making progress. 

Mydeimos was a little less growly, but that didn’t mean too much - especially considering Phainon hadn’t minded that beautiful man snarling and hissing at him in the first place. Just now it was without Phainon’s guards; those were merely hindrances that he had growled at to leave him alone when he was yearning for Mydeimos.

Words that made his guards look nervous, all while obeying his demand easily. 

After all, who had the right to tell him no if he wanted to spend his time watching that man work in the kitchen? Peaking into the doorway every few minutes to make sure he was fine, feeling his own eyes linger on the pink dragon he had seen many times before - all before writing her off.

.. She didn’t seem like she would put up much of a decent fight if push came to shove over winning Mydeimos’s heart, so he wasn’t sure if he was.. Too jealous yet. There was still time to change that, though. He knew that much as his thoughts of that man only continued while he walked back and forth - rubbing the nape of his neck with a heavy exhale. 

“Phainon,” His name being said was more than enough to make him halt his steps - turning a little to look at Kephale who was approaching from behind him curiously. His voice was quiet and mellow, as if he was more than a little aware of who was behind that door Phainon was pacing outside of. 

“Father?” Phainon absentmindedly greeted, confusion seeping into that lone word as he swallowed roughly - doing his best to steady his thoughts as his feet completely stopped. Unable to help himself but to worriedly look at Mydeimos’s door, checking to make sure the dragon inside there hadn’t noticed the noises outside yet. 

“Let’s have a chat, my son,” Kephale began with such a heavy sigh, shaking his head before turning away from Phainon and beginning to walk away as well - fully knowing Phainon would follow after him, “Walk with me.”

“.. As you command,” Phainon muttered, feeling a bit sorrowful as he moved away from Mydeimos’s bedroom - but he would just have to come back later and perhaps translate outside of his room. Whatever the case was, he found himself walking behind his father - feeling himself sweating a little as he slowly walked. 

“What do you think of Mydeimos?” 

That question was enough to make Phainon stare at the back of his father’s head, his mouth opening and closing like a floundering fish as he tried to swallow down his own rampant emotions. All to see Kephale stopping to turn to him - in the middle of the hallway with no one around.

That was eerie enough, no guards for his father..? This must be a topic he didn’t want anyone else hearing about - and that was enough to make Phainon knit his brows in pure wonder. 

“I like him,” Phainon told his father, not sure of what else he was supposed to say but the truth in this instance.

He was at the core of it, very fond of Mydeimos. He liked him, a lot. And that was that, wasn’t it? Why was it some big issue that they needed to be in private to discuss..? Wouldn’t their friendship (or more considering how much Phainon yearned for Mydeimos) only work to foster better relationships between their two kingdoms as it already stood? 

Though, his father only creased his eyes a little - looking wholly unimpressed in a way that made Phainon cock his head to the side just a bit. Doing his best to understand what that man was looking worried over, especially as his crows feet appeared so heavily at the corner of his eyes.

“You like him? Interesting.. Are.. Is he in danger?” Kephale asked in a slow and timid sounding voice, as if he was so dreadfully wary about this topic. 

.. It was enough to make Phainon tilt his head a little - trying his best to gauge the emotion his own father was feeling currently with their eyes meeting. Appearing as if he was nervous over this topic, but that was a little silly.. 

“Danger? Heavens no! I won’t allow him to be harmed,” Phainon informed his own dad with a nod of his head, deadset on the words he had said, “I’ll make sure of that.”

It was a promise, after all, Phainon absolutely wouldn’t forgive anyone that hurt Mydeimos while he was here - if anything, he himself would punish them. Thoroughly. Enough to make sure they were not even able to think of harming Mydeimos again - or maybe unable to think in general, Phainon wasn’t sure!

“Phainon, I was asking if you were the one endangering him,” Kephale clarified - and that was enough to make Phainon straighten out. Feeling his tail droop a little to the floor, and yet.. He could only put a smug little smile on his lips - moving to place a hand on his hip as he sighed a little dramatically.

“Mm,” Phainon hummed over it - his dad wasn’t wrong to be scared of such a thing, but Phainon wanted to devour that dragon in other ways. To sink his fangs into Mydeimos and hear him cry out in pleasure while Phainon laps his blood from the wound, marking him and his and only his again and again.

He wanted to pin that beautiful and strong man down and start a family with him.. 

In danger from Phainon..?

“No,” Phainon coyly replied, unable to help the smile on his lips with his own mounting desires - tapping his fingers on his own hip as he thought again and again of how well Mydeimos fit in his arms; of how Mydeimos pulled himself closer to Phainon as well.

He was much too perfect for Phainon to ever harm. 

“You’ve been hunting him, following him around, and watching him. Is he n-”

“He’s not in danger, father,” Phainon found himself interrupting - it wasn’t like him to interrupt his father, in fact, he prided himself on being respectful.. But something about this topic was gnawing into his brain in such a bizarre way. Screaming at him that this wasn’t right, no one should be thinking he would ever harm Mydeimos, not when that was the farthest thing he wanted to do.

Though, Kephale didn’t comment on the interruption - instead looking a bit more.. Relaxed, as if the snippy reply actually was comforting in some odd way as he stared and studied his son, “.. You’re sure of it? That prince is quite important for the future of our kingdom,”

“I know that,” Phainon laughed a little as he spoke those words - of course Mydeimos was important to the future of their kingdom. That man was the crown prince of Kremnos.. And someone that Phainon desperately and rather carnally desired to be closer to.

Those thoughts made him sigh a little, tilting his gaze to look at the wall in his own thoughts;  “He’s important to me, as well.”

Those words made Kephale’s expression flicker a little, looking as if he was trying to figure out what Phainon was trying to imply with those words, “Important to you?”

“I like him a lot,” Phainon explained tiredly, trying his best to figure out how to fully convey just how much he actually meant those words - instead suffering from his mind wandering a bit idly back to Mydeimos.

“.. I do not know what you mean by a lot, but get to know him a bit more before deciding such a thing,” Kephale instructed, and that was enough to make Phainon’s eyes and mind snap back to him - blinking blankly at his father who seemed a bit exasperated now,  “For the sake of our people.”

..? For the sake of our people?

Those words were confusing, odd to where it only made Phainon think again and again about what a good thing it was that he liked Mydeimos this much. Didn’t that decrease their chances of returning to war one day if the two future kings were fond of each other, and perhaps even more than merely ‘fond’? 

Phainon wasn’t sure how to figure out why it could ever be a bad thing, “Is it not a good thing that I’m fond of another kingdom’s prince? It would aid both our kingdoms..”

“Phainon,” Kephale sighed, letting his shoulders sink a little with his exhale as he seemed to try to get a grip on his thoughts - his eyes raising to look at Phainon once more in the eyes, “I am speaking merely as a worried father, not as a king.” 

That made Phainon move his hand from his hip - looking at his father with mute distress as he stared at the person who had raised him. Still feeling.. A little confused over what he was implying or meaning.

“I want my son to be happy and at peace, just like any father would.. I want you to make sure you know that man before you.. Take him somewhere you may regret,” Kephale explained with another full body exhale - one that made Phainon blink a little. Doing his best to comprehend but..

.. ‘Take him somewhere’..? That was assuredly meaning only one thing, and Phainon had to tut just a bit over it, closing his eyes over the idea of even doing that to Mydeimos. It was too soon, he couldn’t just drag that man around when he still growled and hissed at Phainon when he messed up even the tiniest of bits.

It was clear Mydeimos wasn’t ready for any of that.. Not yet. 

“.. I won’t overstep,” Phainon promised with a sigh, feeling a little bit sorrowful over the way he knew he really had no choice in this matter, “I want to take my time enjoying him.”

“We should work on your phrasing of things sometime,” Kephale mumbled after a moment - seeming a little uncomfortable to where Phainon found himself blinking at him. Doing his best to figure out why his father was saying something like that. 

Phainon could only innocently stare with those thoughts, “Did I say something wrong?”

Kephale, on the other hand, shook his head slowly - a quiet huff of laughter leaving his throat before he seemed to give up just a tad, “Just.. He is not in danger with you, correct?”

“Of course not,” Phainon agreed with a nod - a bit too eager as he found a smile coming to his lips.

If anything, he wanted to spar with Mydeimos - but to actually hurt the fellow crown prince? He had no desire in doing such a thing! He treasured that man so much already!

“That’s all I needed to know,” Kephale conceded before giving a nod back, a slow and steady movement of his head right back to his son, “Though.. The staff are becoming a bit wary over how you watch him sleep in the garden.”

.. Wary?

Phainon felt himself chuckling a little over that - his mind a little curious over why they even cared. It wasn’t as if he was hurting anything or anyone else. If anything, he was most at peace watching Mydeimos sleep around in the sun and lounge as if he was a cat. It was beyond endearing, and why would Phainon ever feel ashamed of watching him..?

“Wary? Why? Mydeimos hasn’t complained,” Phainon found himself pointing out with a lazy shrug of his shoulders - still not figuring out why anyone else would have an issue with it..

Kephale only gave him a narrowed stare - one that seemed like it was trying to bore into the depths of Phainon’s soul, “.. Does he know you watch him sleep?”

.. Ah.

Well, Phainon felt himself sweating a little over that; “Can.. I please be excused now, father?”

“That’s a no, correct?”

“Please.”

chapters.title: Chapter 5
chapters.html:
“May I ask you a question?” 

Mydei couldn’t help but find himself curious as he stared at that woman he had reported for duty to so many times before - watching the way she twirled on heel with a rather innocent yet curious expression. 

“Of course, Mydeimos!” That woman so happily said, and a piece of Mydei felt bad that he hadn’t even asked for her name in the days he had been here. But she didn’t seem bothered by it - if anything, she always looked as if she was holding in a laugh when she saw him.

Mocking or cruel? He had no idea, or perhaps it was just how she always looked, either way it wasn’t important.. Not when he had finally worked up the nerve to ask about a topic that kept lingering in his mind; “.. What are Prince Phainon’s special diet requirements?”

That instantly worked wonders as he watched the color leave her complexion, appearing as if she had so abruptly seen some type of ghost that now was haunting her - a ghostly visage that made her slowly swallow. All before laughing a little nervously, swaying between her feet as if she was uncomfortable shifting her weight between them while under Mydei’s studying gaze. 

“Ah.. Uhm..” She began, high-strung and tense, appearing like this was the worst question in the world he could have asked,  “Why are you asking about this?”

..?

Was this topic involving their prince really this harsh and taboo? Mydei was only wondering due to them talking about it several times before, but now she seemed to be so desperately bothered, as if she was praying for Mydei to leave her alone and looking away every chance she got. It was baffling, but Mydei could only assume they wanted their prince’s reputation to remain perfect.

.. To be weak to a little cheese and milk truly was a pathetic thing, but it wasn’t as if it was Phainon’s fault either.

“I found myself a little perplexed over it; Is it something to do with dairy?” Mydei conceded, not bothering to even try to lie about it as he tilted his head a little to the side - raising a brow as he waited for her reply. Only to watch her dart her eyes around the room; assuredly to other maids and servants to plead for aid.

None came however. 

“Uh.. No, not quite; I’m sorry, I’m not authorized to tell you about such things,” She said after a few heavy moments of Mydei only staring at her - doing his best to understand those words.

But those were curious in themselves.. 

“.. Authorized?” He echoed after a moment, feeling his mind stuck on whatever that phrasing was supposed to mean. Was his diet really that.. Forbidden to speak of? That sounded utterly insane to Mydei, but nothing about that prince made much sense anyways to him. 

“He’s a very private man..” She mumbled in a voice that sounded like she wasn’t sure whether to laugh or cry over those words. 

“.. I see,” Mydei hummed out, but he was lying.

He didn’t see or understand that at all. Not when Phainon was always nosing into Mydei’s business, though.. It wasn’t as if he had tried to learn about Phainon really, if anything, Mydei had answered questions but he knew nothing about Phainon. That man hadn’t told him much, but at the same time that was a little bit Mydei’s fault for never asking, wasn’t it?

Whatever, Mydei had to drop it and click his tongue a little idly - it’s not like he wanted to know too much about Phainon anyway, he could live without knowing.. 

Only for that woman to cut into his thoughts like they were butter, “Do you mind working with Hyacine again today? Bless her soul, she tries her best, but I fear she’s not very skilled with making pastries..”

He knew this song and dance very well, people had been.. A little more kind to him lately, but he also knew it was because Phainon was constantly lurking around him. They still opted to send him to work with Hyacine due to them both being outsiders - it was enough to make him sigh, but not enough for him to have a problem with it.

“I do not mind,” He nodded, because why would he ever have a problem working with someone he considered his friend? 

“Thank you!” That woman chirped, and Mydei didn’t hesitate before turning and walking away from her - doing his best to throw his thoughts about Phainon far, far from his mind.

Or well, he could just ask Phainon himself.. Whatever the case, his feet took him over to that familiar corner in the kitchen where he and Hyacine usually worked.

“Mydei,” Hyacine began without missing a single beat as Mydei moved beside her - his eyes focusing on her bowl of flour she seemed to already be attempting to work with, “Are you being nosy?”

.. Was he?

Mydei had to move his eyes a little over that - looking up at her to meet her gaze that seemed more amused and softly warm to him, as if she was beckoning him to confide in her. 

“.. I was just curious about his diet they whisper about all the time,” Mydei confessed with a quiet tone to his voice, not wanting to be too loud lest some other people snoop and eavesdrop on them,  “Sometimes I hear mutterings about how he had to hunt for his own meals.”

Mydei’s eyes couldn’t help but notice they still were making specifically strawberry snacks for that crown prince - blinking a little over it with a click of his tongue as his eyes roamed over the jam she already seemed to have prepared. At first he had assumed it was merely Phainon’s favorite fruit, but this all seemed a bit excessive considering they had said it was a ‘craving he couldn’t quite scratch properly’ when Mydei asked about it.

.. Curious how they answered about that, but not over like Phainon’s diet.

“Mm..” Hyacine hummed a little, “I know he really likes meat, but I’m never allowed to aid in preparations with it.” 

.. Meat preparations?

How in depth could his requirements and taste for meat really be? That was enough to make Mydei click his tongue a little before creasing his brows as he still was trying to gauge what Hyacine was working on. One thing he had learned over the days of knowing her; she was messy in the kitchen.

An utter chaos storm, she wasn’t very fond of pausing to organize anything - and that was what Mydei found himself doing in between correcting her methods for things. Already moving to steal one of the bowls while she seemed busy or distracted folding in some sugar into flour idly. 

Hyacine didn’t stop her rambles however, instead slamming her hands into the dough she seemed to be working on, “Something about how I’m ‘a dragon who may be trying to gobble up all his delicious foods’, which is insane. Do I seem that gluttonous to you?”

“No,” Mydei replied with a quiet sigh as he moved a little - looking at the jam she seemed to have already made in that bowl. Liquidy, but it would work.. 

.. It didn’t matter anyway, the headchefs had giggled something about how ‘the prince doesn’t mind as long as we tell him you worked on it!’, which was insane. Wouldn’t that just anger Phainon more to know an enemy fallen prince was in his kingdom messing up his food..?

The way this entire castle worked and functioned was more and more baffling to Mydei with every passing day.

“Exactly, if my horse was here I would show them ‘gobbling’ up food,” Hyacine huffed in a tone that made Mydei a little fearful - swallowing over the way she sounded more and more like his mother when she was perturbed at things, “Though, can I ask; why don’t you just ask the crown prince yourself? He seems a little.. Fond of you, in a way.”

“Hmph,” Mydei didn’t even know what to say outside of huffing at the idea of that.

Fond of Mydei? Mydei certainly wasn’t sold on that idea, even if the crown prince lingered around him and seemed so keen on speaking to Mydei - it didn’t go further than that. 

“Don’t make that noise at me, we’ve all taken note of how he checks in on you and stands in the doorway for a few seconds watching you,” Hyacine hissed at him all while still seeming to be working the warm water and yeast together in her bowl. An attempt that made him a bit worried as she cracked open an egg into it.

.. He didn’t want to think about nor count how many egg shells were already on the counter as his hands instead moved to pick them up languidly. 

“I prefer not to take note of that,” Mydei confessed between gently scooping them up - a bit thankful that they had a place for their trash right beside their station. Granted, that was a new feature - assumedly the other staff members had taken note of their.. Situation. 

“I think he’s pretty fond of your tail.. I’ve found him staring at it a few times before he noticed me looking at him,” Hyacine only continued to ramble onwards, as if she didn’t have a care in the world while pouring a little too much salt into the bowl, “He’s kind of scary about it..”

Those words were enough to make Mydei’s thoughts pause as he watched Hyacine’s bowl bubble a little; “Scary?”

Hyacine still didn’t look at him - instead she seemed so focused on the concoction she was brewing with a heavy sigh escaping her, “He looks like he’s fighting the urge to lunge at me sometimes.. I’m not sure how to explain it, but it’s like..”

Mydei found himself waiting for her to reply - his eyes only  able to worriedly watch the way she was immediately moving on to cutting the butter. Not even waiting before putting it into the same bowl and making Mydei tilt his head. He couldn’t read Elysian, but he was certain he knew how to make a pastry, and this.. This was not it. 

“If I look at him, he looks like he would growl at me, but when you look at him he perks up and starts wagging his tail and smiling.. You don’t think that’s a little odd?” Hyacine asked, throwing Mydei an odd stare that made him leisurely look at her. Doing his best to hide the pain he felt in his heart over whatever she was doing while cooking.

“.. I prefer not to think about his emotions and actions towards me most of the time,” Mydei muttered as he watched her put the flour into the bowl as well, not even hesitating to start folding it together with her spoon. 

Hyacine didn’t seem to buy that answer however - huffing a little over it, “Can you stop preferring to not note or think things about him? There’s a lot to gossip about here and you’re running from it..”

“.. You shouldn’t gossip about the crown prince, someone may hear,” Mydei was reprimanding her, sure, but it wasn’t as if he actually believed such nonsense. Not when it seemed to be a quite normal thing to gossip about the royalty here.

If anything, it made him wonder if the staff gossiped like this in Kremnos as well. 

“Sighs..”

That singular word did more than enough to make Mydei shake his head a little - trying to comprehend what Hyacine had just said, “Don’t.. Just say sighs out loud?”

“Mydei,” Hyacine started, turning a little before leaning on the counter - making him look at her with raised and curious brows, “Everyone gossips here, you and I have to band together because we are the outsiders and that’s why you are one of the girlies for now.”

“Girlies?” That was the only word he managed to echo out, feeling his mind confused and a bit dazed over that as he slowly blinked at her. 

He was a part of the.. Girlies?

.. What exactly did that mean?

Hyacine didn’t even seem like she was keen to explain it - sighing once more, “Sorry, the only other person I’ve been able to talk to as of late is my penpal Castorice..”

Though that.. Made Mydei furrow his brows together a little - doing his best to understand who Castorice could be. There was really only one option and that.. That was making him feel even more deranged that those two knew each other? 

“Princess Castorice? From Styxia?” Mydei asked, feeling a bit in a daze over the idea of them being friends, though.. He guessed it wasn’t that odd.

Not when he was the odd one out, really. He didn’t know any of the other young crown princes or princesses, all he knew were mute rumors of them and miniscule tidbits of information about each of them. The war being decades long had practically made them all strangers and legends to Mydei, nothing more.

Well, not anymore, he supposed. 

Hyacine did perk up a little at that; “Oh, you’re familiar with her?”

But.. Mydei found himself sweating, his eyes looking back to his mess of a workspace as he bit onto his tongue idly.

“.. A little, I fear Prince Phainon may have.. Tortured her a little regarding me.”

“Huh..” Hyacine hummed, all before laughing a little over her own thoughts apparently. “I say huh but no, she told me about this..”

“I’m surprised they let you send letters,” Mydei confessed quietly, all while he could feel his heart giving up on Hyacine’s work in progress, watching the way she had worked much too quickly for him to save it.

All he could do now was mourn as the butter seemed to not blend together well with her folding painfully. 

“Castorice requested it, and the friendship between Styxia and Aedes Elysiae is pretty close,” Hyacine absentmindedly explained, all before she seemed to glow a little - beaming Mydei such a warm smile that he almost winced over it, “Maybe you should get a penpal, too!”

“.. I do not think they would be as eager to allow me such a thing,” Mydei muttered out - also partly because he didn’t exactly know anyone to send letters to in the first place. “Castrum Kremnos is not.. Known for our friendly past with the other kingdoms..”

Though, Hyacine didn’t seem bothered at all by that - shaking her head and making those cute rolled up ponytails or whatever bounce with the movement, “Bah.. You’re just the crown prince! It’s not like keeping you happy while you’re here increases the chances of your kingdoms getting along better later on in life or anything.”

“.. Right,” Mydei mumbled out as he moved to begin his own bowl - putting more lukewarm water into it with yeast and a bit of sugar with a shake of his head as he borrowed them from Hyacine without a word of explaining why.

He was vaguely aware of the stare Hyacine was giving him over that as well; “What are you doing?”

“Restarting the pastry dough,” Mydei answered simply - only to immediately hear Hyacine sigh so painfully dramatically in response. 

“You hate me.”

Mydei felt himself clicking his tongue over that - doing his best to suppress the bubble of laughter that was brewing inside of him at those words. A smile on his lips as he quietly went about his work, enjoying the company of Hyacine with a fond emotion in his heart. At least with her, his work days weren’t painful.

Instead they felt a little vibrant - as if they had a touch of whimsy sewn into them while Hyacine told him the latest gossip she had been hearing. Whether it was about what maid had stolen some of the crown prince’s clothes as of late, or tales of her past days working here.

.. All seemed to somehow bring up Phainon; as if she was desperate to talk to Mydei about that man - and all he could do was sigh. Even as he was released from his work and moved to leave, he didn’t get very far walking down those now familiar halls.

“Mydeimos,” Mydei had to stop his feet at that - blinking to look at Phainon, his head craning a little to look at the way Phainon wasn’t smiling today.
