His voice had an odd edge to it, as if he was nervous or annoyed - and Mydei failed to wrap his mind around why that was as Phainon’s eyes danced around before meeting Mydei’s own. 

Not to mention the way his tail finally wasn’t wagging so happily - no longer giving Mydei a warning that he was nearing and looking so very stressed as he pressed his next question;  “Who is that pink haired dragon?”

.. Oh?

“Hmm?” Mydei curiously hummed, tilting his head a little over the way Phainon shifted his weight under Mydei’s stare so anxiously. As if he was nervous to even bring up this topic. 

“The.. The one you work with? You talk with her a lot during the day? Who is that?”

Ah.. He had a crush on Hyacine? Hyacine had said they had never spoken before, so had Phainon just avoided the kitchens until now? Mydei could understand if Phainon was enraptured by how small and cute she was, only able to chuckle a little over how bashful this dragon in front of him seemed now. 

“Oh,” Mydei cooed out before moving to cross his arms over his chest - a smile dancing on his lips, “A friend.”

.. Yet that only seemed to work and make Phainon look even more nervous - as if this was the worst news he had ever heard as his eyes dipped around and his jaw seemed to roll idly. As if he was tightening it out of stress before relaxing again - all to let out a quiet sounding chuckle. A nervous thing as his hand moved to rub the back of his neck. 

“A.. Friend?” Phainon quoted in a tone that sounded almost ghostly - a little choked as if he was struggling to figure out what to say. And Mydei couldn’t believe the way his pointed ears were drooping a little, his tail no longer wagging behind him as he looked so painfully sullen. 

All before Phainon awkwardly tilted his head with such a pathetic expression, “Mydeimos, are we friends?”

Was he wondering that so that he could ask Mydei to leave Hyacine alone? Assuming that if they were friends, his chances of making Mydei leave her to him was higher, perhaps? 

Whatever the case, Mydei huffed a little laugh over that - just a quiet exhale as he continued to keenly watch that over-sized puppy; “Why are you asking me these kinds of questions today?”

That question easily earned a look of shock from Phainon - his head jolting back a little all before he gave a shallow little laugh. A pathetic sounding attempt at laughter, an attempt to be smooth and hide the fact he was interested in Hyacine.

In a way, it was adorable - to see a grown ass man like Phainon with such an innocent little crush.. Mydei couldn’t help but laugh a tiny bit. 

“I’m.. I’m curious?” Phainon croaked out in his pained sounding voice - as if Mydei had asked him the worst question ever and Mydei had to roll his eyes over it. That was the least believable thing Phainon had said to Mydei so far, and with that explanation Mydei began his walk to his room. Deciding to forego his normal reading since.. It seemed Phainon would just be hounding him today over Hyacine if he did. 

“Since when are you so curious about who I talk to throughout the day?” Mydei idly asked, watching out of his peripheral vision as that large dragon moved to his side - not bothering to hide the way he was still smirking over it all while looking upwards at Phainon,  “Are you against me speaking to citizens of your kingdom?”

A pointed question, but he was rather enjoying watching Phainon squirm under the weight of those questions - unable to keep his smile back as that man gave him a look of almost horror.

“No! No, no, that’s not it..” Phainon weakly and so quietly began, seeming more and more like a sopping wet dog than anything else - his tail dragging behind him to where Mydei had to sigh over it,  “I just.. Mydeimos..”

Well, it did turn out Mydei was a little bit easy to guilt trip, giving a sigh over how Phainon seemed so depressed now that he had kept information about his love interest from him. 

“.. Her name is Hyacine, you would know that if you had spoken to her instead of only speaking to me for some reason,” Mydei snarkily told him, moving his eyes forward to instead ignore how that dragon still looked so depressed.

It wasn’t his problem if Phainon had been too shy to talk to Hyacine first; and if he was worried about competition, Mydei certainly was not competition.

.. He was one of the ‘girlies’ after all, whatever that meant. 

“Mydeimos, don’t be mad at me.. You sound mad at me..” Phainon whined at his side, making Mydei roll his eyes over how he still sounded so sorrowful - as if this was the worst day of his life.

It was enough to make Mydei shoot a glare at Phainon sharply. 

“I am not mad,” Mydei hissed to him, unable to keep himself from sounding more aggressive the longer that man pouted over Hyacine, “This is simply what I sound like.”

Phainon only seemed to lower his head even further at that - acting more and more like a scolded puppy than a giant dragon who would lead his country one day. Even making fake little sniffling noises as if that would help his case, “.. I cannot argue that, but your tail is lashing!”

.. Mydei had to force his tail to stop doing that - not even formally aware that it was as he clicked his tongue and slowed his steps a little. 

“Hyacine is a royalty from the kingdom of Aquila,” Mydei explained - darting his eyes to look at Phainon to his side again as Phainon raised his brows over hearing that, “Familiar?”

The least Mydei could do to try to make Phainon stop acting like Mydeimos had just buried his pet goldfish was to give him information on Hyacine. Certainly she couldn’t complain; she loved to gossip, after all. This was no different, right? 

“Mm..” Phainon hummed after a moment, looking a bit distracted by that new information as if he were doing his best to take it all in, “I’m not sure.. I’m not usually allowed to talk to foreigners..”

.. Well now, that was a bit strange to Mydei - feeling him pausing his steps as he moved into that familiar guest hallway. His eyes moving down in it in mute wonder if Hyacine also was in one of these rooms, before drifting his attention back to Phainon - watching him curiously while his own mind only continued to return to those odd words he had just said. 

“.. Not allowed to talk to them?” Mydei echoed after a few moments, staring at the way Phainon was shifting nervously while stopped with him - his eyes looking back and forth from Mydei to Mydei’s bedroom door. As if he was silently begging for Mydei to hurry up and leave so he could go hunt for Hyacine himself.

All before moving a hand to idly scratch at his neck - an odd thing that made Mydei tilt his head to stare at that collar around Phainon’s neck. For once noticing just how.. Red his neck was? 

.. A rash, maybe? 

“Ah! You’re fine though, Mydeimos! Don’t worry!” Phainon chirped after a few seconds after dropping his hand with a little forced laugh - high-strung and not sounding happy at all. 

Like he was forcing himself to say these odd things to Mydei now that he was obviously pining to go speak to Hyacine. 

“.. I may have preferred to be included in that,” Mydei confessed with a heavy sigh, shaking his head slowly over how insane this entire conversation seemed to him now. Moving to cross his arms over his chest before staring at the way Phainon moved just a step closer, leaning a bit more towards him as well with a small smile on his lips. 

One that looked like he was doing his best to comfort Mydei, or trying to disarm him. Whatever it was - Mydei could feel himself scowling a little as they made eye contact.

Not that it bothered Phainon, instead that prince laughed a little, “Cruel! It’s.. Everyone just worries for my safety, that’s all.”

“But not with the Kremnoan crown prince?” Mydei instantly countered curiously - raising one of his eyebrows to his hair line as he watched the way Phainon looked shocked to be asked such a thing. As if he himself had forgotten he was speaking to the crown prince of Kremnos and wasn’t just speaking to another servant in his kingdom.

Whatever the case was, Phainon gave a shy little chuckle over it - moving a hand to rub at the back of his neck as well, either out of nervousness or that rash on his neck. 

“Well.. I requested they stop following me around when I’m with you, actually..” Phainon confessed in a quiet tone, sounding more and more like he was scared of getting scolded for it.

Yet Mydei found himself only able to stare at that man - a bit flabbergasted that Phainon didn’t even perceive him as a threat at all; “Do you have some sort of death wish?”

“Nope! Well, uh..” Phainon moved a little - pausing to instead bring his hand to his face, scratching his cheek a little nervously, “Maybe a little, I don’t know. Sparring with you does sound fun, to be honest. I’ve thought about it a lot, you know? The time we fought.. I’d like to fight like that again, but less with our lives on the line.”

.. Sparring? That did sound enjoyable to Mydei, but he had to click his tongue over it; “Our lives being on the line was what made it exhilarating, you fool.”

There was no way that he would ever be allowed to spar with Phainon, anyway. Not when Phainon was their crown prince and his guards seemed so wary of Mydei. Even after telling them to leave him be, he still rarely spotted them lurking about. To duel or spar with that crown prince would be a foolish mission. 

“Ah.. Okay! You can try to kill me and I’ll just enjoy myself!” Phainon chirped out so happily - beaming a smile to Mydei which was.. Stunning to look at, beautiful - just like that man always was. But so very.. Confusing? 

Mydei really had no idea what this man was thinking - finding himself more and more confused the longer he stared at Phainon and watched him wiggle a little under his gaze. As if he was suffering and brewing in his own anxiousness while Mydei was trying to process what the hell this man was trying to say to him.

“.. Are you unwell?” Mydei timidly asked, unable to understand what the hell he was trying to say?

He wanted Mydei to try to kill him? Did he think that Mydei was so weak that he would be unable to harm Phainon in a way that actually mattered?

Mydei found himself clicking his tongue in pure annoyance with his own thoughts biting into him now. 

“No!” Phainon whined out, all while looking like he was so painfully depressed over all of this.

But that was enough to make Mydei huff out a little laugh - moving to place his hand on that door with such a heavy full body sigh escaping him. 

“Mhm,” Was all Mydei said before looking over his shoulder at that prince - shaking his head languidly, “Good night, Prince Phainon.”

“Good night, Mydeimos!”

Mydei huffed over how happy that man always sounded - as if he was doing his best to be as friendly as possible and for some reason.. Mydei found himself pausing as he opened his door - no longer looking at Phainon, and feeling himself unable to bring himself to. Instead staring at the white paint that he had grown so familiar with. 

“.. Mydei,” He corrected quietly.

Only to hear Phainon confusedly echo it from behind him,“Mydei?”

“It’s..” Mydei trailed off, choking a little as he tried to force himself to say what he was truly thinking,  “It is what I allow my friends to call me.”

The effect of that didn’t need to be vocalized - nor did Mydei even need to look at Phainon; why would he need to when he could hear that tail moving again. As if so earnestly excited to learn about Mydei, and for some reason it made Mydei feel almost.. Embarrassed? Nervous as he stayed staring at the door handle - holding it anxiously in his hand while refusing to look at Phainon.

“Mydei..” Phainon purred out in an odd tone that almost sent a shiver down Mydei’s back - much too seductive to where Mydei couldn’t help but look at that man in a daze, “You know you’re inadvertently telling me we’re friends..”

Mydei found himself blinking at the way Phainon’s tail was wagging too much - too quickly as Phainon seemed to be almost glowing. As if this was the best day of his life and Mydei for his own life couldn’t even figure out why.

Only able to quirk his jaw a little to the side, “Are you going to be bizarre about it?”

“No! I’m very happy, Mydei!” Phainon chirped out, swaying a little as he spoke with such an odd expression that made Mydei’s stomach churn in an odd way.

It was so bright and sunny, passionate and warm - yet it had such an odd edge to it that Mydei couldn’t help but feel like he was oddly.. In danger? That Phainon was looking at him as if he were something he could eat - a little meal or snack that Phainon was so eager to hunt.

It was off putting in such a way that Mydei struggled to convince himself to look away from Phainon - tearing his attention from him and fighting down the shivers he felt on his skin over not watching that man. 

“.. Good night, Prince Phainon,” That was all Mydei could manage before moving into his bedroom and shutting that door at the same time Phainon happily said good night as well. 

“Good night, Mydei!”

Mydei didn’t waste a single moment before bracing himself against that door - pressing it closed with his own body before leaning his forehead onto it as well. For some reason, he could feel the way his heart had sped up - roaring in his ears all while he struggled to get his mind in the right place. 

.. That look shouldn’t have been so eerie to him, it shouldn’t have made him dread turning his back on that man; and yet his mind kept thinking of the odd darkness lurking in them. Such a deep hunger that Mydei almost didn’t know what to place it as - an emotion he had never once seen aimed at him so sharply.

An emotion that made him feel his cheeks burning with his own embarrassment every time he found the answer for the name of that expression dancing in Phainon’s eyes. 

Lust. 

That was the only emotion that Mydei could name that those eyes seemed fully engulfed in.

And that was precisely why he had to sigh so heavily, doing his best to wish Hyacine luck with whatever Phainon was feeling towards her.

chapters.title: Chapter 6
chapters.html:
“This..” 

That trailed off word was enough to make Phainon look upwards - meeting the gaze of turquoise eyes that looked more than merely a little worried, “This is a bit stressful.”

Phainon found himself humming over that - it was a little amusing in a sickening way. He shouldn’t find the way she was so obviously uncomfortable entertaining when technically she had done nothing wrong to him. But Mydei’s eyes were on her, and only her. 

.. Making her squirm a little couldn’t hurt anything, could it? Not when Phainon wanted to pout over the fact Mydei seemed more fond of her when he was trying so hard! What was he doing wrong?!

“Is it? I’m just eager to meet Mydei’s friends!” Phainon chirped out as he moved his head to rest on his hand - staring at the way she had barely touched any of the snacks he was offering to her as they sat alone at that garden table. His tail only idly smacked into the floor at his side as he refused to look away from her - studying her every move.

Small.

She was incredibly small, and if anything, cutesy more than anything else. Did that interest Mydei? Was Phainon really simply too big to even be considered an option for him, or was it something else?

.. Was it because they were both males? Mydei had said he didn’t have a problem being a clutch mother, but was that a lie in the spur of the moment to try to appear better or something? Was he just nervous? They didn’t need to have children if Mydei was uncomfortable with the thought, or they could adopt.

Sure, their kingdoms would be furious over it, but Phainon was willing to make it work!

Regardless of Phainon’s own derailing thoughts as he stared at ‘Hyacine’, she didn’t seem convinced by his words anyway, “Is.. Is that true?”

Phainon found himself humming out a little laugh - such a quiet sound as he innocently raised a brow, “Mm? Why would it not be?”

“Forgive me, Lord Phainon..” Hyacine immediately began as she shifted in her chair yet again - her eyes keeping contact with Phainon’s own all while looking more and more distressed with Phainon’s own prolonged eye contact. As if he was looking at her oddly, and perhaps he was; he didn’t really care to change his expression either way.

Hyacine pursed her lips a tiny bit before beginning again, “But you seem quite bothered, all your body language says is how angry you are at me..”

.. His body language?

That was more than enough to make him remove his hand from his lazy position, no longer leaning on it in the trade of leaning back into his chair with his fingers tapping at the glass slowly. So very aware of the way Hyacine’s eyes flickered to watch his fingers move. 

All before he gave another laugh at that - unable to help himself as he cocked his head to the side innocently, “Don’t be silly, I’m not angry!”

Those words weren’t a lie - and yet they still had such a dangerous lilt to them that not even Phainon could ignore it. He couldn’t help but clip his own words, borderline biting them out as his mind continuously reminded him that this girl was what Mydei liked. This was the type of person he preferred over Phainon, and that.. 

“.. Are you not?” Hyacine asked, looking more and more worried as she tried to figure out how Phainon ticked - but he could only laugh again at that. 

“I’m jealous,” He hissed out instead, he wasn’t angry - nor was he furious at her. He was unmistakably jealous that she had something Mydei liked, that she was drawing his attention, and that she had earned those small soft smiles from Mydei.

He enjoyed all of Mydei’s emotions to him, but they had all been with rather negative connotations - never once reaching the small sweet smiles Mydei chose to give to Hyacine instead. It was a little infuriating, sure, but it was mainly enough to make him feel insane in his own jealousy. 

But that only worked to make Hyacine’s eyes widen as if she were some type of owl, “Jealous?”

Her voice sounded rapt with disbelief, as if she couldn’t understand the idea of the crown prince being jealous towards her - so heavy in her inability to believe that it made Phainon click his tongue a little in annoyance. Did she care so little for Mydeimos that she hadn’t even noticed it herself..?

“Seething with it, really,” Phainon confessed as he moved to wave his hand idly - sighing so dreadfully loudly that it almost made him laugh over how dramatic it sounded to his own ears. But he wasn’t lying. How could he be lying when he had to sit there and merely.. Watch.

“The way he laughs with you.. The way he smiles at you.. What have I done to not earn that?” Phainon asked as he leaned his head back enough to gaze upwards at the sunsetting sky - nearly fighting the urge to glare at it as he rolled his tongue behind his lips. Unable to satiate the growing annoyance and spite in his veins when he thought again and again of his own failings with that man. 

Only for Hyacine to look more and more baffled - shocked even as she shook her head slowly with those words from Phainon, “‘He’? Lord Phainon, if you mean Prince Mydei I-”

“He lets you call him Mydei?” Phainon interrupted, unable to help himself as he felt a snarl burning into his lips. 

Of course she was allowed to call him that, Mydei himself had said his friends were allowed to use such a name, and yet.. And yet.. Phainon was sitting here burning in his own envy - feeling as if it would choke him until he died on his own spit and venom at this rate. 

Though, his jealousy seemed palpable in the air and his hissed out words from the way Hyacine seemed to twitch a little over them, “Yes.. I have permission to call him that..”

Phainon had to hang his head a little in defeat over those words - dejected, hollow, and feeling like all of the joy had been sucked out of him; but he couldn’t do anything about it. If this was what Mydei wanted.. He just had to try harder, right? 

That was all he could think while keeping his index finger tapping at the table - staring at it a little before looking at her yet again; “.. Is it because you’re small and cute? Is that what he prefers in a mate?”

“I.. I think you have misunderstood something, Prince Phainon,” Hyacine spoke in such a hushed tone - as if she was scared of being reprimanded for it right now. And Phainon could only sigh over that. 

“Speak freely. I do not, he prefers your company ov-”

“Do you know the story of Queen Gorgo and King Eurypon falling in love?” Hyacine cut in, obviously uptaking the ‘speak freely’ part without much of a complaint - only to make Phainon leisurely blink at her while sitting up a little.

That was.. An interesting question to be asking right now. Was she a friend of their family and Phainon had no clue of it? 

Phainon couldn’t help the way he was instantly intrigued by this - removing his hand from the table to instead straighten himself out. Sitting up and politely looking at Hyacine with his full attention on this topic; “.. Mydei’s parents?”

“Correct,” Hyacine confirmed with a little nod, now moving to grab one of those pastries as if she knew she had placed Phainon into check and was merely waiting to end the game.

And Phainon was powerless before her to do a single thing about it anyway;  “.. No.”

“They say it was a romantic story like no other,” Hyacine began with such a dramatic sigh before taking a bite of her food. A tiny bite, one that made Phainon feel his eyes twitch a little over how dainty she was through and through. All before she swallowed and began to speak again,  “As it goes, the rumors say Queen Gorgo fell first, yet King Eurypon fell harder.”

Phainon had to confess; he knew next to nothing about the affairs of Kremnos, let alone whatever stories of romance were buried within the kingdom’s walls. It was an interesting topic for sure, but it was never anything he was able to dig deeper into. 

No one could, anyway. It wasn’t as if Castrum Kremnos was known for being eager to tell their stories of love, not war, in the time of.. Well, war..

Hyacine only continued on, “Now, Mydeimos is allegedly just like his mother in looks.. But who knows about his personality, after all, Kremnos wasn’t friendly with any of us.”

.. Allegedly?

Phainon had to blink over that; had Hyacine never seen Queen Gorgo before? Because Phainon certainly could agree that Mydei looked more like his mother than his father. But he hadn’t even thought about the fact that most people probably had no idea whether these rumors were true or false.

.. For some reason it made him a little giddy to be able to have a say in it - to know Mydei on a level that others didn’t and have the ability to say that he did look like his mother. It was such a simple thing, and yet it easily filled him with delight. 

Phainon chose not to comment on that - instead watching and waiting for Hyacine to continue as she seemed to be relaxing more and more. Taking her sweet time to nibble at that treat that she had finally decided to eat. A thing that Phainon had set between them to be polite, but now he felt a bit shocked over how she was eating them right now.

Hyacine once again continued regardless of his own bafflement towards her, “What’s important about Eurypon and Gorgo, however, is the fact that Eurypon never truly looked her way until losing in a duel versus her.”

“.. A duel?” Phainon echoed out without even being able to stop himself - an action that made Hyacine give him a little knowing look. The look that Phainon had gotten from his teachers in school when they knew he was fibbing and yet they were choosing their battles with the young prince wisely. That, that was the look Hyacine was giving to him now.. 

“Kremnoans value strength and honor quite highly, and to be blunt, Lord Phainon.. Do you really believe I’m on a mission to fight Mydeimos, let alone win?” Hyacine asked, and that made Phainon jerk his head back a little - feeling as if he had been slapped by those words,  “Forgive me, but I have no interest in that..”

.. This wasn’t a situation like Mydei’s parents, however. This was already unfolding so painfully different that it made Phainon’s stomach curdle in pain when he thought about it for too long. That familiar anxiety biting and gnashing into every reach of his body as he tried to stop it - powerlessly sniffling a little. 

“.. Yet it’s not a story like his parents; he has interest in you already,” Phainon pointed out, only to feel a little bit flabbergasted over the way Hyacine had sighed dramatically over that. Clicking her tongue and shaking her head as if she absolutely could not believe the crown prince was arguing with her right now.

“Prince Phainon, forgive me.. But no he does not,” Hyacine told him in a tone that sounded more and more exasperated - as if she couldn’t even believe she was trapped talking to Phainon today. And that was enough to make him stop moving the tip of his tail - staring at her in wait.

Phainon really couldn’t find it in himself to believe her with just those few words; “How can you be so sure?”

“I’ve seen the looks he gives me when I mess up cooking recipes. It’s more like a very disappointed father than someone who.. I don’t know.. Stands in the doorway and watches the person they’re interested in daily?” Hyacine hummed out - making Phainon slowly blink at her as she moved to lean into her chair a little. Her head slowly moving from side to side to force those ponytails to bounce with the movements, “He thinks I don’t see the grimaces, but I do.”

“He still has patience with you.. I..” Phainon trailed off, finding him a bit unsure of how to argue against her when he really didn’t know Mydei well enough. He couldn’t simply  easily say if that was normal, or if having less patience for Phainon was a good thing.

.. Could Mydei be playing hard to get? Surely not, right? That sounded like an insane thing for a crown prince to be doing to a fellow crown prince, and yet.. Phainon had to move a little to put his elbows back on the table - not wasting even a moment before putting his head in his hands and groaning a little. 

Hyacine was remarkably quiet while Phainon was whining, all before he moved his fingers the tiniest of bits to peek at her - only to see her looking as if she had seen a ghost. Sitting across from him and merely leisurely eating her sweet treat as if there wasn’t a grown ass man across from her having a breakdown.

All before Phainon dropped his hands with a heavy sigh, which seemed to work wonders in making her speak again; “Lord Phainon, if he let me send out a bad pastry batch I think he would kill himself and I both, please have mercy.”

A bad pastry batch. 

Phainon had been getting a lot of sloppy treats as of late, and he hadn’t minded due to the fact Mydeimos had been in the kitchen working on them. But now he had to idly wonder if they were just using Mydei as an excuse.. Whatever the case - he felt himself leaning back again, hands outstretched on the table in front of him as he fully tilted his head back to stare at the sky above. 

“I think I like him,” Phainon confessed as he kept his eyes on the vibrant red and oranges hues of the sky, only dully noting how even that made him think so fondly of that man - sniffling a little over how he wanted to see him more and more. 

“I’m sure, Lord Phainon,” Hyacine replied in a quiet tone. 

Phainon had to sigh over it, “I think I like him a lot..”

“I’m sure, Lord Phainon,” Hyacine replied in a now more flat and quiet tone, sounding like she really was not being paid enough for this right now. 

Phainon had to lower his head back down to the current reality he was in. Ignoring the sky above him in favor of staring at that pink puffball in front of him with tired eyes. Doing his best to try to not see her as some sort of competition, only to click his tongue; “Do.. You talk to him a lot, right? Do you think I have a chance with him?”

“Yes, Lord Phainon,” Hyacine told him without missing a beat, as if she had already been thinking about that before this matter was even brought up to her. And well.. That made him wonder just what all Hyacine and Mydei actually whispered about in the kitchen.

Surely he wasn’t a name that was brought up too much, right? How could he be when he had barely interacted too much with Mydei? Though, maybe he made some.. Impressions? Good or bad, it had to mean at least something?

Phainon couldn’t help himself but to feel a bit of disbelief in the topic, “Really?”

Hyacine looked down with the question - as if she was a bit uncomfortable over being asked something so simple. All before she shook her head slowly, “Well.. Truthfully speaking, it’s forbidden for dragon-blooded people of different bloods to mix..”

That..

Phainon found himself moving to cross his arms over his chest - a habit of Mydei’s that he now was finding comfortable as well. Sitting there as he thought about those old time traditions that still kept everything so tight in every kingdom. 

“.. I know that,” Phainon mumbled under his breath, knitting his brows in his new found worry that Kremnos may treasure those rules close to their heart just like they valued the meaning taught to them by the dragon Nikador. Whatever the case, Phainon just.. Wanted to try love, at the very least. 

“I’m unsure how willing he would be to break such a.. Tradition and rule; after all, they claimed it was to limit how much power a kingdom had with draconic blood in their veins,” Hyacine hummed in a hushed tone, seeming  less than convinced over the idea of Mydei wanting to mix their draconic bloods together.

It made sense, no one was allowed to do such a thing - and it most likely would start up some type of war, yet Phainon couldn’t help the affection he felt for that dragon. The way his heart sped up when he even thought of Mydei or tried to think of anything else to pull his mind from him. 

.. It was obvious to himself that he wanted Mydeimos desperately badly, and the fact that old laws and rules or traditions were a limiting factor.. That was more than a little tiresome to Phainon’s mind. 

Regardless, Phainon felt himself whining a little over that, “We don’t.. Have to breed or anything like that right away.. We could take our time with children..”

Though, even as he felt downtrodden, he couldn’t help but notice the way Hyacine was giving him an expression that was completely in disbelief. As if Phainon was saying something insane to her right now. 

“Uh huh.. No, I’m sure you can wait, that’s why you asked him about his heat cycles and his nesting? And if he would be willing to mother a clutch?”

Ah.

Phainon had to dart his eyes away at that - sniffling a little fakely over the way he had easily been called out and taken out back to be executed. 

Phainon took a minute before daring to slide his eyes back to her, feeling more and more like a scolded pet dog as he blinked at her - pleading a little for mercy, “.. He told you all that?”

“Mhm,” Hyacine hummed in mute amusement, seeming like this  topic was both horrifying to her - and probably a little funny, “He was a bit offended, I had to do some heavy lifting for you to convince him that you might just be eager to befriend him.”

Phainon felt himself jerking back a little over those words - his mind running amuck as he tried to comprehend what Hyacine was saying to him right now, “.. Offended? I didn’t mean to offend him.. Ever!”

“I know, I figured as much and told him such,” Hyacine confirmed with a little nod of her head, looking almost bored as she moved to finish off her pastry - clearly unbothered by the fact Phainon still hadn’t eaten at all, “Mydei just seems a bit.. On guard, right now.”

“On guard..” Phainon echoed out without much of a second thought, feeling as if he were in some type of daze as he blinked at her - trying his best to already try to riddle out how to make Mydei more comfortable in Aedes Elysiae in his mind..

“He’s a prince in a foreign land with no one he knows here, it’s natural for him to be on edge,” Hyacine explained with a shrug of her shoulders, and Phainon almost wanted to ask her if that’s how she had felt being here but.. They probably didn’t know each other enough for that, and it wasn’t as if he had made a good impression.

He could only sigh and slowly move a hand to the back of his neck, rubbing it absentmindedly, “Right.. Right.. So, I need to give him time and space to get used to me before I ask about children?”

Hyacine studied him for a moment after that - staring him down all before cocking her head to the side, “.. Maybe we should start from a different stage one approach, Lord Phainon.”

“Why? If he has my children, he won’t think about leaving me anymore,” Phainon pointed out with confusion running rampant on his own features. He didn’t think he was wrong at all in his mindset, even if they adopted children - they would make Mydei more likely to stay in Aedes Elysiae, and Phainon was desperate..

“There’s.. A lot to unpack with both of you, one thinks the other wants him executed, and the other wants to make sure the other doesn’t ever leave,” Hyacine conceded, making Phainon feel a little confused over what she meant by those words, “How am I going to fit this all in my letter to Castorice..?”

“Castorice? You’re friends with her?” Phainon found himself questioning that almost immediately, feeling as though the Mydei half of what she said was more for him to ask Mydei personally later. 

“Mhm.. She’s going to be thrilled to hear about how much you like Mydei, I hear you two were great guests when she was trapped between you both,” Hyacine dramatically sighed out, though that made Phainon feel more and more like a scolded child - hanging his head a little in his shame, “Not to worry though, Lord Phainon! I’ll talk with the fellow nurses and ask for some zinc supplements for you!”

..?

Why was she suddenly giving Phainon suggestions with his vitamins? Phainon couldn’t wrap his mind around it at all as he tilted his head to the side as if being at a forty five degree angle would help him in this scenario. 

“.. Zinc? Why do I need more of that? Was it something I said?”

“Absolutely.”

────────────── 

Phainon couldn’t help the way his feet had dragged him to the baths today - he had barely seen Mydeimos at all before that dragon snuck off into his own bedroom. Only able to sneak a few glances to him during his working hours with Hyacine at his side - and then he had opted for dragging Hyacine away for a chat.

.. A foolish chat, considering the way Hyacine had seemed almost revolted at the idea of Mydei being interested in her. Phainon would have been insulted for Mydei, if not for the way he instead felt so painfully relieved over it.

Though, he really hadn’t expected the hour long discussion about how to properly breed another dragon-blooded person.. Nor did he expect her to explain why she was going to get him more zinc in his diet for better breeding as well; that all was baffling to Phainon considering he expected her to be his competition for Mydei’s hand.. Not.. Trying to help him with Mydei in such a lewd fashion. 

Still, it gave him much to think about as he moved into the bath quarters - sighing a little as he found his way to his own private bathing area, not so much as blinking an eye as he closed the curtains behind him only to hear people scrambling after him. Always too eager to tend to him in every single way. 

“My lord,” A man from behind began, and Phainon didn’t even bother looking at him - already undoing the buttons on his shirt with a tiredness seeping into his bones as they continued to speak, “Would you desire a bath?”

“.. Yes,” Phainon conceded without any fight at all, instead just tearing fabrics off of himself all while his eyes moved to watch the way people were immediately scrambling about with the sounds of water beginning to rumble in his ears. 

That same voice spoke again, “I’m glad! You’ve been ignoring us for a few days, we miss you dreadfully so.”

Phainon barely paid them any mind as he instead moved to undo his pants with a shaky breath - unable to stop his mind from returning to Mydei again and again. He at least.. Felt a bit better that Hyacine didn’t seem interested in Mydei, but Phainon couldn’t help but be wary that Mydei may feel more for Hyacine regardless.. 

Though, Phainon’s eyes only warily moved to look at that steaming pool of water in the center of the room - elegant and engraved with marble. A perfect bath for Phainon, but now he only had one man on his mind as he thought about how warm it must be.

“Is there a way to get hot water into a bedroom?” Phainon absentmindedly asked as he already handed his clothes to a servant who looked much too eager to be given them - not that Phainon could force himself to care about that right now.

Not when his mind kept reminding him of the way Mydei was bathing in the cold and alone.. It felt unfair.. Why was he forcing himself to suffer in such an odd way when Phainon would happily share his bath waters with him?

“Mm? For you, anything is possible. Are you wishing to bathe in your room today?” That eager servant who had been talking to him asked, but Phainon had to press out a inaudible sigh over that. 

“No.. Not for me,” Phainon muttered as he moved into that bathwater - not hesitating at all before practically flopping down into the steaming waters. The heat never bothered him, if anything, everyone had always told him he was much too hot to the touch. So steaming baths like this wasn’t a problem - if anything, the burn that tingled against his skin was a bit soothing in a way. 

Even if now he was moving his eyes to watch that attendant move to the side of his bath, enough to be in eyesight from Phainon as if he was so desperate for his attention. 

“Ah,” The man hummed out, all before shaking his head slowly,  “Then most likely not.”

Right.

Phainon always was treated differently than others, and that would only be more true for a foreign prince who called himself a ‘prisoner’ while here, huh? Not even an actual guest..

“.. I see,” Phainon murmured, feeling more and more hopeless as he tried to ransack his brain a little bit more for ideas to make Mydeimos more comfortable.

“You seem.. A bit sullen over being told that! Do you wish for us to bring you some fruits to enjoy during your bath? A massage?”

Phainon moved his eyes a little to fully focus on that man - sinking a bit deeper into the baths before looking forward at the faucet where the water was flowing from. Idly watching the way someone else was already putting baths into the waters before he pressed out a quiet sigh over those questions. 

“No, I just.. Need to get my mind off a few things,” Phainon admitted with a heavy sigh, darting his eyes to that man once more, “Do you think love at first sight is real?”

He couldn’t help but watch the way that person squirmed a little - seeming as if he was suddenly so painfully nervous. As if this was a question he had never expected from his prince in his entire life, but Phainon found his own expression blank. Merely watching and waiting for an answer to be given to him. 

“P-Pardon me, your highness?” He began all before laughing a little nervously - seeming as if he was sweating too much under Phainon’s unwavering and probably a bit eerie gaze,  “I.. I’m unsure! But if you think so, then I must agree!”

.. Right, that’s how it went in his life. If he says something; people would agree and nod to him, huh?

Though, that man only continued with a beaming smile, “Who is the lucky lady?”

.. Lady?

Phainon felt himself clicking his tongue over that, sinking just a bit more into that hot as could be bath with a heavy sigh; “.. That’s private.”

He forgot that people would be expecting him to find a little princess, some girl willing to bear his eggs and weren’t even entertaining the idea of making a draconic prince carry his clutch or to wed.. 

“Oh, my apologies, my lord..” That man seemed more than a little embarrassed, though he cleared his throat as someone else immediately moved to the side of Phainon - settling a plate beside his arm on the outside of the bath slowly, “Though, I hope you’re not against some strawberries? We went ahead and pre-gathered some for you since you’ve been in the mood as of late..”

Phainon had said no to those, but he had to sigh over it as well - they probably had run off to get them as soon as he so much as stepped in the public bathing area. Now he could only stare at them in mute fascination, “Strawberries..”

Phainon couldn’t help but move his hand to pick up one of those fruits by the stem of it, slowly twirling it between his clawed fingers as he inspected it. Pristine, the perfect fruit waiting to be bitten into and devoured - and yet Phainon found himself sighing over what he truly wanted to sink his teeth into and taste. 

His forked tongue only languidly moved to run across the sharpened bottoms and tops of his teeth with a heavy sigh.

“Y-Yes?”

“Do you think the crown prince of Castrum Kremnos likes strawberries?” Phainon asked in a quiet tone, only moving to push his middle finger into that fruit - breaking the flesh of it to watch the pinkish red hued liquid immediately roll down his thumb.A mess, but he was already in the bath anyway as he watched it slowly dribble from where Phainon pressed down more and more. 

The strawberry was so tender, so ripe and ready to spill that he couldn’t help but to hum over the sight - watching the glistening juice only slide down his finger a bit more. Basking a little in the way it seemed to come undone with such a simple movement of his finger - flesh giving way to let him do as he pleased..

“Uh..” That man began, only to make Phainon’s eyes slowly move to look at him in a studying way, “F-Forgive me, your grace.. I’m.. I do not know a thing about their crown prince to have a true say in it; but are the Kremnoans not.. Barbaric?”

That was an odd sentence, one that made him slowly move to put that strawberry down and to the side with a sloppy movement as he forgot what he was once so amused by. A piece of him debated smashing it to bits in his hand while staring at that man, but instead he couldn’t do that to it. Not when it reminded him so much of Mydei, even if he wanted to mark Mydei with his claws and fangs.. Something so cruel wasn’t in the cards for Mydeimos.

Not from Phainon.

“.. Barbaric?” Phainon repeated as he moved to lick that juice from his own fingers - looking away from that man since well.. That wasn’t a sight meant for him, languidly licking up the sweetness with his tongue with a heavy sigh on his lips.

He missed Mydei so much. 

“I’m not sure they would do anything but crush the fruits in their hands and make a mess of it,” That man explained as if Phainon himself hadn’t just done the same thing, making his tongue pause before he gave a small chuckle of laughter over how idiotic that was. 

“.. Is that so?” Phainon asked tiredly, unable to even process his own emotions as he slowly looked at his nails. Tracing over just how sharp they were leisurely, all before looking at that man yet again. 

“Well.. You’ve never read a Kremnoan cooking book, have you?” That man asked, making Phainon his head to the side as he waited to hear what he had to say. Only for that man to laugh so heartedly - seeming as if he was telling the funniest joke ever, “They don’t exist!”

That man only seemed to laugh more as he explained that - seeming as if his own sides would tear open as he continued to laugh at his own joke.

Only for Phainon to cock his head a little, “Interesting..”

He didn’t buy that at all.

It was clearly just meant to be a dig at Kremnoans, to insult them, especially considering the way Mydei’s eyes had twinkled when he first stepped into the kitchen, let alone the library. There was no world in which this man was being honest and not just trying to make a mockery of the person Phainon found himself hopelessly enamored with. 

That seemed to be more than a little apparent to that man as he now awkwardly shuffled his weight. Looking as though he was now once again nervous instead of laughing alone at his own joke; “Well.. You, ah.. Seem like you’re not in the mood for chatting today, so I will leave you be!” 

“Mhm,” Phainon hummed as he watched that man immediately moving, so quickly that Phainon couldn’t help but follow him with his eyes as he watched him go. Lurking and lingering in the water all while watching that yapper leave.

Not that it mattered.

Phainon would assuredly remember his face. 

“Take care, my lord..”

Phainon felt himself clicking his tongue in his annoyance over that - unable to stop the way he sank a little into his bath all while his eyes stared forward. Even if this was his private bath area, even if only the people allowed in here were himself and his staff; he really wouldn’t mind having Mydeimos in here, as well. 

His mind couldn’t even stop returning to Mydei either, thinking a bit deeply on what Hyacine had told him - the way she had gone into depth of what position to put Mydei into to make sure the clutch of eggs takes better inside of him. He had been a bit fascinated by it.. But more so baffled over why she was being so detailed about it.

“I’m curious to see how it goes, from a medical standpoint, at least,” She had explained, all before sighing dreadfully loudly and leaning back in her chair, “And as Mydei’s friend, I want to see him happy.”

Phainon truthfully just had to assume it was her pulling out every method to make sure he never tried to speak on this topic with her again; but who knows. Regardless, he had taken a little bit of note that she seemed to have some sort of medical history; enough to where he had to hum and note them down in his mind for later.

All while sinking more and more down into his bathwater - up to his nose with only his hair remaining dry, his eyes coyly watching the way people wordlessly were moving to begin washing him. Already greedily picking up his tail to move washcloths against his scales and he couldn't help but feel a little displeased over it.

His eyes watched as they moved, all while staying silent, all while wishing endlessly that it was Mydei washing him - or that he could wash Mydei.. Either way.. He didn’t mind.. He just.. He just wanted Mydeimos to understand him, was that truly such a crime?

Mydei couldn’t help but to intrude a little on Hyacine’s space - leaning just a tad to look into the box she was sitting down with a heavy sigh escaping her. All while Mydei found his eyes roaming the contents. 

Powdered dyes and wax..? That was obviously to make candles, but why on earth was Hyacine lugging it around?

“What is that for?” Mydei asked with a quiet hum, his eyes rolling over the contents in there again and again before moving his hand to tug at the collar of his shirt a bit idly. 

They were working in the garden today, a rarity, but apparently they had special permission from the prince - and that was why Mydei now had been on his hands and knees for hours plucking weeds and huffing a little. It was work he fully enjoyed, sure, but there was something odd about the way he could feel eyes on him always.

Phainon, assuredly, but they just seemed so much.. Heavier now. A weight in Mydei’s mind even when he tried his best to ignore the scorch of them - only able to slowly move his tail back and forth as he tried to ignore whatever the hell was wrong with that prince that was lurking about the area. 

“This? Apparently it’s for candles,” Hyacine explained simply, but Mydei had to click his tongue over it - staring at the mess in that box. Really, the more eerie thing there had to be the white dyes and the red dyes - did they not desire any other colors outside of those two? 

Strange, considering how they seemed so very.. Fond of the color blue in this kingdom. But he had to opt to throw his thoughts out, instead blinking his eyes and raising them to stare at Hyacine dully. 

“Candles? Why do they suddenly have you tending to bees for candles..?” Mydei was genuinely curious, mainly due to the fact he didn’t even know where the bees were. Somewhere outside the castle walls, apparently, which was why he had been herded into the gardens instead and kept under supervision from the other staff members working out there.

.. And Phainon, of course. 

“I don’t know.. Some holiday but they’re not very big on explaining it,” Hyacine sighed out, shaking her head before waving her hand a bit idly, “Something to do with Oronyx?”

Oronyx.

That was a name that was brought up a lot in this kingdom, written in their books and leaving tracks everywhere - all while Mydei could barely make any sense of them.

Mydei moved languidly to stand up at that, sighing a little as he rolled his wrists inside of his gloves tiredly, “Their dragon? A celebration of them, then?”

“I suppose so, it’s never been too clear on their stance towards Oronyx,” Hyacine replied without missing a beat, making Mydei hum a little over that. 

They worshipped Oronyx, didn’t they? That was common in kingdoms to worship the dragon who had given humans their blood and continued to serve them, but.. Why did Hyacine seem a little bit unconvinced of such an idea? 

“What do you mean? The books that.. I borrowed had many lines praising them,” Mydei inquired, feeling his brows knitting together as he instead stood there and stretched a little - straightening himself out before looking in that box a little bit more. Moving to examine the contents of it before humming a little.

That.. Certainly was merely a mix of waxes to make candles, which was enough to make Mydei’s eyes wander away from it. Instead looking around the garden and studying the sheer amount of boxes coming in now - never allowing himself to mess up and glance to that prince who was lurking in the darkness just behind the walls, however. 

.. If he did that, the dragon would surely come over here.

Regardless, he couldn’t even riddle out why this kingdom would suddenly need so many candles. Were they making a giant altar to the dragon or something? 

Though, Hyacine was a bit stuck on something else; “You can read Elysian?”

Ah.. Mydei had to bring his eyes back down to her - staring for a moment before feeling his jaw twitch uncomfortably under her accusatory stare. There was no getting around this, was there? Now he had to confess to the weird favors the crown prince of Aedes Elysiae had taken upon himself, huh? 

Mydei heaved out such a heavy sigh at that, closing his eyes before moving a hand to his face and pinching the brow of his nose for a moment before shaking his head, “.. No, Prince Phainon translated them for me.”

That was such a simple thing, and yet his face burned with the admission. He felt like he was being judged so painfully harshly as Hyacine only slowly gave him such an odd smile. A knowing smile, one that seemed like she was actually having the time of her life suddenly as she shifted her weight a little and Mydei.. Didn’t dare question the way her eyes moved to the side.

Right to where he knew Phainon had been leaning against the wall and keenly watching him for so long. 

“Wow,” She hummed, and Mydei couldn’t help the way he felt his tail lash abruptly to the side over how he knew his goose was cooked, “He’s translating entire books for you now?”

Her voice was so dreadfully full of whimsy and teasing that Mydei couldn’t help but click his tongue a little. Sighing as he moved to remove his gloves since he was done pulling weeds from here, anyway. 

He could only weakly try to reprimand her, “.. Don’t say it in that tone.”

“You know,” Hyacine began, and Mydei had the sickening feeling that he wasn’t sure he wanted to know even if he did,  “He did speak to me yesterday.”

.. That was a bit odd, he had to admit that much as he tugged his second glove off - pausing a little to stare at her before tilting his head just the tiniest of bits to the side; “Hmm?”

Though, Hyacine only looked a little coy over that - her normally soft and warm smile turning into one that was full of knowing. Nodding just the tiniest of bits, “Oh, are you curious now? Curious to hear what the crown prince was wanting to speak to me about?”

“.. A little,” Mydei admitted after a beat of silence, unsure of how to even fight that in any sense as he felt beads of sweat forming on his skin. 

“I respect the honesty!” Hyacine nodded with a little finger wag, as if she was as happy as could be and somehow - that was almost contagious, just for a few brief moments at least before Hyacine looked him dead in the eyes once more, “It was about you, of course.”

Mydei found himself slowly looking at Hyacine over that - doing his best to take her in and understand what the hell she was saying to him all before finally processing what she said.

It shouldn’t be too hard to understand, and yet, he found himself blinking over it slowly, “Me?”

“He wants to be your friend, more or less, and asked me about how I befriended you,” Hyacine explained as she moved to now look at the contents of her own box - bending down a little to shift through the mess of wax and little vials of dye that Mydei found himself keenly watching.

Mainly due to the fact that he was refusing to look upwards and at Phainon, instead doing his best to ignore him being there in trade of swapping sides to be unable to see Phainon at all. 

All before crossing his arms over his chest, tutting a quiet bit before turning his head to the side - anything to get further away from Phainon if it was possible, “.. And what did you tell him?”

“Ah well.. You know..”

..?

“I do not know. That is why I asked?” Mydei pointed out rather confusedly, cocking his head to the side as he stared at her. Doing his best to stay just a little bit sane as Hyacine gave him such a little smile, her eyes dancing around before she seemed to only smile more.

Warm and soft; those were the things Hyacine’s smile usually seemed to give an aura of. Only now, it seemed a bit more mischievous; “Curiosity killed the cat..”

“Correct, yet I am not a cat. I am a dragon, much like yourself,” Mydei countered instantly, moving to wave his hand as if to show he was in fact a dragon. 

Not as much as Phainon, not as giant, but assuredly as he moved his tail to the front of him and grabbed it idly to show it to her just a bit; He was a dragon at the end of the day. 

Hyacine only watched that, looking a little amused over the way Mydei’s tail only barely could be put into his own hands and have a bit left over. But his tail had never been long. It was always.. A bit more fat than he would have preferred, chubby, and Mydei had no idea how to fix that.

His mother had once told him all the sweets he ate probably went straight to his tail - but even when he went on a strict diet it stayed as plump as ever. Why would he change the foods he loved if he still was going to be stuck with this chubby part of himself..?

“I would argue you’re actually more dragon blooded than I am, obviously. But you’re also more of a cat than I am,” Hyacine sighed out as if that made any sense at all - instead Mydei found himself clicking his tongue over that. Letting go of the smooth underbelly of his tail in favor of crossing his arms yet again comfortably over his chest. 

“.. I do not know how to refute this when I’m unsure how you’ve come to such a conclusion,” Mydei growled out, idly aware of the tip of his tail thrashing a little behind him in his annoyance - but he couldn’t really argue something when it made almost no sense.

Sure, he enjoyed napping in the sun, and sure, he did find himself lounging around most of the time; but he thought that was rather normal for dragons. They all loved being warm, didn’t they? 

“Exactly,” Hyacine huffed out as she put her hands on her hips all before looking a little bit smug - her own tiny tail wiggling just the tiniest of bits from what Mydei could see over her head.

.. Was she claiming this as a victory, or something? 

“You two,” That voice seemed annoyed - angry even and it instantly made Mydei jerk a little, moving to turn and face that woman who had just spoken to him. Only he was right in time to have fabrics forced into his hands with a click of her tongue, “If you have so much free time to chat together, wash these for the crown prince.”

Hyacine didn’t even waste a moment before chirping over that, “Yes ma’am!”

“Yes ma’am,” Mydei copied, all before feeling Hyacine tugging at his shirt a little, doing her best to drag him away to the little buckets of soapy water that had been put out earlier for other people to wash items and possessions. 

“You know,” Hyacine hummed as they moved, making Mydei’s feet turn a little to walk more easily with her, “I think that’s the first time you’ve been scolded for something.”

Mydei couldn’t help the way his ears pricked a little - keening to listen to the hurried whispers that immediately came from behind him with some gasping noises following. “Are you insane?! Don’t you know that he’s Prince Phainon’s special m..” The annoying part was how he couldn’t hear the rest of it, if anything.

Clicking his tongue to disperse his own thoughts with a rather heaving sigh escaping him. There was no use trying to ask or wonder what they meant, not when no one would answer him anyway. He didn’t think he wanted to be Phainon’s ‘special’ anything, though. 

“.. People appear a bit wary around me,” Mydei mumbled as he did his best to focus on the way Hyacine was immediately robbing him of those clothes he was given - and his gloves for that matter, “Ignoring that; have you ever seen the crown prince wear pure white?”

Mydei couldn’t help but to ask that as he watched her stretch out a white shirt - silky, much too soft to where Mydei knew it was a royalty’s shirt, but in pure white.. It was almost eerie in a way that made him squint over it. 

Hyacine, however, didn’t seem to mind as she scrunched it up before dousing it in the soap bucket without much of a second thought, “Hmm.. Not that I can remember, but maybe he’s trying a new fashion statement.. He is the prince, after all! Keeping things lively!”

.. Right. Mydei couldn’t relate to that at all as a crown prince, yet he understood the sentiment she was trying to convey easily enough - humming a little as he furrowed his brows to watch her roughly bring the pair of pants up to that bucket as well. 

“.. Or they’re just his sleeping garments.” Mydei supplied lazily, feeling like he would hate to be seen in pure white in public, let alone in formal events.. 

“That feels a bit more likely,” Hyacine conceded with a quiet little noise leaving her throat as she said those words,  “Still, I’m on laundry duty quite often and I only rarely see those come to be washed.”

Rarely? That wasn’t too odd, he surely had tons of clothes he could use instead if Phainon wasn’t fond of those, right? He was the crown prince, after all. 

Mydei huffed a little at his own thoughts, “Maybe he doesn’t use them often?”

“Are you implying the crown prince sleeps in the nude? How lewd of you..” Hyacine teased though her hands were already moving to scrub at the shirt - and Mydei almost wanted to growl over how he was willing to help. But one thing he had learned while here was not to underestimate that small dragon who also was trapped here.

.. Especially if she was determined with her task. 

Mydei sighed just a bit, “.. I meant he most likely has other pairs.”

“Hmm,” Hyacine hummed, her head moving to the side to look at Mydei - all before her hands paused as she looked down once more. A quiet little breath of laughter left her as she shook her head, “Well, to be honest.. I’d keep your voice down because the owner of them is coming..”

“Hmph,” Mydei sighed out, though for once he didn’t actually hear that tail coming - was Phainon in some type of bad mood?

.. Not like Mydei’s thoughts on the matter made a difference, not when that crown prince was too eager to speak to him himself. 

“Mydei,” Phainon started, making Mydei languidly turn a little - just enough to look at that man who had now moved to his side. Blue eyes staring down at Hyacine who slowly rose to her feet as well, only for him to immediately jerk his attention back to Mydei.

Odd.

His expression was painfully odd today - stressed and forced, no smile on his lips even though he had been watching Mydei for so long today.

“.. Prince Phainon, to what do we.. Owe this honor to?” Mydei asked flatly as he forced himself to bow a little - idly aware of the eyes that were on them all. Watching their crown prince talking to these two outsiders, and he had to huff a little over it. 

Only for Phainon to laugh a little, bumping their shoulders together in a way that made Mydei’s eye twitch just a tiny bit. 

“Goodness! Speaking to me so stiffly like that, is it because other people are around?” Phainon asked with a laugh fluttering out of him, all before that laugh ended a bit high-strung, his smile twitching at the ends of his lips, “You’ll make me upset, you know, Mydeimos..?”

There was an odd little lilt to Phainon’s words, an anger that he couldn’t quite grasp that made Mydei feel more and more confused as he stared at that man.

Only for Phainon’s eyes to dip down immediately at that bucket Hyacine and Mydei had once been crowding around, “My, my.. What do they have you doing?”

“.. Washing your clothes,” Mydei boredly answered - too aware of the way Phainon had only moved closer to his side, barely behind him yet still nearing him. As if he was keen to stay behind Mydei oddly, and Mydei couldn’t figure out why. 

“Mm..” Phainon hummed, his voice still sounding so very odd to Mydei’s ears, “How interesting..”

“I’m quite sure this is the least interesting thing I could ever be doing,” Mydei argued, jerking his head to look up at that man over his shoulder - staring at the way those eyes seemed so hungry today. Dare and focused in a sense that made Mydei’s thoughts fell flat as he tried to process why this man was so..

“Most certainly, yet.. I’m rather intrigued!” Phainon told him with a beaming smile, for once making Mydei’s eyes flit down at his sharp teeth - feeling a little bit stunned over that before his mind struggled to catch up. 

The holiday.

He wanted to ask about that, and surely Phainon of all people would answer him, right? Unless he truly was reading something wrong.. He had no idea, that prince still was an absolute riddle to him. 

“Prince Phainon, what is t-”

“If you’re going to ask me a question, Mydei, use just my name without a title. You’re upsetting me by saying we’re friends yet being so formal..” Phainon interrupted to reprimand him, making Mydei blink languidly at him. Trying to understand what on earth was happening here today before sighing over it.

It was uncomfortable.

Something about the way Phainon was staring at him had changed, that much was certainly  true - and all he could do was try to ignore it. 

“.. Phainon,” Mydei started, ignoring the way he could hear that prince’s tail wagging earnestly, “What is the holiday coming up soon that everyone is whispering about?”

Though, Phainon only cocked his head to the side at that. Eyes looking suddenly as innocent as ever as he tried to understand it before echoing Mydei; “Holiday?”

“In just a few days?”

Phainon’s expression didn’t waver. In fact, he didn’t seem to move at all - even his tail had frozen with that question as he seemed to either process it, or he had figured it out and was trying to explain it. Or not explain it.

Either way, Phainon remained standing there staring him down, all before his eyes darted to Hyacine nervously and back to Mydei. 

“Oh! Don’t worry about that, Mydei!” Phainon chirped out with a nod of his head, returning to moving more now that he seemed to have come to terms with the idea of telling Mydei nothing,  “It’s just a ritual to praise Oronyx and what their sacrifice gave to us and our land.”

Though, that was an odd way of saying that, wasn’t it? Mydei found his mind latching onto one word in that sentence as he furrowed his brows at Phainon; “.. Ritual?”

It was so blatant that Phainon didn’t like this topic - his eyes instead dipping away immediately as he seemed to struggle with eye contact with Mydei now. As if he were some sort of scolded child being asked what he did wrong, a prince that seemed to be more than a little scared of Mydei being mad at him or something. 

“Mhm, a meeting of sorts..” Phainon explained, yet that still didn’t really explain a thing - did it? 

“Meeting?” Mydei only echoed out again - feeling more and more like a dazed parrot as that man seemed to avoid going into detail. 

It was quite clear to Mydei that he didn’t want to talk about this, but the way Phainon was wiggling and shifting his weight around made it so much more blatant to where Mydei couldn’t help but watch him the entire time with his head craned for eye contact. 

“It’s nothing you need to worry about, Mydei! How is your day going?” Phainon decided after a few moments, as if he was trying to cheerfully change the topic while meeting Mydei’s eyes - a smile dancing on his lips, “You should take a break and take a walk with me.”

.. A break?

Now Phainon was trying to pull him away from his work? That was a new one that made him languidly blink at Phainon, if he actually accepted this, he would never live it down with Hyacine. But if he didn’t accept it, he ran the risk of that crown prince publicly pouting and angering the people Mydei worked with.

“.. Are you more troublesome when I’m out of the kitchen for some reason?” Mydei asked with a heavy sigh as he realized there was no decent answer for himself - he was in a losing battle and Phainon was eating all of the pieces involved in their imaginary chess match.. 

“I agree with him, Mydei,” Hyacine finally spoke, making Mydei’s head snap to the front to stare at the girl who was nodding at him. Looking painfully coy as she spoke those words, as if she knew fully that she was throwing Mydei to the wolves.

“Hyacine?” 

Mydei asked that in a flabbergasted tone, but it didn’t matter as Phainon stepped closer to him, a laugh loud against Mydei’s ears as that man seemed so happy to have Hyacine on his side. 

“Thank you, Hyacine! I’m glad someone is here to speak some sense into Mydeimos!”

“Whose team are you even on?” Mydei growled out to Hyacine - and Hyacine slowly seemed to melt a little over that, her brows knitting together in a form of worry as she dramatically sighed at his questioning. 

“It’s hard to do my work when Prince Phainon’s tail is thrashing from side to side.. It’s dangerous..” Hyacine explained, and Mydei felt his jaw drop - yet no words came out either, “He’s going to hurt his tail.. Dragon tails aren’t meant to be doing all of that.”

..?

He really couldn’t tell if Hyacine was on his team, or Phainon’s with how she was now making excuses for that man as well?

What gives? 

“Ahh.. I just can’t help it when I’m around Mydei!” Phainon whined out, and Mydei clicked his tongue over it, shaking his head a little over how pathetic that crown prince sounded. As if he was truly so happy or pouty when Mydei was involved for some reason that Mydei just.. Couldn’t wrap his head around. Not really, not easily, at least. 

Mydei gave a heavy sigh over that - feeling his shoulders sink in exasperation, “.. What are you, a dog?”

“Woof.”

Mydei didn’t dare look at Phainon with that - instead focusing forward and only Hyacine fully instead, clicking his tongue a little while watching the way she looked more than a little baffled over it. As if she was hearing the most insane thing ever, all before she chuckled a little quietly. 

“Goodness me,” Hyacine began, and Mydei could already feel himself closing his eyes in his mounting agony, “How often do you two bark at each other?”

“We don’t,” Mydei growled out without missing a single beat, only to hear Phainon behind him laugh again. 

A sweet sound - one that made his stomach do flips so easily as he grit his teeth and stared at Hyacine, doing anything but giving that man a lick of his attention.

“I’ll bark when he tells me to.”

“Wow.. That is quite the normal thing to say, your highness!”

Mydei couldn’t help but close his eyes a little - a full chested sigh leaving him as he tried to ignore their conversation around him, all while wondering if this was how Castorice had once felt in this kind of situation.. 

“I do not desire a dog,” Mydei sighed out as he looked at Hyacine - doing his best to not overthink the conversation they had been having as he gnawed at his own tongue just a tiny bit.

Though, nothing could have warned Mydei for the way he was going to straighten up immediately - his face burning as Phainon seemed to lean down to him. Just enough to where Mydei could feel his breath fanning against the outside of his ear hotly.

“I’ll be so much more than just a mutt for you, if you would let me..” 

Those words were whispered so quietly that Mydei knew Phainon only wanted them to be heard by Mydei - a hushed little promise that made Mydei’s heart speed up in a way that he had never felt before. All while his mind could only focus on that coiling heat on his ear, feeling stunned the longer he stood there and said nothing. 

It almost tickled in a way, yet it was something else that made Mydei’s body twitch in anticipation - those words shouldn’t be exciting, but when spoken so quietly, so seductively.. He couldn’t help but to feel his hands form fists with a heavy sigh escaping him with his new mounting frustration. And he dared not categorize that frustration, either. 

“Hyacine,” Mydei finally managed as he opened his eyes again, unable to help the shake in his voice when he could swear Phainon was still so close that he could hear his quiet breathing,  “Please handle this without me, forgive me for leaving it to you.”

Hyacine didn’t even seem phased by that, only slowly nodding her head a little, “It’s alright, Mydei.. I’m scared to learn what he could have possibly just whispered to you.”

“It’s better to not question it, just as I will not be doing,” Mydei muttered before turning away from Hyacine and skillfully avoiding Phainon as well - doing his best to ignore the small smile on Phainon’s lips that was so blatant. 

A smug smirk knowing that he was winning this war, but Mydei didn’t care as he moved away from Hyacine - sighing as he knew Phainon would undoubtedly move to his side; “Awe, but Mydei.. I would love to explain it to you in detail!”

Phainon’s words were borderline sang out that it only worked to annoy Mydei a bit more - still feeling the burn of Phainon’s breath against the cusp of his ear if he even let his mind be still for a moment.

“Curious how you’ll ramble about such bizarre things such as that, but you will not inform us about that ‘ritual’ any further,” Mydei hissed out as he strode out of that familiar garden - his eyes darting to the side as Phainon now found his place there easily.

Those eyes still looked hollow in some way, darkened as if he was always zoning out thinking about something else - or some deep rooted sense of yearning was clouding his mind. Whatever it was, Mydei had to drag himself out of it and flick his own eyes away with his hands twitching. 

Though, his words seemed to have worked well at robbing the wind from Phainon’s sails - hearing that man sigh quietly over it, “Ah.. That’s.. Well! It’s a bit of a cultural difference, isn’t it? I’m sure you’re not overly eager to tell me about things Castrum Kremnos does in honor of Nikador, right?”

Mydei gave a shrug of his shoulders over that with a cold laugh escaping him as he walked into that familiar marble floored area outside the garden wells. Walking the hallway with not much in his mind nor a destination, “.. Why would I not? We host monthly sparring tournaments and enjoy bonfires with pomegranates to replicate the era from when we would drink the blood of the fallen.”

Phainon hummed a little at his side over that - making Mydei look at that man whose eyes were focused on the ceiling for some reason as they walked, all before he dropped them down to meet Mydei’s gaze. Curiosity seeming to linger in them as he tilted his head a bit to the side, “Pomegranates? Do you.. No longer drink blood?”

“Of course not.”

“.. I see,”  Phainon muttered in a voice that sounded almost a little disappointed before he waved his hand a little lazily, as if to disperse whatever asinine thoughts he was conjuring up in that snow white head of his, “In any case! Our holiday is.. More boring, yet private..”

“Private?” Mydei echoed out, unable to look away from the way Phainon’s jaw clenched at that, looking more than a little uncomfortable now that Mydei was back on that topic as if Phainon himself hadn’t led them to it. 

“No.. Outsiders, I’m sorry Mydei..”

“It’s fine,” Mydei sighed a little as they continued to walk, looking away from Phainon in favor of focusing ahead, “I won’t impede where I’m not wanted.”

“You’re wanted! You’re wanted so much.. I wish you could be there, but.. I just can’t.. I’m sorry..” Phainon’s words were more than a little pathetic sounding, as if he was nearing breaking into tears and Mydei found himself scoffing over that. 

“.. You’re acting like a scolded dog when I haven’t even tried to ask to attend.”

“I.. Yes,” Phainon's voice didn’t change at all, if anything, he seemed even more depressed with Mydei’s words, “I suppose I am.”

Mydei didn’t have any patience for this today, however, or at least, whatever patience he once had Phainon had immediately gobbled up without a second thought. 

“Now that we’re far enough away,” Mydei began, all before abruptly stopping and turning to Phainon - borderline snarling at that prince who stepped a tiny step back in his shock, eyes as wide as possible over the way Mydei had flipped his emotions so quickly, “Do not do that again, Prince Phainon.”

Whatever shock Phainon had on his features seemed to melt away at that, instead it was fully replaced with that same emotion Mydei found himself feeling drawn into. Staring at the way Phainon seemed so keen on this type of reaction, his eyes unable to look away from how Phainon almost looked.. To be blushing?

Flustered even, as he gave Mydei such a small smirk - a tiny thing on his lips while tilting his head so innocently, “Mm? Do what, Mydeimos?”

“Speaking into my ear like that,” Mydei growled, trying to ignore the way he felt almost nervous over Phainon’s expression - not nervous in the anxious sense. But something else that Mydei dared not give a name to as he stared at those shock blue eyes that still were staring at him with such ripe emotions. 

Emotions that were much too dark for Mydei to fully read into, but one thing was obvious; Phainon was enjoying this situation carnally. 

Mydei dared not think on that for too long, however, instead continuing with his thoughts as he did his best to ignore the incessant wagging of Phainon’s tail, “Do you have some sort of death wish, your highness?”

Phainon only laughed at that, unbothered and relentless as he stepped closer to Mydei again - taking his ground back and leaning towards Mydei without a care in the world, “No.. But if you’re offering, I’ll happily accept a fight with you, Mydei..”

Mydei didn’t like it.

He didn’t like the way his stomach was churning uncomfortably over that, some emotion running rampant through his veins that was borderline anxiousness yet excitement; all due to that way Phainon had dropped his tone. Low and seductive, sounding less and less like he wanted to fight Mydei, and more like he was doing his best to convince Mydei to come to bed with him for the night. 

“Do not speak to me like that, either,” Mydei attempted to reprimand him for it, feeling more and more deranged the longer he thought of what that voice was doing to him - and praying that it wasn’t obvious.

All while Phainon licked his lips dangerously slowly; “Like what?”

Mydei wasn’t sure what was going on between the both of them, but he knew he was losing as he had to force himself not to watch Phainon licking his own lips; “As if you’re.. Trying to coo at me, or trying to seduce me.”

Phainon only quietly laughed again at that, staring Mydei in the eyes as if he didn’t feel shy at all anymore, “Mm? Well, I am?”

“.. Pardon?” That word left Mydei’s mouth before he even had a second chance to truly think about it - feeling more and more dazed as he even dared to consider Phainon was trying to actually seduce him.

That.. Couldn’t be. 

“What is it? You asked, and I answered,” Phainon replied without missing a beat, so eager to hear more and more from Mydei and Mydei.. 

“.. Leave me be.” That was all Mydei could manage, grounding out those words through his teeth as he tried to rein in his thoughts - feeling like he may actually go insane if he stood there and listened to this crown prince any longer. 

Though, that seemed to easily work on Phainon, making his entire mood flip instantly almost. Returning to that same sopping wet puppy voice and lilt he normally had, “You’re going back to work?”

“Yes,” Mydei sighed, doing his best to merely put this event out of his mind. If Phainon had meant it as a tease, it had worked so perfectly as Mydei moved his hand to grasp at the braid on his shoulder - anxiously toying with it a little between his claws. All while trying to ignore the way Phainon seemed to still be watching even that so closely. 

“.. Alright, I’ll return to watching you from afar, then,” Phainon hummed, and Mydei wanted to growl at him to stop watching him - but that seemed like a useless and lost battle when his mind even conjured it up, “Though, Mydei..”

Mydei looked at him at that - narrowing his eyes a little to stare at that prince who had returned to looking just a bit nervous. No longer trying to ‘seduce’ Mydei and once again returning to being so blatantly worried about something.. 

“I do mean it. I wish I could take you to that holiday you’ve been hearing about, but trust me when I say it’s nothing you wish to see..”

“As you say, Prince Phainon,” Mydei mumbled out all before turning away from Phainon - not caring to check on the reasoning behind why Phainon made such an audible clicking noise behind him.

Frustration? Annoyance? Mydei wasn’t sure, but he did know he was more than a little irked still by those words that had been so hotly whispered against the cuff of his ear and the words that followed after. A quiet taunt from the prince who seemed to have made it a habit to mock Mydei in this odd fashion to where it didn’t even make sense in his mind.

All he knew was the way his hand rose to his ear idly as he walked - finger tips avoiding his horns all while brushing against the back of his ear’s cartilage. Right where Phainon had so hotly breathed on him as he spoke, still feeling a shiver running down his spine when he thought of the sensation again and again.

Only to drop his hand with a heavy exhale, doing his best to ignore the embarrassment burning into his cheeks.
