“Did.. You give Mydeimos the sweets..?” Those words left Phainon’s mouth in such a shaky tone as he stood there feeling people patting out his attire. Fixing the sleeves, making sure it fit nicely around his tail, straightening him out just like always..

And Phainon could only think of that crown prince who wasn’t supposed to be around today - the man that couldn’t come to the ritual, even if Phainon wanted him there. 

He wanted to know if Mydei would accept him and his kingdom for what they really were, or if he would hate him.. Yet if Mydei found out, Phainon knew that man would never be allowed to leave. That sounded like a positive to him personally, but right now, he had to think about it rationally. 

Mydei had to go back for the sake of his kingdom one day, and Phainon couldn’t keep him here; he had to obey his father and get to know Mydei.. Take it slow.

.. But that didn’t mean he couldn’t give him so many treats to keep him busy while Phainon and everyone else was away today!

“Of course, your highness.” One of the women touching at his sleeve replied, making him languidly look at her - staring at her as he desired a reply so badly, his throat bobbing with how hard he found himself dryly swallowing. 

“What did he say?”

“.. Forgive me, he looked a bit surprised and muttered his thank yous rather quietly,” A different woman replied, making Phainon click his tongue over it with a heavy sigh. 

That was what he had expected to be honest, it wasn’t as if Mydei had been extremely outgoing about feeling welcomed here. Having treats and sweets pushed onto him was probably odd, but Phainon knew he liked them.. Mydei had confessed to such a thing when they first met, so treats should.. Be a good gift, right?

“Mm,” Phainon hummed softly, Phainon did have to look at one of them sharply; staring them down with a smile on his lips; “That’s fine! Did you get what I wanted?”

That seemed to work wonders on them - making them bow their head just a little bit more as they removed their hands from Phainon’s shirt cuff they had been trying to fix for much too long. 

“.. Yes, your prey is already awaiting punishment from you for speaking poorly of the crown prince of Kremnos.”

“That’s good! Everyone should be taught a lesson to treat our guests with respect,” Phainon chirped, feeling so much more merry over hearing the good news as he laughed a little over his own request,  “I’m merely helping the lesson sink in today.”

He was never specific about these rituals, he simply attended them and did as he was asked - but today was different. It was so painfully rare for him to be angry, and yet he was still so furious. Livid, even, enough to where he wanted to watch them die with his own eyes and feel their flesh beneath his claws. 

“Yes, your highness..”

Phainon could feel it - the way his tail was wagging once more with excitement much to the dismay of the workers around him. But this was all going so well!

He would handle this issue for Mydei, and Mydei would never even have to know someone spoke about him so poorly! Phainon liked to assume he was being such a good mate for Mydei, even if Mydei didn’t consider him to be his mate yet. 

“Mydeimos has the day off today and I gave him a lot of books.. I hope he’s satiated with his treats and stays in his room slacking off..” Phainon began to ramble out loud, closing his eyes as he tried to envision that dangerous dragon lounging around today enjoying the Elysian sweets Phainon had made for him.

An addicting sight in his imagination, such a beautiful man that made Phainon wonder if he would read at the same time, or perhaps he would never risk ruining the pages with his snacking. Not that Phainon cared; he would personally lick the pages clean for just the slightest taste of Mydei’s lips possibly touching the crumbs. 

.. And then rewrite the pages for Mydei, of course.

“He deserves to..” Phainon sighed in a daze as he lowered his head once more - forever a bit saddened by the fact Mydei forced himself to work every day even  when Phainon really didn’t agree with it. He could easily talk everyone into leaving Mydei alone, letting him explore, letting him go out of the castle with Phainon, and yet.. 

Mydei refused.

He had restated quite a few times that he was a prisoner, not a guest, and every single time Phainon’s stomach churned in such a horrid way. He felt so sick over the fact the only person he had a crush on, let alone fallen in love with head over heels, refused to see himself as something more.

He had the crown prince of Aedes Elysiae wrapped around his finger; and Mydei still refused to abuse it, refused to even acknowledge it and seemed to run away from that.

.. Phainon had to sigh over that; he wished Mydei would abuse it, just a little, just a lot even.. 

“We.. Stationed a few guards around to make sure no intruders wander in on accident,” One of the staff members replied, making Phainon slowly drag his eyes to them - staring them down before raising a brow in curiosity over those words. 

“Peacefully?” He asked in such a sharp tone, an angry one, because if Mydei did try to come to this ritual - if he did begin to be nosy and the guards harmed Mydei.

.. Phainon wasn’t quite sure what he would do! Mainly because he would love to watch them try to fight that prince, solely due to the fact he was quite confident that Mydei would win those fights easily. 

“Peacefully?” One of them echoed, making him sigh so dramatically loudly over how they sounded confused by that. As if there was a single thing confusing about that word at all. 

“If my Mydeimos is harmed, I’ll be quite angry,” Phainon explained tiredly, shaking his head a little with his own thoughts as he kept moving his head around to look at all the people worrying and fussing with his hair and clothes.

Five people in his room with him, and yet none of them were the person he actually desperately wanted in his room. 

“.. Your Mydeimos?” One quoted, making Phainon snap his head to them with such sharpness that he could feel his teeth gritting together in his annoyance. They sounded so baffled, so off guard that it was irksome to Phainon - a bother that someone could even find those words odd. 

They made perfect sense; Mydeimos was his. Even if Mydei didn’t quite know it yet, that was fine, they would cross that bridge quickly when the time came. 

“Did I say something odd?” Phainon asked with a chuckle, a loaded question as their eyes dared to look up a little from where they were fixing his solid white pants legs in such a hurry. All before they dipped their head down low again, nodding so many times all while Phainon found it somewhat amusing.

To have such shaky hands over such a simple question; if the answer made you shake like that, Phainon didn’t know why you would be so bold as to ask it! 

“Of course not, your highness. We will make sure there’s no force being used to retain him.” They borderline whimpered out, sounding more and more pathetic to where Phainon couldn’t help but laugh a little at those words - shaking his head along with it. 

“That’s good! I also don’t think any of you would win that fight, but I don’t want to burden him with any stress either,” Phainon explained, shrugging his shoulders back a little to hear a nice and satisfying pop in them before he gave yet another hushed chuckle, “It’s bad for the baby.”

“B-Baby?” That same servant quoted out, looking more and more terrified as almost all of the staff paused in fear of what Phainon was saying. 

“Me,” Phainon told them with a sigh, and he was pretty sure he could hear some sighs of relief but he was doing his best to ignore that, “Regardless, he doesn’t need to know about these types of things yet.. My father scolded me about it, so I tried to pull out all the stops to make Mydeimos happy while I’m gone.”

Phainon felt himself heaving out a little sigh - his shoulders sinking as he tried to rationalize all of it, “At least, I assume so..”

“Anyone would notice you being gone from their life for a day, your highness. We will do our best to keep him happy,” Another staff member spoke up, making Phainon click his tongue a little over that. 

“Hah.. Saying that about Mydeimos is quite funny, I think he may be relieved to have a day away from me, honestly!” Phainon laughed a little over it, mainly because he knew what he was saying was undoubtedly true. Mydei had a habit of throwing him glares and glances that seemed as if he was annoyed or something.

A piece of Phainon knew that he was probably supposed to not like them; to try his best to fix it and impress Mydei. Yet, he adored them. He loved the way Mydei looked when he was mad, he loved how he looked when he was happy..

.. He wasn’t a fan of how Mydei looked when he was sad, however. But the rest of his emotions were so delicious that Phainon wanted to see all of them, more and more. xEven if he was angry at Phainon for flirting with him, even if he was growling and seeming like the distance between them was widening.. Phainon couldn’t help the sickening feeling of how delighted he was when those golden eyes snapped to him while looking like he wished the worst for Phainon to happen.

Everything about Mydei was so painfully addicting that he couldn’t help the way his hands always twitched so eagerly for him; yearning for more of those harsh hisses and snarls from him.

Phainon didn’t mind it at all! So much so that he found himself already a little flustered thinking back on the way Mydei had seemed so angry at him just a mere few days ago. Those eyes narrowed and cruelly looked at Phainon like he was nothing more than a plague ridden rat - and Phainon..

Phainon had gone back to his room that night and panted over it - unable to stop the excitement in his body and how much he wanted to pin Mydei down due to it and draw out other emotions from him, just for Phainon.. 

“I will warn you,” Phainon happily began in his own thoughts, already moving a little to one of those servants with a bubbling manic laugh still leaving him with his thoughts of Mydei in his mind, “If someone goes awry and it involves Mydeimos..” 

Phainon didn’t hesitate before his hand jerked outwards, grabbing the woman who had been messing with his sleeve for much too long - cupping her jaw as tightly as possible. Overly aware of the way he was seconds from breaking the skin of her cheek with his claws, but he didn’t find himself caring as he dragged her closer.

His mind was not even fully noting the way the other servants had stepped away from him without a word.

It didn’t matter, anyway. 

“I will prioritize him over the ritual, understood?” Phainon asked as he forced her head to look upwards at him - scoffing a little over how short these people were in comparison to his beloved who was such a good height.. A perfect height, even. 

.. This gap was just too much, an annoying thing as he watched her wince between his fingers - clearly not enjoying the way his clawed fingers were digging into her skin a bit. Threatening to draw blood more and more with every single passing moment that her words didn’t leave her mouth. 

“Y-Yes, your highness.” She finally spoke, and at that - Phainon released her easily with a laugh leaving him over how quick she was to leave his side and join the others. Obviously just eager to leave this situation with her life now as her eyes stayed on the ground. 

“Good! So everyone do your best to keep my favorite guest happy!” Phainon chirped out energetically, unable to help himself but to laugh a little over the way people immediately began to scurry in a hurry. So earnest and eager to make him happy that even with such a simple request they were assuredly doing their best to make sure Mydeimos was well taken care of.

After all, it would be a shame if Phainon was in a worse mood than he already found himself to be in - sighing a little as he tugged at his shirt and slowly moved to the mirror. Not caring at all for the person who was attending to his tail and polishing his scales there while looking in that mirror.

The scales on his face looked as shiny as ever, spotless and perfect - only to make Phainon himself feel so.. Dull. Every time his thoughts led him back to Mydei he felt full of life, but today he could only stare at how devoid of joy his eyes were. There was no Mydei to be had today, after all, not even a glance considering this ritual would last sunrise to sundown.. 

“Ready to begin?” Phainon asked as he turned on his heels, not truly asking since they would follow him regardless as he walked out of his bedroom door - only ignoring the footsteps behind him as they chased him endlessly. Yet they never dared pass him, never dared to lead him or walk beside him.. 

It made him scoff every single time - only that fellow crown prince didn’t seem to care to walk behind Phainon, whether that be for cultural reasons, or Mydei seeming them as equals.. It didn’t matter; Phainon adored it. 

This walk, on the other hand, was as boring as ever as he strode to that familiar room that normally was locked - a room that was much too large, hidden a little within their kingdom as he began to walk down that familiar hallway. A hallway he hadn’t taken Mydei down during their tour, on purpose, as much as his father seemed to doubt him; he was taking it as slow as he could.

Though, now there was no Mydei. He was merely alone with his thoughts and these people as he pushed open that arched doorway that was silent behind it. 

Silent, until he pressed it open - pushing it open and wasting no time to stride into that room with a sigh heavy on his mind. It was never interesting to him, not when he had seen the sight of so many people kneeling like this before. Hundreds of times, really, all while he moved into that fancy room without a word - for what could he say?

They didn’t want him to speak to him, they wanted him to merely eat his meal and accept their offering - and how could he refuse when he had been so specific with what he wanted today? Instead walking on that soft plush red carpet, a thing that stood out in their otherwise blue and white kingdom, but it had to be that color.

Too much blood was spilt in this wide room for any other color. 

Still, Phainon found himself growing rather fond of the color red anyway - especially when it was next to the elegant colors of gold.. Though now his eyes had to focus on the altar awaiting him - along with the series of stairs that he had walked up so many times before. 

Phainon felt himself heave a sigh, just a little - just the tiniest of bits as he climbed up that staircase and up to the altar. A familiar place he had been so many times before, adorned with enough candles to burn the entire castle down had it not been made mostly of stone. Every time was the same, the whispers and prayers aimed at him as he neared the top, the feverish murmurs softly behind him chanting in prayer. 

Even as he finally crowned the top of those stairs to come face to face with a familiar man. The same one from the baths, now sweaty and clearly panicked - already tied up with a gag in his mouth to make Phainon sigh a little. It was quite boring without the thrill of the chase his instincts longed and yearned for, but a ritual was a ritual.

He turned languidly now that he was at the top - not at all giving a second thought towards the man that had been so disgusting towards Mydeimos and the Kremnoan people as a whole. His tail lashed a bit with his mounting annoyance as he looked to those worshippers lining the rows. 

There were always so many who attended this - their heads bowed low in the matching attire of wearing pure black with hoods to obscure their faces. Never viewing themselves as good enough to even glance upon Phainon during this prayer to Oronyx and their kin, and Phainon found himself tutting quietly over it.

This had become so redundant that Phainon found it almost boring now as he let a little sigh out before turning back to that man who was still on that altar. Phainon’s eyes only idly wandered to look at the rows of candles lining the area illuminating him, even if that man struggled, it wasn’t as if there was anywhere he could go.

Not when everyone here was praying for him to die. 

Phainon hummed a little as he neared that man - stepping coldly closer as he clicked his tongue looking down upon what was once such a loyal servant. Now terrified, so clearly in fear of what he knew was to come - of course he knew. He had prayed for others to perish just like he now was enduring, only for once.. His time had come to be on that altar. 

“I once found myself to be level-headed and patient,” Phainon murmured as he looked at those ropes tying the man up easily - eyes staring at the way he was straining and making such quiet muffled noises. Pleas for mercy, assuredly, but Phainon wasn’t one to feel keen on listening anymore. 

Instead his fingers languidly moved across the marble slate that man was laid upon - his finger tips savoring the coolness of it before stopping just an inch away from a puddle of sweat from that man. A disgusting waste of how cold that stone was - almost as cold as Mydei had felt against Phainon’s chest that one day when he got to relish in carrying him..

.. He missed feeling that man against him so direly. 

Phainon could only drop his hands from that slab of marble at that - sighing over how pristine and beautiful it was. His thoughts fully knowing it was washed and cleaned so thoroughly just for him to ruin it again and make those people below the stairs feel so pleased. 

Prosperity. That was what they were praying to Oronyx - no - to Phainon for. Worshipping him for a safe future for their kingdom, and that was enough to make him chuckle just a little when he thought about it. What better prosperity could he bring to them than to end the war with Castrum Kremnos forever? 

To have his loved one truly become his and combine their kingdoms together in such a deeper way than some treaty could ever compare to?

Phainon’s eyes only slowly roamed back to that man’s face - looking at the way he seemed so panicked; so frightened. And Phainon had to laugh a little over it, “Yet nowadays I realize I wasn’t truly level-headed nor patient.”

Phainon sighed with his own words - closing his eyes a little before he timidly moved his hand to that man - so gentle, so tender, a touch he wished was for Mydei as he sweetly pressed into his bicep. 

.. A gentle touch didn’t suit this man, and that thought alone was enough to make Phainon sink his claws into that man’s skin. Watching the way he pierced into him so easily - so much like that little strawberry he was enjoying while that man mocked the person he adored. 

The whimper, however, was a thing a strawberry could never make as well as the thrashing that man was doing now. Even though he was pinned down, tied down and unable to escape, Phainon found himself only idly watching - amused in a sickening way that this person thought he stood a chance of seeing tomorrow still.

“I was merely a little bit hollow; lacking something I personally wanted to cling to and call my own,” Phainon continued saying, sighing as he watched that deep maroon colored blood trickle down his hands - eyes only watching it as that victim seemed as if he suddenly wasn’t quite such a devoted worshipper anymore. Not now that he was the one being sacrificed to Phainon, at least. 

“A dragon who lacks something they treasure is quite a sorry case,” Phainon muttered darkly as that man managed to yank his shoulder free - letting Phainon’s claws tear into his skin easily as he jerked away. But Phainon didn’t mind, not as all he could hear was his own rage and the prayers of their people in his ears. 

“It’s like having a void inside of you that nothing can fill; you think you’re happy and fine, and yet..” Phainon continued on as he slowly walked a little circle around that man - his eyes wandering to the straps holding down his legs and chest. Keeping him completely at Phainon’s mercy for him to enjoy at his own leisurely pace, “You only finally wake up when someone forces you to.”

Forces..?

That wasn’t quite the right word for this - not when Phainon was so thankful to Mydei for helping him realize there were so many more emotions in this world that he hadn’t experienced yet. Things he hadn’t realized he was capable of even feeling, and he had to laugh a little at how cruel his word choice was.

Mydei hadn’t forced him to do anything, Mydei had merely.. Existed and that had been enough to give him a push into the light that he so desperately yearned for; even if he originally did not know how badly he wanted it.. 

“Forces.. Or merely helps you open your eyes to what you could have if you woke up.” Phainon conceded with a sigh - looking at the way they had already removed this man’s shirt for this to happen to him. A strap on his legs, and one for right below his breasts - just enough to pin him down all while he still was tied up with his hands and legs as well.

Uncomfortable. It was probably so very uncomfortable, and Phainon almost felt a little guilty for allowing one of his followers to suffer for so very long with being in distress! Even if they had wronged the one he loved, Phainon was still very giving - lenient despite it all, he would say!

“I wonder..” Phainon began with a heavy sigh as he moved his right hand to that man’s chest - languidly feeling his ribs beneath the skin there with a heavy and thoughtful sigh escaping him over how easily they would snap beneath his fingers.

Warm.

His skin was warmer than Mydei’s and that was enough to make Phainon snort derisively - unable to hold himself back from slowly pushing down on those ribs that seemed suddenly so very fragile beneath his hand.  So fragile that Phainon found himself clicking his tongue a little over how they broke with just the lightest use of his force.

A marvel always as he only continued to slowly press down harder and harder, his eyes only watching the way that man had begun to cry. To scream out against the cloth in his mouth all while thrashing to try to break free - even though it wasn’t possible.

Not with his own bindings and Phainon’s own hand trapping him down and sinking lower and lower. Savoring the way every single new crunching or cracking noise made that man’s body attempt to squirm and escape. Trying every new direction all while Phainon simply.. Watched. 

He could take his time here - it didn’t matter, a slow death, or a fast one; he had nothing else on his schedule today. Thus, he could only sigh a little as he watched fat heavy tears shake down that man’s face while he seemed to stare upwards at Phainon. A silent plea that Phainon wasn’t weak to at all, only tilting his head a little as he stayed on the side of that altar staring downwards.

“Do you think you’ll ever wake up after this?” He was genuinely curious as his eyes looked at the way that man was now coughing up what seemed to be blood - letting it trickle out of his own mouth all while Phainon had to hum a little at that.

Were all his ribs on his side broken? It was an odd feeling, not sturdy at all anymore, a bit squishy beneath Phainon’s fingers to where he had to tilt his head as he dragged his eyes to his chest. 

“Even if you squirm and cry, do you think someone will help you..?” Phainon asked as he slowly sank his claws into that tender skin now - always feeling a little amazed at how easily flesh broke beneath them as that man tried to cry out again. For mercy, for aid, whatever it was - he would never get it.

And Phainon could only sigh as he looked at his fingers, watching the blood pool out of that man to coat his claws thoroughly, “I don’t understand.. Why would you be so cruel to him when you don’t even know him?”

How could he ever understand that? He knew that he couldn’t so all he could do was slowly sink his claws deeper and deeper. Enjoying the way that man was wriggling once more - thrashing as if it was helping him at all and not only making Phainon’s claws tear more and more of that tender flesh.

Every single movement made Phainon raise a brow curiously as he moved his eyes to look at that man’s face - eyeing the way blood was still slowly running down the side of his mouth and his face.

A mess.

This was becoming so messy that Phainon’s sleeves were gathering blood on them as well, and Phainon had to sigh a little over that. He had hated seeing Mydei mess with these clothes so much - it had actually made his heart skip a beat over the idea of Mydei having to wash dried blood off his clothes, but thankfully he had been clean in the last ritual.

.. The same couldn’t be said for his clothes this time - instead drawing out a sigh from his lips so painfully easily. 

“You didn’t see how excited he was when I showed him our kitchen.. And you insulted their cuisine?” Phainon pointed out with a laugh - though he was more than a little aware that the man was full on sobbing and wailing now - a muffled set of noises yet it didn’t matter, “Bold, considering I am now making a mess while devouring you, and I’m sure Mydeimos would have been so much nicer to you.”

It didn’t matter because that man was going to die soon - both of them knew that as he seemed to relax a little. Letting his head fall onto that slate of marble with tears endlessly escaping him alongside those weak moans of pain.

Sounds that Phainon didn’t care about as he moved his gaze back to focusing on his hand - watching the way that chest was blooming and opening so easily. Letting blood flow out of it in such a mess to puddle beneath his body, and making Phainon sigh a little. 

“You should be thanking me for this, you know?” Phainon pointed out as his fingers dove deeper into that man’s chest - humming a little at how warm that blood was as it gushed out of him easily,  “You were one of my worshippers, so eager to once feed people to me. And now it’s your turn. Why are you so upset..?”

It truly didn’t make any sense - not as that man cried out over Phainon plunging his fingers deeper into him. Feeling every movement of that man’s body that was losing so much fight by the second, and Phainon could only laugh a little over it - over how quickly they were giving up on their own life. 

“Isn’t this everything you’ve ever wanted? To sustain me and become useful to me?” Phainon asked as his fingers felt as though they touched some intestine that he didn’t care too much about, chuckling a little over the cry that man tried to scream out uselessly all while Phainon’s fingers dug into it, “Were you not devoting your whole body and soul to me and our kingdom?”

Phainon couldn’t understand what the issue was, sure.. He was sure this was painful to endure, so excruciating that this man hadn’t stopped wailing even though the cloth gag tied around his head and mouth. Especially if the puddle of blood running off the altar and onto the floor was anything to marvel at. 

But this is what they prayed for, wasn’t it? To make Aedes Elysiae thrive, just as they always had.. Usually Phainon was merciful, snapping their neck first or just tearing their heart out in a split second - but today.. He didn’t feel like it. Not when he remembered those taunts this man had said towards Mydei to Phainon to torture him mentally. Surely he was allowed to torture him physically in return, right?

“This is merely.. To make sure you’re put to full use.” Phainon sighed with his words - eyes meeting with that man’s as he slowly dragged his hand up to his mouth, tongue not wasting a single moment before licking up just a tiny bit of the blood glistening on his fingers, “Even if you taste disgusting.”

Phainon knew he was being cruel - but he couldn’t help himself as he flicked his fingers a little, watching the way that man flinched over his own blood splattering onto his face and Phainon had to click his tongue over that. Really, with how much blood he had lost - Phainon was amazed he was conscious at all still. 

Still, Phainon found himself merely standing there - eyes moving instead to look at how many people were in the crowd all in prayer towards him and their futures as a kingdom. Every head bowed low, focused wholly on praying, all while they merely allowed this man to bleed to death. To be tortured by the man they were praying to.

.. What an odd kingdom they were, Phainon knew that much from how secretive they were about this. If it wasn’t odd, they wouldn’t have to hide it from Mydei, would they? 

It was enough to make Phainon laugh a little, chuckling as he shook his head from side to side to look at the man who now sounded hoarse. As if his wailing was ruining his throat, or perhaps that was from gagging and choking on his own blood; Phainon had no idea.

“It’s too late,” Phainon cooed as he looked at that man in the eyes, staring him down before giving such a heavy full bodied sigh, “No one can save you now, even if they wanted to. Even if you went to the royal doctor immediately.. Your life is over.”

Phainon wasn’t even sure if that made that man sob more or not considering the fact he was already blubbering messily. Weeping and wailing when he could, and Phainon had to tut over it as he brought his hand back to those warm insides - no longer caring as he began to tear at anything his fingers touched. 

His ears listening to those cries growing louder, achingly loud with the man’s agony, all before it was quiet suddenly.

Death.

That was the lack of sound, that man was assuredly dead now - and Phainon found that so painfully dull and boring. No one even managed to keep his attention half as well as Mydei did, not even as they were dying and fighting for their lives.

Phainon sighed over it, instead ripping out new items and guts to move into his jaws - gnashing down on the flesh and sinew to taste the rich blood in his mouth. This wasn’t a good meal; not like it normally was, he was much too angry. Letting himself make a mess and having blood run down his chin all while he silently feasted at those intestines without much of a second thought.

This was normal for him, after all. 

Every crunch of bones made him feel sour in his mood - grimacing over how he really wanted that man to suffer more, but as blood only continued to spill out of his unmoving body it was abundantly clear he was already dead. And now Phainon had to devour his insides before they went cold, sighing as he licked at his own fingers in between bites; as if that cleaned his fingers at all..

By this point in his life he never even bothered to differentiate the organs, instead just gripping them and ripping them out indiscriminately all to be forced into his own mouth messily. Not caring for the gore and blood as it splattered out, there was no need for respect when this man showed in his life that he knew nothing about such a thing. 

Every bite sounded so loud in his ears - deafeningly as his jaws crunched on those bones that meant nothing to him, only more annoyances to swallow down as he feasted on the organs that were presented to him. Every new handful that he pushed into his mouth made him feel as though his patience was going to snap.

He didn’t want to be here.

He wanted to be watching Mydei, to be near Mydei, he wanted to ask Mydei what he thought of the snacks Phainon had made for him. He didn’t want to be gorging himself on blood and guts as he snarled at that deceased man.. He wanted to be at Mydei’s side and watch him enjoy his snacks. 

Though, he found himself pausing as such a loud screeching noise entered his ears as if to answer his silent prayers in his mind - enough to make his hands pause and his eyes to shoot upwards to look at that creaking door. 

Phainon found himself pausing as he watched that door open - so dramatically and rushed that it was clear the person opening it was moving in a hurry. Only for Phainon’s eyes to find the person who was interrupting; the one person who could instantly make his heart skip a beat as he stared down as that dragon who was only standing in the middle of that carpet. 

Only one, maybe two feet into the room - absolutely frozen as the door slammed shut behind him, golden eyes searching the sea of people who were all now staring right back at him before languidly dragging his eyes around. 

“M.. Mydei?” Phainon couldn’t help himself but to say that as he stared across the room at that golden red scaled dragon - down the stairs and at the man who had assuredly not been expecting this. That much was obvious by how wide those golden eyes were now, appearing as if he was beyond terrified - or baffled. Either way, Phainon found his mind in a daze over seeing that crown prince in here.

Though, the worst part had to be the way the whispers had stopped and been replaced by hurried growls from those in the rows.

“Intruder!” was a word that made Phainon feel himself laughing, unable to stop himself as he only rose to his full height slowly - not caring at all for the liquid that was staining his clothes and the red tainting him. Jerking his hands just the slightest bit to remove some of the dripping gore and blood from his hands all while he moved slowly. 

All he could focus on was the way those beautiful eyes had moved to him - looking more stunned than he previously had been with his mouth ajar. And Phainon didn’t mind at all - feeling as light as a feather as he instead moved down those bloodstained stairs - stepping in the blood that had been trickling down all while keeping a smile on his lips to the dragon who seemed more than just a little baffled. 

“Phai..non..?” Those words were spoken so slowly to where Phainon found himself laughing a little over it, pleased that everyone else had realized not to speak - to allow their crown prince to enjoy himself, and his guest. 

“Mydei! Mydei, Mydei, Mydei..” Phainon purred out as he moved closer to that man - unable to hold back his happy chirps of his beloved’s name all while mourning the way his hands were coated in blood and tissue beneath his nails - he would have loved to have touched Mydei’s face so sweetly and brush his hair back. But that foul man’s blood didn’t even have the right to touch Mydei’s face, nor be near it..

Instead Phainon could only tut a little in a teasing fashion - no longer able to keep a grin from his mouth;  “You’re not supposed to be in here, you know?”

“Mydei.. Mydei.. Mydeimos.. Let’s go take a bath, yeah? I’m pretty messy..” Phainon sighed, looking at the way Mydei only seemed to be frozen there - watching him. But that was fine! Mydei was his now, even if he didn’t understand what was going on!

And that was enough to make Phainon feel so giddy as he bent down a little - just enough to easily pick up Mydei and lift him over his shoulder. Laughing a little over the way Mydei felt so rigid all while he fit so perfectly on Phainon’s shoulder with his hands on Phainon’s back. Tossed over there like a sack of potatoes and still saying nothing. 

It was a bit odd how silent Mydei was being as he was practically treated like he weighed nothing - but Phainon didn’t mind it. So long as it meant Mydei was allowing him to touch him, to feel how cold he was against him again.. 

Phainon adored it, actually; “You’re not even complaining about me picking you up right now!”

Phainon couldn’t stop the bubbling laughter in his entire body as he effortlessly walked out of that familiar room - humming a little over the way Mydeimos was lacking any fight right now. Probably due to the way he certainly had six hundred thoughts running through his mind all at once, but Phainon didn’t mind - humming a little as he kept that dragon slung over his shoulder.

His hand lowered just a bit, enough to rest it at the base of Mydei’s tail with another manic laugh leaving him. 

That part of Mydei was so smooth to the touch, scales that seemed to need preening and carefully cleaned that Mydei himself couldn’t reach and see fully well. But Phainon didn’t mind taking up that job as he moved into the hallway with a merry little tune leaving his throat as he rubbed a small circle into Mydei’s spine soothingly. Slow and tender as he walked without a care in the world.

Well, a singular care; he had in fact gotten Mydei a bit bloody! 

They both needed to bathe together desperately now.

chapters.title: Chapter 9
chapters.html:
Mydei had messed up

He could see that much now as he stared at the floor while being carried by that giant dragon. His eyes only watched the splatters of blood that seemed to be dripping from Phainon’s own body and footsteps that were leaving tracks of blood as well. His hands only dangling as he found himself too stunned to speak.

His day had started out a bit odd; being given an entire tray of sweets in a small little cart that was pushed into his room to awaken him. Making him blink and stare at the way it all were treats he had no idea the names or origins of.

Oddly, the people that had brought it to him seemed so.. Nervous? As if they were fearing him speaking to them, and that was incredibly odd considering he had been working with some of them for at least a week or so now. 

“Prince Phainon,” was all one of them had told him as they bowed their heads again and again, acting terrified while scurrying away and Mydei.. Couldn’t bring himself to eat them. His mind only continued to return to his first talk with Phainon and how he asked if sweets were what Mydei wanted when nesting. 

This had to be some type of odd insult given that much. 

And that was how Mydei had begun his day of looking for someone to give him answers, only for the entire castle to seem.. Empty? No one on staff was around, not even Hyacine when he checked the kitchens and elsewhere - and a piece of him told him to go back to his room and not waste food. 

Yet, for some reason, he felt more than a little perturbed that Phainon was avoiding him today. Sending him treats all while staying clear of him along with everyone else - a rationale part of Mydei told him that it was probably a reason. That they were most likely enjoying their holiday ritual or whatever Phainon had told him. 

.. Nothing could have prepared him for the way guards were patrolling around so much - enough to where Mydei found himself clicking his tongue while he snooped around looking for Hyacine now. Knocking on doors in search of her now that they both had the day off - only to freeze in front of one, his ears listening to the quiet murmurs he could hear in there. 

And he wasn’t proud of his next actions; he would actually go on record and say it was a type of ‘spur of the moment’ move as he opened that door and moved in so abruptly as one of those guards turned down the hall. If they normally hated his existence, today would be even worse and Mydei wasn’t exactly keen on hearing it. Or whatever they may do to him.

Though, he now was sure he should have handled the guards instead when he opened and entered that room - finding himself stunned over some.. The gathering inside there seemed so very odd. Everyone was in the same attire, hundreds of people perhaps, all knelt and praying now looking at him.

Only for him to become even more dazed when he moved his eyes to the person up on that altar. Those pure white clothes Hyacine and Mydei had been given to clean.. Now Phainon was wearing them, and they were doused in blood - there was no question about what those red liquid was. Not as his own eyes stared upwards and looked at the very obvious corpse laying on that slab of marble. A sight that made Mydei feel like he couldn’t move as his mind slowly caught up to him over the sight of Phainon’s chin coated in blood along with his hands.

That dragon was saying something to him, nearing him, and yet.. He was completely stunned over the sight of it all. It was undoubtedly what was happening here; Phainon was eating someone.

They were all worshiping him while he was doing such a thing, and now.. Mydei couldn’t even fathom it, he didn’t know what to say, nor did he want to say anything incorrectly. Not when they so obviously treated this like it was something to be celebrated, instead he only watched Phainon near him, repeating his name in such a giddy tune like this was the best day of his life.

Smiling at him as if he didn’t have blood coating his fangs and reddening his lips - just to immediately scoop Mydei up like it was no issue at all.

.. And Mydei had simply let him.

That was how he got into this position of just being carried by Phainon - feeling his stomach churn as he thought of it again and again. The way that dragon had approached him with such a sweet smile on his face while drenched in blood, only to carry Mydei as if it was the most simple of tasks. As if he weighed nothing..

The worst of it all was how Mydei’s heart had sped up and thumped against his chest, a part of him wanted to claim it was fear - that even he was was terrified of a person who ate other people. And yet, he knew it wasn’t that, not when his instincts kept trying to tell him to purr. To try to seduce the dragon who was so feral and cruel and had such very powerful claws..

Was that his own instincts as a dragon telling him that, or was there something worse at play in his own mental state? He didn’t know, and all he found himself willing to do was let that man carry him off. Absentmindedly listening to the way Phainon was humming sweetly, all while his tail wagged while he walked with his wet hand soaking into Mydei’s clothes as he rubbed his back a little. 

Should he ask where he was being taken to? He didn’t know as he kept his eyes on the ground behind Phainon, barely looking up to glance at the people feverishly cleaning the blood where Phainon was walking behind him. As if they were doing their best to hide the deeds and hunger Phainon inflicted today.

His eyes only wordlessly lowered again - instead staring at the way Phainon’s tail seemed so happy, wagging from side to side as he walked with the quietest of jingles with the jewelry that had been tied around it.

All while the tip of his tail had blood on it, not his own, but someone’s and Mydei.. Mydei didn’t know what he was supposed to make out of all of this.

Obviously, everyone in the kingdom was in on their cult activities; maybe outside of him and Hyacine, at least. And that sounded insane when he even considered it, but the worst part was how he had the creeping feeling that he needed to do something. To worm away from that man, to fight back to escape from wherever he was being taken.

.. And yet he didn’t.

He still remained there watching the amount of blood being left on those perfect white floors lessen with every step as if the life taken on that altar was meaningless. And Mydei found his mind racing to try to figure out just who he had eaten - and why. Why would they all be just.. Okay with this?

Was this truly some kind of ritual to praise Oronyx? Was this kingdom truly that far gone? He didn’t know, but all he did know was the way his ears pricked a little - straining to listen to the water he could hear now as he lifted his head up a little. Enough to gain some awareness of where he was being carried off to.

The baths.

Phainon had said something about them both needing baths now, hadn’t he..?

Why did that just sound so painfully insane to Mydei as he squirmed a tiny bit - only to feel a hand patting above the base of his tail with a laugh from Phainon.

“Finally trying to get down? It’s okay, Mydei, I’ll put you down when we’re in my private bath quarters, okay?” Phainon hummed out in a tone that was much too amused for Mydei’s own liking - and still he knew he had to pick and choose his own battles here.

Sighing as he went borderline limp again while that man dragged him through the bath area that he had only ever gone to one other time, and that was with Phainon as well. But today it was.. Empty. Cleared out most likely for that insane ritual they were doing that Mydei had wandered into..

.. Was everyone required to attend? Was that why he had the day off from work? They all were just.. Too busy watching Phainon devour a man? Surely that.. That couldn’t be..

“I wish I could read your thoughts,” Phainon wistfully murmured, so softly that Mydei’s ears barely picked it up from the way his head was hanging down Phainon’s back. Only to click his tongue annoyedly at that.

He really couldn’t get a read on Phainon at all; he seemed so very.. Excited that Mydei had gone into that area and even scooped him up - it was enough to make him wonder just what that man’s thoughts were with him. Was he in danger, or had Phainon actually saved him from being in danger with those people that were less than pleased that he had stumbled into there?

Whatever the answer was, there was no denying the blood on Phainon’s hands and face - the blood soaked garments and the way he actually had quite a strong grip on Mydei’s hips right now. As if he was terrified of Mydei actually escaping him and telling someone, and Mydei couldn’t blame him.

This was .. An insane secret for a kingdom known for wheat farming to be holding. But that was it, wasn’t it? The reasoning behind Kephale being so terrified of him being here? He knew about all of this, and didn’t want Mydei to know, and now he had personally seen it all?

“We’re here!” Phainon announced making Mydei’s head jerk a little as a curtain fell around him - making him idly aware that they had just moved into a chamber in the bathing quarters that was blocked off by just one regal set of curtains. 

And Phainon didn’t waste a single moment at that, instead putting Mydei down on his own two feet - and before Mydei could even consider trying to make a run for it, Phainon only leaned forward a little. 

“Would you prefer me to undress you for our bath, or will you do it yourself?” Spoken so low and seductive that Mydei couldn’t even process his own thoughts - slowly moving his hands towards the hem of his shirt only to hear Phainon chuckle a little. 

A hand moving to the top of Mydei’s own to make him jerk a little in shock - throwing such a sharp glare at Phainon that only seemed to have the opposite effect for some reason. Such a smug smirk coming onto his lips as he sighed softly, “I know you’re as eager as I am, but let’s make sure we’re alone first before you’re nude.”

Phainon straightened himself out at that - looking at someone else for once and Mydei had to pause to reevaluate the situation he was currently in. Was he actually going to do this? It was fine, wasn’t it? It was just a bath together, nothing more, nothing less. A bonding moment between two crown princes after Mydei had caught him doing something nearly unforgivable. 

.. Nearly?

Why was he suddenly considering it only ‘nearly’ unforgivable..? 

“Get him a pair of clothes to change into,” Phainon commanded one of those people in those private baths - making Mydei resist the urge to glance at them, instead swallowing a little dryly, “My clothes, mind you. Not his own, something soft and comforting.”

Mydei wanted to growl over that, to say he didn’t need to be coddled or have ‘soft’ clothes to comfort him, that was all so idiotic. And yet he didn’t say a word. He instead remained standing there as his eyes watched the way Phainon was pacing around.

Worried?

He didn’t seem it, instead he seemed much too happy, genuinely appearing thrilled every time he looked at Mydei. 

“The rest of you should leave,” Phainon purred out, as if it was something that was just a suggestion, but it obviously was not as everyone in that room nodded as immediately began to flee as if their lives depended on it. And, well.. Now Mydei had to think that maybe it did. 

“Now then!” Phainon began all while turning attention wholly back onto Mydei, clapping his hands a bit cutely - completely unfitting considering the way they still had a coat of blood on them, “Let’s undress!”

.. He really did sound much too cheerful that he so quickly practically was tearing off his own clothes all while Mydei was doing his best to ignore that. Instead languidly moving as he did take note of the marks of blood on him now - assuredly from Phainon messily, but marking him in blood nonetheless. 

Mydei sighed over it - tugging off his now bloody shirt and idly moving to the side, at least. He wanted to, only for a hand to immediately snap to his waist as soon as Mydei did as much as turn slightly to put his shirt on one of the benches in that circular room. Scoffing a little over how tight that hand was on him, digging into his pants just a tiny bit.

“Where are you going, Mydei? You can just put your clothes on the ground, there’s no reason to move away from me,” Phainon told him, and Mydei moved to immediately bat that hand away from himself - throwing a glare at that man who seemed like a kicked puppy suddenly. 

“Wherever I please,” Mydei snarled at him, and he absolutely despised the way Phainon let out a quiet sounding chuckle at that before letting go of him. An action that made Mydei jerk himself free quicker to return to his self imposed task of putting his shirt neatly on that bench. 

Sure, it needed to be washed, but he had to heave a sigh as he moved to remove those bloody pants and settled them on the bench as well. Only to feel his fingers pause with his underwear, his fingers twitching a little over the way he wasn’t quite sure about this. Taking a bath with Phainon.. That was all it was, right? Nothing more, he hoped. 

Whatever the case, he did feel like he needed one as he kept his back to that man - refusing to look behind him as he slowly removed his underwear, all while praying for his mind to stop paying any attention to the way Phainon’s tail had begun to wag behind him like a dog. 

And Mydei absolutely did not want to assume it was due to Phainon staring at his ass - or whatever he could see of his ass with his tail blocking most of the view. 

Either way, he could feel the burn of embarrassment almost instantly in his cheeks - taking a moment to refuse to turn back to that man while his tail curled around his leg just a bit. Not that it mattered either way, not when Phainon had come to him and immediately just picked him up again without a single moment to waste. 

And Mydei debated snarling and biting that dragon’s hands off, if not for the way Phainon had instantly moved the both of them into the bath without a breath of delay. 

Hot.

That water was much hotter than the water Mydei was used to as he was put into it like a child being dunked into a pool. Huffing a little as Phainon released him only to hear some quick splashing behind him - noises that Mydei didn’t dare to look behind to view. Not that it mattered as he stood there letting his body adjust to the heat.

At least, that was what he planned to do before moving to the other side of the bath, only to have that idea stolen from him as arms once more found their way around him - tugging him roughly backwards and in between Phainon’s own legs. A tight fit considering Mydei wasn’t that much smaller than him and had a.. Plump tail, but that wasn’t the worst of it.

The worst of it was the way he could feel those hands on his hips moving up and down as if Phainon was trying to massage him a little. The worst of the worst of it was the way he could.. Feel Phainon now. 

.. The intimate part of Phainon, at least, and Mydei had to click his tongue a little as he dared not wonder if that dragon was a shower or a grower. Either way; He was big, and that was more than enough knowledge about Phainon’s penis than he ever had hoped to learn. 

“Mydei,” Phainon began with only the sounds of rippling waters between them, soft and polite sounding all while Mydei found himself latching to the fact there was blood in these waters. Being soaked clean from Phainon’s demonic claws that were now so lovingly pressing into his skin as if Mydei was something he cherished.

As if he hadn’t probably used them earlier to take someone’s life and eat their innards. 

Still, Phainon only continued, “Did you like the desserts I had made for you? They were supposed to make you stay in your room during the ritual, but ah.. You’re a bit too curious, I see that now..”

.. So they were to keep him busy? 

An insane method, but he supposed if he wasn’t overly wary of it.. It probably would have worked on him. He certainly felt a deep amount of regret now as he sat between Phainon’s legs, feeling the way Phainon seemed to be pressing them closed around him, as if he was doing his best to make sure the fit was as tight as possible. 

Insane. This entire day had been insane, and Mydei still wasn’t sure what to even make of it, or if he could tell a single soul of it - let alone if he hoped to be believed.

It sounded fake to even his whole mind that an entire kingdom could be a cult worshiping their prince.. And now Mydei was stuck knowing that it was true as Phainon only seemed to lean into him a little - pressing his chest into Mydei’s back as Mydei still refused to look at him. Instead staring downwards at the steaming waters that seemed to have had something added to it.

Foam was brewing on the surface with the scent of lavender heavy in the air - a scent for relaxation, but Mydei didn’t know if that was possible anymore knowing what he knew now about the man nuzzling his head into Mydei’s own head as if Mydei wouldn’t notice it. 

“.. I didn’t.. Eat any,” Mydei confessed in a heavy breath, doing his best to ignore the splashing sounds behind him and the footsteps - only trying his hardest to get a grip on himself. 

The main objective was to survive, to survive today and see another dawn, and also to survive this entire stay here. He would.. Simply have to never bring this up again; act as if he knew nothing and pray he was released. 

“Mm..” Phainon only hummed behind him - and Mydei twitched a little over a tail that didn’t belong to himself wrapped around his ankle. Just the tip it seemed, but that was enough for him to try to move out of that man’s hold. A useless attempt as Phainon only huffed a little laugh, moving his entire arm to Mydei’s waist to hold him there with those weak attempts, “Bring his sweets to my quarters from his room.”

Mydei couldn’t use his full strength.

That would be absolutely idiotic to do when the entire kingdom obviously worshiped this man - he had to.. Plan this accordingly, act as if he could do nothing and let Phainon have his fun unless it was simply too much for Mydei to handle. Or if he pushed some sort of line or boundary, Mydei would never allow such a thing to go too far.

.. But if it was just Phainon being clingy and hugging onto Mydei - he could handle that for now. 

“Mydeimos..” Phainon whined behind him, all while tugging him a bit closer and making Mydei bite out a growling from his throat - unable to keep it in as his mind only continuously traced back to that man tied down to that altar and the sight of Phainon nearing him covered in blood.

.. Why?

Why did that keep making his heart speed up at that memory? Why did he think Phainon was a little endearing as he looked at him with such a genuine smile on his blood stained lips? 

He had to be losing it.. That was the only option.

“You seem so tense,” Phainon hummed and Mydei was a little aware of the way his head was pressed against Mydei’s shoulder. So gentle, so timid that it seemed like Phainon was silently begging for permission. 

Permission that Mydei wouldn’t give as he instead sat there with his head drooped a little - eyes staring into that water and at the reflection of himself. 

He looked paler than normal, as if he had seen a ghost while his eyes searched for an answer - but Phainon didn’t seem to mind at all. 

“It’s alright.. You can relax a little.. No one will do anything to you, alright?” Phainon murmured those words so softly into Mydei’s skin that he had to fight back the shiver that ran down his spine. Only to fall a little short as Phainon’s hands drifted lower on his hips, one gripping onto him a bit tightly before the other found his way to his tail.

“I always wanted to help clean your scales.. It was regarded as reserved for only other dragonkin mates decades ago..” Phainon murmured, and Mydei had to swallow back a growl as he felt fingers at the base of his tail - a thumb pressing down on a scale before slowly rubbing it.

.. Cleaning it, apparently. 

“.. I’m.. Surprised to hear dragon blooded humans were ever allowed to mate with each other,” Mydei grumbled after a few moments, choking the words out as he tried to ignore how oddly sensual this felt - his eyes wanting to look at that man and yet he couldn’t bring himself to. Instead focusing on that hand on his hip in the water.

.. Large.

Phainon’s hand was so painfully large on his hip that it made Mydei’s head almost spin and feel dizzy - blinking a little over how easily those clawed fingers seemed to be near his intimate area and Mydei found it bizarre. He had never thought he was small, in fact he knew he wasn’t, and yet.. This dragon was simply much too big.

“Are you? Ah..” Phainon gave a quiet little chuckle - leaning forward a bit more to wetly press his chest into Mydei’s more - and Mydei scoffed a little over how close they were and the odd position of Phainon rubbing his tail. It couldn’t possibly be comfortable, and yet that man seemed so keen on speaking into Mydei’s ears, “I’ve been reading about it recently out of.. Curiosity, you could say.”

“.. Curiosity,” Mydei repeated in a flat tone, unsure of whether to believe him or not considering the way Mydei had.. Never once thought about these things for himself, instead feeling his cheeks burn at the thought of it. 

If cleaning another dragon’s scales was considered reserved for their mates, what on earth was Phainon trying to convey right now as his fingers seemed to be trying to slide up and under Mydei’s scales. Dented fingernails rubbing the sensitive skin underneath each of them as if he was trying to tease Mydei.

Slow and leisurely with the waters rippling around them and new water constantly flowing into the bath to keep it so dreadfully hot. 

“Of course! I’m just so eager to learn!” Phainon chirped, and Mydei couldn’t even figure out a reply to that - even if he had wanted to reply, his mouth only opened and shut again. His mind felt so painfully stunned over today. He knew a few things, at least.

One; Phainon was certainly eating a person today, blood and gore running down his face and claws with his attire painted red were enough to tell Mydei that much. 

Two; The people of Aedes Elysiae seemed to worship Phainon in some way, offering him up sacrifices on that apparent altar and whispering praises while he ate someone. Alive? Dead? Mydei didn’t know what their fate was before Phainon showed up, but he certainly ended them one way or another.

Three; Mydei’s own instincts were going haywire today. He was unsure if he was terrified of the fact a man who ate people was trying to cuddle him, or kind of turned on by it. He had to assume it was due to his own draconic instincts wrapping their claws into his humanity over such a feral sight. 

Even with his blood not being as rich as Phainon’s, the fact that he still had them there was.. Evident, now. Especially with how his body got excited and made him breathe heavier every time he considered how decent at hunting for his mate Phainon must be. Insane and deranged thoughts, and yet he had to move a hand to his own arm - tightening around his wrist to keep himself from losing himself to them. 

“You’re quiet again.. That’s fine.. You’re so cold to the touch, Mydei.. It’s nice.” Phainon purred as his head seemed to rest a little on Mydei’s shoulder - rubbing into him just a tiny bit but Mydei felt that was just an excuse.

There was no way he was cold when the water was so hot and his embarrassment was heating him from the inside out - every single movement he made felt like he was feeling more and more of Phainon’s.. Third leg and made him flustered. There was simply no way he was cold, not with that man’s hand still rubbing his tail under the excuse of cleaning him.

‘Cleaning’ him in the sense that Phainon’s fingers felt more experimental than anything - roaming around a little to rub at Mydei’s tail languidly. Pushing up and down on his scales teasingly, or as if he was searching for something - and Mydei didn’t have to wonder what he wanted to find as Mydei jerked a little. 

“A loose scale..Can I have it? I really want it,” Phainon asked without missing a single beat, making Mydei’s breath completely leave him as he moved his hand to grip at Phainon’s wrist that was still holding onto his hip. A hiss on his lips over that question, his mind a complete blur as he could feel the way Phainon’s fingers had latched onto that scale that was ready to leave him - tight and unyielding. 

“That’s..” Mydei began, feeling his throat struggling to adapt over how that dragon was asking for something so personal - scales were usually thrown away. 

Unless you had a mate.

In which case it was traditional to give them to your love for jewelry or ornaments depending on what your lover preferred, and that was the only time you gave them to others. A deep and meaningful gift, and now Phainon was humming in Mydei’s ears - unabashedly purring as if this was the best day of his life all while those two fingers stayed holding onto that scale of Mydei’s. 

“Don’t you have.. Enough scales for yourself?” Mydei growled out, unsure of what else to say to this prince who had such a hold on him - such a demanding man who only rubbed his head into Mydei’s shoulder with a little late fluttering out of Phainon’s throat over the hissed out words. 

“None as beautiful as yours, Mydeimos.”

It shouldn’t be embarrassing, it shouldn’t make Mydei feel like he wanted to fold for this dragon - and yet his mind was so confused today. Everything he had ever been taught was being tested, and he had no idea how he was managing to have enough patience for it all - clicking his tongue over those words in the absence of actual words coming to his mind. 

“Take it if you so desire, but know that it holds no meaning to me,” Mydei spat every single word out of his mouth as if it were venom, unable to help himself as he bit down on his tongue a little to stay sane.

Though, he was finding that harder and harder to do as Phainon wiggled that scale a little - gently trying to pull it free from Mydei’s tail with a soft chuckle escaping him, “That’s fine. It can be sentimental to just myself, I don’t mind that at all..”

.. Mydei suddenly felt like he had chosen the wrong choice here - he absolutely should have said no but the moment had passed now as he felt that scale be wiggled free with a hum from Phainon again. All while Phainon seemed to lean back a little, his hand still on Mydei’s hip all while he pressed his lower half more into Mydei.

Leaning back? Was that what he was doing? Mydei really couldn’t tell, nor was he willing to look back at that dragon to check either. 

The more bizarre thing was the way Phainon stayed silent after that - instead letting the water make all the sounds in the air, soap and lavender lingering in a soothing way, not cloying at all. And a piece of Phainon was a little bit amused that Mydei still didn’t look up from his book with even his name being said, “You’re avoiding me! And it’s odd of you to skip work.. But you’re avoiding me! Why?”

That question made Mydei’s eyes slowly leave his book - creeping up to Phainon’s face before tilting to the side a little. His golden eyes looked like they were clouded in a mess of tangled emotions, so many that Phainon couldn’t get a read on Mydei at all as Mydei’s tail slapped into the ground a few times.

All before Mydei quoted him in an odd tone - high-strung and sounding as if he was rather unhappy currently, “I am not ‘skipping’ work, I was told not to work there today.. Why?”

Phainon had to swallow over that; taking in the way Mydei seemed to be genuine yet his words were void of emotion - as if he was trying his best to show no emotions towards Phainon. And perhaps that was due to the ritual Mydei had seen, maybe his mind had finally caught up to him.

Phainon had no idea as he swallowed a little, uncomfortably shifting his weight.

“Are you actually inquiring as to why I would be avoiding you, Phainon? You..”  Mydei asked before scoffing loudly, his words sounded sharper than a knife as he moved to lazily wave his hand to the side of his head - as if he was doing his best to disperse the topic from both of their minds by waving it away. “It doesn’t matter, I’ll stay in my own area and you stay in yours.”

Phainon couldn’t help but to drop his hand from the bookshelf at that - hearing his own claws scratch against the wood as he hummed a little quietly. His mind was not even fully comprehending the words that were being said to him as he chuckled a little, “What do you mean by that?”

“Let’s cease talking as we do. There’s no reason for us to be.. Overly familiar when I am merely a.. Guest here for now,” Mydei explained as his eyes dropped back to that maroon book in his hands - still sitting cross legged on the floor as if he wasn’t bothered at all by it.

And Phainon couldn’t blame him, he kept hearing the whispers debating what Mydei meant to Phainon after his display yesterday carrying him away while covered in blood to bathe together.  That scenario was doomed to be the topic on everyone’s minds, and enough to make people not question or bully too much anymore. 

Even though Phainon was rather sure no one had ever picked on Mydei even before this; he was still a crown prince, and the crown prince of Castrum Kremnos at that. Phainon highly doubted anyone personally wanted to be the cause of that crown prince becoming unhappy, or even worse..

Yet now, Mydei was growling about how he didn’t want to speak to Phainon anymore? Was the ritual truly so terrible to him? That didn’t seem like the case from how Mydei had just let all of that happen yesterday, between bathing together and sleeping together while Mydei was naked.. Surely he wouldn’t have just gone along with it in refusal to cause issues.

.. That didn’t sound like Mydei, but maybe it was; either way, Phainon wasn’t exactly keen on just allowing it all to happen, though. He had no desire to let that man slip away from him, not now, not ever.

“Mm.. You’re making me nervous, Mydei! Why would we stop talking like this? I’m rather fond of it,” Phainon countered with a quiet little laugh, waving his hand lazily before moving to put it onto his hip with a smile on his lips.

A lie, but it was a smile nonetheless as he stared at Mydei, waiting to hear what reasoning that man could possibly give Phainon all while he seemed to be in deep reflection over Phainon’s words. Looking more and more like he was having to heavily think on this topic, all before he clicked his tongue and turned his eyes back to his book. 

“.. It’s for the best for both of us, I believe,” Mydei mumbled out rather quietly, and while Phainon knew they were in a library, Mydei really didn’t need to speak so quietly.. Not when he was speaking to the crown prince of Aedes Elysiae, and that made Phainon only stand there stiffly.

Eyes watching Mydei’s every move before realizing that man wasn’t going to say anything else as the sound of a page turning could be heard in the lull of any words; “I disagree! Mydei, speak to me..”

Even with his pleading, Mydei only gave him an odd little look - one that looked unamused and unsold on the idea Phainon was trying barter with him over. 

And that was enough to make Phainon start scavenging his mind for excuses to be around Mydei more, to have more talks and bond more. If the ritual had spooked him, they just needed to work through it! If Mydei thought Phainon had tried to push his luck last night, he hadn’t! He had politely waited until Mydei left his bedroom, actually!

But now he needed something.. And Phainon found himself to be so painfully greedy in regards to Mydei - even now as he swallowed slowly as the answer came to his mind.

“Actually, would you be willing to spar with me, Mydeimos?” Phainon asked, feeling himself perk up a little as he grinned at Mydei - watching the way those golden eyes slid to him so leisurely. So dreadfully slow that Phainon knew he was probably winning this fight - unable to stop the tip of his tail from wagging in his new and renewed hope in opening Mydei up again.

“.. Spar?” Mydei quoted out, but Phainon found himself watching the way Mydei’s eyes were already lighting up in his unabashed wonder. 

Phainon was more than a little prepared for this, already spending days fantasizing about fighting Mydei again that he couldn’t help but nod swiftly over it, “With your gauntlets, you can try to kill me if you would like, I just.. I think I need to clear my head and practice against someone who can give me a challenge!”

Clearing his head was certainly an excuse, but Phainon didn’t know what to say as those eyes were staring into him so hauntingly - piercing him into his core and making him shift his weight between his feet as that prince remained there. It was odd to see a prince sitting on the floor like this - but Phainon knew it was probably to avoid people seeing him.

Most likely due to the fact most people in the castle had seen him yesterday, but Phainon wasn’t sure how to convey to him that it was fine; no one would bother Mydei!

“And what if the crown prince is wounded? Surely I will be held accountable,” Mydei pointed out in a rather bored sounding tone - one that made Phainon swallow heavily once more. His own spit feeling uncomfortable against his throat before he laughed a little. 

“I’ll enjoy it,” That was a promise as he spoke those words, earnestly meaning them - and yet Mydei only stared at him with an expression that could only be described as flabbergasted, nothing less - and nothing more. 

“Pardon me?” Mydei asked in a voice that sounded as if he was straining a bit to keep his focus - and Phainon had to chuckle over that as well. Moving only a few steps closer to that man still on the floor - striding with confident steps all before leaning down a little towards Mydei who was now fully staring upwards at him. 

“Make me bleed, Mydeimos,” Phainon purred out those words as seductively as he could, all while offering his hand towards Mydei to help him up. 

Mydei seemed as if he had to take a moment after that - studying Phainon so blatantly before sighing as he closed his book. Not wasting a single moment before putting it back on the shelf with a scoff as he gave Phainon his hand; “.. What type of dragon are you?”

“I wonder..?” Phainon asked right back with a little laugh, immediately tugging Mydei to his feet and feeling himself unable to stop the smile that had crept onto his lips - staring at the way Mydei moved to look at that book one last time and well..

.. Phainon had to mourn the way Mydei wasn’t wearing the clothes he had borrowed from Phainon, instead he had changed back into his work attire as ‘prisoner’ at their kingdom and that made Phainon click his tongue in annoyance.

Not at Mydei, of course! Never at him, but towards the fact Mydei felt like he had to be wearing these clothes instead of some of Phainon’s silk comfortable ones.. They were a little bit big on Mydei, so maybe they had annoyed him or were bothersome in that case? Phainon had no idea as he sighed a little wistfully with his own thoughts. 

Phainon could admit it.

He absolutely was gripping onto Mydei’s hand even after helping him up - watching the way Mydei physically turned his head to look down a little at their hands with a stunned expression marring his beautiful features. All before Mydei yanked his hand free and threw Phainon such a pointed and dangerous glare that only worked to excite Phainon even more.

“.. Very well, I will spar with you. I am allowed to use my gauntlets, yes?”

“Of course, I would prefer you to be comfortable in our duel, and if you’re most comfortable using your fists; I’m powerless to tell you no,” Phainon nodded instantly, unable to help himself as he gave a little laugh over how silly Mydei sounded.

This dragon still didn’t comprehend that he was allowed to do anything in this kingdom and Phainon himself would bail him out no matter what it was. It was kind of cute in a way.. And annoying. Phainon didn’t find himself overly fond of how Mydei seemed to undervalue himself. 

“‘Powerless’ is an odd way for the man with all the power currently to speak,” Mydei grumbled all while already moving to walk past Phainon - and action that had Phainon’s tail back to its spine aching speed as he hummed in amusement and chased after that man immediately. 

“Not true, Mydei.. I’m quite weak to you, if you have requests I will see that they are done with all the power I have,” Phainon replied with a little laugh,  “Especially if it makes you more comfortable around me and here. I want you to..”

Stay forever.

Those were the words Phainon couldn’t bring himself to say just yet - choking a little as he struggled with his own brain, only for Mydei to click his tongue loudly. 

“Right.. I’ll go get my gauntlets,” Mydei grumbled back, still quickly moving to try to out pace Phainon, but it wasn’t as if Phainon wasn’t prepared for such a  thing, instead laughing even louder in that silent library to chase after Mydei.

“I’ll go with you!”

“.. I should have expected as much.”

Chapter End Notes
