chapters.title: Chapter 11
chapters.html:
At this point, Mydei was pretty sure this world was just messing with him, but at the least he was a bit eager to take up Phainon’s offer to spar and fight each other. It would be nice to vent his frustrations out on that man, and he seemed.. A bit too eager for Mydei to harm him.

Was it so he could have an excuse to get rid of Mydei, or was it the other option that Mydei’s mind was struggling to understand? The option that Phainon genuinely just wanted to feel Mydei hurt him and cause him to bleed.

.. Mydei had heard that some people were in fact into such sexual forms of play, but he didn’t know if that applied to Phainon or not. Let alone the fact he wanted Mydei to do it to him.. 

“Why don’t you wear your jewelry anymore? Your tail was beautiful with that chain wrapped around it,” The devil himself jammed his way into his thoughts, humming out those words from behind Mydei and making him pause a little as his fingers brushed against the gold of his gauntlets. 

Lingering on them in his dresser he had stored them away before slowly tilting his head; just enough to look at where Phainon seemed to be standing at the side of his bed so innocently. 

“.. I should not be flaunting jewels and gold while a.. Guest,” Mydei replied a little bit coldly, sighing over the mere idea of wearing such things when he could barely be considered a prince more than a prisoner. 

Though, he had to call himself a guest due to the fact he knew Phainon would raise a hissy fit over it - and Mydei wasn’t sure if he really wanted to hear it today from that guy.

Instead Mydei focused his eyes on that pair of gauntlets as he took them out of the drawer - sighing a little as he heard Phainon’s tail swishing rather loudly. That was a sound that he was growing quite used to realizing was not a good thing for Mydei personally.

“Mm.. Should I gift you some, then? Since I’m the crown prince who is hosting you, surely you wouldn’t refuse to wear my gifts to you?”

Mydei had to turn slowly to look at that man - an itch in his own mind as he recalled the fact Phainon had tugged free one of his scales. An act that was.. Beyond odd to him, considering owning a scale from a person with draconic blood usually had romantic implications with it. 

Was he.. Supposed to view Phainon differently, or just accept that this was the reality he was oddly living? Maybe Phainon just actually liked how his scales looked..? Or were courting rituals a bit different outside of Castrum Kremnos? He didn’t think so, but Mydei didn’t know what to think really ever anymore.

“Are you trying to push me into some kind of corner?” Mydei asked as his fingers gripped onto his own gloves - feeling his eye twitch just a tiny bit as he tried to figure this man out.

But asking did nothing for Mydei’s sanity, not as Phainon seemed to brighten up over it - a sparkle in his eyes as a smile grew on his lips so immediately over the question; “Yes. Is it working?”

..?

What kind of answer was that..? Was he enjoying toying with Mydei so much like this? 

“.. I have little right to refuse the crown prince’s gifts when I am living in his own kingdom,” Mydei began to explain as his eyes trailed down to his hands - feeling a bit miffed over this line of questioning, “But I would hold disdain over it.”

“How much disdain?”

“Enough.”

“How much is enough?”

Mydei had to flick his eyes upwards - staring at the way Phainon was merely staring right back at him with such a dopey looking expression. As if he fully knew what he was doing, and yet he didn’t care at all; like his goal was to piss off Mydei or something.

And by god was it working as Mydei tried to take his time staring at Phainon, looking at his face and features all before slowly blinking; “Are you always this annoying?”

“Only towards what I fancy for the day,” Phainon began with such a heavy sigh as if this was the hardest question of his life - all before he moved a little to point at Mydei, wagging his finger, “That’s you now, but everyday, by the way.”

.. This was complete lunacy, Mydei understood that now as he stared at Phainon, trying his best to comprehend what the hell this man would ever be trying to get at. The obvious answer was love, but Mydei really didn’t like the idea of this actually being Phainon trying to be romantic with him.

Mainly because they were two crown princes. They were never going to fall in love and have it work, there was just no scenario in which that worked. Yet Mydei’s mind kept gnawing at his bones and making his heart speed up when he thought too long on the idea of Phainon romantically pursuing him. 

Maybe it was due to the fact Mydei had never been pursued, but whatever the case was.. His head felt like it was spinning regardless. 

Mydei had to press out a sigh of his own with his thoughts, shaking his head leisurely; “Are you certain you wish to spar? What if I ruin that face of yours? What would you have left then?”

“My charming personality,” Phainon replied without missing a beat, but Mydei could feel the way his own jaw twitched before he began to grit his teeth. 

“That’s not much to work with,” Mydei countered without much of a second thought - raising a brow over the way Phainon barked out a laugh over that.

Was this.. Friendly banter?

Were they simply joking around with each other? 

Mydei really had no idea.. This was so very baffling to him as he cocked his head to the side to watch that man laugh. His laugh was so melodious that Mydei felt like his head was a bit stuffy - a bit dizzying as he thought of how smooth that laugh was.

.. Enticing. That was the word for the way Mydei felt with that laugh, and Mydei felt more and more embarrassed as Phainon gave him such a warm smile after his laugh. 

“Cold! It’s alright, Mydeimos. I have more than enough faith that I can protect my face against your attacks,” Phainon practically purred out those words, making Mydei blink slowly - whatever feelings of yearning and his fluttering heart he once had was so very gone as he blinked at Phainon.

That sounded more than a little offensive as Mydei fought back the urge to snarl at this absolute buffoon, taking a moment to collect himself all before sounding more than a little annoyed to even himself as he finally spoke; “You think so little of my abilities?”

“Heavens no! I think you’re just little in general,” Phainon immediately corrected himself with a wave of his hand - but Mydei only felt his snarl getting worse over those words. Looking at the way Phainon was now obviously struggling for his footing as he shuffled his weight, eyes danced around Mydei’s guest bedroom as he awkwardly tried to figure out what the hell he meant to say.

All before Phainon eventually waved his hands a little, laughing again (but this time Mydei found himself to be quite immune to how sweet it sounded), “Don’t look at me like that! You’re uh.. Shorter than me! It would be hard for you to hit my face!”

.. This man had to be trying to anger Mydei again, that’s all. 

Nothing more, nothing less. Phainon just actually wanted Mydei to growl and try to choke him to death - he knew that much as he slowly blinked at Phainon. Staring at the way Phainon was knitting his brows together before moving to rub the back of his neck and his eyes turned upwards to the ceiling slowly. 

“.. I’m going to be aiming for your face,” Mydei confirmed with his hissed out words, finding himself less than endeared with the idea of having any mercy for Phainon when this man so clearly was desiring to be hurt.

Only for Phainon to lower his eyes again - hand dropping to the side as he sniffled a little. Too loudly, really, as he seemed to cough a little to clear his throat.

All annoying little gestures in Mydei’s eyes as he glared at that man - feeling no mercy in his heart for a prince who was mocking Mydei’s height. He was not small. Not at all, other people were much smaller than himself. This crown prince, however, was just too large and clumsy. 

Large and foolish. 

“Did I say something wrong? I’m sensing that I said something wrong..” Phainon’s voice sounded whiny, worried like he was struggling to think of what to say and sniffled a bit over his own words. But Mydei felt no mercy still, only staring at Phainon as if to silently tell him to try to figure it out for himself because Mydei would not be aiding him.

Though, Phainon’s eyes only seemed to plead at him, blinking slowly at Mydei as he let out such a quiet little whimpering noise over the way Mydei was still just standing there with his gauntlets in his hands. 

“Your silence is scaring me.. Can I ask if you’re proficient in other weapons as well?” Phainon asked, and Mydei was very aware of the way this man was so blatantly trying to change the subject now.

But it was on a topic that Mydei quite liked, so he had to give in to the man with a sigh; “.. You claimed I could use my gauntlets.”

“Yes! You can, I’m just curious about you in general, Mydei!” Phainon immediately reconfirmed, looking as if he was a bit more panicked over the way Mydei’s voice sounded annoyed now. 

Mydei had to roll his eyes just a tiny bit over that - moving to shake his head leisurely as he looked back down to his gloves, “Much like you, I can wield many weapons through being trained. I merely prefer my gauntlets.”

He was assuming that Phainon could use multiple weapons, at least, he had no idea but Mydei’s own training as a crown prince had taught him an abundance of skills in weaponry. Though, that could be not universal considering Aedes Elysiae originally was known for farming this wheat and hailing the land and all it would give them.

Castrum Kremnos was known for.. Certainly not that. 

“Wow, talented and beautiful..” Phainon cooed out, only to make Mydei feel that similar flicker of agitation in his mind once more. 

“Your words are like sandpaper to my ears,” Mydei growled as he moved a step closer to Phainon - shaking his head disapprovingly slowly and with a tired sigh falling out of his lips easily. 

Though, Phainon only blinked at him for a moment before speaking, “Huh.. What year was sandpaper invented?”

“Be quiet. Where are we sparring?” Mydei hissed out, not daring to consider the fact he wasn’t sure if he should be bringing up sandpaper or not in this time period. 

That wasn’t important, what was important was the fact this man seemed to be playing with him still - teasing him like Mydei had not seen him actively eating a man yesterday atop an altar with the entire kingdom’s staff watching and kneeling to the sight.. 

“Oh! Let me ponder this..” Phainon purred his words smoothly before moving a hand to his own chin to rub at his skin almost absentmindedly - making Mydei’s annoyance creep up even more over how insane this felt.

This had happened before, where Phainon would tease and play with him like this - all while claiming there was nothing malicious about it. But if it was not meant to be malicious, what was the goal of it?

Mydei didn’t know, but what he did know was the way he was moving to cross his arms over his chest - fingers gripping harshly at his gloves with a tired little sigh; “.. Can you think faster? What kind of person asks to spar without knowing where?”

“I’m trying to think of which is more romantic..” Phainon immediately muttered out, sounding like he was really in quite deep thought but it only worked to make Mydei roll his eyes over the mere idea of that. 

“Are you trying to annoy me even more?” Mydei inquired, feeling his jaw snap uncomfortably to the side with the realization that he probably was aiming to bother Mydei in some sort of way considering he had ruined his quiet day of planned reading.

Granted.. He had not really been reading much, he was more so sitting in the silence of the library to merely.. Think of everything that had happened as of late; but could he really be blamed for that? 

“Okay, okay, let’s go to the public one since you seem less likely to be annoyed with that..” Phainon nodded with his own thought, smiling so brightly at Mydei that it only worked to cause a frown to form on Mydei’s own lips in his thoughts - a sinking feeling of dread boiling up inside of him as he tried to conjure up a reply. 

“That is the correct answer, Phainon,” That was all Mydei could sigh out as he shook his head, doing his best to try to stay sane. 

Though, that was only even more difficult as Phainon flashed him such a warm and comforting smile. The one that would have easily disarmed someone else had Mydei not been becoming a bit immune to giving in to his own emotions.

.. A bit. Just a bit. That was the key words in there as he felt his stomach churning a little over how that smile made his emotions flare up in desire and want. 

“Come with me, dearest,” Phainon spoke, making Mydei do his best to burn away whatever feelings he was currently working on having. He didn’t need these nicknames to be used to tease him, not when he was already working on trying to ignore his affections as he slowly gave up.

Instead moving to follow Phainon out of his bedroom and clicked his tongue a little over the way that oversized dog was holding the door open for him so politely. 

“‘Dearest’? What happened that makes you believe you are allowed to call me such a thing?” Mydei asked with a sigh slipping past his lips as he shook his head, walking by that man and watching the way Phainon closed his door shut softly. 

“It’s just friendly banter, Mydei!” Phainon informed him as he spun on his feet, eyes twinkling as if he was so very happy over every thing but Mydei found himself stuck on that. 

Banter..?

Mydei had to click his tongue over that with his earlier thoughts - darting his eyes away as he instead focused on his gauntlets he was putting back onto his fingers. Already moving to testingly flex them with a pleased hum leaving his throat over how he had longed for this again.

He felt most at home and safe when he had these on his hands, and now he finally had them back on. He supposed he could thank Phainon for one thing, even if he did feel like he needed to stay clear of the man.. 

And now they were merely walking those halls, making Mydei sigh as he had no idea what kind of situation he truly was about to stumble into with this man as Phainon led him away with that familiar humming taking place, so joyful and whimsical..

.. Mydei hated it.

He hated the way Phainon seemed so genuine,  he hated how he seemed sweet and welcoming, he hated all of those lies so painfully much that it was becoming more than just bothersome. It was giving Mydei some kind of feeling he didn’t want to name, mixed with one that could easily be defined as hope.

And Mydei hated it. 

He hated the way he found Phainon amusing with his tail, so earnestly giving away his feelings of being excited or happy. He hated the way Phainon always smiled at him and seemed so gleeful just to see Mydei again. 

Mydei hated the way that he enjoyed it. 

.. That was all the more reason why Mydei wanted to tear that man’s smug face off with his gauntlets, to fight and gnaw at him and vent his frustrations towards him. It was the real true option for him as he pressed out a sigh while walking. 

All before Phainon veered around a corner with a laugh, “You’ve never been down this way, correct? Unless you went exploring more than just that room yesterday..”

“.. No, I’ve never been this way,” Mydei grumbled out as he raised his eyes upwards to look at the intricate carvings. Feeling a bit baffled that they took so much time to carve the wood and marble everywhere in this kingdom, but it was beautiful.

Well worth it, he supposed.

“Well! We’re going to where the knights train and spar daily. I’m sure they can make way for two crown princes wishing to..” Phainon trailed off, and Mydei had to ignore the way Phainon’s eyes slid to the side to look at him - looking amused, “Bond, I suppose!”

Bond.

This man was utterly insane, but Mydei merely clicked his tongue and stayed silent as they walked. Instead blinking as the bright sunlight hit his eyes as Phainon led him to such a clear opening. Just for that giant prince to talk to a man with Mydei waiting a bit to the side - studying him and the way he seemed smiley to everyone, not just to Mydei.

.. Almost everyone, he supposed. He certainly had been less than excited to speak to that woman who had spoken to Mydei.

But now Mydei could only turn his attention to the knights who were now pausing their spars, instead moving to the side to whisper and gossip between each other and that was enough to make Mydei sigh a little as he stood there.

This was going to cause more talks to rise, he knew that much, but he absolutely was not going to miss a chance to try to attack that man again in a field where it was allowed.

Especially as his eyes moved to watch Phainon move to the side of that large clearing, looking at some swords while still nodding to the assumed instructor beside him. Looking so intently focused on deciding which sword he should take, all before seeming to laugh and picking the largest claymore.

A thing that should weigh a ton, and yet Phainon merely plucked it from the rack with a singular hand - all before looking at Mydei with a smile on his lips. A sign that he clearly wanted Mydei to come over to him. 

.. Mydei didn’t like the fact that his body listened, either. Feeling himself immediately moving to Phainon’s side as that dragon moved to the opening of the clearing - throwing another smile to Mydei over his shoulder. 

“They said we can have as long as wanted, though, I did ask for a bit of privacy,” Phainon began to speak as Mydei moved closer - already looking at those knights and listening to the clinking and cluttering of metal while they seemed to be leaving. “They were quite worried about leaving me alone with you, but I’m sure you’ll be gentle with me.”

Gentle.

Mydei could only roll his eyes over that and remain silent as he watched everyone leave them alone - making Mydei only return his eyes to that crown prince. Just to watch him readying his sword, a grin heavy on his lips with a sparkle in his eyes. 

“Are you ready, Mydeimos? Since you are a guest here, you may strike first,” Phainon told him with a lopsided smile on his lips. 

Too cocky, too annoying, Mydei found himself already gritting his teeth in annoyance towards that; “Wow, how polite of you.”

“Isn’t i-” Mydei didn’t wait to hear out the rest of Phainon’s words however, instead lunging forward with his gauntlets. Dashing forward and feeling a growl in his throat bubbling forth - desperate to feel his hands grip any sort of flesh on that prince, only to feel annoyed over the laugh he heard as that claymore was moved to swiftly block his attack, “Woah! Warn me first!”

“Why? You seemed to have reacted just fine on instinct alone,” Mydei muttered out as he slammed his hand to the side, parrying that annoying blade before using his other fist to aim to punch at that man’s stomach as well. Only to meet the blunt metal of his sword once more with a loud clank of metal that made Mydei snarl slightly, “For your face’s sake, I hope you can keep it up.”

“You’re so mean to me!” Phainon whined, all while moving rather swiftly to try to slash at Mydei as well - an action that had Mydei smiling wickedly over how easy it was to dodge that blade. 

Big, not clumsy, but not nearly as fast or agile as Mydei, that much was obvious from his fighting style being much more rigid and formal. 

They were a bad match to spar together, and that’s why it felt so perfect as Phainon quickly surged forward, seeming eager to fight more and more - just like Mydeimos was. 

Though, he certainly was still a yapper in combat; “Mydei, does fighting excite you?”

“A chance to wound you excites me,” Mydei grumbled before moving quickly forward again and again - finding himself humored a bit over the way Phainon seemed to be so easily blocking it. 

Humored in the sense that Mydei was truly enjoying himself, so at the very least; at least Phainon was proficient in combat.

Phainon laughed a little quietly at that as he moved his sword to block another blow aimed for his face - sighing loudly and dramatically, “You’re so mean to me, Mydei. It would be saddening if I didn’t find it extremely attractive for some reason.”

“Attractive? Your venomous words will not aid you in combat,” Mydei spat as he once more tried to lay claim to something - anything as he grit his teeth more and more over the fact Phainon seemed to be having too much fun.

.. Yet Mydei was as well, wasn’t he?

.. Mydei wasn’t sure how to stomach that if it was the case, instead finding his words failing him over how idiotic he felt. Why was he feeling almost.. Let down? He had been expecting something like this in his life, to be married away for the sake of their people - even if his mother had tried her best to argue against it.

This.. This was assuredly just a forging of forced bonds in their kingdoms. A loveless relationship that would help their kingdoms, and Mydei.. Mydei could only swallow as his hand found his way to his stomach - idly feeling where his children were, children who.. 

Even if one of their parents hated them; Mydei would be enough.. He was making that vow right now - that he would care for them, even if Phainon did not truly. 

“Was?” Phainon asked, but Mydei..

.. Mydei just had to accept the fact that he was being used - that this man had done this for his kingdom, and Mydei was just the Kremnoan prince for him to use. 

A clutch to bind their kingdoms together and end the war, nothing more.

“Mm? What were we talking about?” Mydei asked as he slowly tried to get up again - no longer feeling those soft and warm feelings of safety with Phainon, instead.. Desperate to escape him again. Eager to be freed of him and speak to anyone that wasn’t him. 

Yet Phainon only softly laughed at that, whining a little as he tucked Mydei back down into his arms, “See! You’re too tired to go out today, Mydei.. Stay with me..”

“We’re nasty, Phainon..” Mydei huffed out as he stared at the ceiling - feeling his eyes burning over how much he had been staring at that today with hopelessness in his heart. Yet now, the depths of it all were.. Threatening to swallow him whole, an ocean aching to drown him as he realized this all meant nothing and he needed to come to terms with it.

Easier said than done, truly, considering the way his hormones were wrecked currently - a mess of emotions and desires that were idiotic and foolish, incredibly mundane and boring.. And yet he had wanted them to be real. 

He had wanted them selfishly, for even just a moment, and let himself believe it..

“You want a bath?! I love baths!” Phainon sang out much too happily - now seeming like he didn’t mind at all that Mydei wanted to leave. Instead, moving instantly to the side of Mydei and untangling all of their limbs, “Let’s go take a bath, Mydei..”

Mydei let out a quiet hiss over the way Phainon seemed to swiftly leave the bed, or well, at least their covers before moving to grab onto Mydei - wrapping him easily in the sheets before letting go again all while Mydei had to stare over the way Phainon was.. Wearing underwear. He didn’t quite remember when Phainon had put those on.

But the bigger issue was the way he moved to put on a robe of sorts - barely actually covering anything and leaving nothing to the imagination. All while Mydei found himself curling into those sheets - at the least he was alone to rest for a bit if that man was leaving..

That was what he thought and assumed, at least, all until hands were on him so tightly - yanking him out of bed all while he was still rolled up into those blankets. A snarl leaving his mouth without much of a second thought towards that man. Gripping onto the sheets to drag them with himself all before giving a broken whine.

Not that he wanted to, but because of how.. Odd he felt inside, his body moving made him so painfully aware of how wet he still felt, not just that, but the heavy weights in his stomach moved with the sudden movement. As if rolling slightly inside of him and that.. That was much too odd as he groaned a little before his head fell into such a familiar position.

Being clinged onto and picked up by Phainon really shouldn’t be ‘familiar’ and yet, he had to huff out a sigh - dragging those blankets closer to his face as he scowled over the way Phainon was shamelessly tucking him closer to sniff at him. 

“You smell so good right now,” Phainon whined out, sounding so very pathetic in his words, “Do we have to bathe? Can’t I just.. Clean you myself?”

Phainon was asking that, sure, but thankfully he had already begun to walk towards the door - a thing that made Mydei cover himself even more. Borderline wrapped himself up for a funeral with how tight he felt in those blankets, all while doing his best to ignore the way Phainon was..

.. Just in his underwear and his robe. 

Did that crown prince truly have no shame? 

“Clean me how, exactly?”

“I have a working tongue,” Phainon replied as he already carried Mydei out of that room - making Mydei roll his eyes over that. 

“No.”

“Please.. A few licks..”

“Licks where, precisely?”

“Ah..” Phainon trailed off, making Mydei glare at that man - driving daggers into him with his eyes and praying that Phainon could feel them through his thick scales,  “Armpit? Your taste was so strong there last night!”

.. His taste. Was that just a fancy way of saying where he was sweatiest, because he really had no idea what else that man was talking about.

“.. What kind of freak are you?” Mydei asked with a sigh falling out of him without even meaning to - shaking his head a little before dragging his blanket closer. There was.. A heavy amount of shame burning into his body over the fact he was naked and at Phainon’s mercy as he carried Mydei.

Though.. He had to admit, it felt less likely for him to show off Mydei’s nudity now that he was.. Whatever they were. 

“Do you not remember? I was choking you and licking you there. You seemed to really enjoy it, moaning and trying to whine through me gripping your neck,” Phainon hummed out, as if he was reminiscing on such a good memory that Mydei could only slowly drag his eyes to stare at Phainon,  “Until you peed your-”

“Shut up,” Mydei growled out, cutting Phainon off and not giving a single care in the world that Phainon made a small like ‘o’ with his mouth as he looked down at Mydei. A smile much too smug on his lips, too knowing and happy as he continued walking and Mydei absolutely hated it. 

“You are only angry because I am correct,” Phainon purred at him, and Mydei also hated the way he could hear Phainon’s tail swishing away so quickly as well. A piece of him feeling that familiar embarrassed burn in his stomach when he remembered what Phainon had done to him using that tail.. 

“I am only angry because I am mad,” Mydei grumbled out before retreating a tiny bit into his blankets again - a piece of him not even wanting to think of the fact they were still damp, and the way anyone that looked at them for too long would be able to tell. 

“W.. What?” Phainon asked before laughing a little, shaking his head as he instead looked to where he was dragging Mydei off to, “Anyway! When should we.. Tell my father you aren’t leaving?”

Those words were jarring however, enough to make Mydei cock his head slightly to the side - staring once more at Phainon with confusion on his features, “.. Aren’t leaving?” 

“Well, If I tried to live in Kremnos I think..” Phainon trailed off, looking like he had something more to say. Something that really was threatening to creep out of him, and yet, he laughed a little, “It would go badly, I think! People would be really upset!”

Mydei had to stare at Phainon over that silently, eyes dipping away as he slowly reached the conclusion of what that man was implying. Those familiar images of Phainon eating someone with practically everyone in the castle being there were hauntingly in his mind. Even more so now that his shoulder burned from those ravenous bites Phainon had given him during sex.

.. Yet Mydei’s mind could only linger on the burn of fingers he could still feel on his throat; heavy and daunting, seeming like they could so easily choke him and make it all end and still.. Phainon hadn’t, if anything, he was a bit too gentle than Mydei would have liked to have experienced. 

Returning to the thoughts of ‘people’ being upset over Phainon leaving, Mydei could.. Only assume he meant the people who seemed to worship him. That did seem.. Very likely that people would lose their minds if their apparent idol was suddenly gone.

.. But Mydei hadn’t agreed to stay here, either. A thought that was heavy in Mydei’s mind, and from the claws digging into his legs and his chest - he could only imagine Phainon was haunted by the same thought as he seemed.. A bit keen to keep Mydei as close to him as possible out of fear of him leaving. Or just territorialness over his eggs he had laid, Mydei had no idea which. 

“How are you feeling, Mydei?” Phainon asked softly, apparently not enjoying the silence that Mydei had fallen into over this topic. 

And Mydei.. Had to consider that question deeply, frowning a little over how he could feel every single step Phainon took so deeply. As if those eggs were jostling around inside of him and trying to find a place to comfortably stay.

It was annoying, if anything. 

“.. Uncomfortable,” Mydei decided with a heavy sigh, feeling the ebbs of tiredness working into his mind as he thought more and more of how useless his body felt right now. It was a weight dragging him down - even if his legs were still tingling from their exhaustion and Mydei was a bit baffled at that.

Was his stamina truly so bad, or was this man just so.. Gifted to where it had left his legs in need of aid for this long? 

Though, Phainon only hummed quietly, “Is there anything I can do? A massage, perhaps?”

“And would that work like your ‘stress relief’ too? Do not touch me,” Mydei growled out over that - not at all enjoying the idea of being held down for another round.

.. Even if he knew he probably would lose himself in the pleasure again, he absolutely did not care to endure that today. Not when his body still needed to adjust to those eggs as it was. 

“I’m.. Currently carrying you, Mydei. I’m touching you a lot,” Phainon pointed out with another one of those insufferable laughs that made Mydei’s heart betray him. Fluttering so happily and skipping a beat in sheer unabashed joy that made him feel like a moronic fool. 

“Put me down,” Mydei hissed out, words laced with venom as he immediately begin to twist a little. 

He didn’t need this man.

Even if he was merely a tool to be used by Phainon and Aedes Elysiae, he could stand on his own two feet and carry the burden. 

He didn’t need Phainon. 

“Ah,” Phainon only innocently began, “But you’re.. Naked, Mydei.”

“Put me down you insolent fool,” Mydei repeated, not in the mood at all as Phainon sounded so genuinely worried it was.. More than enough to make Mydei hate this situation all the while more as Phainon slowly paused to let Mydei down on his own two feet.

.. Mydei could admit he was an embarrassment as he touched the floor - making sure his bottom half was covered all while his other arm pressed against the wall to keep him upright immediately. His eyes could only focus on the floor as his stomach seemed a bit upset over it all.

Stomach, or eggs? Mydei really had no idea as he hung his head a little to press his hand to his stomach - snarling a little over the awkwardness in his own body all before he felt that blanket being stolen from him and wrapped around his shoulders securely. 

“Are.. You sure? You look pale,” Phainon softly spoke from behind, voice so quiet that he sounded as if he was trying not to frighten a feral kitten, “You’re not heavy at all, you should let me carry you, Mydei.”

“Be quiet,” Mydei growled out, not daring to look at that man again as he instead tried to shift his weight between his feet. Every movement only shifted those eggs inside of him and made him bite his tongue over how full he was,  “I can stand on my own.”

“I’m not worried about that, I’m more than aware you can do it,” Phainon immediately argued, still staying behind Mydei, “There’s simply no reason to if I’m here..”

Mydei didn’t care to hear it, there was more than enough reason to push himself - he did not need to be appearing so weak and pathetic in a foreign land. He needed to walk tall and proud in this place - and yet, that was becoming incredibly hard as Phainon pressed his body against Mydei’s back. 

“Mydei, you’re much too wobbly and not used to how your body has changed. Please just let me be useful to you,” Phainon mumbled out softly, his lips already on Mydei’s nape to press kisses onto his skin that only felt as if they burnt against Mydei’s skin. Hot and chaste, “I told you, I want to be used by you. So please, just let me worship my mate for today until you’re adjusted to your womb and our children..”

“Are you always this clingy with people?” Mydei asked with a breathy chuckle on his lips - doing his best to ignore the hand on his hip that was holding him steady. 

“Only you, beloved,” Phainon murmured against Mydei’s skin, making him painfully aware of the way Phainon seemed to be trying to cover his body with the blanket and his own body. 

“.. That doesn’t make me feel better,” Mydei confessed with a heavy sigh, feeling himself giving up a little on this idea. 

“Does it not? I’m sorry,” Phainon mumbled, and Mydei wanted to scoff at that - to mock him, and yet, he was easily picked up again and swung into Phainon’s arms. As if that man just couldn’t hold himself back any longer from doting on Mydei and being his personal chair for the day.

It didn’t matter anyway, he was just going to be hidden away inside Phainon's private baths. He didn’t.. Need to walk there in the nude with just a cloth around him - now when Phainon was offering to carry him for now. 

Though, there was something else that Mydei found his mind latching onto - his eyes slowly looking at those clawed hands that were gripping onto him so tightly before blinking to Phainon, “You’re apologizing, but are you aware you’re trembling, Phainon?” 

“I.. I confess, I’m a bit.. Nervous, Mydei,” Phainon replied, and most curiously, he didn’t bother to look back at Mydei. Instead seeming like he was much too focused on getting Mydei into the baths than anything now, and while Mydei was.. Thankful, considering how sweaty he was, it was still bizarre behavior from Phainon. 

“Nervous? I didn’t think you actually possessed such an emotion,” Mydei huffed out with a bark of laughter - a sharp thing as he clicked his tongue over how he was pretty sure this man normally didn’t feel that emotion often.

Only, fingers dug into Mydei more even through the layers, as if Phainon was trying to cling to Mydei for dear life; “My.. Father.. Will hear of this..”

“You didn’t consider that before putting eggs into me?” Mydei was genuinely asking, able to hear his own confusion and bafflement leaking into his words as he threw that man a blank stare. 

“Well! It was worth it to have you in my arms like you are now!” Phainon laughed with his own words - throwing Mydei such a dashing smile as if he was trying pickup lines with him. Only, Phainon had to sigh immediately after as Mydei ducked more into his blankets. Retreating a little as he heard the sounds of rushing waters and other people in the public baths.

All the whispers starting up over undoubtedly their prince being here already almost nude, and the bundled up dragon in his arms who probably only had most of his tail hanging out at the mercy of the world.

 “But I do think he will be.. Less than pleased,” Phainon spoke after a few moments, as if he himself had gotten distracted while walking to their destination - a rarity that made Mydei look away from him. Instead staring at nothing as he willed himself to disappear into the blankets. 

“From that ritual the other day I figured you could do no wrong,” Mydei mumbled out, feeling a little amused that even Phainon could get in trouble in this kingdom.. 

Only, Phainon didn’t reply instead to that as he instead moved Mydei into that quarters that he had been to just the night before. An insane timeline of events to unfold, and now.. Everything had changed so much.

It was completely different, and Mydei was now growing more and more at the mercy of Aedes Elysiae. 

“Leave us,” Phainon growled to one of the people at the bath, and Mydei was anything but shocked over how quickly they made a scramble to leave. Clearly, well trained to do what he said, when he says it - and yet, Phainon only sighed. 

“I can do wrong, yes. I wouldn’t call mating with you ‘wrong’, anyway. But I’m.. Not sure how he will handle my breeding of the crown prince of Kremnos..” Phainon explained as he slowly set Mydei down again - drawing out a breath from Mydei from between his teeth as he grit them together. 

He would undoubtedly get used to this feeling, but for now, it was an annoying feeling inside of him constantly - one that was haunting him every time he moved.

.. He really did prefer to be cared for and tended to by Phainon for just today. 

Mydei scoffed a little as he looked over his shoulder - watching that man shrug off his own robe before following suit with his underwear. A sight that Mydei looked away from, for some reason, even though that man had quite literally already given him a clutch; it still felt too intimate. 

“Breeding..” Mydei repeated, huffing a little as he felt Phainon’s hands stealing his blanketed sanctuary away from him - tugging it off his shoulders and leaving it on the floor, all before picking Mydei up once more just like he had the other day. 

Such a swift movement to put Mydei quickly into that steaming water with Phainon following suit and that..

.. That was enough to make Mydei melt, sighing out a little over how nice it felt to be in these baths after the hellish past day or so had been. 

“Sorry, should I use a different word?” Phainon asked all while he was settling in behind Mydei once more as if he belonged there. 

“.. No, that’s what it was. Nothing less, nothing more,” Mydei replied, feeling a bit numb over how he had already come to terms with the fact he was not going to be loved in this world; but at the least he would love his children.

His fingers moving to easily undo his braid at the side of his head, a quick movement of his fingers to remove that golden cuff and feel Phainon pluck it from him. Apparently to set it on the side of the baths all while under Mydei’s careful gaze. 

“Nothing more?” Phainon asked with a sheepish sounding laugh, “That’s..”

Phainon trailed off, as if he had finally run out of excuses to give - and Mydei could only face the front, ignoring whatever was happening in that man’s head for now. 

“Wash my hair for me,” Mydei demanded, anything to make that man ignore the idea of coming up with more excuses for their breeding to make their kingdoms find a more permanent peace.

.. Mydei didn’t need to hear them. 

Though, Phainon did seem to perk up a little over that, “Ah?”

“Did I stutter?” Mydei sharply asked, throwing a glare over his shoulder at a dragon who looked much too giddy over that - practically shining as if he was the sun while looking back at Mydei. A twinkle in his eyes that Mydei wanted to snarl over. 

“No, I’m more than happy to do what you want from me!”

“Good boy,” Mydei sighed as he faced the front again - instead deciding to ignore the way he could hear Phainon readjusting himself - moving around all while a tail returned to Mydei’s legs as if a habit from Phainon. Wrapping around him possessively while Phainon began to silently pour water much too gently onto Mydei’s head.

Soothing and slow, precise and clearly not wanting to get any onto Mydei’s face as he moved his hand to shield Mydei from the water pouring from whatever tool Phainon was using to gather it. 

All before after a few moments, Mydei could hear hands rubbing together behind his back quietly - not a word was spared as Phainon immediately moved them to Mydei’s head. Fingers rubbing at his scalp to massage shampoo onto his hair leisurely, as if Phainon was in no hurry to rush this at all. 

.. Not that Mydei could be angry over that, anyway, instead closing his eyes to feel those claws on his head. Scratching him slightly, but not enough to actually do any harm as Phainon seemed much more eager to use his fingertips as much as he could to work the shampoo in. 

And then that came to an end as Phainon seemed to take up focus with the rest of Mydei’s hair and not just the scalp. Washing them as well, before moving on to rinsing Mydei with a hum leaving his throat - back to singing the same tune he had sung so many times before all while soaking Mydei. 

Not that Mydei cared, he could only find himself scoffing a little every time a gentle hand found its way to his forehead to block off water going onto his face and eyes. That and sounds of water moving gave Mydei the sign that the dragon was finished with his chore, and that was confirmed as Phainon now seemed uncomfortable in the silence. 

“Mydei..” Phainon whined after a few moments, and Mydei felt himself tensing up as a large hand moved to cup at his pectoral. Grasping and kneading at him to where Mydei found himself baffled over it - watching those fingers massage him lazily. 

“Don’t be so handsy, it’s a bath no-”

“I’m not being handsy, I’m just.. Soothing my mate,” Phainon argued without missing a single second, seeming like he was dozing off a little as he laughed softly, “Feeling his breasts and how heavy they are in my hands.. Admiring him, you could say.”

Mydei had to press out a sigh over that explanation as Phainon’s fingers dug into the plump of his breast, “.. That is called being handsy, yes.”

“Mn..” Phainon hummed out, all before clicking his tongue as if an idea had suddenly come to mind, “Lean back on me, Mydei..”

Mydei didn’t like the fact he listened to him rather easily - not finding himself willing to argue with that annoying man as he slowly leaned into Phainon’s hold. Awkwardly sitting more against one of his legs with one of Phainon’s arms going under his own neck. 

“Just like that, now put your arm around my neck,” Phainon instructed, and that was enough to make Mydei give him an odd stare - blinking at that dragon who had such a shy little smile on his lips. 

A smile of a man plotting, Mydei knew that much as he frowned over it; “For what?”

“Please..” Phainon was borderline whining - and that was enough to make Mydei roll his eyes as he moved to put his arm around Phainon’s head a bit lazily, not feeling it was worth commenting on the way Phainon had practically picked up Mydei to put him into his lap.

How would it ever be worth bringing up when Phainon was already nosing into his armpit and licking there a bit too energetically. Almost seeming like he was eager as all hell to get another taste as Mydei breathed out a quiet sigh over it. 

“You are.. A freak,” Mydei hissed out as he felt those lips latching onto his skin and lightly sucking - a wet tongue lapping at his skin and making him click his tongue over how odd this was. Every lick against his skin sent shivers down his spine with how wet that tongue was, so blatantly slurping and making obscene noises from sucking at Mydei’s skin. 

It was too much, really, considering the way it sounded like Phainon was drinking the finest of wines.. Not.. Sucking Mydei’s armpit while slowly groping at his breast, with a tail still demandingly coiled around Mydei’s legs.

It was too silent to where Mydei found himself only able to focus on that mouth on his skin - the quiet sucking and licking of it in between water being pushed into the bath.. All before Phainon broke away partly, just a tiny bit. 

“I’m passionate about my mate, that’s all,” Phainon quietly muttered with his lips still pressed against Mydei’s skin to slur his own words slightly,  “Just relax, Mydei..”

Mydei found himself scoffing over that - his body twitching a little over the way Phainon’s mouth and breath felt against his skin. 

.. He was ticklish, even if he hated to admit it - having his armpit licked like this was strange beyond all repair, but he had to sigh over it and lean his head back on the bath. At least Phainon’s hand massaging his back at the same time did feel nice - pleasant and soothing to where Mydei could feel himself drifting off just a tiny bit.

Only when Phainon wasn’t aggressively slurping at his pit, of course, when that dog was whimpering and licking him - Mydei wasn’t sure what to focus on. Not that it mattered as a voice instead rang out in the silence.

“Your Highness,” Mydei found himself blinking his eyes open in a startled fashion - already moving to swing his arm forward and get that man away from him. A useless attempt considering the way Phainon’s claws dug into him in such a demanding fashion - dragging him closer all while Phainon’s head jerked up.

Too fast, so fast that drool was still connecting Phainon’s lips to Mydei’s armpit in such a thin line that it made Mydei’s face burn to watch Phainon’s tongue lap it up. Not even seeming bothered nearly enough as he dove back into Mydei’s armpit to lick whatever drool was there up before sighing heavily. 

“I’m busy, do not disturb me,” Phainon growled out in such a darkened tone that Mydei found himself staring at the ceiling in a bit of a daze. Barely even registering the way Phainon had snuggled back into Mydei after those words, licking his neck as if he were trying to soothe Mydei back into his sleepy state. 

“I know, my lord. And normally I would love to obey you, however, King Kephale has demanded that I tell you and the crown prince of Kremnos he expects to speak to you both when you are finished.”

Mydei could feel the way Phainon tensed up around him, no longer tenderly nuzzling into Mydei and practically silently pleading for him to relax and succumb to Phainon. Instead, his hands had begun to shake again, still clawing at Mydei’s body a little - yet somehow not digging in enough to break skin.

.. Mydei had to praise him for that, blinking a little at the clear display of self control, all while fighting his own spiking anxiety it seemed. 

“.. My father?” Phainon replied as Mydei slowly made an attempt to untangle himself from that man - biting back a growl in his throat over the way Phainon’s tail moved to push him closer. Lazily sitting on his lap and nudging him backwards; back into Phainon’s embrace all while he could tell that oversized lizard was staring at whatever attendant was speaking. 

“Yes sire, please excuse me..” They spoke once more, and that left Mydei staring at the rippling waters while feeling Phainon’s fingers tap at his own skin beneath the waves of it. There were no words being said between them, no noises but the waters now and Mydei..

.. He found that suffocating. Phainon wasn’t known to stay quiet, he wasn’t known to not have things to say, and yet.. He was saying not a word - nothing to comfort either of them and instead allowing the silence to fester. 

“.. That sounds dire,” Mydei instead shattered whatever silence was brewing, not feeling keen on letting that dragon soak in his own thoughts; even if Mydei truly did not know what to say, either. 

“It.. Does,” Phainon chuckled a little - still too high-strung, forced and achy to Mydei who now was craning his head a little to look at that dragon. Staring at the way Phainon was nervously peering into the waters and back to Mydei, looking as if he was preparing himself for a scolding like he was a mere child.

.. Not that he had room to mock him anyway, he also was dreading speaking to his parents; maybe more so than Phainon was with his own father. 

Though, Phainon slowly met his eyes and looked more than a little worried; “Has he.. Spoken to you since you’ve been here?”

“No,” Mydei flatly said, turning his head away from those innocent looking eyes - becoming more and more aware of the way his heartbeat only sped up when he looked at them for too long, “I can only assume he has been informed of our situation.”

Phainon’s fingers tightened on Mydei at that as he leaned forward - putting his neck on Mydei’s shoulder with a whine, “What!? How would anyone know?”

That question made Mydei’s face heat up - more than that man licking at his armpit and whining at him, more than the fact he was sitting on his lap obediently. 

“.. Perhaps not about the eggs, but you were not.. Trying to keep me quiet, Phainon,” Mydei pointed out as he tried to ignore the scratchy-ness in his throat that had been biting into him all day, “In fact, you were demanding I be louder. I’m sure a guard overheard that.”

“W.. What if I was just torturing you? Why would they assume it was love making?” Phainon immediately asked, not beating around the bush for a moment.

And all Mydei could do was sigh dreadfully loud; “Did I sound like I was in agony?”

“No, you sounded so nice,” Phainon instantly replied - his words coming out as such a breathy whine, all before he gave a quiet chuckle, “I want to hear it again..”

Mydei had to scoff over the way Phainon instantly moved to start nuzzling their heads together - idly aware of the way Phainon was moving his hips slightly, hands already sliding down Mydei’s waist timidly. 

“Be quiet,” Mydei hissed as he snapped his free hand down to grab one of Phainon’s, “Hurry up and bathe yourself, you fool. We need to.. See your father.”

“Ah,” Phainon hummed, straightening himself out a bit too quickly - snapping upwards with a heavy exhale, “That did in fact work wonders in killing my mood again, Mydei..”

“Good.”

chapters.title: Chapter 14
chapters.html:
“Phainon,” That painfully familiar voice began to ring out in his ears - sounding so pained and jaded as if they couldn’t fathom a single thing that he had been up to as of late all while merely greeting him, “What have you done?”

That was a loaded question that made Phainon feel his tail shift uncomfortable - sliding against the plush leather of the sofa all while he stared right back at his father. 

He hated this.

He hated how Kephale had made Mydei sit in a chair without him, alone. 

.. He especially hated how they had rushed to get here and Phainon hadn’t been able to enjoy drying Mydei’s hair for him and massaging him - he knew his body was probably in agony from the way he had visibly paled when moving around. Growling about how he could walk here himself only to clutch his stomach and snarl at Phainon.

Not that it mattered as Phainon instead carried him here regardless, huffing a little over how Mydei had quieted down about it once again just like he had when walking to the baths in the first place. A battle he kept picking with himself and losing it seemed, but Phainon would never hold that over him. 

Not when he was adjusting to his body changing, and not when he needed Phainon to comfort him more than anything; Phainon would keep this struggle between the two of them.

“.. I am fond of him,” Phainon eventually decided on saying - blinking a little as he met his father’s gaze before slowly narrowing his eyes towards the older dragonkin. He wasn’t overly keen on being scolded in front of his mate, not while Mydei was in such a vulnerable state of mind that this was.. A fragile time, and Phainon didn’t have any desire to impede on Mydei’s own thoughts.

He had plenty to think about, even without Kephale stepping in.

“I’ve done nothing that I will ever regret,” Phainon stated, and even he could admit his voice was chilly in his throat - despondent with how he felt currently and how desperately he wanted to hide that fellow crown prince away and protect him in his bedroom.

Mydei was supposed to be resting - it was much too soon for all of the random other nonsense that could be weighing down on his mind and Phainon..

.. Phainon dreaded whatever Kephale could say to make him feel worse.

“Phainon, to a normal human Mydeimos looks fine. But to my eyes, I know what I am fully looking at,” Kephale sighed as he moved to cross his legs over each other - leaning back fully into his chair with a heavy frown seeming to weigh down all of his features, “The gravity of Mydeimos’s situation is quite dire.. To think my own son lost himself s-”

“I did not lose myself. I was fully in control and understood what I wanted,” Phainon cut in, barely able to contain himself as he bit at his own tongue in between his thoughts - his own rage bubbling inside of him as he dared to even consider this as some kind of mistake.

This was no mistake, nor was it Phainon slipping up.

He wanted that dragon so desperately, so carnally that it was aching to him. 

“There was no lapse in judgement or error in my ways, father,” Phainon explained as he did his best to relax backwards into his own seat - propping his hands politely into his lap just as he had been trained to do as he stared a bit coldly at that man.

All before darting his eyes to the side, looking at that most assuredly frazzled dragon-blooded man. Staring at the way Mydei’s own expression seemed to be heavy with thought - cloudy and murky as he tried to figure out his own emotions probably.

But Phainon could only give him a warm smile - praying that Mydei would look his way instead of the blank look he was studying Kephale with currently. 

Phainon tilted his head over it, all before giving a small laugh, “If I had the chance, I would take it again and again in any life.”

That seemed to have been enough at the least to garner Mydei’s attention back onto him - his eyes dragging a bit to look at Phainon and study him just as he had been doing for Kephale. Looking as if he wasn’t fully sold on the idea of it all, all while darting his eyes away curiously.

.. Probably due to the fact his attention was much more set on Kephale - clearly nervous about why he was dragged here by that man, and Phainon couldn’t blame him.

Even if his smile did falter immediately over losing that brief moment of Mydei’s attention, instead copying and looking to his father as well. 

“Our kingdom depends on you, Phainon. Every choice you make matters, even rash decisions,” Kephale began to explain, but that only made Phainon click his tongue in pure annoyance at that - staring at the way his father seemed so deadset on thinking this was some brash and unthought out choice.

As if Phainon wasn’t living his best life - and hadn’t been enjoying lovingly washing Mydei’s body, taking his time to soothe whatever aches that man had from their lovemaking only for Phainon’s father to ruin it all. 

Infuriating was the word he would describe it, really, because he knew exactly what he wanted - and it was the man who now was carrying his clutch and sitting to his side. Across from Kephale, and away from Phainon.

.. Infuriatingly annoying. 

“Do not call my love rash, father,” Phainon grumbled out, doing his best to not think about how deep his anger seemed to be digging into his bones - grounding into him so cruelly and clawing at his skin,  “I don’t enjoy that being used towards Mydei in any sense of the word. I was not rushing, I was desperate to lay claim to my mate before someone else took him; yes. But I had heavy considerations and thoughts about this ever since the moment I met him.”

This was true.

And how was Phainon supposed to think of anything negative about mating with Mydeimos Kremnos? If anything, he felt it should be celebrated - those old rules were beyond foolish and outdated in his opinion. It seemed natural to him to breed with another dragon, because who else would truly enjoy the role if not for another dragon?

Idiotic.. It all felt idiotic and as if it was trying to keep him down on purpose - a thing that he could never allow as he clicked his tongue again. 

“I fail to see how this could ever be viewed as a bad or rash decision from your perspective,” Phainon hissed out without even trying to hold his venom back from leaking into his words - feeling more and more bitter with every single word he dared to utter.

All before he waved his hand a bit dismissively with his own mounting annoyance towards his f ather.

“You are a king seeking to end a war with a neighboring kingdom, and now your very own crown prince has become lovers with their kingdom’s crown prince,” Phainon pointed out with a heavy sigh leaving his lips - eyes darting to look at Mydei and study the way he was still so eerily silent. Certainly that was due to him assuming he had no rights or that he couldn’t speak without his turn being given in the presence of the Aedes Elysiae king - but it wasn’t as if Kephale would ever harm him.

Not when Phainon cared so deeply for him.

That was enough to make Phainon jerk his eyes back to the man that had captivated Mydei’s attention as well; “Why do you wish to talk me out of that? Are you a fool?”

Kephale was silent over that - most likely due to the fact he had never quite.. Had his son bite as him so much, and Phainon could feel the way his own throat was closing a bit under that dragon’s tired stare. He appeared as if he was heavily thinking on those words Phainon had spat at him, all before he sighed loudly. 

“Very well, I will move on then,” Kephale mumbled after a moment, shaking his head as he now moved his attention elsewhere - and for some reason, that made Phainon’s heart skip a beat as he watched those slitted and jaded eyes look to Mydei.

A studying gaze that seemed to peer even deeper into Mydei than he had with Phainon, as if he could read his son easier than this stranger - and that was enough to make Phainon more and more uncomfortable. 

“Mydeimos,” Kephale began, his tone remaining the same as it had been for Phainon - if anything, a bit softer as if he was doing his best not to scare the foreign prince, “Now I will ask you; What have you done?”

That question made Phainon blink a little - moving his eyes to stare at Mydei just the same as he tried to understand why Mydei was being asked that as well. Though, it wasn’t as if Mydei was a person that needed his hand held or to be protected from a conversation.

No, even now Phainon was very aware that the prince was capable of enduring and standing his own ground - enough to where Phainon had to breathe in sharply, unable to comprehend how his hands had tightened into balls so sharply that his claws were breaking the skin of his palms.

.. If anyone needed to be spoken to sweetly, it was Phainon right now, he would argue. 

“Your silence is damning, Mydeimos. Tell me, how do you feel about your current predicament?” Kephale only prodded forward in that silence - making Phainon jerk a tiny bit over how it was haunting to him. 

“.. I will do what I must for the betterment for all Kremnoans,” Mydei replied after a few silent moments - as if he was taking his time to choose his words and well.. Those were certainly 

“As a king rightfully should, yet I was not speaking to the Kremnoan prince. Not right now,” Kephale laughed - a forced noise considering the way Phainon had heard his actual laugh so many times before and now it sounded hollow. Fake and meaningless, just an attempt to make Mydei relax around him.

Phainon found it almost insulting that he was pushing himself that far - but if it worked to soothe Mydei even a little, he had to bite his tongue.

Kephale only smiled warmly and innocently, “How is Mydeimos Kremnos himself feeling at this moment? Speak freely.”

Mydei was silent for a few moments - but Phainon could see the way he seemed to physically be rolling his jaws and twitching his muscles. Doing everything he could to remain controlled all before he breathed out a quiet huff of air audibly. 

“Pardon me, but if I may truly speak freely.. Mydeimos Kremnos is still the Kremnoan prince, even if you wish to speak to him without the title,” Mydei began, seeming a bit as if he was still very on guard as he spoke quite formally - and well.. That was natural. 

That added up for Mydei, Phainon had to admit - to always be on guard and seem as if he was fully doing his best to consider everything before speaking. 

.. Phainon had to grip his hands harder to force himself not to get overly excited over how much he wanted to praise Mydei.

Though, Mydei only continued wholly unaware; “And my feelings are unchanged; I would do anything for my people, Your Highness.”

“Fear not, Mydeimos. It would not be a discussion with a Kremnoan if they were not snarky or aggressive at the slightest,” Kephale hummed out - and that was something that made Phainon jolt a little. Waking up out of his own thoughts that were plaguing him and making him jerk his head to focus wholly on Kephale.

“Father,” Phainon breathed out, doing his best to ignore the searing paint that was burning into his palm - that meant nothing to him in the grand scheme of things. Let alone this conversation as his mind only felt more and more baffled at Kephale’s words, “That barely seems polite to say to him.”

Only for Kephale to slowly look at him - a tilt of his head as if he didn’t understand his own son’s question as he blinked at Phainon. An expression that was more than just a little unreadable to the dragon who had once thought he could easily understand his own father.

.. Though, now he had to finally come to terms that their blood wasn’t as thick as he once assumed.

“He claims he would do anything for his people. Is enduring petty insults not part of that?” Kephale asked a bit coldly, as if he didn’t fully comprehend the question from Phainon even though it was incredibly simple.

And all Phainon could do in return was fight the urge to snarl a little - feeling baffled the more this conversation played out; “That’s..”

Kephale only looked away from him at that, as if deigning his own son was not the important focus for now. 

“Tell me, Mydeimos,” Kephale began, all before offering him a rather warm appearing smile, “Do you desire your children?”

That question was enough to make Phainon’s breath freeze in his throat - a strangulation of sorts where he couldn’t even riddle out his own shock before he slowly looked to his father with a stunned expression. 

There was no need for him to try to keep himself calm - not when he was sure his tail slapping against the chair said enough for himself even while silent. 

“.. Desire?” Mydei echoed out after a moment, and that was enough to make Phainon cock his head to the other side - now neglecting his father in favor of looking at Mydei. 

Staring at the way he seemed to be so deeply in thought, heavily thinking on how he felt about that truly before speaking any other words.

.. Something about that was more than a little terrifying for Phainon as he felt himself sweat a little - shifting his weight in his chair uncomfortably as he tried to ignore the creeping dread clawing into his chest. 

Though, his lack of follow up made Kephale only continue on;  “Or do you seek the option and freedom of having them dissolved inside of you? There are no signs to most people that you have any eggs buried within you; the damage to your body would be minimal and carry no repercussions due to it only being known between the three of us.”

.. Dissolved?

That was enough to make Phainon’s blood run ice cold as he stared at Mydei - struggling to drag his eyes away from him and instead looking to his own father who was offering something so.. Awful.

To dissolve their eggs.. That was just..

Phainon couldn’t even process his own thoughts - instead feeling his mouth open and close a few times, threatening to choke him with his own venom boiling inside his veins as he tried to figure out what to even say to this all. It felt like his own head was dizzy - a mess of thoughts and none of them were good.

None were things that he had ever once thought he would be dreading thinking of - only moving to claw his fingers into his own skin a little bit more. 

“Breeding and laying your own clutch is impossible now, bu-”

“No,” Phainon cut in, unable to help the way his own voice was shaking as it left his mouth - unable to help the fury that was seeping into his own mind as he tried to control himself. 

He could feel the way Mydei’s eyes had snapped onto him, and yet.. He couldn’t help but laugh a little at his own mounting insanity involving this conversation in specific. 

“That’s enough. Don’t speak to Mydei anymore,” Phainon mumbled out, barely even able to hold himself together for the time being. 

“Phainon, our conv-”

“I understand what this is, and I do not approve of it. Testing me is fine, my loyalty is unwavering towards Mydeimos; but it is cruel to allude to such ideas to someone whose emotions are berserk," Phainon interrupted as he immediately rose to his feet from where he was sitting - no longer finding it in himself to sit there.

“You’re upsetting him and all you did was merely suggest such a thing,” Phainon growled out, though he wasn’t even sure if he actually meant his own words or if he was speaking about himself and not Mydei.

Either way - he couldn’t help but move to Mydei’s side without much of a second thought crossing his mind, barely restraining himself as he instead angled himself easily to grip onto Mydei. A part of him found himself so very relieved that Mydei didn’t even seem to put up a fight as Phainon tangled their bodies together - stressfully pulling him as gently as he could right back into his arms. 

All while Phainon felt his tail whipping from side to side - annoyed over the way Kephale had cleared his throat from behind him and begun to speak yet again. 

“.. I do apologize, Phainon is quite right that I am doing my best to test the both of you b-”

“I believe this discussion is over, father! I adore Mydeimos, and he wants to keep our children. Surely.. You don’t have a problem with that, do you?” Phainon interrupted all while sounding much too cheery for his own mood as he moved to face Kephale once more. 

A piece of him was doing his best to ignore those golden eyes of Mydei’s that were focusing on him yet staying silent in his hold - as if they were doing their best to read into Phainon’s current state of mind.

.. Not that Phainon minded that, if anything, he welcomed every inch of Mydei’s attention he could keep for himself; but right now he had to narrow his eyes at Kephale - doing his best to try to make sure his own position and feelings were being heard. 

Only for Kephale to remain as prim and proper as ever - tilting his head all while he barely flinched or showed any true emotion of his features. Appearing more as if he were a beautiful stone statue, all while his tail gave one lazy slap against the floor.

A sign of annoyance; but that proper king would never allow himself to show any more weakness than just one singular motion.

“.. Are you threatening me, my son?” Kephale asked in a tone that sounded more accusatory than anything - though, it’s not like Phainon could judge him for that. Not when he was right to be accusing Phainon who was certainly meaning it as a threat.

All he could do was chuckle lightly, fingers digging into Mydei as much as he could - desperate to hold that man as close as possible all while giving Kephale a warm smile. 

“Nonsense! What kind of son would threaten their own father?” 

Those words left his lips so clipped and jaded - rough and painful to his own throat and they both knew why. They both understood fully why he was 

“I see,” Kephale spoke after a few silent moments, a sign that he was conceding this war as he shook his head slowly with a languid sigh leaving his lips. His eyes falling closed as he seemed to try to come to terms with something all before opening them with that familiar fake smile on his lips once more.

A smile that was once more commonly used when attempting treaties and goals for peace; now being sent to his one and only son so painfully fakely that it made Phainon’s stomach curdle with dissatisfaction and uncomfortableness.

“I understand, cease your anger and spite. I never held any intentions of harming Mydeimos, let alone his newfound children in his womb.”

Phainon didn’t even have anything to say to that - instead clicking his tongue as he instantly turned on heel. No longer feeling like he had a singular word to share with him as he instead strove out of his father’s lavish office - his lips only barely quivering in his barely controlled rage as he tried his best not to show it.

Not in front of Mydei - not when he was so blatantly confused, and so painfully silent and obedient in Phainon’s arms. It was unlike him, but perhaps it was something about ‘picking his battles’ well, and not picking this as his own battlefield between family members.

.. At least, that was all Phainon could assume as he swiftly walked with his room as his only destination in mind - feeling more and more desperate to hide Mydei away more than anything else in this world now. 

Only for Mydei to finally break the silence after a few heavy moments of Phainon briskly carrying him away, “.. You claimed to have anxiety over speaking to your father, but I.. I’m unsure who is more scared of who.”

That voice of Mydei’s was softer than normal - more soothing and sweet as if he was doing his best to calm Phainon’s nerves all while still not squirming in his grasp even a little. Instead he seemed to be rather relaxed in Phainon’s arms - as if somewhat currently at peace with being bridal carried even if his tail was slapping into Phainon’s leg as they walked.

“I was scared because I had assumed our discussion would be more civil,” Phainon flatly stated, though he was unsure of how much he believed his own words as he sighed softly. 

His mind was still only.. Reeling from his thoughts and that conversation - it was impossible to think clearly when his own father had said something so awful as to suggest they should dissolve their eggs.

Their children.

Their clutch that Phainon was going to have with Mydeimos Kremnos..

 “Instead, he only desired to warp you into succumbing to his own wants,” Phainon murmured a bit darker under his own breath - feeling himself already moving to bite into his cheek as he tried to ignore those eyes on him. 

“His.. Own wants?” Mydei quoted out, sounding as if he was a bit confused or dazed - and that was only natural.

Phainon had to admit that this was probably gibberish to Mydei, all words that made him feel dread more and more as he sighed heavily. 

Kephale’s own desires for his kingdom and the betterment of them all wasn’t that hard to figure out - not really. Not when he had already gone as far as to lie about Phainon’s existence to the entirety of the rest of the world. A well kept secret that somehow had not been spoken of to other people, or gotten out of the kingdom walls.

A miracle, really, but Phainon found himself now laughing a little over it. 

“.. I will confess to you, Mydei,” Phainon began as he ceased his laughter, instead glancing to that dragon in his arms who looked less than amused, “That man is not my actual father. Kephale has never borne children, nor his own clutch.”

Though, the strangest thing about that had to be the way Mydei’s own expression barely even flickered. Even if his pupils seemed to vibrate just the tiniest of bits; he didn’t look away, nor did he look shocked. If anything, he seemed like he was merely.. Expecting such a twist to be spoken to him for some reason. 

“Then where do you hail from?” Mydei instead asked as if it was the natural progression of their conversation - and maybe it was, but Phainon didn’t feel any less insane the more he considered how well Mydei seemed to be taking this.

.. Maybe that had something to do with the fact it was hard to beat the ritual Mydei had already watched, on the other hand. 

“Oronyx, according to the myths, at least,” Phainon explained as if it was the most simple thing in the world - to himself, it was. But he fully knew to an outsider like Mydei this was probably utter insanity. 

“Aedes Elysiae’s dragon themself?” Mydei asked in a rather quiet tone - one that sounded more unsure of himself and the question than anything as he raised it. 

“An egg late to hatch,” Phainon mindlessly mumbled out - he himself had been informed this time and time again and been treated as if he was something so sacred due to it.

.. Mainly because he supposed he was sacred to the people living here, but that was all the more reason why he was so fond of the way Mydei seemed to still be fighting his desire to growl and glare at him; to treat Phainon like he was an annoyance more than something to be treasured. And that.. That was so very exciting to him. A thought that made his heart speed up and his blood to truly pump through his veins. 

Phainon knew that it had to do with something stirring in his instincts as well; so primal and carnal in his desire to hunt and chase that even the idea of his desired mate playing hard to get was thrilling to him. 

“Cared for by humans for years upon years, winter after winter,” Phainon continued as he ignored his own thoughts of hunting Mydei for fun - useless thoughts considering he already had given that man his eggs. 

Even though Phainon felt dread in his veins still when he thought about how Mydei had only spoken for what his kingdom wanted and how it would benefit them; not his own wants.

Phainon.. Hated considering the very decent probability that Mydei didn’t want to have a clutch with him and was doing it solely for his people. Phainon couldn’t bear the thought of actually trapping Mydei into something where he felt unloved..

He would.. Do anything to fix this, if possible, at least to prove his own love for him..

“I’m not sure if I believe it myself, but the amount of dragon blood in my own veins and the hunger I feel with humans..” Phainon forced himself to laugh a little as he shook his head - doing his best to ignore the closing of his own throat with his mounting feelings now.

Between his fear of Mydei not desiring him or their children, and his father.. Today felt so very.. Off.

“I find it hard to come up with another reason for it, when my own father has told me we are barely related through blood,” Phainon murmured as he continued to walk - not daring to look at Mydei at all, happy to have his attention as always, but feeling as if he was too weak to look at those vibrant eyes.

Eyes that were searching for answers, and all Phainon wanted to do was hide his own weakness from them - praying that Mydei couldn’t dig deep enough to figure Phainon’s boiling emotions out easily. 

All Phainon could manage to do was laugh a little and shrug, “If anything, I’m Kephale’s very great grandfather, oddly.”

“Your bloodline sounds like a nightmare to try to map out,” Mydei muttered, sounding a little unimpressed which.. Phainon honestly felt it was a bit impressive in itself - as if Mydei simply either didn’t believe him, or was just willing to believe anything at this point.

Whatever the answer was, Mydei only quietly scoffed after a few silent moments of Phainon walking, “Oronyx still possessed unhatched eggs?”

Phainon huffed a little over that question - feeling himself twitch just the slightest bit over how Mydei had said Oronyx. As if they had a say in the fate of their children after they had passed..

“To be quite honest, I feel as though they kept my egg as a trophy,” Phainon grumbled out, doing his best to shake those thoughts from his mind a bit idly, “A sign that Oronyx truly did walk this world, even if their blood was becoming thinner.” 

It was an amusing thought to him - a thing that made him wonder if Mydei felt the same way; awkward and unsure of where they truly stood with humans all while walking amongst them. Or perhaps Phainon only felt more distant due to the fact he also ate humans.

.. Who knows! Phainon certainly didn’t. 

“Only I hatched,” Phainon laughed a little as he shook his head, doing his best to get rid of his past thoughts,  “From that moment on, I became something they worshipped, even if they quickly came to understand my hunger was more vicious and bloody than they had ever hoped.”

Those rituals had existed for all of his life, after all - every few weeks they would feed him someone, and Phainon had come to understand it wasn’t normal.

That he wasn’t supposed to be gorging himself on people and devouring them, that he was supposed to be living in harmony with humans and calling himself one of them. And yet.. He simply couldn’t. He felt too distant from them, jarringly different from all of them and they all looked at him as if he held the answers they wanted as well..

.. He didn’t. 

He didn’t know how to easily help these people, all he could do was his best and hope it was enough to please everyone that prayed to him so openly. 

Though, his eyes did betray him and glance at that beautiful dragon in his arms - blinking over the way Mydei was staring at him silently. As if he was trying to delicately pick out what words to say next on this matter, all before his brows slowly knit together. 

“Why are you telling me all of this?” Mydei questioned, and Phainon could feel his own tail dragging - perhaps his entire mood was lacking in hindsight, but either way he couldn’t help but offer a simper smile to Mydei.

A soft thing, just an attempt to soothe his beloved who was certainly doing his best to adapt to.. Everything that Phainon had saddled him with. 

“I..” Phainon began, all before dipping his eyes away to focus on where he was walking - more than a little eager to return Mydei to somewhere safe and comfortable, “I think that it’s important that my mate knows more about me, that’s all!”

“I see, thank you,” Mydei flatly replied, sounding as if he wasn’t actually seeing much at all - or thankful for that matter. 

.. But at least he was willing to hear Phainon out, and that was more than enough for him for now!

Phainon couldn’t help but beam him a smile, doing his best to ignore the blurriness and the burn of his eyes as he did so, “Of course, Mydei! I’ll answer anything you want to know from me now, I promise!”

Mydei only seemed to study him for a moment at that, all before huffing quietly, “.. Where are you taking me?”

“Ah.. Back to bed?” Phainon offered, a little unsure of himself as his fingers dug into the fabric Mydei was wearing - clinging to him as he did his best to control his own breathing all while every step felt almost painful to himself.

Suffocating as his own feelings were finally catching up to him - haunting his every movement as he did his best to swallow it all down.  

All before Mydei only spoke again, “May I ask a second question?”

Phainon couldn’t help but to chirp out his reply; anything for that man in his arms.

“Yes!”

Mydei seemed quiet at that, all before Phainon moved his own eyes to meet Mydei’s - staring at the way Mydei was looking.. Almost a little bit worried, as if something was weighing his mind down as well.

“.. Why are you crying, Phainon?”

Phainon wasn’t sure how to answer that as he opened his bedroom door sloppily - weak movements, but never quite messy enough to drop Mydei, but it.. Wasn’t like him even as he shut that door and moved to lock it. Even with tears heavy on his eyelashes he couldn’t help but to keep crying as he slowly walked over to his bed - doing his bed to ignore the way the covers were replaced.

.. He was quite fond of how deeply his old ones had smelled of Mydei after their night together, but they did leave it in the baths in their hurry.
