He had to sigh as he settled Mydei down gently onto it - all before crashing after that man, rubbing his head onto Mydei’s chest and not at all caring for the way Mydei made an odd noise. One that was clearly out of shock and confusion, but Phainon had to ignore that - instead moving to nuzzle his head into Mydei more and more.

Arms wrapping around him slowly all while he felt himself breaking down more. 

He couldn’t.. He absolutely couldn’t let his father actually take away their children, he wanted this so badly.. He wanted Mydei to stay with him so much.

chapters.title: Chapter 15
chapters.html:
At this point, Mydei was feeling as though he was becoming much too familiar with Phainon’s bedroom ceiling as he blinked upwards at it. Unable to look away really lest he stare at that dragon who was once again coiling around him - only now it was so much more.. Pathetic, really.

Even as he laid there on that soft bed and a newly fluffed up seeming pillow behind his head - he couldn’t help but gently comb his fingers through Phainon’s hair. Mindlessly petting the man who all seemed to be blubbering more and more. His head tucked into Mydei’s chest to nuzzle into his breasts all while holding onto Mydei as if he might run or slip away.

.. A far shot considering the way Mydei’s body still wasn’t normal - it was still the first day of having a clutch inside of him, anyway. It wasn’t as if his mind was really thinking about how fast he could run away.

Besides, that was nearly impossible due to the way Phainon was whimpering and rubbing heavy tears onto his shirt that were bleeding through and soaking Mydei just a little. Impressive, really, considering the odd angle Phainon was at to even comfortably rub his head onto Mydei with his horns, not to mention his size.. 

“Mydei,” Phainon whined out again and again, always seeming like he wanted more of Mydei’s attention even though Mydei was already trapped beneath him. His fingers only remained in Phainon’s silky soft hair as he paused them to look down slightly - just enough to catch a glance of those vibrant blue eyes staring at him from the corner.

Leering, looking as if they were panicked more than anything; Chaotic in their nature as they almost looked to soften and sharpen in the blink of an eye depending on if Mydei was looking at him. 

“You’ll keep them, won’t you?” Phainon asked in a mumble, his own voice coming out slightly slurred due to the way he wasn’t picking his head off of Mydei’s chest. Instead merely resting on him and rubbing his cheek a bit incessantly into Mydei in between his own words. 

“You’ll keep our children safe.. Close to you..” Phainon explained as Mydei’s hand only remained on Phainon’s head - staring at the way those sky-blue eyes were searching him endlessly, “You’ll keep them, you’ll keep them..”

.. Mydei didn’t know what to think about all of this.

It was obvious Kephale’s offer to dissolve his eggs had thrown Phainon himself into an over-protective type of mood and situation, but Mydei hadn’t even answered the man fully outside of diplomatic words. Nor had he even looked deep enough to know his own answers yet.

.. His own family would be another issue if they found out, he knew that much for certain as his own tail twitched at his side - idly feeling a coiling tail wrapping around it possessively. 

“You’ll keep me too, won’t you?” Phainon asked, his voice coming out weak and as if it were a plea as he sounded pathetic to Mydei. 

Whiny and not at all like the man who had been angry in Kephale’s office - but was it all a ploy? Mydei had to question that given the fact he was on foreign ground.. A plan and a trick from Kephale and Phainon to trap him here for a better treaty, maybe?

.. It sounded a little unlikely when Mydei looked at the way Phainon was still bawling as if he were a mere child fearing his favorite toy being torn from his arms currently. 

“.. Aren’t you supposed to be a more pure-blooded dragon than I am? Why are you such a sopping wet beast?” Mydei asked in a quiet voice, not really bothered by the idea of himself being Phainon’s ‘favorite toy’ for once. If anything, he couldn’t complain as Phainon’s hand was massaging at his back soothingly.

A motion that was rather pleasant, considering the way Mydei himself hadn’t even noticed his own back pain. 

“I’m.. Mydei.. I just..” Phainon began, sounding not an ounce more clear than before as he made a garbled noise of frustration as well - a noise that sounded like Phainon was really struggling right now, “I really like you.”

“Do you?” Mydei asked without missing a beat, only deciding that was a mistake as that tail around his own tail tightened so instantly. Coiling around him as if he was some type of prey all while Phainon let out a soft little wailing noise. A sad trill of sorts, and certainly it was out of frustration yet again. 

“Yes! A lot! I want to stay by your side with our children!” Phainon mumbled out, though Mydei only felt his eye twitching a tiny bit over the way it sounded almost like gibberish as Phainon began to cry once more.

As if he couldn’t help but to bawl into Mydei and cling to him for dear life as he rubbed his head harder into him. Almost like a dog trying to mark his territory, and that thought only made Mydei frown a bit more when he remembered what all that prince had.. Done to him during sex.

.. He really was just a giant dog, and Mydei wasn’t sure if it was endearing, or pissing him off at this point.

“And I want to raise them and take care of them.. Take care of you, too..” Phainon softly seemed to whimper out - sounding more and more like he was bawling into Mydei more than anything else.

“Phainon,” Mydei breathed out with a heavy roll of his eyes - shaking his head against the pillow as he tried to relax again while giving up on looking at Phainon while he spoke, “I can barely understand you with how much you’re slurring your words.”

That didn’t seem to get through Phainon’s thick head however as Mydei’s eyes found their way back to the ceiling - blinking slowly over the way Phainon was mumbling something once more in such a quickened way of speech all while it was gibberish. None of it was decipherable to Mydei as he waited for Phainon to finish whatever he was saying - his mind only focusing on the nice comforting vibration on his chest of Phainon’s throat against him.

“.. Dissolving..”

That word was enough to make Mydei slowly blink - his fingers threading through Phainon’s hair before moving to brush against those horns atop his head. Idly feeling every part of that dragon who didn’t seem to care at all - if anything, Mydei was pretty sure Phainon kept leaning into his hand a bit needily. 

“What? I only caught the tailend of that,” Mydei asked in between his own bored movements - a piece of his mind was able to digest what Phainon was saying considering that word was being used again, but Mydei only found himself sighing over it.

Dissolving his eggs and acting like this had never happened was a curious proposal every time Mydei crossed back to it - only able to wonder if it was for the best that he accepted the offer and yet.. He sickeningly didn’t want to. Something inside of him was quietly clawing at his bones and telling him that he wanted this - that he was.. Content that Phainon had.. For lack of a better word, bred him. 

Phainon did slowly raise his head a little over Mydei’s words however - showing off how flushed he looked and how red his own eyes had grown. A sight that made Mydei raise his brows a bit inquisitively as Phainon sniffled weakly, all before putting his chin right back down onto Mydei’s chest weakly.

“What are.. Your thoughts on what my father said..?” Phainon questioned a bit quietly, and that only made Mydei feel even more confused considering the fact they had.. Already gone over this in that man’s office, hadn’t they?

Or was Phainon simply not satisfied with the answers he had given?

“My thoughts?” Mydei echoed out - mainly in an attempt to buy himself some time as he stared at that oversized lizard on his chest, doing his best not to show any emotions over the way Phainon looked so.. Pathetic.

It was oddly endearing in a way that Mydei really did not want to question himself further in regards to - doing his best to try to swat away his own thoughts of how enamored he felt towards that dragon sometimes. 

“Genuinely,” Phainon muttered as if that explained much else all while his eyes remained as soft as ever towards him,  “I deeply.. I want to know how you feel about what he said to you.”

.. That sight almost made Mydei feel a bit uncomfortable as he endured that gaze pleading with him silently - staring him down and so blatantly watching every single feature or expression Mydei could possibly change in his face.

But Mydei could only sigh inaudibly under that gaze; “I meant it when I said I would endure for the sake of m-”

“I care about how Mydeimos Kremnos feels. I want to know how he feels, not to be told he will ‘endure’ for the Kremnoan people,” Phainon cut in without missing a single beat or breath, sounding more annoyed than anything that he was being given that line from Mydei again, “I want Mydeimos Kremnos to be happy in his life, not to suffer well and quietly for other people.”

Suffer well and quietly?

Mydei slid his eyes away at that - only able to look at the golden intricate carvings in the light of the world outside of Phainon’s windows. A soft halo glow ebbing through all while the sun seemed to slowly be setting all the same - a scene that made Mydei wonder where the day had gone, or if he truly had just rested that much without realizing before waking for a bath.

“A mark of a good king is doing just that,” Mydei decided as he tore his eyes away from the orange glow and back down to looking at that dragon whose tail was still coiled around his own so tightly. 

“You can be a good king.. And happy, Mydei,” Phainon argued with a heavy sigh escaping him, sounding more and more like he was simply so very desperate to make Mydei understand how he felt right now,  “There’s no need to sacrifice happiness in your own life for others..”

Those words were still so very quiet - hushed as if Phainon was doing his best not to scare off some frightened animal and that was almost sweet if not for the way Mydei was trapped under him regardless of if he wanted to try to escape.

“.. I cannot tell if you’re trying to comfort me, or yourself with how much you’re crying,” Mydei muttered with a slow shake of his head - only to listen to the sharp intake of air Phainon gave at that. Though, he sounded more like he was drowning than anything. 

“Both,” Phainon mumbled in a rather quiet voice as if he wasn’t overly sure what to do with himself - even though he laughed a little softly at the same time, “Knowing how you’re doing would do a lot for me personally, so I..”

Phainon’s voice broke off at that - sounding as if he was growing more upset by every passing word all before he made such a quiet groaning noise. His hand raised to wipe away his tears, but that seemed like a waste of effort to Mydei as he only watched Phainon immediately cry more as if he couldn’t quite get himself to stop. 

“I love you,” Phainon started even though he was still wiping away his tears - doing his best to offer Mydei such a soft smile as he gave up on his attempts regardless, “I really love you Mydei, you don’t have to understand it considering how we don’t know each other..”

Mydei found himself not breathing at that however, instead he remained there watching that dragon awkwardly shuffle his weight around. Dipping the bed down with his moving body a few times around Mydei, all before he seemed to sniffle again and move his head to wipe his tears awkwardly on Mydei’s chest. 

“But I adore you..” Phainon added with a sigh as he once again moved his eyes to look at Mydei - eyes that were remarkably calm for how much he had been crying, Mydei had to give him that much.

Gentle and reassuring, all while he was still crying quite heavily - his own tears clinging to his eyelashes messily as he stared at Mydei with such a little smile on his lips. 

All before Phainon repeated those words yet again; “I love you..”

Mydei wasn’t sure how to process them - even if a piece of him knew this man most likely was not lying with how suffocating his presence had been in Mydei’s life it.. Was still hard to believe. They barely knew each other, and yet Phainon had made him his mate and now was blubbering nonsense on him and holding onto him as if he were something to be protected.

No.

Like he was something that needed to be protected. 

“I just really need you to know that, Mydei,” Phainon moved with those words - shifting his weight as he picked himself up off the bed and slowly moved to straddle Mydei a little. Just enough to cage his arms around Mydei and fully trap him there, his eyes staring downwards all while his hands planted themselves firmly at the sides of Mydei’s head who.. Only stared right back up at him. 

“I love you, even if you hate me, even if you want me to suffer for what I’ve done to you.. I don’t think I could ever stop loving you,” Phainon explained, all while his tears hadn’t even stopped. If anything, they seemed to be flowing even more now as they messily dripped downwards onto Mydei’s face.

.. And Mydei was pretty sure whatever was between the both of them could be considered dangerously toxic in a way - unhealthy and surely not as deep as Phainon was claiming. That something in their relationship wasn’t supposed to be like this, not yet, not when Phainon clearly was forming some kind of unwell attachment to him..

But Mydei couldn’t even deny the fact that he found himself enjoying it a little, enjoying the way this man seemed so desperate and needy for Mydei and only Mydei. Something about it made him want to wag his own tail for once and pet the man even more as his hands twitched at his side now - all before he found himself clicking his tongue a little. 

“.. You’re crying on my face,”  Mydei pointed out, unable to help himself but to try to change the topic a little - doing his best to ignore the way he wanted to trill a bit possessively over how much that dragon seemed to adore him.

.. That was natural, wasn’t it? For a dragon to like to be treated like a treasure? Surely Mydei wasn’t that insane for feeling himself delighted in being deemed valuable to someone.. 

“Sorry, you’re just so beautiful I can’t help but to stare,” Phainon argued as he hummed softly shaking his head a bit slowly all while doing nothing to help the fact Mydei’s cheeks still had Phainon’s tears wetting it. 

If anything, Phainon only seemed to get a bit closer. 

Mydei scoffed over it - narrowing his eyes towards Phainon who only gently moved a hand to Mydei’s forehead, pushing back his bangs soothingly. A much too sweet gesture that made Mydei feel hot and bothered over the way Phainon was just being.. Endearing to him. 

Doting and loving - all without having to, and that was enough to make Mydei’s eyes dart away from him, “What kind of nonsense is that..”

“Just the truth, Mydeimos,” Phainon argued instantly, as if he had always been prepared for such a question like that as he chuckled a little quietly,  “I want to keep you in my life.. I want to keep you here by my side and raise our children together all while pampering you as much as I can.”

.. Too much.

This was actually too much for Mydei  to bear as he felt that hand drop from his forehead and instead move down to his braid - gentle fingers rolling against his hair that was tied together all while his own eyes found their way back to Phainon’s. Taking note of the way Phainon seemed to be so blatantly adoring him - studying him and watching him with only love in his eyes.

It was haunting in a way that Mydei didn’t even know he needed, nor wanted. Haunting in a sickening way where he so direly wanted those eyes to continue staring at him like this for the rest of time. 

“Forever?” Mydei asked, feeling a little bit unsure of his own sanity as he slowly tried to come to terms that he may be actually going insane due to Phainon - but that was fine. If this was an unwell type of sickening love, he almost felt excited to experience such a thing.. 

“Do you even have to ask..? Yes, forever,” Phainon laughed a little with his own words - sounding more manic than anything else, but Mydei couldn’t find it in himself to care.

Not really as Phainon only moved his hand back to soothingly brushing Mydei’s bangs back slowly, “I never want to let go of you.. You’re the thing I’ve come to treasure the most.. It’s only natural I want to keep you for myself, after all.. I’m just a slave to my own instincts as a dragon.”

Mydei found his mouth opening at that - all before closing as Phainon’s hand only gently caressed his cheek, thumb rubbing over his cheekbone to aid in Mydei’s mind blanking just a little bit. 

“Marriage,” That was the word that eventually came to mind with the words Phainon had said - such a statement of dedication that Mydei found himself wanting to bind that man to his words. To force him to stay true to him..

If Phainon was going on and on about happiness, surely.. That meant Mydei was equally allowed to be greedy towards those feelings Phainon held with him, right?

Though, Phainon wasn’t exactly.. Skilled at hiding his shock as his mouth floundered immediately like a fish flopping onto land pathetically. All before he managed to find his voice in such a croaked out way; “M-Marriage? What do you mean?”

“My parents would never allow it,” Mydei answered - though he felt his throat closing up the more he thought of that. He was rather enjoying the way Phainon looked so excited - staring at him as if he had just said something was completely unbelievable all while his tail had uncoiled from Mydei’s.

All to be much too honest. Blatantly wagging behind him all while he still was staring down at Mydei.

 “You have to convince them of your love and marry me,” Mydei explained as he exhaled at the same time - barely even aware of the way he had been holding his breath in the first place. 

Though, it didn’t seem like Phainon was doing much better as his eyes still appeared to be so blown wide open that Mydei could barely fathom how he was crying like that, “W.. Are you offering to let me marry you, Mydei!?”

“.. If you pass my parents’ trials,” Mydei mumbled as he did his best to hold his chuckle in his chest - unable to stop the way his own hand raised to Phainon’s wrist, gently grasping onto the hand that was tenderly touching him with a heavy sigh escaping him.

Every part of Phainon was so.. Warm, even to his fingertips that it made Mydei want to lean into that touch and fully bask in it. It was almost embarrassing when he considered just how much he wanted to do just that - instead trying to swallow down those feelings in trade of focusing on his parents and how they would feel now. 

Phainon’s tail on the other hand hadn’t stopped wagging at all - he still seemed as happy go lucky as possible, “What trials are those? I can do it!”

“.. They’re..” Mydei felt himself pausing as his mouth hung open slightly - doing his best to try to figure out how to word it all before pressing out a heavy chested exhale, “Traditional.”

Truthfully, Mydei couldn’t even blame them in this scenario - his own head was spinning every single time he spent more than two seconds thinking about how it all had unfolded and yet.. He knew it would be worse for the both of them, especially when he thought of how deeply they valued obeying the old laws of only one dragon blooded person per pair.

.. The man leaning over Mydei was certainly more than enough dragon to meet that quota for the both of them. 

Phainon only slightly quirked his head to the side at that - sending white locks of hairs askew while he kept his eyes on Mydei, “Traditional? As in they prefer deep courting rituals?”

Mydei wasn’t sure what to make of that, not really as he stared at Phainon all before clicking his tongue. 

“.. Yes, you could say that. They will be.. Less than pleased to find out about my.. Health currently, the best thing possible is to announce our marriage as well..”

Those words felt heavier than he had once thought their weight to be as he spoke them - feeling his own mind reel over the fake he was speaking of marriage. This was.. A long standing agreement, something that would tie them together for life as royalties - and a piece of him was begging his mind to think it fully through. To think every angle of it through and through, yet..

He struggled too much with those thoughts as Phainon adjusted himself slightly, making sure that he wasn’t crushing their children. 

“Announce.. Our marriage..” Phainon echoed after a moment, seeming as if he was going his best to convince himself that this was reality and actually happening. 

“The courting rituals and methods can be held off on, but it’s better they hear about our desire to be wedded sooner than later,” Mydei clarified as he cleared his throat a little - looking at the way Phainon had stopped his crying now and was still just.. Absentmindedly petting Mydei’s face and his bangs idly. 

“Our desire..” Phainon echoed after a moment, his head tilting even more all before his lips curved so effortlessly into a smile. A soft thing, yet Mydei already was powerless against the way that man looked at him so earnestly.

“.. Did I say something odd? Why are you staring at me like that?” Mydei asked after a few moments of feeling himself sweat under that stare.

“I just.. The talk of marriage with you makes me very happy, Mydeimos!” Phainon said that, sure, but Mydei wasn’t sure he fully understood Phainon at all with how he had immediately begun to cry again. His lips quivering all while his brows knit together - looking more and more flushed as his claws dug into Mydei’s face a tiny bit now. 

“You’re crying again,” Mydei pointed out, not even feeling it in himself to flinch away from those deadly fingers - he knew fully well he wasn’t in danger anyway, not when that man had been so blatant and obvious with how much he didn’t want to harm Mydei.

.. A care that went so deep that he had practically been carrying Mydei around as well, not even letting him stretch his legs very much or attempt to walk on his own and get used to those eggs inside of him. 

“This is a different type of crying.. I’m so excited, that’s all,” Phainon replied with a little laugh - though Mydei didn’t exactly know how to understand that either. Only to feel his lips quirk a bit into a small tiny smug smile over how that man seemed to fold so easily. 

Mydei had to press out a sigh - moving his hand to Phainon’s cheek to copy that man, only to scoff a little over how wet Phainon’s own face was. His fingers brushing away tears as he gave a small grin towards Phainon now,  “Will you behave then when I return to work tomorrow?”

But Phainon only jerked his head backward a little at that - not enough to make Mydei’s hand leave his face, and even if he had done so; Phainon leaned his head right back into Mydei’s hand as if he had abruptly realized his mistake as quickly as he had caused it.

“Return to work..? Why would you do that?”

That question was asked in such a tone that Phainon almost seemed fragile while he asked it - as if the answer could shatter him to pieces, and Mydei could only drop his hand from that man’s face at that. Watching and almost savoring the way Phainon flickered an expression of sorrow so painfully briefly over it cutely. 

“To seem normal, I suppose. I cannot have my parents hearing I just stayed in your room for days,” Mydei explained with a heavy sigh escaping him, a part of him wanting to brush his hair back but it was a useless thought considering Phainon himself already seemed more than a little content playing with Mydei’s hair,  “How else will word of you courting me spread?”

Though, Phainon did seem to freeze at those words; “You want me to dote on you and give you gifts in public?”

Mydei found himself twitching a little over that phrasing and the way Phainon seemed so unable to hold back how giddy he was from leaking into his voice. Sounding more and more like he was a shaking wet dog vibrating with excitement as he processed the words that Mydei had said to him. 

“.. I don’t know if I enjoy your phrasing with that sentence or how excited you seem,” Mydei admitted with his own thoughts - shaking his head a little to watch the way Phainon lowered himself a bit lazily. Moving back into that position they once were in with Phainon rubbing his head into Mydei’s tear-stained chest.

And for once Mydei found himself mourning someone else’s touch leaving him - that hand dropping from Mydei’s face to instead return to holding onto him quite tightly, but it wasn’t as if Mydei would voice those thoughts. 

“I’ve been thinking about this for days,” Phainon seemed to purr out, and Mydei really really was uncertain of how he was feeling about any of this anymore, “I actually get to start courting you in public.. Alright! I’ll behave while you work!”

“I’m unsure if that’s trustworthy, but I cannot disprove you currently,” Mydei grumbled out - not at all oblivious to the way Phainon’s eyes were seemingly glimmering all while he spoke. Looking as if he had a dazzling twinkle in his eyes that was assuredly only meaning mischief in Phainon’s mind was brewing up, and Mydei.. Mydei could only exhale silently over what a lost battle this was.

“Do you want to go to work now? I have a lot to prepare if so..” Phainon asked rather innocently, and Mydei almost believed him - almost.

The fact of his tail wagging so much was more than enough to make Mydei fully aware that Phainon was still plotting something devious and Mydei was undoubtedly going to have to weather whatever the hell that could be.. 

“.. No, I..” Mydei began with a sigh - a piece of him wanting a few mere moments without Phainon for his own mind and to think about it all rationally without this dragon ruining whatever pieces of his sanity he had left. And yet, “As much as I would prefer to, my body.. It doesn’t feel right.”

“A day of rest is good..” Phainon agreed, but his voice was trembling all while he leaned up a little - just enough to lazily grasp onto their ignored blankets and pull it over the both of them now. 

Clearly, he was more than a little eager to oblige with Mydei’s desire of resting and staying in bed. Especially as he made sure Mydei’s blanket was weighted nicely with his own head flopping right back down onto him. 

“You’re crying again,” Mydei pointed out, fighting the desire to sigh once more all while Phainon laughed a little at that. 

“God forbid I have hobbies,” Phainon murmured softly, but Mydei barely found that to be the problem here as he rolled his eyes.

Though, that was an odd sentence the more he thought of it - staring at those blue eyes that only looked right back at him so painfully innocently. 

“What are your hobbies?” Mydei asked as the realization of it all finally hit him - he had no idea what this man liked to do. He knew.. Next to nothing about the man that had given him a clutch and now was being so needy with him and his attention. He didn’t know what Phainon liked, or what he liked to do; he just..

.. He barely knew this man at all, and still was allowing this all to happen to himself? What was wrong with Mydei?

But Phainon was ignorant to Mydei’s own rising confusion - his eyebrows only shooting up a little to his eyebrows as he wore a look of utter shock on his expression immediately; “My hobbies?”

“Outside of the joke, what do you like to do?” Mydei asked in a sputtered out way of speaking, feeling his face burn over how this felt.. Mortifying in a way, he should have known things like this before agreeing to have children with this man, let alone a plan for their wedding. 

But Mydei found his own brain arguing against most things, hissing at himself silently over how Phainon couldn’t be that evil or praying for his downfall if he had taken the time to translate books for Mydei in his freetime.. 

Phainon did sit up a tiny bit at that though, “You’re.. Asking about me?”

Mydei clicked his tongue in response - feeling the burn in his cheeks only worsening as that man seemed to be getting happier over such a simple thing. 

“I know next to nothing about you, is it not natural that I ask about you to mend that?”

Phainon fell silent at that for a moment, all before he let out a quiet little hum before moving his arms a little - crossing them against Mydei’s chest to make a little makeshift pillow out of them for him to put his chin on. Carefully avoiding Mydei’s lower abdomen, yet certainly staring Mydei down in the eyes with every movement he made. 

“I spend my time doing my normal tasks of a crown prince; training proper fighting, classes for man-”

“Outside of that,” Mydei interrupted, not caring to hear out the absolute basic things every prince had to go through.

Those were not hobbies, those were merely rules and regulations that every prince was forced into adapting and learning. Every kingdom had those types of ideals for their crown princes and princesses, and Mydei certainly didn’t think they counted as hobbies when he knew fully well Phainon had probably been forced into caring about those things.

Much like he himself had been. 

Phainon did tilt his head a little on his arms though, “Outside of that?”

This felt more and more confusing as Mydei stared at that weight on his chest - doing his best to comprehend why this felt like Mydei was struggling to pull teeth, “.. Yes? What does Phainon of Aedes Elysiae like to do?”

“Ah.. I like..” Phainon trailed off a little, his eyes closing as if he had to think deeply on this before that beamed open - a soft smile on his lips, “Watching you, I think?”

“That’s.. Not a real hobby,” Mydei sighed out, shaking his head a little before pulling his hand up to toy with his own braid. His eyes watched as Phainon’s own only moved to watch Mydei’s hand as well, seeming to take a moment before flicking back to meet Mydei’s gaze.

“Then maybe I don’t have any?”

.. That was a depressing thing that the crown prince of Aedes Elysiae had just offered up; words that made Mydei’s fingers pause their twirling against the cool golden cuff at the end of his hair to stare fully flabbergasted at Phainon now. 

“There’s nothing you like to do?” Mydei asked, feeling more and more baffled the longer he even debated the idea that this dragon really had no other hobbies. It was.. Strange, really. What kind of person couldn’t name a single thing they enjoyed?

“I don’t.. I don’t really know? I’ve been kept to strict rules my entire life and never really.. Explored outward beyond those when the expectations on me devoured everything,” Phainon murmured softly, seeming like he was a bit lost in thought all before he chuckled quietly as well, “Is that odd?”

“.. For a man who told me I don’t need to sacrifice my happiness to be a good king, you don’t seem to follow your own advice,” Mydei huffed out, narrowing his eyes to the man who only offered him a gleaming smile right back. 

“Well, when you say it like that, I sound a bit pathetic,” Phainon laughed as he spoke - appearing less than bothered by those words. 

Yet Mydei only blinked at him over it; “You are.”

“Ouch,” Phainon said, and yet his voice was light - fluffy even as he laughed a little and seemed so very smug over Mydei’s growled words, “Can I get a kiss, Mydei?”

That was enough to make Mydei inspect that man fully - taking a few moments to take in the slight dimples he had with that smile. A cute face, one that Mydei knew fully was so painfully deceitful when he remembered it covered in blood and gore. 

Though, now he only had one thought on his mind as he took in the way Phainon seemed to be staring at him with a glow in his face - practically beaming as he stared fondly at Mydei.

 “.. Do you like when I’m mean to you?” Mydei finally pushed himself to ask - it had been something he had absentmindedly noticed at first. Those glances where Phainon seemed to be excited after Mydei growled at him, those moments where he appeared even happier after Mydei spat venom.

They were more than a little obvious now that Phainon was openly asking for affection right after Mydei insulted him even the tiniest of bits. 

“A whole lot,” Phainon confessed although he didn’t actually seem ashamed at all as he pressed out a sigh, “It’s exciting if it’s you.”

“There’s something wrong with you,” Mydei decided instantly - exhaling deeply as he watched Phainon already leaning up a little, so confident in himself as if he knew Mydei would enable him to do as he pleased. 

“A kiss?” Phainon asked again with all the false innocence he seemed able to conjure up in his body. 

“Just one,” And Mydei conceded just like Phainon seemed to have known he would have. 

“I’ll make it count, then,” Phainon mumbled softly - and Mydei almost had a second to reply to that, almost. All before a hand was roughly on his jaw demanding his attention with how tightly he was gripping at Mydei. 

Fingers digging into his cheek a bit all while Phainon immediately sat up much too quickly, just to angle himself downwards and to mash their mouths together in a fashion that couldn’t be described as anything but hungry with how his tongue pushed into Mydei’s mouth as soon as they connected. Lips massaged against Mydei’s own in such a devouring fashion that Mydei found his mind blanking over it all.

Not just the feeling of Phainon’s tongue passing into his mouth again and sliding much too far to choke him, but the way Phainon’s eyes weren’t closing at all. Even as Mydei winced as tried to back away futility with his eyes closing a tiny bit - all he could take note of were those vibrant blue eyes strikingly staring him down.

Watching him struggle around the kiss all while only seeming to lick into Mydei’s mouth more every time he tried to swallow around Phainon’s tongue to gulp any air he could. 

It was suffocating; too much and the fact he was just being watched like some type of prey made his stomach churn in an odd emotion. 

An emotion he really didn’t like putting a name to as he closed his eyes to just give in for that man devouring him in a kiss. So messy and wet in his own mouth that it was baffling, so very baffling.

.. Because Mydei enjoyed it. He knew fully well that emotion in his stomach was pure lust over having someone desire him this much - a desire to be consumed completely by his mate while he could feel Phainon’s tail on his own tail possessively yet again. A comforting presence that seemed to be a habit now, and Mydei..

If it was Phainon.. Mydei was fully coming to terms that he liked being devoured.

Chapter End Notes

Chapter Notes

tw more culty blood drinking and stuff .......... but how did u make it to chapter 16 if ur not chill with that ur so powerful

Phainon could barely do anything but stand there and twirl his fingers around that golden red scale - eyes tracing over it multiple times as he stood at the counter merely waiting.

It was rare for him to go into town, and even more rare for him to desire to buy things in town. 

“Is this chain to your liking?”

Those words were enough to make him drop his hand a little - eyes staring downwards at the older gentleman who was shaking while sliding a golden little piece of jewelry across the counter. An action that made Phainon stare at it, all before moving his eyes back to that scale in his hands while sighing just a bit. 

“Mm,” Phainon hummed as he flipped that precious scale between his fingers again and again - his heart beating so rapidly every time he considered who it belonged to, “I want something more plain for myself, the scale is the valuable thing to me, not the necklace holding it.”

The man working in the small little shabby shop only aggressively began to nod his head over that across the counter - immediately pulling back the jeweled chain he had once been offering to Phainon. Beautiful, intricately made with rather large gemstones running through the metal as well - but Phainon didn’t care about gemstones.

He cared about Mydei.

Mydei.

“I know,” Phainon whispered back softly, fully aware of how odd this probably was even for someone with draconic blood in his veins, “I was just inviting you to enjoy yourself more, if you wanted.”

Those instincts he was burying and trying to hide away - Phainon was powerless to stop the way he wanted to see Mydei let go more and more just like he did when they were alone. To relax and let himself just give in to whatever desires he had currently..

That was why Phainon couldn’t help but cock his head to the side, “It used to be tradition for Castrum Kremnos, did it not?”

That was enough to snap Mydei out of whatever trance he was in. His eyes immediately narrowed upwards as Phainon leaned away and straightened himself back out.

“.. Pardon me?”

“Blood drinking. Before it was changed to drinking a mix of pomegranate juice, correct?” Phainon asked with a teasing lilt to his voice - fully aware of the way he had to be correct. He had taken such careful notes of this that he knew Mydei was trapped right where he wanted him. 

And that much was obvious as Mydei only appeared more than a little shocked and baffled to hear Phainon ask such a thing, “Where.. Did you learn that?”

“You told me that yourself,” Phainon hummed as he stared at Mydei - all before flicking his eyes to the side, towards some.. Specific people that already were nodding at him silently, “I don’t blame you for forgetting, it’s been quite a few stressful days for you. But.. Even if you won’t feast with me, surely in the name of Nikador you’ll not let this blood all go to waste?”

Phainon had to direct his attention back to Mydei at that, offering up a small and welcoming smile towards him as well. 

“Using Nikador against me feels as if you should be put on trial for such a heinous crime,” Mydei growled out, however, appearing less than pleased and Phainon couldn’t help but to chuckle a little bit. Shrugging his shoulders as those servants now approached from behind Mydei.

Not unnoticed by Mydei whose sharp golden eyes jerked to look slightly at them as Phainon spoke again; “Ah, I’m lucky I’m in the Kremnoan’s future king’s good graces then, huh?”

“.. What are these?” Mydei asked as he was already turning a little to look at the people behind him who had already taken a knee behind him with soft display pillows in their hands. Raised with various items awaiting, Phainon couldn’t help but move closer to Mydei to gently push bloodied fingers against that braid of his. 

“More courting gifts, naturally!” Phainon explained as he raised those locks of Mydei’s hair to his nose slowly - sniffing that deep scent of strawberry before humming a little and moving to take some of that golden jewelry from the servant who was patiently kneeling behind Mydei, “I made arrangements for it earlier today, and the chalice is for you to not have to worry about dirtying yourself, beloved.”

Phainon offered up that cup without a second thought in his mind, only to feel his own instincts purr a little as Mydei accepted it quite easily from him. 

“Very well,” Mydei huffed, but Phainon only clicked his tongue in amusement over how easily he was giving in. All before moving his hands to drape some of those chains of jewels and gold around Mydei’s head carefully. Taking in the way Mydei was merely allowing this to happen - unmoving as Phainon wrapped his horns lovingly in gold to add to his dazzling appeal. 

“Really?” Phainon asked as he continued to bring more jewelry to rest on Mydei’s body - his eyes meeting with eyes that were more rich in vibrant gold than metal could ever be to Phainon.

“Why are you acting so shocked? I’m agreeing to take part in your traditions,” Mydei huffed out - his eyes dipping away behind Phainon and Phainon found that endlessly amusing. He was so obviously staring at the deceased person bleeding everywhere, and yet he wasn’t making any moves to actually near the body.

That was fine though!

Phainon was already honored enough that Mydei was trying, instead already pulling that golden cup from Mydei’s fingers with a gleaming grin towards that dragon sitting there comfortably, “Here, I’ll fill up your cup then.. No need for you to move!”

Phainon meant those words as well - immediately turning away to swiftly drag that cup through the open chest of a man, a smile on his lips all the while he tried his best not to dirty the chalice too much. He wanted Mydei to remain pristine, beautiful, and spotless.. Just like how he deserved!

Once he felt that cup was decently full of the dark blood he turned on heel to look at that man who was only keeping his keen eyes on Phainon’s fingers around that cup. Watching his every move as Phainon walked back to the man who was now glimmering more than anything - shimmering with his jewelry now draped over his head and horns.

Not a word was spared between the two of them as Mydei accepted that cup of blood from him - not even batting an eye as he instead brought it up to his lips.. And chugged it down. A movement that Phainon couldn’t bring himself to look away from. Instead merely standing there staring as he watched Mydei’s throat bob with his swallows.

Heavy and thick liquid to where a bit dribbled out of the corner of his lips messily - not that Phainon minded as he fell to his knees quickly with a hand on Mydei’s thigh to hold onto. His own lips raised to let his tongue lap over the blood that was spilling out to help keep Mydei clean, and to drink whatever he did not. Every single drop that trickled from Mydei’s lips felt like it was just as valuable as the gold adorning Mydei’s head to Phainon.

So precious, and yet Phainon knew to pull away as Mydei finished his drink - instead leaning back on his hind legs to watch the way Mydei spread his legs out a bit. Enough to be more comfortable all while cracking a rather smug looking grin towards Phainon who.. Didn’t want to get up. 

For once in his life he felt so very correct on his knees before someone - kneeling before them and staring upwards at someone that deserved all of his attention and care. His eyes were only able to look at that coy smile on Mydei’s lips and take in the way he seemed so very smug after drinking blood, as if it truly had never bothered him to begin with. 

Phainon found himself only able to adore that man who looked as if he was made for a throne, crafted out of marble to absolute perfection as he seemed to tilt his head to the side to fully take in Phainon kneeling before him. And Phainon’s own hands shook a little as he pulled them slowly up to his own lips. 

Phainon was trembling under that sharp gaze.

He could feel that - but he didn't think he cared as his grin only grew with his tail swishing behind him so happily over the man he was fawning over looking right back at him. Those golden eyes peering at him in such a studying way only made Phainon feel like he was struggling to breathe, his thoughts only becoming more and more chaotic under that stare with how deeply he wanted to claim that man again.

All he could do was breathily laugh instead as his smile never broke - remaining a manic grin behind his fingers as he took in the sight of his mate staring down at him.

“You’re so stunning, Mydeimos.”

Chapter End Notes
