chapters.title: Chapter 17
chapters.html:
“What kind of desserts do you prefer, Mydeimos?”

That question was enough to make Mydei slowly straighten himself back out - his eyes moving languidly to look at the woman who was now looking.. Flustered as their eyes met. Red tinted her cheeks as she dipped her eyes lower so obviously nervously to try to avoid his gaze.

But Mydei.. Really had no idea why as he only turned his body more to look at her after dropping his current pan he had been retrieving from the oven on the counter with a quiet clanking of metal sounding off. 

“.. Me?” He asked, as if she hadn’t quite literally said his name only a few moments ago - one of his brows raising to his hairline as he took the time to take her in.

He really hadn’t gotten most of the fellow staff members’ names, a shame really, but they didn’t seem.. Too inclined to speak to him before, they mainly stayed clear of him for being an outsider if anything. But he supposed now that their prince was so clingy and doting towards him every time they were around each other.

.. Even if they were in public. 

“Indeed! We’re dying to know,” That girl only continued - nodding her head at a speed that made Mydei feel pricks of worry towards her neck getting whiplash,  “Hyacine told us you seem rather fond of them as your favorite food, and Prince Phainon made us bake you some..”

Mydei found his mind only stalling at that - a piece of him now idly wondering if there was some new event being set up for him to attend or some other nonsense like that. He truly had no idea what to make of it as he blinked at her. 

Yet again, all he could do was feel bubbling questions rising to his mind and speak them slowly; “Is that.. Needed knowledge for something?”

“Ah, no no! Forgive us!” She immediately waved her hands dismissively at that - and the usage of ‘us’ only served to make Mydei look past her a bit languidly. His eyes taking note of the horde of staff members staring at the both of them and undoubtedly eavesdropping in.

But it’s not like he minded as he instead focused back onto her with an inquisitive stare; “Forgive you? I’m sorry, am I missing some context?”

The girl only looked a bit more distressed over that - shifting her weight between her feet before looking behind her for aid from the other girls. Which, surprisingly, seemed to work as Mydei moved to cross his arms over his chest while watching a new one move forward. 

“Prince.. Mydeimos, if I may..” She began, and that was enough to make him tilt his head a tiny bit to take her in and ready himself for whatever they wanted from him,  “You are expecting children with Prince Phainon, are you not?”

Ah.

So that was why they were so flustered about asking Mydei things now - he was no longer just their co-worker or the crown prince of Kremnos to scare them, he was also.. Whatever he currently was being perceived as to the public with Phainon. (He’s not sure of the answer to this question himself.)

“.. I am,” Mydei sighed in response, feeling all of his energy immediately vacating his body over that man being brought up. 

He enjoyed Phainon’s presence, he did, he knew that much now - but that didn’t mean he wasn’t a bit.. Hyper. Overwhelming. Doting. Too clingy. Energetic. Eager.

.. There were an endless mess of words you could use to describe Phainon and how he acted around Mydei, and Mydei was pretty sure all of them would work. 

“It’s only natural for us to be eager to get to know what you like the most. We’re up close and personal to one of our future rulers now and..” She trailed off - looking as if she too was growing more and more nervous the longer Mydei’s attention was focused on her, “We treasure Prince Phainon quite a lot here! We want to extend the same towards you as well!”

Mydei had to take a moment to take in those words - he understood where they were coming from. It was rather natural to make sure you were pleasing the crown prince’s.. Betrothed, or whatever Mydei was to him. He knew that fully well, but the idea of this line of questioning made him snort a little.

Just a quiet huff of laughter the more he even debated telling them, all before giving her a very wary smile on his lips. 

“Are you sure you want to know that?” Mydei asked softly, genuinely curious if she knew just what she was asking for and that was enough to make her eyes widen with shock.

Most likely because they all knew Phainon ate people, surely Mydei’s reply about desserts couldn’t be that odd..!

“H-Huh?”

Mydei only lowered himself a little, leaning forward to be more on her level as he looked her in the eyes with a hint of mischief creeping into him, “If Phainon finds out you learned things about me first.. Who knows how he would feel about that?” 

That was enough to make all of the color drain from her face immediately - staring right back at Mydei as if she had just been shown a ghost all before she nodded slowly. A nod that ramped up in speed as she chose to excuse herself with tiny footsteps backwards, “You.. Are correct! Please pardon us!”

Mydei straightened himself back out as he watched her scurry off - chuckling a little inaudibly over how that jest only truly worked due to the fact they were already somewhat fearful of being devoured by their prince. Or perhaps fearful of the public outrage Phainon could have.. Who knows, Mydei certainly didn’t! 

“Mydei,” That was a familiar voice that made Mydei find his way to his other side - turning once more to the shorter dragon who was staring at him with bright eyes and a small smile on her lips. 

“Hello Hyacine,” Mydei replied as he lowered his arms again - his eyes moving to his work in progress pastries that had been interrupted twice now, but he didn’t mind. Not when the other option was speaking with Hyacine and he doubted anyone would seek out punishing him anymore. 

Instead, he was more than happy to give Hyacine all of his attention.

Her eyes only sparkled at him in pure curiosity and wonder - a sight that made it hard not to smile back at her over; “Is it true? Are you.. Expecting?”

.. He was suddenly a little less than happy to give Hyacine all of his attention.

“Yes,” Mydei breathed out - feeling a piece of him forfeiting his own sanity as he knew he was about to have to answer a bunch of new questions yet again. 

For some odd reason though, Hyacine only shook her head before moving to the counter at the side of Mydei with a heavy sigh leaving her chest; “Wow.. That prince sure does work fast..”

.. Mydei could agree with that much, that was certain. 

“You seem less than shocked over this news,” Mydei huffed out as he watched her looking as if she was inspecting Mydei’s work.

Ironic, considering she herself usually was a disaster in the kitchen - he didn’t think she had any footing to stand on in this topic..

“Well,” Hyacine huffed, oblivious to his thoughts as she put her hands on her hips to look at him with an amused expression on her face, “Everyone has been talking about it lately.. And Phainon is all over you every time I see you around.. And I may have given him some tips..”

.. Tips?

What on earth was that supposed to mean?

“Pardon me?”

“Pardoned! I’m surprised he’s letting you stand around on your feet so much, though I guess you aren’t showing yet..” Hyacine only continued on without much of a care - her eyes drooping to quite blatantly stare at Mydei’s stomach and something about that made his skin crawl in a way that forced him to grit his teeth a little.

He had grown used to the heaviness in his body - weighing him down and sometimes shifting inside of him, if anything, he was a bit fond of knowing they were safe inside of him but.. To be stared at and inspected to see if he had a bump forming yet.

.. It was embarrassing considering Phainon’s eggs had been much smaller than he expected that giant man to be possessing. 

“I refuse to be coddled constantly by an oversized dog,” Mydei hissed out, instead moving back to his pastries that were assuredly just growing cold now, “No matter how pathetic he seems when alone with me.”

.. Mydei refused to admit how he enjoyed it either. 

“Wow,” Hyacine breathed out - seeming less than impressed or shocked to hear such a thing really, “Is he really that clingy?”

Mydei also absolutely refused to admit how he felt just as clingy towards that dragon when they were alone together for long enough.

“Yes,” was all Mydei offered up instead, turning away a little to ignore the burn on his face when he thought of how he wanted to see Phainon again. It was natural for him to feel that way towards the man he was going to marry, right? 

“Makes sense.. Territorial dragon.. Did he put all that jewelry on you too?” Hyacine asked, and that was enough to make his cheeks burn even more as he hung his head just a little in shame - his teeth moving to bite at his gums as he felt his embarrassment only rise when he remembered he did in fact allow Phainon to put that jewelry back on him this morning.

.. How could he have had refused when Phainon came to Mydei’s room to dote on him and lovingly drape those golden metals over his horns again - the clinking of chains hitting while dangling off his head only made his heart flutter a little every time he thought of how happy that snowy haired dragon had looked over it. 

“.. Yes,” Mydei painfully admitted - feeling his head hang just  a little bit lower to jingle those golden chains even more. 

Though, Hyacine only made an odd noise at his side; “Speaking of..”

“Hmm?” Mydei began, but it was useless as he turned his head to look at her. 

“Mydei,” The new third voice entered the conversation without much flair - a voice that sent an odd chill down Mydei’s spine as he heard how softly it was spoken. Silky and smooth as the man who owned it seemed to be pleased, or doing his best to already try to soothe Mydei.

A foolish attempt as Mydei gave a sigh. 

“Ph-”

Mydei didn’t even have time to fully turn around and question the man - instead abruptly finding himself cornered with both of Phainon’s arms around him on the counter. Crowding around him all while Phainon’s chest was against Mydei’s back - only to make Mydei’s eyes flick down and stare at the golden chain hanging from one of his hands.

A sign that there was nothing good about to happen to Mydei..  Mydei had to huff and try to turn at with his own thoughts, only to feel one of Phainon’s arms snap around him a bit. 

“Ah, don’t move, you’re perfect like this!” Phainon whined out, and that was enough to make Mydei press out such a heavy and deep sigh. All before he could feel those arms loosening a bit around him - instead he tilted his head a little to look behind and over his shoulder as Phainon crouched swiftly down. 

“Phainon,” Mydei began as he watched that man tenderly grab at his tail - an action that sent even more shivers down Mydei’s spine without much effort,  “What are you doing?”

Mydei wanted to look so badly - feeling those gentle fingers rubbing underneath his tail was enough to make him jerk a little. Just enough to press himself more against the counter as Phainon seemed keen on only giving his tail ghost touches that effortlessly made Mydei feel more and more flustered that everyone was undoubtedly watching Mydei twitch and quiver over his tail being held and pulled on a little. 

“More courting gifts.. I was late to pick up this one but I hope you don’t mind,” Phainon explained in a quiet murmur, all while Mydei yanked his body forward as Phainon’s hand stroked against his tender underside, “I know your tail is sensitive, but try not to jerk it from me, beautiful.”

This bastard knew what he was doing, and that was why Mydei’s hands were now gripping at the counter as he grinded his teeth together - barely controlling his urge to lunge for the man and snarl more at him. He probably would have, if not for the fact he was very aware Phainon only enjoyed such reactions from him. 

“.. Then stop rubbing the sensitive parts of my tail,” Mydei hissed out through his teeth, though, with how Phainon almost seemed to be massaging his tail - he knew that was a plea on deaf ears. 

“Sorry, Sorry.. I’ve never put jewelry on a tail..” Phainon sighed out rather dramatically, making it painfully obvious to Mydei that he was simply having fun with this situation, “I’ll have plenty of time in my life to practice, though!”

.. Mydei wasn’t sure if he liked the sound of that as his ears only heard more jingles of metal from behind him mixed with brief sensations of chills against his tail. Clearly, jewelry was being put on him, but that was ignorable.

Those fingers pressing into the underside of his tail - kneading into that sensitive part of him that never was touched.. That was not ignorable as Mydei felt his own sanity quickly threatening to snap with every teasing push into his soft tail’s belly. Almost finding his own legs quivering before.. It all abruptly stopped. 

“Hello Hyacine!” Phainon chirped out, as if he had done nothing wrong and Mydei wasn’t nearly panting - his own body practically screaming to cling to that man and yet.. All he did was keep his claws on that counter with a snarl on his lips. 

“.. Hello Prince Phainon! Please ex-”

“May I ask the staff what they think of Prince Mydeimos?” Phainon cut in, but Mydei could barely even hear that annoying man through the blood in his ears and the shake in his bones over the adrenaline from being touched like that. 

“Ah.. W.. Are you asking me or implying you want me to gather them all..?” Hyacine sounded worried - and all Mydei could do was to try his best to regain himself and his composure. Doing his best to stand up straight again while ignoring the sound of jewelry on his tail that made him.. More flustered than he would like when his tail moved. 

“Phainon-” Mydei tried to croak out as he turned around languidly to look at the two of them - a bit miffed over the way Phainon’s eyes were so focused on Hyacine. 

“I’m asking you,” Phainon easily said, moving to put a hand on his hip with a disarming smile on his lips so sweetly, “You would be more honest than they would, wouldn’t you?”

“Don’t scare her, Phainon,” Mydei found himself growling, and that seemed to be enough to earn those blue eyes jerking to him out of the corner of his eyes. As if Phainon was deciding for a moment whether or not to obey and listen to Mydei, all before he laughed a little. 

“Ah! I wouldn’t bite your friends, it’s okay! I’m just curious, Mydei!” Phainon nodded several times, but something.. Was off about it. High-strung and forced, as if he was unhappy to be reprimanded by Mydei in this specific topic. 

“They’re.. Very fond of him,” Hyacine replied instead, wholly unaware of the way Mydei could notice those odd little tics of Phainon’s personality - instead garnering both of the crown prince's gazes instantly, “They have been attempting all day to make him take breaks and relax more.”

“Oh! They sound just like me! Isn’t that neat,” Phainon laughed a little, still sounding almost hollow to where it made Mydei’s ears prick just a bit over it, “Has Mydei listened at all?”

“No, Prince Phainon,” Hyacine answered immediately without missing a single heartbeat of a second, and that was enough to make Mydei sigh. 

“Whose side are you on, anyway..?” That was his whispered out question as he looked down a little - feeling thankful that the shake in his legs wasn’t noticeable to anyone else. Maybe Phainon due to how close he had been, but at least he hadn’t openly commented on it.

“Phainon’s,” Hyacine answered also just as quickly to make Mydei jerk his head a little to give her such a flabbergasted expression over that, “Not only because he is.. A bit overwhelming, but because I do believe you need to rest more.”

“I am a dragon, this is not a normal pregnancy. I do not need two worrywarts pressing against me constantly,” Mydei growled out at her, unable to stop the edge from leaking into his own words as he spoke them. 

Though, it’s not like it mattered as Phainon only seemed to move closer to Mydei with his hissing, “Mm, I did come to speak to you about something rather.. Important.”

“Important?” Mydei echoed as he jerked his head to the side - looking at the way Phainon looked to be.. Plotting something, assuredly with how his eyes were twinkling so very much over whatever was happening inside his head. 

“Please excuse us! I’ll be stealing him away now!” Phainon sang out, but he didn’t even wait a moment - instead he was already grasping onto Mydei’s arm and tugging him away without much other thought or words spared to Hyacine who.. Seemed fine with it. 

She only waved in a good bye and Mydei could feel a sense of dread sinking into him as he looked to Phainon right after that - staring at the way Phainon appeared to be striding forward so excitedly. 

“Where are we going?” Mydei pushed himself to ask, even though he knew he himself had no desire to refuse whatever this man wanted from him anymore. Instead merely did his best to avoid swinging his tail too much to hear those jingles driving him to insanity when he thought of how warm Phainon’s hands were.

His eyes only creeped downwards to look at where Phainon had a nice grip on his arm to keep leading him and.. Mydei felt some odd and bizarre feeling of greed where he wanted those hands on his body even more..

“To my garden,” Phainon coolly replied, a smile on his lips as Mydei glanced back up at him, “I want you to relax some before..”

.. The way he trailed off was enough to ruin whatever mood Mydei had been in as Phainon seemed unable to find the words to continue on his thoughts - instead looking like he had a brief expression of worry before relaxing again. 

“.. Before what, Phainon?”

“Ah well,” Phainon started, appearing a little more smiley than what was normal - and that was an impressive feat in itself as Mydei stared him down while they walked,  “Nothing to worry about!”

“Nothing you say ever fills me with confidence,” Mydei grumbled right back as they stepped into that garden that was becoming so very familiar to Mydei at this point. It was almost comforting in a way, and Mydei could understand a little why Phainon was keen on keeping it a bit more private than other places. 

“And yet you follow me and trust me regardless of that fact, isn’t that so romantic?” Phainon asked with a little clipped type of laugh - sounding like he truly was finding it funny as Mydei heart only skipped a beat a bit pathetically over how sweet it did seem to him, “It really helps me remember that our love is so true..”

“.. It’s rather remarkable how your kingdom has kept your insanity so secretive when you act like this with me,” Mydei growled out regardless of it all, feeling his brows knitting together out of pure habit as Phainon finally released his hold on Mydei’s arm. 

An action that made Mydei yearn for that warmth back on his skin, but it wasn’t as if Mydei held any desire to vocalize such a thing either.

“But that’s just me trusting you as well.. My beloved fellow crown prince who has stolen my heart and soul!” Phainon purred out all while his hand went to his own chest - gripping at it as if he were making such a passionate plea.

.. That was enough for Mydei to feel his own face droop into a slight frown over how dramatic this man was sometimes, “I would argue it’s more dedication from your worshippers..”

“My worshippers? Mydeimos, I don’t know if you have noticed, but they wholeheartedly adore you as well,” Phainon hummed as his eyes rather slowly rolled to look at Mydei - seeming like they were amused over his words and studying him while they walked and that.. That was enough to make Mydei sigh. 

“.. Due to you,” He pointed out effortlessly, shaking his head a little over how Phainon was so smiley all of the time - especially when he looked back at him. 

“Well.. Yes.. They do feel so strongly due to our love,” Phainon conceded as he tilted his head back to focusing on where they were going, “But I’m sure they’ll grow to adore you for you just the same!”

.. Grow to adore him? Adore Mydei..? The thought was odd, but not unwanted, no king wanted to be hated - even if it was in a different kingdom.. 

He was losing this battle, he knew that much, that was precisely why he had to change the topic, “Where are we going, Phainon?”

“Deeper,” Phainon purred in a voice that shouldn’t sound as sultry and seductive to Mydei as it currently did, “Just past these hedges..”

And that was more than true as Phainon’s feet stopped to turn to the side a little - letting Mydei look past him and to the thing he seemed to have been keen to lead him to. Only, Mydei found himself blinking at the tree that was keeping up those ropes attached to a rather regal looking chair.

.. It looked old and well loved, white painted much like the rest of the kingdom with gold detailing to where Mydei had to look at Phainon curiously. 

“.. A swing?”

“Rarely used and no one enters this place anymore,” Phainon shrugged as he walked over to it, motioning quite blatantly for Mydei to have a seat on it, “It’s the perfect place for you to sit and relax while we discuss things.”

“With the way you’re so desperate to make me relax, I can only assume this is bad news,” Mydei huffed out tiredly as he moved to cross his arms over his chest - eyes narrowing a little towards that dragon whose tail was happily swaying like a dog yet again. 

Phainon was stunning.

He had to admit that much when he saw him in the sunlight, dazzling with his shiny translucent sparkling scales and practically twinkling with his eyes and smile. Everything about him seemed to glow as if he was angelic while he only stared right back at Mydei with such a pleading expression on his face.

.. It was almost annoying how perfect he appeared to Mydei. 

“My beautiful to-be-husband who is so smart and gorgeous and perfect,” Phainon spoke in a tone that made Mydei’s eye twitch just a little,  “Please take a seat!”

“.. Right,” Mydei replied regardless as he obeyed anyway - moving to that swing that Phainon was standing behind with a heavy sigh already on his lips for whatever Phainon was going to say to him and this.. 

This was the one time where he could always feel his clutch inside of him buried away incubating. Those moments when he sat or laid down and felt them move inside of him, squeezing against his own body and making him growl a little over the mixture of feelings.

But Phainon didn’t comment on it, instead, he only gently pushed that swing - such a soft movement that Mydei could barely even tell the chair was moving outside of the slight breeze on his face while his eyes took in the sight of the garden before him. 

It was less well kept back here - Mydei had to assume no one was permitted this deep into his garden in the area it was in, but he didn’t have long to think about it anyway. 

“Word has been sent to your parents about our wedding,” Phainon spoke instead to cut through his thoughts - making Mydei blink a little before looking over his shoulder and staring at that now nervous looking dragon. 

So that was what this was about? His parents..?

“.. And?”

“Just the wedding, I assumed the rest is better spoken in person,” Phainon mumbled, a bit unlike himself but Mydei could understand why he probably felt anxious on this topic. Mydei certainly and heavily implied how much his parents’ opinions meant to him, and that meant Phainon had to make a decent impression on them.

Mydei had to sigh a little, finding mercy in his heart as he faced the front again to let that man calm down a little, “And why must I be pushed on a swing while getting this news?”

“It’s fun, isn’t it?”

“You are beyond insufferable,” Mydei scoffed out - though he couldn’t deny the smile on his lips over how oddly silly that prince behind him was, “When did you send word to them?”

“This morning,” Phainon replied, only to quickly add onto his thoughts,  “My father did, technically.”

.. A piece of Mydei felt a deep sense of dread over the king speaking to his father, but he could do nothing but enjoy the feeling of air passing him by as he lazily moved to lean back in that chair. Giving up on remaining on edge when Phainon assuredly meant him no harm, especially not with how lightly he was pushing that swing. 

Especially when Mydei knew he could be rougher if he desired, considering how easily he picked up Mydei all the time to show off his strength to the dragon he wanted to mate with. 

“.. And what was said?”

“That we plan to wed, of course, and how excited we would be to speak to them in person about this topic,” Phainon explained in a quiet voice - more hushed than before as he seemed to be more focused, “Mainly wrote that with intentions of them learning you’re not being tortured into this path..”

.. Right.

Mydei did have to admit his parents probably thought he was going through utter hell to randomly bear Phainon’s children and agree to marry him. It sounded insane to him as well that he would have easily agreed to such things, and he was the person actively making those choices.

He could do nothing but bite into his lip a little - trying his best to gauge how he felt on the topic all while having nothing more to say. What could he ever say when they would be here soon regardless of how he felt?

“Do you like it here, Mydei?” Phainon instead asked after a few heavy moments of silence between them, but that was a question Mydei hadn’t thought heavily about either. 

“.. I don’t know,” Mydei admitted as he looked upwards a little, staring at that sky that was so far beyond his fingertips all while Phainon still pushed him sweetly. 

“I know,” Phainon also admitted, sounding much more quiet, “Can we go into town?”

..?

That was a question that made Mydei leisurely move to look at Phainon - taking in the sight of those vivid blue eyes staring right back at him. 

“.. Huh?”

“You haven’t gone because you thought of yourself like a prisoner,” Phainon offered up rather easily, but Mydei could only watch the way he shifted his weight between his feet between his words, “But surely now you know  you’re more than that, right? So.. Can we take a stroll into town, Mydeimos? I would like you to see more of my own kingdom that is.. Going to be yours as well.”

.. His kingdom as well.

That was a thought that he would be lying to say he hadn’t thought of quite a few times - finding his mind confusingly stalling every now and then when he returned to it all before pressing out a sigh. 

“I am.. Finding it hard to refuse you with that logic,” Mydei grumbled, mainly because he would have to come to know the people and how they lived if he was actually staying here.

Outside of the cults and rituals, outside of their religions and how they worked, he had to eventually meet the Elysians for who they actually were behind it all - right?

“So you agree?”

“Yes.”

────────────── 

Mydei could admit this wasn’t quite the experience he had been expecting.

Maybe if he had been alone it would have felt more.. Organic, but as it stood now while walking with Phainon - he felt like he was still being pampered too much. 

Every now and then a new person would come up to offer them items, whether it was fresh fruits or flowers - Phainon declined them with a smile on his face and the people offering.. Looked just as happy - ecstatic to be seeing them in town and so eager to please them. 

All while Mydei mainly focused on the buildings between those rather embarrassing meetings with people offering him up items. He had to repeatedly refuse - finding his mind tumbling a little when he watched their smiles only brighten while scurrying away from him.

.. Not to mention the tail that was wrapped around his own wrist like a leash.

It was an odd thing - yet for some reason the pressure was oddly reassuring, a heavy force wrapped around him that was keeping Phainon close to him - and keeping himself close to Phainon. A possessive display, but for some reason, Mydei couldn’t find it in himself to scold that dragon who was watching his every move either - instead he merely ignored it and continued to walk with him.

Even if it coiled around his wrist a bit harder when someone approached, he couldn’t bring himself to yank himself free. He was finding it comforting in an odd way to know Phainon was this worried about him and territorial, sweet and tender almost.

.. What was wrong with him? His parents were absolutely going to kill the both of them if he kept up this odd level of weakness..

Though, he didn’t have too long to think about such a thing as a small hand grabbed his free hand immediately. An action that made Mydei’s feet absolutely pause in the middle of the main road - instead darting his eyes to look at.. A child. 

“Princess! We found you!” She immediately chirped out - beaming such a smile that made Mydei blink slowly, eyes only able to take in the fact she was missing one of her front teeth. 

“.. Princess?” He echoed out, vaguely aware of that tail on his wrist tightening still so possessively and needily - as if Phainon was silently trying to urge him to keep walking. 

.. Mydei certainly did not listen to him, he in fact did the opposite and put up no fight when that girl immediately began to tug him away - only following without another word as he heard Phainon following behind him like he was his shadow. 

It only took a mere moment of being led astray to find a few kids playing off to the side of the road in a small grassy area - one that made Mydei blink at the newfound trio before him that all seemed to be.. Up to no good.

“They’re calling you my princess, you know that right?” Phainon asked rather quietly as the girl unhanded Mydei - letting him straighten himself back out and cast a stare to Phainon with a raised brow.

All before he moved to put his arms in a cross position over his chest; “Am I supposed to be upset?”

“No,” Phainon rather smugly spoke - looking like he was becoming more and more proud or mischievous as his smile grew, “It’s just adorable th-”

“Prince Phainon can be the chef!” One of the children cut in immediately - words that made Mydei jerk his head to look at them with brows raised. Only to languidly turn his head back to look at Phainon, feeling himself unable to stop the smug smile growing on his lips as he took in the sight of how far Phainon’s jaw had dropped over that.

“‘Your’ princess, huh?” Mydei asked in a teasing tone - yet Phainon’s eyes only stayed locked on the child that had handed out his role to him. 

“Chef?” That word was echoed in the quietest voice from Phainon, and was more than enough to make Mydei snort a hushed laugh as he only moved his eyes back to the children. Opting to ignore the man who clearly wasn’t happy with his role in.. Whatever this was.

Only to blink his eyes over one getting closer to him - a thumb to their chest, “I’m the knight for the princess this time!”

“You were the knight last time!” Another shouted right back, moving just as close with a pout on their face.

“Wh-” Mydei began, and absolutely never finished as he was effortlessly swept off his feet - back into a cradled position against Phainon’s chest who had nothing but a devious expression on his face as Mydei’s widened eyes finally looked up at him, “Phainon!”

Though, Phainon only ignored him with a laugh escaping his chest - sounding more than a little giddy as he was already full speed running away.

.. From children.

“Sorry! Working as the chef was just a set up to kidnap the princess! I’m taking him now!” Phainon only chirped out, seeming as if he was more than a little happy to break back into the main streets with Mydei in his arms - laughing all the while as Mydei only found himself heavily sighing. 

“You are much too territorial, they are children,” Mydei pointed out - watching the way those stark blue eyes danced between Mydei and looking at where they were running off to. Only laughing a little bit more as his fingers curled into Mydei possessively. 

“They should have let me be your knight, Mydei! They couldn’t even protect you from a chef!” Phainon argued as if it was the most obvious answer ever - and all that served to do was to make Mydei roll his eyes at him before narrowing them sharply. 

“.. They’re most likely no older than eight years, you insane dragon,” Mydei pointed out again, vaguely aware that he should have fought back at least a little as this man began to slow to a trot through the busy streets - a dopey smile on his face that seemed too happy.

Too in love appearing for the fact he was a prince carrying another prince in public..

Phainon merely shrugged over it with another laugh leaving him, “I’m your knight in shining armor! You should be praising me for my dedication of working secretly as your chef for so many years!”

..?

What was this made up roleplay he had conjured up so immediately?

“Unhand me,” Mydei growled out - fully aware his voice sounded as if he was scolding Phainon, even though a piece of him.. Found this sweet. Oddly endearing that Phainon had made up some story in case the children found them again, some plot for them to enjoy even if Mydei knew it was just Phainon’s territorialness spiking.

.. Idiotic, and yet it was enough to fluster Mydei the more he thought about it. 

“Very well,” Phainon sounded so in pain as he slowly got to one knee - a pose to let Mydei down to his feet with such gentleness that it almost made Mydei feel even more flustered over the gasps and cooing he could hear from people passing them by or standing and watching.

“I’m surprised your guards allow you to go out here alone,” He hissed out, turning his back to that man as he instead decided his attention was better served and for his own sanity’s sake, used elsewhere. Even if he did hear another quiet round of chuckling from that dragon who was assuredly standing up behind him to follow him. 

“They don’t,” Phainon purred out as he seemed to take his place as Mydei’s side - leaning into him just a tiny bit, “They’ve been following us the entire time, but they’re under strict restrictions not to bother us.”

“.. It’s worrying that I did not notice,” Mydei admitted as he felt the urge to look behind himself, to search for whoever was stalking them both. Instead all he did was languidly bring a hand to the bridge of his nose and pinch it tiredly, heaving a sigh over how his senses already felt duller.

“Nonsense! It’s good that you’re relaxed enough here to not be on edge or on guard to notice them! I’m happy by it,” Phainon only hummed out - and Mydei was vaguely aware of the way Phainon had chosen to turn down a quieter alleyway now, directing them both with his entire weight practically leaning into Mydei until he gave in and swerved down it. 

“Regardless, I’m fairly certain you could fend off most attackers on your own,” Phainon only continued his rambles with a little laugh as they now were in a new more secluded area, “Even without your gauntlets, I think a good punch would break most people’s bones easily from you!”

Mydei found himself daring a glance to that man - looking at the way he always seemed to be smiling before focusing back on where he was walking instead, “.. Is this your way of praising me?”

“Of course! My mate is perfect, after all!”

.. How odd it was for Mydei to hear those words being said about himself. So happily decreed and fully meant.. It was soothingly nice in a reassuring way, one that made Mydei huff a little over his own thoughts and feelings towards the warmth he felt with Phainon.

“Hmph,” Mydei scoffed - doing his best to resist the urge to click his tongue in favor of instead questioning the man, “Where are you leading me to now, anyway?”

“Here,” Phainon purred out as he led Mydei to an oddly secluded place between some buildings and alleyways - guiding him to this small little balcony that made Mydei cock his head to the side as he walked closer. His shoulder pressing against Phainon’s chest in the close proximity as his eyes only stared at what was before them.

The rows of golden wheat that Aedes Elysiae were known for - rows that were waving in the wind as if it were a moving sea, crashing upon the shore and sparkling in the sunlight.

The sight felt almost foreign to him as he looked slowly at the man to his side; “.. A view point?”

“Yep! Nothing wrong with merely enjoying the view of the city and the fields of gold, is there?” Phainon asked - and Mydei only found his eyes flickering down over the way Phainon was leaning into him even more. Pressing against him and crowding him more and more towards the railing almost.. Possessively in an odd way. 

As if he was doing his best to hide Mydei from any prying eyes..

“Not at all,” Mydei decided as he moved his gaze back to those flowing and abundant crops, “It’s only surprising the crown prince that's worshipped in his kingdom knows of places like this.”

“Just because I am worshipped does not mean I do not adore my kingdom for what it is as well,” Phainon chuckled a little with his own words as if he was finding something humorous, “This is my home, and I treasure it greatly.”

.. That was natural, Mydei thought - but there was something more to it as he looked at that man slightly, taking in the way those sharp blue eyes had never once moved off of him. Only remaining focused on him and studying him - watching his every move and acting as if the view behind Mydei wasn’t nearly as beautiful as what his eyes were instead looking at. 

“.. You say that, yet-”

“I’m staring at you? Well,” Phainon hummed, all while those eyes didn’t seem to feel shame at all - remaining completely on Mydei even after being called out for doing just that, “I do consider you my home and greatest treasure, it’s only natural I can’t keep my eyes off of you, correct?”

.. This was embarrassing. Mydei knew that much for certain as he tried to look back on the sight Phainon had dragged him to. Doing his best to ignore the burning in his face and the way he could hear Phainon’s stupid tail wagging incessantly in his own happiness.

.. It was addicting.

So very addicting was Phainon’s happiness that Mydei found himself desperately wanting to drown in it - to bask in it and feel just a fraction of how happy Phainon felt all the time. It was enough to drive him insane and it only got worse when he actually looked at those beautiful eyes studying him.

It felt impossible to truly experience such a level of happiness, because Mydei knew he.. Had something to do with it. That Phainon only ever appeared this happy when he was with Mydei - and if Mydei wanted to feel that.. He.. He needed to love Phainon just as much, didn’t he?

Though, Phainon only chuckled a little behind him, “Besides.. You should love it here, the land is full of gold; and you rather like that, don’t you?”

“Wheat is golden colored, I will give you that much,” Mydei conceded with a quiet laugh - all before feeling his body go rigid.

“You fit in here, Mydei..” Phainon purred, all while his fingers were already combing through Mydei’s hair so sweetly that he could barely hear him through his own heartbeat, “I’ll do my best to impress your parents, I promise you that much.”

“That’s a big promise from you,” Mydei forced himself to say, turning his head a little to look at the man who only eagerly took the new opportunity to brush Mydei’s bangs back as well with the new angle. 

“And I mean it,” Phainon spoke with that familiar twinkle in his eyes, “I’ll behave.”

.. Something about his tone was almost reassuring to Mydei. Just enough to where he had to take a moment to look at those waving fields of wheat again - his eyes taking in the scenery of people tending to their farms and talking, laughing together.. 

Even if the castle had their secrets, the people who lived here seemed so.. Normal and free. It was.. Nice enough to where Mydei easily found himself relaxing into that hand that was rubbing at the back of his scalp leisurely. 

“.. Honeycakes,” Mydei mumbled softly, unable to help where his mind was trailing off to as he watched the sunsetting before them - his eyes only closing a little to lean into that touch for a minute of soothing.

“Honeycakes? Are we already calling each other pet names?”

.. And the soothing was gone as Mydei blinked his eyes open once more with a heavy sigh. 

“I like honeycakes the most, you fool,” Mydei growled as he turned away - striding past Phainon’s rather bewildered looking face without much of a second thought. It didn’t matter anyway.

He knew that man would follow his lead anyway, “Oh! Let’s get you some then, Mydei!” 

“Good dog.”

chapters.html:
Phainon couldn’t help the way his feet paused at the edge of that hedge - staring at the way Mydei had his eyes closed with a plate of half eaten food beside him. Clearly relaxing a bit on that swing that Phainon had showed him yesterday and that was enough to make Phainon’s heart speed a little bit - pumping with pride over how he had successfully given Mydei another spot to enjoy.

.. The peace of that spot, however, was nothing Phainon could promise to him as his own tail began to sway easily while he pushed himself to move closer to the lounging dragon.

“My-dei-mos,” Phainon slowly chirped out every single word in a singing tone as he took a few steps - practically skipping with how he watched those vibrant eyes snap open again to narrow at him so dangerously. A vague threat and a look of mute annoyance - a cute look, if you asked Phainon!

“What?” Mydei growled out - unamused and sounding dreadfully unhappy. 

But that was powerless  to stop the fluttering of Phainon’s heart as he considered how it was beating against his own ribcage so painfully every time Mydei gave him those looks and snarly words. He was perfect in every sense, especially when Phainon’s eyes roamed over him to see him once again wearing the jewelry he had been gifted.

Even without being asked, it was draped over his head and his tail so beautifully - Phainon couldn’t help but get closer to him with a smile plastered on his face unrelentingly. 

“Woah.. So growly today, what did I do wrong?” Phainon asked as he swayed a little, doing his best to match his own tail’s happiness as he beamed a smile to Mydei. Only watching the way Mydei’s own fat tail seemed to curl a little on the swing beside him - an action that was rather adorable as Mydei moved to prop his head up on the swing’s armrest. 

“You’re too energetic for this early in the morning,” Mydei growled out in such a tone that only made Phainon feel more and more excited - his heart thundering in his ears over how Mydei still didn’t relent with this part of his personality, “Be quieter.”

Phainon hummed over that, only stalking a few more feet forward all while those golden eyes leered at him. A sight that only made Phainon more giddy as he moved instantly take up what little room there was on that swing - moving Mydei’s tail into his lap and snuggling a little to feel that man against him. 

Though, he had to wince a little over that. 

“Ow,” Phainon whined out as that tail on his lap slapped into him like an angry cat - with much more force than just a simple feline, however,  “Why are you hitting me with your tail too?”

“I never said you could sit with me,” Mydei growled out - sounding as if he was daydreaming about how he could bite off Phainon’s head, all while Phainon only found himself able to stare at that golden haired man with all the adoration in the world. Feeling his own tail twitching happily over how Mydei was acting this way, all while seeming to be fully relaxed against Phainon. 

“So mean today..” Phainon huffed out, though he lacked any true venom or emotions in his words - unable to even make his own happy smile fade away with the sound of jingles coming from Mydei’s tail every time it slapped down into him in a perturbed fashion.

An action that only did wonders to make Phainon’s own greed and territorialness purr over Mydei wearing the jewelry he had gifted to him. A nice feeling of his mate accepting his courting and his advances.. 

“Don’t touch me,” Mydei growled out however as Phainon’s hands moved to hold onto that tail - not to stop his slapping and annoyed methods of showing Phainon his dissatisfaction. But because Phainon knew fully well Mydei liked his tail to be touched, maybe even a bit too much to where it was rather adorable to hear his breath struggle.. 

Not to mention the way Mydei was pushing his body more and more into Phainon -  practically fully leaning on him at this point and only working to seem like he wanted the opposite of what he was saying.. Probably due to the sunlight being on them both and making Mydei tired, but regardless - Phainon couldn’t help but to lean his own head to the side a bit. 

Angling himself to rub his head against Mydei’s with a quiet chuckle leaving his throat; “You’re leaning into me Mydei.. I’m getting mixed signals here.”

“I told you to be quieter,” Mydei grumbled out - sounding no less happy than he had sounded the entire time, making Phainon huff a breath of laughter as he kept his own head pressed against Mydei’s. 

This was nice.. To merely have his lover putting his head (granted at a bit of an odd angle due to Mydei’s own curved horns) on Phainon’s shoulder and Phainon putting his head onto his.. Perhaps Mydei was just a bit more loving when tired, or when they were alone.. Whatever the case, Phainon couldn’t stop his hands from slowly moving to the underside of Mydei’s tail.

Thumbs working idly to press into that somewhat softer underbelly with curious touches - eager to hear the stuttering of Mydei’s breath every time.. It was delicious in a way that made Phainon’s own tail sway more now - dragging the tip of his tail against the ground as his own eyes only stared at the half eaten plate at the other side of Mydei. 

“Was your breakfast to your liking?” Phainon asked in a quiet tone, doing his best not to shatter any delicate moments they could be having - only to hum a little over the way Mydei blatantly sighed over that. 

“You really do not know how to hush up..”

.. Phainon could agree to that much, but as his own eyes only took in the sight of Mydei’s half eaten food - his mind was full of wonder of if he was picky or not. Surely not..? Though, it was worrying in a way. He wanted Mydei to be as happy as he could be, especially while carrying a clutch - the idea of him being unhappy with his food was a nightmare to say the least.. 

Only to say that went tenfold when he was incubating their children inside of him.. 

“Bite and snarl all you want,” Phainon mused, laughing a little under his breath as he rubbed his cheek into the top of Mydei’s head - basking in how soft his hair was and how Mydei didn’t even budge at all before he spoke again, “I’ll still find time to check in on you.”

Oddly, Mydei didn’t reply to that instantly. If anything, that seemed to have worked to quiet him as Phainon tried to soothingly rub Mydei’s tail like he had done yesterday, kneading into it to feel every ridge and bump on his beloved’s tail.. 

“I was removed from kitchen duty,” Mydei spoke after a few moments, words that made Phainon blink a little with his fingers pausing - doing his best to try to figure out why on earth that would even be the case. 

“Hmm?”

“I rather liked spending time there,” Mydei only continued, sounding more annoyed now as he straightened himself out - moving his head away from Phainon’s shoulder to thrash his tail again in Phainon’s hands, “Now when will I speak to Hyacine?”

Ah.. Phainon had no idea that was all happening, but all he could do was flick his eyes down to look at that angry tail. So obviously perturbed and pissed off that it honestly was cute to Phainon, all before he looked up again to see Mydei’s arms crossing over his chest - his eyes now glaring at Phainon as if he was truly interrogating him.

.. But that only made Phainon feel more excited, perking up a little with a laugh leaving him. 

“You can invite her here! I don’t mind if it’s your friends,” He told Mydei, because he meant those words - and that seemed to be enough to make Mydei snap his head forward - glaring now at nothing all while his tail still said more than enough about his true mood. 

“That’s good,” Mydei grumbled out, shaking his head swiftly, “Considering the fact she’s the one that brought me breakfast here in the first place.”

.. Phainon almost felt the pricks of annoyance in his skin over someone coming to his private garden without permission, but he supposed it didn’t matter when he thought of Mydei being happy to see her and well.. If he gave her permission, it was just as good as Phainon giving her permission himself.. 

That was why he could only tilt his head a little, “Oh?”

“She’s quite picky,” Mydei began, huffing out a little scoff over his own thoughts, “She spent a long time detailing to me the specifics of my meal and the nutrients within it and instructing me to eat it all for our children.”

.. Phainon found this all a bit odd, more than normal - at least. 

As if Mydei had been lonely and was dying to talk to someone today, only continuing to ramble on about things to extents that Phainon wasn’t used to. But that wasn’t to say he was complaining or would point it out! If anything, he only felt more than a little excited to hear out every single thought Mydei wanted to give to him!

“That’s kind of her,” Phainon chirped out with a nod - his eyes looking down at the breakfast that was.. Rather well built, he had to agree that most. A wide array of morning foods to cover every section of the foods he may need, it was rather sweet when he thought about it.

But not too shocking considering she had gone into detail of the best breeding positions for Phainon to do to Mydei and made him feel almost embarrassed to be having that conversation with her..

“I’m assuming she is partly why I’ve been banished from actually doing labour like I was brought here to do,” Mydei sighed out so heavily - sounding a little bit remorseful more than as if he was actually saddened by any of it. 

Phainon moved his hands lazily to pat at the top of Mydei’s angry tail now - humming a little over how Mydei seemed to be slowing down his slapping into Phainon’s crotch now, “Why is that?”

“When I walked into there today the staff were in a huddle around her talking about how it’s bad for me to be on my feet,” Mydei hissed out - seeming increasingly bitter before he fully leaned back into the swing with such a deep rooted sigh that Phainon felt his brows raising in slight amusement, “I think they assumed I could not hear them, but they’re not exactly quiet when giddy over things.”

Mydei’s own words made his eyes slowly move to Phainon again - studying him as if he was waiting to hear what kind of words Phainon would say in reply to that but.. What was he supposed to say when he fully agreed with the staff? 

Instead he felt himself sweating just a tiny bit, swallowing as he looked away with a quiet hum over how he did think Mydei needed to rest more..

“How are you otherwise?” Were the words Phainon decided to opt for to change the topic - his eyes roaming a little nervously. Trying his best not to stare at Mydei’s eyes for too long, lest he folds much too easily for whatever Mydei may want from him.

“.. I am fine,” Mydei only sighed out after a few moments, taking a second before looking away from Phainon - his arms lowering from being crossed over his chest to relax again into the swing.

.. It was a nice day out, Phainon had to admit that much as his eyes only glanced upwards - staring at the way the sky seemed to be fully alive. Blue with not a cloud in sight, only distant birds singing their songs in the very same air as they flew by. 

“Truly?” Phainon asked as he leaned forward just a tiny bit, enough to move his hand from Mydei’s tail and in trade he moved it timidly to Mydei’s lower abdomen. Not pressing on him at all, but still putting enough pressure to lay his hand comfortingly on Mydei, “You would tell me, wouldn’t you?”

.. That all seemed to be the wrong option as Mydei instantly moved to slap at his hand - borderline bristling as he forced Phainon’s fingers away from him, “I am fine, just as I said I am.”

Those words came out so very clipped and jaded that Phainon couldn’t help but to chuckle a little - already fondly thinking of how nice Mydei’s stomach had felt under his hand. There still was no large bump to give away his children being buried inside there, but that didn’t matter. The knowledge alone was more than enough to make Phainon’s tail spring to life. 

“Are you sure you don’t need anything? You know,” Phainon paused for a little - feeling the way his gaze was twinkling as he stared into golden eyes that were so very narrowed towards him,  “I’m more than happy to serve you.”

“You are overbearing and an annoyance on your best days,” Mydei told him all while his eyes still remained looking at Phainon as if he wished he would randomly combust. 

But that was a hard sell, Phainon had to admit as he admired his beloved’s face - staring at the way Mydei’s cheeks were slightly pink ever since his stomach was touched, even through the layers of clothes.. It was still intimate, wasn’t it? To have his clutch touched, even if it was by his mate..

Phainon only felt excited over the red in Mydei’s face - his eyes taking in the sight of it before dragging over his pointed ears that also were gifted with a brushing of red on their tips. Phainon knew for a fact that this man was perfect, but seeing how easily he still got flustered over things like this only added to his adoration of him.

They had made love, and were expecting children together.. But even the gentlest of touches worked to make Mydei’s breath halt and struggle when around Phainon.

It was beyond cute. 

“You say these things, but you’ve become rather flushed in the face nowadays when I say them..” Phainon pointed out, only to immediately hiss out a little grunt over that tail in his lap swiftly giving him another lashing - a harsh reminder that it was still laying on him lazily. 

“Are you trying to anger me?” Mydei asked in a tone that sounded a little amused, as if he wasn’t actually aiming to hurt Phainon very much (an action Phainon was more than a little thankful towards, of course). 

“Of course not,” Phainon grumbled out, shaking his head all before laughing easily - flicking his eyes to meet the gaze of Mydei’s inquisitive ones, “That would be bad for our children..”

For some reason, Mydei only held that gaze - his eyes dancing such a tiny bit as he looked into Phainon’s, seeming as if he was doing his absolute best to take in the sight of Phainon and try to identify if he was lying or not. A silly thing, really, considering Phainon had no interest in lying to Mydei! 

“.. Do you like children?” That was the question that Mydei asked - immediately making Phainon’s mind halt over how Mydei’s thoughts hadn’t been about Phainon trying to anger him. But instead on a topic that was so much more.. Important, he supposed.

Though, all Phainon could do was feel his mouth open - and snap closed a few times as amber eyes coated in gold watched him painfully keenly. 

“Huh?”

“Yesterday,” Mydei began in a voice that sounded so matter-of-fact in the way he was speaking - as if he had been absolutely haunted by this question as his brows knitted together just a tiny bit,  “When you dragged me away, I thought about it more.. Do you not like children?”

That.. Phainon had to nervously laugh at that, waving a hand dismissively as he felt Mydei’s tail tip curl on his lap. 

“Oh!” Phainon hummed out with a fond smile on his lips - staring at Mydei as he took in the sight of how Mydei seemed to be.. Protective. As if he was somewhat defending their eggs from him if he didn’t like children - his own hand resting on his own stomach all while Phainon couldn’t help but feel his tail sway so eagerly over the sight of him being so defensive, “I like children, Mydeimos, I simply..” 

How was Phainon supposed to fully explain he was greedy beyond belief? That he wanted Mydei to save all of his gentleness and love for their own children?

“Want to see you being a doting father to our own children, and.. Hmm..” Phainon trailed off as his eyes only took in the sight of Mydei’s hand on his stomach. 

It was cute in a way, considering no one would ever harm him while he was here - let alone Phainon of all people trying to do anything bad to their eggs inside of him. And yet, Mydei was so blatantly displaying territorialness towards their eggs while speaking about this topic.

.. Had the thought of Phainon not liking children truly haunted him that badly?

“You were jealous that you were not a prince?” Mydei offered - making Phainon flicker his eyes upwards to scoff at those words being said to him. Tutting a little before clicking his tongue loudly, and rather fakely as he gave a laugh over that thought. 

“.. I was not going to say that!”

“You should know that an eight year old poorly compares to a fully grown prince,” Mydei mused quietly - sounding as if he was doing his best to scold Phainon as his head shook slowly from side to side, “Having confidence issues so direly a child makes you waver is not attractive, either.”

.. Phainon couldn’t help the way he felt his eye twitching over those words.

“I’m not worried about them stealing you away!” Phainon whined out, moving to turn to Mydei more as he felt Mydei’s heavy tail slap into his crotch again cruelly,  “I am much stronger and could kidnap you much more easily than they ever could.”

Mydei gave him a look at that.

One that seemed like Mydei was debating if he should smack Phainon over the side of his head or not - all while his lips pressed into such a small little disproving frown. 

“.. How endearing,” Mydei huffed out after a moment or two of making Phainon merely sweat and squirm a little under his heavy gaze. Looking as if he was simply at his wits’ end with Phainon all before saying those words with such a degree of sarcasm that Phainon almost wanted to whimper.

And maybe he almost did, but he absolutely was not going to admit to it out loud, he promises that much.

Phainon leaned a little on the armrest, waving his hand back and forth as he tried to beam Mydei one of his charming and disarming smiles, “Listen, I’m just saying I would fight for you no matter who it is..” 

Mydei chuckled a little quietly over that - shaking his head as he sighed in a tone Phainon could only take as his own victory, “You are quite a piece of work, aren’t y-”

“Your highness,” Mydei’s words were cut off by a new voice - one that made Phainon’s blood run cold as he felt a bit of furious rage creeping into him over someone interrupting Mydei. Not just interrupting him, but interrupting him while he was in a private area of Phainon’s garden - a place where Mydei should be at rest and find himself as at peace as ever.

Not.. Being cut off while he was speaking by some man that made Phainon’s eyes slowly drag to look at whoever was addressing him. Feeling his sharp teeth only gritting together as he glared so painfully sharply at that man who didn’t seem to budge under his gaze. 

“.. Hello, I do not recall giving anyone permission to come here,” Phainon rather coldly bit out, feeling his own voice to be grating to his ears as he stared at the man who still did not appear as if he was bothered at all.

.. That was annoying. 

“I was sent by King Kephale to retrieve you,” That man supplied easily, answering effortlessly why he was feeling so bold to go against Phainon right now. And that.. That made Phainon bite at his own tongue - feeling his own mounting annoyance in this topic before he breathed out a sigh. 

“I am bonding with my mate right now,” Phainon coolly replied, feeling his hand twitching against the smooth wood of their seat - his entire body feeling achy with how irked and bothered he was now, “I’ll be there soon.”

“He is to come as well,” That man replied immediately, and that was enough to make Phainon scoff over Mydei being forced to speak to Kephale again.

Only for Phainon’s mind to immediately blank with the man’s next words; “His father wishes to speak to him.”

Ah..

Mydei’s father?

That was a person that Phainon found himself so painfully interested in - not just due to the fact that he was desiring to make Mydei his for forever, but.. Eurypon was well known for his fighting and leading on the battlefield - even his queen was combative and fierce to battle with, the idea of meeting them himself was a very interesting one.

Though.. He had to admit, it was a bit more nerve wracking now that Mydei himself was at his side - their own and only son that they had, and it was no secret that Queen Gorgo was very protective over her son as well. The fact that only his father had appeared.. Was that worrying, or a blessing?

“.. My father?” Mydei echoed out in a voice that sounded more than a little hollowed and worried - as if he was now choked up by his own thoughts and thinking about meeting his father.

.. Phainon would have wished he sounded happy over it, but instead it seemed as  though Mydei was worried for the reunion. For obvious reasons, sure, but that didn’t mean Phainon didn’t hold a little bit of sorrow in his heart over the fact Mydei wasn't excited to see his family again..

“He arrived this morning, and now the two kings have requested their sons,” The man only explained further as if he wasn’t even bothered by Mydei’s repeating of his words at all. Only serving to make Phainon feel the way Mydei’s tail immediately moved off of his lap - a clear sign that they were going to go now instead of enjoying their day together.

Annoying, but there was no way he could deny the two kings even if he did want this lazy day to himself with Mydei..

“.. Right,” Mydei grumbled out after a few seconds, sounding less than happy and Phainon couldn’t blame him at all as he grit his teeth a little before sighing deeply. Moving off of their swing to instead beam Mydei a reassuring smile - always doing his best to try to make that dragon happy if nothing else. 

“Up we go, Mydeimos..” Phainon purred out as he offered his beloved his hand, delighting in the way Mydei took it a bit gingerly, as if he was completely unsure if he should yet.. He was such a sweet creature, Phainon had certainly learned that much with how easily Mydei would submit to him so beautifully and enable him.

Phainon only gently pulled Mydei to his feet as he mumbled something about ignoring his plate of food - Phainon would simply send someone for that later. But the oddest thing was how Mydei didn’t pull away immediately, only allowing Phainon to push into him even more as he stood even.

.. It wasn’t hard to figure out why Mydei wasn’t shying from his touches, though, not when Mydei himself seemed to be more than just a tiny bit anxious over his own father. 

“.. My father will not be pleased at all,” Mydei began as he moved to follow after that man who had fetched them - making Phainon hum quietly in reply to his beloved’s mounting worries, “You understand that, correct?”

“About the eggs, or the marriage?” Phainon asked with a tease to his tone as he pressed his shoulder against Mydei’s own - fondly drinking in the way Mydei didn’t shove him away. He made an odd scoffing noise out of his annoyance, though that may have been towards Phainon’s rather astute line of questioning. 

“Yes.”

Phainon had to click his tongue over that - staring at the back of the man who seemed to be looking over his shoulder every few moments to make sure the princes were following him. Most likely due to the fact he would be slaughtered if he showed up without them.. 

“.. Of course,” Phainon hushedly admitted, his voice dropping a little as he found himself less and less willing to share his conversations with that random attendant/servant as they walked,  “I know, you’ve expressed this many times and I would be ashamed to not listen to my darling’s worries.”

“You should be more worried yourself, then,” Mydei replied so painfully smoothly and instantly that it made Phainon feel his own hand twitching at his side. 

.. Why would he ever be worried about himself when he was safe and sound in his own kingdom? This was a king who had worriedly traveled to check on his son who he clearly loved and adored, otherwise he never would have done something so.. Foolishly risky to travel here himself.

Phainon found himself humming over that, “.. Are you truly expecting it to be that bad?”

“Yes,” Mydei flatly replied and that.. That was enough to make Phainon a little aware of the way Mydei seemed to be closing up on himself again. Shorter replies, snapping and to the point of his words abruptly - it was enough to make Phainon frown a little over how sour Mydei’s mood had turned. 

“He’s your father, Mydei,” Phainon replied as if that wasn’t the most obvious thing in the world and probably only worked to help annoy Mydei - but he couldn’t help but to continue anyways as they leisurely left the garden,  “Won’t he accept this either way if it came from your heart?”

Their pace wasn’t a quick one, and it was rather blatant as to why; neither of them wanted to meet with Eurypon. Even if he is Mydei’s father, they both assuredly were feeling their nerves climbing up to a boiling point so swiftly. 

“.. I’m unsure of that,” Mydei quietly muttered, “There is an entire kingdom behind myself as well that must be accounted for.”

Phainon still didn’t quite comprehend that. For two kings to marry and mate and permanently end a war.. What was the issue? Sure, Mydei or himself would have to travel between the two kingdoms to see each other constantly - but Phainon found himself more than a little willing to travel to sleep with Mydei everyday..

.. Mainly because he found himself less and less willing to let Mydei out of his sight and his own hands for too long. 

“I know, but.. He is also your father, does he not want the best for you and your happiness?” Phainon asked, tilting his head a little as he looked at Mydei curiously - watching the way his precious mate was seemingly chewing onto his own lip in anxiety.

.. That sight was upsetting to Phainon in a way he couldn’t even fully put into words.

“I fear I myself am unsure of the answer and cannot give you one that would satisfy you,” Mydei spoke after a few moments, becoming even quieter as they walked into marble halls with intricately carved details, “I can only pray his mind is as easy to alter than Kephale’s.”

Phainon had to keep himself from clicking his tongue over that idea - more than a little aware he probably had more.. Pull on Kephale than an actual son and father would. Where Kephale folded rather easily when it came to Phainon’s wants, he wondered if Eurypon would do the same for his own son.

.. Or what ‘trials’ was he himself going to be put through? Regardless, his own mind was a little preoccupied as he looked to Mydei at his side once more. 

“.. I feel as though I need to ask if you’re well, again,” Phainon hummed out after a moment, dipping his eyes to look at the gold wrapped around Mydei’s tail that was still so sweetly jingling and telling everyone whose mate he was. All before flicking his eyes back upwards - meeting Mydei’s own annoyed looking gaze. 

“I am fine still, you fool,” Mydei growled out - but even that was enough to make Phainon laugh a little as he shook his head over it. 

“I am your mate, Mydeimos. I may be a fool, but I am your fool forever, and I am a fool who merely adores you..” Phainon reminded him in a teasing voice, unable to help the smile that was already making itself at home on his lips,  “Let me check on my mate, won’t you?”

“.. You’re an annoying fool as well,” Mydei hissed back, and Phainon couldn’t help the way his heart skipped a beat over that tone. A voice Mydei used when he was becoming flustered, as if those simple few words of Phainon declaring he was Mydei’s had made him embarrassed. 

.. Cute. 

“Pardon us for one moment,” Phainon requested as his feet stopped, taking note of the way everyone stopped along with him rather instantly to give him their full attention. 

“Y-Your highness?” That man shakily asked, but Phainon was already turning to focus on a Mydei who only had a raised brow towards him.

Phainon found himself at the end of his sanity as he pushed Mydei into the hallway wall without much of a second thought. Watching the way Mydei’s eyes widened sharply over being forced against the marble with a click of his tongue sounding but that was only amusing. Amusing, because while Mydei seemed shocked, he wasn’t exactly putting up much of a fight regardless. 

Not that it mattered anyways - not as Phainon immediately dipped his head downwards to press his own lips against Mydei’s gently. Too gently.

He was much too greedy for something soft, especially as his own hands found their way around Mydei’s waist as if they were the most natural place for them to be before he fully mashed their lips together. A new hunger to devour his precious mate as his tongue pressed against Mydei’s mouth - delighting in the delicious way his lips parted so easily to let him roam into there and the sight..

Phainon adored this, never finding it in himself to close his eyes to match the way Mydei fluttered his own eyes shut - clearly basking in their kiss. Yet Phainon always only wanted to watch him. To stare at the way Mydei seemed to melt against him and become so willing in his antics. His eyelashes barely moved as he kissed Phainon right back without hesitation, seeming just as eager for attention from his mate as Phainon was.

And that.. That was enough to drive Phainon to shoving his tongue deeper into Mydei’s lips - drinking in the way Mydei made an odd noise all while his hands found purchase on Phainon’s arms to keep himself upright as Phainon’s tongue slithered into his throat. Mydei’s reactions were much too cute to Phainon’s ears as he watched Mydei’s brows scrunch together as Phainon’s tongue choked him. 

Still trying to swallow and kiss Phainon back, all while Phainon felt relieved to just be devouring Mydei again - to be able to watch his mate squirm a little with drool escaping his mouth over having Phainon’s tongue moving down his throat and rubbing into places it shouldn’t. Phainon’s mind could only ever feel delighted as Mydei only seemed to whine a little over it. 

Twitching in Phainon’s grip that didn’t want to cease at all, only finding himself more desperate to listen to the way Mydei was struggling over it - enjoying himself, yet still obviously more focused on the conversation awaiting them.

.. It was enough to make Phainon sigh as Mydei’s tongue pressed against his own with fingers clawing into Phainon a little - at his limit, probably. And that was the only reason why Phainon pulled his tongue free from Mydei’s throat, kissing him again to feel his lips on Mydei’s soft sweetened ones before fully parting from him. 

“Sorry, I needed to destress,” Phainon mused as he pulled away from Mydei - slowly licking his tongue over his own bottom lip as he watched the way Mydei was breathing heavily. His hands slowly left Mydei’s waist as he merely found himself in a daze over how cute Mydei looked when he was flushed from just a little kissing..

“.. Destressing does not normally mean shoving your tongue down someone’s throat,” Mydei pointed out with such a hissed out tone - most likely due to the fact Phainon was more than a little aware that Mydei liked feeling like that.

To have his breath cut off and robbed from him, and seemingly to have things in his mouth.. It was cute.. Phainon couldn’t help but to admire how sweetly he had reacted and still had a hue of red dust on his cheeks so honestly. 

“No, it doesn’t,” Phainon purred as he quickly took a hold of Mydei’s hand in his own - knitting them together into such a tight hand hold as he turned back to that attendant who looked more than a little nervous over them making out now, “But now that I have a mate I think it does!”

“.. My father is going to kill us,” Mydei grumbled out, but Phainon only focused on the way Mydei’s own hand squeezed his so gently - reassuringly almost as they returned to their walk back to wherever their fathers were waiting for them.

And that thought was enough to make a sinking pit of dread in his stomach as they walked - a thing he could only try his best to ignore in favor of smiling happily to his mate at his side while wrapping his tail possessively around Mydei’s own tail.

“You’re making me stressed again, Mydei..”

chapters.title: Chapter 19
chapters.html:
“Mydeimos Kremnos,” Mydei didn’t need his name said, considering the way he was already hanging his head down a bit dejectedly, but he knew his father didn’t care regardless,“This is not why you were sent here by any capacity.”

“.. I agree,” Mydei mumbled in reply as he stared at his father in his eyes - always willing to give the man the respect he deserved, even if it was making him feel rather.. Worst for wear.

The only thing that was giving him a little bit of mercy was oddly the way Phainon was pressed up against him. His body heat worked to make Mydei sweat a little bit more under his father’s gaze, but it also was comforting to him when he felt Phainon’s tail curling around his side into him. A sweet little reminder that Phainon was.. Very unlikely to abandon him in this situation, even if his father himself chose to. 

“And yet, they have informed me you are to be wedded to their.. Crown Prince?”

Mydei didn’t quite understand why his father seemed confused by that, especially given the way Phainon was actively sitting so close to Mydei that Mydei was fearing he may actually just give up and crawl into Mydei’s lap. 

“.. Yes,” Mydei replied half-heartedly regardless of how obvious the answer seemed to himself. Feeling his hand twitching at his side a little - almost distantly hoping that Phainon would pick it up again and thread their hands together as he did earlier. It was for the best that they were not pushing his father with shows of affection like that, though, Mydei knew that. 

Phainon certainly knew that as well, that was most likely why he was settling for just being obsessively close to Mydei instead. 

“That is not possible,” Eurypon sighed out as he only kept his eyes on Mydei - not even acting as if King Kephale or Phainon were still in the room with them, “My son is expected to have offspring to continue the family line, if he marries a fellow person of dragon-blood; it would be forbidden.”

.. Mydei had to bite his tongue over that, feeling his body twitch over the fact he was.. Certainly continuing their bloodline with how many eggs Phainon had pushed into him and continuously rolled around within him. It was hard to do anything but think of them fondly when he pushed on his stomach at night to feel those little lumps buried away in him. 

“Forbidden?” Phainon instead spoke in the silent lieu of Mydei, as if he knew fully well Mydei was thinking of the eggs in response to his father’s words.

“To mix draconic blood is taboo, surely you Elysians know that?” Eurypon growled out, seeming less and less happy - especially as Phainon broke into the conversation.

“Some traditions make little to no sense to me, sorry,” Phainon mused, and Mydei knew that would only work to anger his father more - but he couldn’t quite blame Phainon for it either. Not when their traditions were so vastly different where Phainon would eat people as a group bonding activity.. And his father refused to have mixed bloodlines..

“To mix draconic blood would easily make your children much more draconic than other normal clutches,” Eurypon only hissed out, making Mydei vaguely aware of the way his father’s brown eyes were now glaring so painfully sharply at Phainon, “Nikador and Oronyx blood have never been mixed for that reason, nor others.”

‘Never’ was sounding like a rather strong word to Mydei as he sat there being the very cause of that word losing its meaning soon.

“And who would oppose it?” Phainon asked, sounding as if his voice was a bit clipped and harsh - enough to make Mydei look to his side at his mate for once. 

Weirdly, Phainon ignored Mydei for the first time, his eyes only staring right back to Eurypon - appearing as if he was more than a little distracted by this topic and Mydei.. Mydei could only turn his head to look back to his father as well, blinking over the way Eurypon looked just as annoyed as Phainon did.

“.. Pardon me?”

Phainon cocked his head to the side over the lack of decent reply from King Eurypon, “Realistically if their bloodlines mixed, what kingdom would have the gall to fight both kingdoms?”

.. Mydei couldn’t think of many kingdoms willing to continue their decades long war with Castrum Kremnos when it finally had all been ended. But the idea of Aedes Elysiae also siding with Kremnos made it.. Sound worse for other kingdoms. Kremnos had kept up the war without an ally for years, and to have an alliance with a kingdom due to their kings being mates.

“Aedes Elysiae would be willing to go to war for their children?” Eurypon huffed out in a voice ripe with disbelief, so very much that Mydei couldn’t help but to knit and furrow his brows together over those words.

Why was that odd? Were wars not usually fought to either defend their kingdoms or to try to better the lives of the younger generations?

Though, Phainon only laughed a little at the side of Mydei, “What an insulting question to even ask. What king would not fight for the sake of their child? Would you not have taken Mydeimos away and begun another war if he was unhappy here and being forced into this?”

Mydei didn’t quite know how to feel about this, he had to admit. He was very thankful for Phainon speaking for him and being angry on his own behalf considering this too involved Phainon. But he felt as if he needed to speak more, to say his own mind and what all he wanted.

Not to just.. Allow Phainon to fight his battles for him unfairly.

“This war has not ended yet, nor will it if these hypot-”

“I am expecting, father,” Mydei interrupted without missing a single second.

Effortlessly shutting his own father up and bringing a deathly silence to the room of men - not a single word was shared between them all. Not even as Eurypon’s eyes dipped to his son across the fancy little tea table, blinking at the two crown princes sitting on the couch together as his mouth opened.

And closed.

Not a word left his mouth - but that was fine as Phainon only seemed to move closer to Mydei. Practically sitting halfway onto Mydei while his tail curled against Mydei’s stomach. A clear showing of possessiveness that Mydei didn’t mind making his father suffer through seeing at all. Instead only watching the way his father’s jaw was flexing with his stress and anger, twitching as if he was struggling to figure out how to address that elephant in the room now. 

“.. Expecting? Expecting what?”

So that was his father’s answer, then? To act foolish and be unsure of the statement Mydei was saying and refuse to accept the clear facts in front of him?

“Six,” Mydei clarified as he held his father’s gaze - not at all caring for the way he could see the way his father’s eye seemed to twitch over that word. 

“.. Six?” Eurypon echoed out, and Mydei could only feel a little bit of pity.

Six was pretty disbelievable, yet, considering the fact he now knew fully just how.. Draconic Phainon actually was, it wasn’t that odd to him that he had a clutch of so many eggs unlike other dragon blooded people.
