“.. Six eggs are inside of me,” Mydei once again clarified with a slow shake of his head, fully aware of the way it seemed so very unlikely.

Yet his father only continued to refuse the obvious answer being placed before him, “For.. You to lay?”

.. Mydei was pretty sure his own body had lost the ability to produce his own eggs once his womb had been opened up by Phainon, let alone the ability to produce six at one time. It was common for dragons to make eggs and have to lay them and let them die while aging, that was what their ruts were for.

He.. No longer had ruts, not when he had been bred. 

But it wasn’t as if he was going to tell his own father all of that, not when Eurypon knew that fully as well. 

“Incubating,” Mydei sighed the word out, shaking his head a little as he watched his father’s face become stricken with grief or shock - a mix of emotions that Mydei found more than a little amusing considering he himself would have felt this way a mere few weeks ago..

“You are.. Implying that dragon-blooded man beside you.. Has impregnated you?” Eurypon slowly riddled out - and that was enough to make Mydei slowly close his eyes in defeat. 

This was such an awful topic and way to tell his parents he was pregnant, and yet he had done this to himself and was.. Now paying for it, he supposed as he opened his eyes again. Taking a deep moment to reflect before nodding curtly. 

“.. Yes.”

“My disappointment in you is.. Immeasurable, Mydeimos,” Eurypon slowly sputtered out, sounding less and less thrilled as he moved one of his own golden clawed fingers up to his face to rub at the bridge of his nose. For once showing off his own golden scales all while sighing so dramatically loudly. 

“I expected as much, but I will be keeping them,” Mydei flatly told his father - watching the way his father’s hand immediately dropped from his face to show his full expression of horror over that statement, “I’m quite fond of them, and I’ve little issues with being a clutchmother.”

Or a carrier, really, either way.. Mydei felt as though he may be succumbing to Phainon’s silly delusions because he too was struggling to see an issue with it all. It went against old traditions, but what logic was there to allow the deceased to still control their current lives when all they were concerned with was the power imbalance of the kingdoms?

Neither he nor Phainon were doing this to empower their own kingdom, and he highly doubted Castorice, who seemed quite fond of Phainon, would be upset enough to break their kingdom’s friendship. Especially considering the way Castorice and Hyacine had been gossiping about the two crown princes through letters..

“Even if I do agree six is.. Too many, I have little desire to let any of them suffer,” Mydei continued onwards in the silence of his father, “They’re precious to me.”

“Phainon Elysiae, is precious to me,” Mydei added on a bit quickly, adding a bit of emphasis to that as he felt Phainon only pressing against him more. Coming off as clingy and needy, but Mydei could admit he preferred Phainon to be that way towards him, anyway. 

“Love does not solve all political issues at hand, however, Mydeimos,” Eurypon grumbled out, shaking his head as he clearly was thinking of the fallout that would befall Kremnos due to this, “This is not merely a fairy tale where you may be with whomever you cho-”

“It will have to be,” Mydei interrupted, only slowly blinking at his father whose jaw went slack over that - and then tightened. A clear showing of his own mounting annoyance towards his son as his own golden tail slapped against the chair he was sitting in across the two crown princes.

An oddity to get that type of reaction from his father, but it was not as if Mydei hadn’t been expecting it either.. 

“Pardon me?”

“Pardoned. It will have to be a fairy tale because I have no desire to get rid of my eggs, as I already stated,” Mydei explained as he leaned into the couch a little - doing his best to relax and only feeling himself a bit soothed over the way Phainon adapted to the new position without a single complaint, “You may disown me from Kremnos and cause chaos in our own kingdom, or we may merely see what people truly do with my pregnancy.”

Those words were enough to make a new silence in the room, heavy and daunting as well as deafening in a way Mydei couldn’t even fathom. Slowly putting his hands over his chest and more aptly, resting over where his children were - eyes only staring at the way his father was rubbing his face and temples again. As if he was doing every single self-soothing method possible in the book before he sighed so painfully loudly.

“.. You have put myself and your mother into quite a situation here, Mydeimos.”

That was enough to make Mydei feel himself stiffen - perhaps a bit too much as Phainon now seemed to nuzzle into his head with his own over it. A blatant attempt to now try to soothe his worried mate, but Mydei..

.. Mydei just wanted to see her. 

“Where is she?” Mydei found himself asking, narrowing his eyes a little at the king who was now hunched over a little, acting as if he was truly so distraught about this.

But Mydei knew fully why that was, his mind was only able to assume his father was dreading the fact he would have to be the bearer of bad news to his council.

“She was too distraught, she did not wish to come,” Eurypon smoothly replied with a slow shake of his head - but Mydei had played this game too many times before with him. So many times he had seen him lie in meetings and do his best to avoid being truthful - his eyes always dipped down when he lied.

His eyes always avoided the other person, and they never blinked. His hands would wring together as he seemed a little bit upset fakely, whatever mood they were expecting a liar to put on display, and that.. That was why Mydei only had to sigh at his own father. 

“.. You have always been a terrible liar, father. Was she not informed?” Mydei asked, not at all willing to play this idiotic game with a man he knew he would win versus. He was lying, about what part of it? Mydei wasn’t sure, but what he was sure of was the way Phainon’s tail was wrapping around his wrist possessively. Curling around him as if he was desperate for Mydei’s attention, or to just calm him down with his own presence weighing against Mydei.

Whatever it was, Mydei clicked his tongue over it silently behind his lips. 

“Your mother worries too much, and this.. This would have been much too much for her,” Eurypon argued with a heavy sigh leaving him - seeming as if he had already given up on dancing around the truth or lying about how he hadn’t told her yet.

Of course his mother would have been eager to read any letters sent from Aedes Elysiae about her son; there was no doubt in Mydei’s mind that his father was the one pulling the chords, not her. 

“You did not tell her in order to have a conversation with me and talk me out of it first, yes?” Mydei growled out, though he knew it was coming out even rougher than he wanted due to his own stress on the matter - narrowing his eyes to his own father as he watched the way Eurypon’s own eyes danced away from him. First to Phainon, then to King Kephale, as if he was taking a moment to finally take in the sight that they were being studied and watched.

That the royalties of Aedes Elysiae were sitting here listening in on their family drama. 

“.. May I speak with my son alone?” Eurypon sighed out - but Mydei only found himself moving to cross his arms over his chest.

‘Family drama’ was a humorous thing to him currently considering the way Phainon was for certain going to become family. He had every right to be there, and well.. Mydei supposed he didn’t care if Kephale was there one way or another. 

“No,” Mydei hissed before either of the two Elysians could opt to answer for themselves, “I refuse to speak to you alone. Speak your mind in front of your soon-to-be-in-laws, father.”

Phainon at his side moved a little at that - shifting his weight as if those words were making him uncomfortable, but Mydei found that less than likely. It was most likely the fact he couldn’t defend and coddle Mydei right now, the fact that he knew his mate was upset and angry and all he could do was sit at his side and seethe over it. 

Whatever the case, Eurypon only slowly shook his head - golden locks falling around his face and framing it a little before he huffed out a laugh, “King Kephale, your son has begun to teach my own son new things, it seems..”

.. Mydei didn’t even know what to make out of that type of response; it was so painfully obvious that he just did not want to speak to Mydei about his mother in front of the both of the Elysians that it was pitiable in Mydei’s mind.

And irksome, really. 

“Love makes young people quite rowdy,” Kephale replied in a cold voice, not seeming as if he was overly sensitive or eager to argue with Eurypon on that matter. Most likely due to the fact he hadn’t exactly been able to stop Phainon or Mydei either way; and had just given in and let them continue their lovey-dovey antics in public. 

“.. Is that you trying to excuse what your son has done? This is not simply some foolish game that two young princes are playing together, they are speaking of.. Unfathomable acts,” Eurypon snapped out, sounding less and less happy with every word he spoke but Mydei could only find more and more pity in his heart.

Not towards his own father, but towards his mother who clearly had not been fully informed on everything today. And to whatever their love had crumbled into to where the idea of Phainon actually liking Mydei seemed outlandish; but perhaps he was too harsh in that thought. His mother loved Eurypon, and Mydei.. Merely had to hope that Eurypon loved Gorgo just as much, for his own sanity if nothing else. 

“Acts of which I played no role in, and your own son you raised appears to be rather happy with the outcome,” Kephale pointed out rather flippantly, not sounding amused at all still - if anything, he seemed to be growing more and more annoyed and Mydei couldn’t fault him for that. “How am I to punish a crown prince of another kingdom?”

“How have you punished your own? How will Phainon repent for his crimes of-”

“Not all kingdoms follow your old archaic rules. For a kingdom who has been at war for so many years, I am baffled to learn you care so deeply about the imbalances of kingdoms with draconic blood,” Kephale only continued on with his words as Phainon was brought up - making Mydei look to his left at that rather obvious perturbed dragon that was smacking his own tail against the chair.

An act that made Mydei stare at Phainon a little as well - it was ironic. For once, all of the tail thumping in his ears was not Phainon’s oversized dog tail, and was now just.. Their fathers angry at each other. 

Phainon did give a sheepish laugh at that, not sounding as if he was truly happy or anything - but a clear attempt at derailing or de-escalating the rising issue, “I believe that we should try to keep this civil, Mydei and I are no-”

Though, Phainon’s words were cut off with a rather loud slamming noise - one that made Mydei jerk his head to look at whoever was breaking down the door so suddenly. Only a fool would actually be interrupting a conversation of two royal families when the topic was so secretive and grave.

Well, moderately secretive, it wasn’t as if Phainon had not been telling everyone in his kingdom about their wedding already.. The pregnancy, however, was certainly secretive.. Kind of. 

Not that it mattered, instead Mydei found himself moving to his feet without wasting a single moment - rising and quickly moving to the woman who was not seething in the doorway rather blatantly. A person that Mydei found himself drawn towards no matter what - a little thankful for the way he could tell Phainon had followed him rather instantly without a word being needed to be spared to him.

.. Him displaying his protectiveness would look good with Mydei’s mother, of course. 

“Mother?” Mydei asked quietly as his own feet stopped - tilting his head a little to the side as he now came to terms that her rather.. Furious looking gaze was not on him. Nor was it on Phainon behind him, but a third option. 

“My son is getting wedded and you left to speak with him without me?” She asked with a rage barely concealed in her own words, moving to close that door a bit quietly behind her politely. 

Mydei could only assume she had slammed it open for dramatic effect and perhaps to tell Eurypon that he had made an error in his ways. 

It didn’t take but a mere moment for Eurypon to round the couch Mydei and Phainon had once been sitting on as well - joining them both to the side of Phainon a few steps away, “Gor-”

“How are you, Mydeimos?” Gorgo instead interrupted, moving quickly to Mydei in favor of her husband - taking a moment to give him a quick once over from his feet to head. Eyes dipping up and down repeatedly to make him sweat just a little over how deeply he knew his mom was inspecting him. 

“.. I am well,” Mydei forced himself to manage out, moving to shift his weight between his feet over how.. Closely she truly was staring at him -  as if she was doing her best to note every difference in his body physically from the last time she had seen him.

“Did you gain weight? I’m glad they’re feeding you well,” Gorgo nodded to him with such a polite and warm smile that it only made Mydei.. Sad to think of how long it had been without those comforting smiles from his mother. 

.. Even if her question was making him feel the way his hands were sweating, a swallow heavy in his throat. 

“That’s.. A little, yes,” Mydei croaked out - barely unable to keep his voice stable as he watched one of her eyebrows raise over that reaction. Blatantly not believing him at all. 

He was thankful for Phainon for that reason as Phainon moved closer to him with a laugh, “Forgive me, I just love feeding your son sweets! Why don’t you take a seat, Qu-”

“You,” She immediately cut into Phainon’s words - making Phainon snap his mouth shut over that,  “You are the one marrying him, correct?”

Phainon didn’t even waste a moment before nodding at that like a happy little dog would, “Yes, I have fallen head over heels for Mydeimos!”

“I will be sitting beside Mydeimos,” She spoke easily, moving past the both of them to where Mydei couldn’t help but turn to watch her go - feeling a bit miffed over the way Phainon only copied him as well as they slowly moved to watch her walk. 

“Ah, but.. I..” Phainon trailed off - and Mydei couldn’t even help him as he found himself just wordlessly following after her. At least she was merciful enough to take the right side of the couch and let Mydei still sit in the middle, most likely due to the fact she had noted where they were when she had slammed the door open. But..

Mydei couldn’t help but swallow as he took his seat beside her, huffing over the way Phainon didn’t seem keen on being left out either. Instead moving to sit on Mydei’s side just like he had been.. Even if it meant they were all much too close to each other on the couch - not that Phainon seemed to mind as he always seemed keen on encroaching on Mydei’s personal space but well..

.. Mydei liked his personal space, the main issue was the fact that Phainon also liked Mydei’s personal space. 

“You may now begin to explain what is going on, King Eurypon. It is lovely to see you as always, King Kephale,” Gorgo spoke - and that was more than enough reason for Mydei to slowly lean towards Phainon. 

He didn’t find himself shocked at all that Phainon moved a little to lean back, making more room for Mydei to lean into him even more as an arm snaked around his hip greedily. 

“.. She’s calling my father that,” Mydei mumbled as quietly as he could - feeling his own nerves rising even though he was.. A little comforted by her being here. This.. The mood of the room still spelled out a layer of doom that had him dreaded all of his choices. 

Phainon hummed in reply, already seeming like he himself was more than a little happy that Mydei was pressing against him, “Is that bad?”

“She’s angry,” Mydei supplied as he moved to sit up again. Though, he didn’t even bother trying to bat that hand away on his hip - if anything, the reassurance Phainon was still beside him and as needy as ever was almost soothing. 

Eurypon only made a rather tired sighing noise however in the absence of Kephale replying to Gorgo - seeming as if Kephale was more than a little aware that he shouldn’t really be touching this family matter. Even if it was to politely say hello to Gorgo.. Mydei couldn’t blame him there - not when he felt himself stiffening over how harsh his mother’s glare was towards his father.

“.. There has already been a council meeting to discuss our next route with you, Mydeimos. Your wedding i-”

Gorgo immediately laughed over that, shaking her head before she waved a hand dismissively and flitted her eyes towards Mydei, “It should be added and noted that your father was not against your marriage until his council began to become upset over you not being wedded to a princess in a different kingdom.”

Mydei could only offer her a simper smile - doing his best to hide his own struggling mind with these topics and how he really.. Had never considered any of them to be an option. Not when all of their kingdoms had been at war his entire life.

“Foolish, really, all the current princesses are also draconic blooded, yet they all wanted to make a scene over mixing dragon bloods together..”

That was enough to make the entire room linger in that silence as Gorgo only moved her leering gaze back to Eurypon. Waiting for his next move - but Mydei could feel his stomach twisting over the way he was merely looking at him instead. He was not a man afraid of combating his father, but.. 

His mother.. 

“Your son is pregnant,” Eurypon huffed as if on cue, words that made Mydei click his tongue behind his lips as his mother’s posture changed so immediately. That regal and prim looking pose now seemed just as stiff as Mydei’s - as if she was beyond stunned at that as her head snapped to the side to stare at Mydei. 

“Mydeimos?” Was the simple word she managed after a moment, only serving to make Mydei feel like he already was being scolded as his eyes moved away from his father - leisurely sliding to meet her own. 

“.. Yes,” Mydei replied after a moment of a rather awkward stare shared between the two of them in the harsh and deafening silence of the others watching the duo. 

Though, his mother only had two ghostly words for him; “You’re pregnant?”

This.. Was not exactly the type of situation or scenario where he would have liked to inform his mother of such a thing, but he didn’t find it to be uncommon to have things taken from him by his father. Not by this point in his life, at least.

“.. Yes, it’s why.. I’ve gained weight, yes,” Mydei muttered a little bit hushedly - unable to help the way he had felt a bit guilty over blaming it on Phainon’s antics.

Only for her to hum over that, “So they were not spoiling you with sweets and desserts?”

“Ah..” Mydei began, but he really had.. No idea how to combat that or what kind of reply she was even hoping for? If anything, his entire mind had drawn a blank immediately over that question and he did remember the times Phainon had given him sweets, but it.. Wasn’t nearly enough for him to put on as much weight as he had.

Even if he himself knew you couldn’t really see his gain, it made him feel somehow embarrassed as he watched his mother’s eyes only flicker down to his stomach once again. 

Phainon’s hand on his hip only tightened a little at that, however, “I’ve been doing that too!”

“Using the world ‘too’ there implies you did that alongside breeding my son, please watch your words,” Gorgo snapped immediately before her eyes returned to the front without a moment’s delay - but that only worked to make Mydei feel a pang of pain in his head.

The beginnings of a headache, certainly..

“.. Can you not call it breeding, mother..” Mydei found himself sighing out as his mind processed his own mother saying that to him - a haunting thing, for sure, and nothing he had ever thought he would be hearing from her.

Not at all helped by the small ‘oh’ he heard peeped from Phainon at his side either. 

“I can fully imagine how this conversation with your father has been going now,” Gorgo smoothly said, making Mydei wilt just a tad bit more, “I imagine you are less than pleased, Eurypon?”

Eurypon made an odd and rather abrasive snorting noise over that - an action that made Mydei effortlessly narrow his eyes to how annoyed his father seemed, “How would I ever be happy to hear my son is pregnant with another dragon’s children? There’s six eggs, and th-”

“Six? Goodness me, Mydeimos.. How big are they? Your stomach isn’t nearly swollen enough for six eggs, are they feeding you well?” Gorgo only cut in so swiftly to make Mydei slowly look at her - feeling himself sweating over the way her head tilted to cause golden locks of hair to spill around her face. 

That.. Well, maybe he should have predicted his mother would be worried about these types of things - but he couldn’t help himself but to smile fondly over it. 

“I am fine, mother, his eggs were rather small,” Mydei nodded a little, doing his best to reassure her that he was perfectly healthy. 

“I think my eggs are a perfectly fine size,” Phainon murmured to his side - quiet, yet assuredly loud enough to be heard by Gorgo as her brows only raised to Mydei. 

An expression that only made Mydei’s face feel as though it was burning just a tad, “Be quiet.”

“Yes, beloved,” Phainon replied without missing a beat, yet sounding like he was a dog being scolded with an odd whine falling from his lips at the same time. It would have been endearing if not for the way Mydei could see the scowl that was only growing on his father’s face when he looked at him. 

“A duel,” His father growled out, two words that made Mydei stiffen up a little - unable to help himself even as he felt Phainon’s thumb tap at his hip. As if it were a nervous habit, and yet.. 

“A duel?” Phainon echoed out, sounding as if he had no idea why this was the idea Eurypon had conjured up but it.. Made the most sense when Mydei thought  about their own customs. 

“Phainon of Aedes Elysiae, if you so deeply desire my son’s hand in marriage, you must be like the others before you and earn it,” Eurypon growled out every single word - not sounding happy at the slightest as his eyes never left Phainon, “A duel.”

That was enough to make Mydei gnaw at his own tongue, there was nothing he could say to convey what a bad idea this was to Phainon. Let alone the fact he could feel his own worry for the dragon pressing himself against Mydei rising - not to say he had doubts about Phainon’s battle prowess but..

.. Phainon is his mate, one way or another, even if his father dislikes it he.. He was still bonded to Phainon, to have the chance to already lose Phainon was making his stomach flip in such a twisting fashion that it felt like it could choke him so easily. 

“.. I accept,” Phainon hummed at his side regardless of Mydei’s own emotions that he wasn’t privy to, making Mydei jerk his head to look at that white-haired man who was still focused on Eurypon. 

“Phainon, it’s no-”

“Very well, tomorrow you both will return to Castrum Kremnos, where you will fight all of Mydeimos’s suitors for his hand in marriage,” Eurypon only interrupted, not seeming as though he particularly cared to allow Mydei to finish his words but that.

.. Mydei could only choke a little over that; “All of them..?”

“This sounds as if you are setting him up, Eurypon,” Gorgo hissed out, and Mydei was more than a little thankful that she was the one to point out how evil this was. Even if it was on short notice, the amount of people that would show up and demand to become one of the suitors for a chance at marrying Mydei was too vast.

Too great; too many warriors would come out of hiding, all greedy to lay a claim on Castrum Kremnos as the drop of a hat..

Eurypon only chuckled a little at that, “And so what if I am? Will the crown prince of Aedes Elysiae give up on the man he claimed to love? Is their bond that fickle that h-”

“I already agreed to it, is that not enough to cease your belittling?” Phainon asked, not sounding particularly amused at all with those words or willing to continue to hear out whatever words Eurypon chose to offer to him. 

That was enough to make Eurypon’s brows raise to his hairline - all before he barked out a laugh, shaking his head before standing with a coy and rather smug smile on his face. 

“I will see the both of you tomorrow, then,” Eurypon nodded, all before bowing before King Kephale who appeared.. Less than pleased as well over the situation - seeming as if he was scowling and fretting over the idea of Phainon leaving to fight in some type of competition. 

“.. Goodbye, father,” Mydei mumbled hushedly - still doing his best to show that man respect even when he felt none towards him currently. Moving to shake his head all while Gorgo copied, standing up as sighing a little.

“Mydeimos,” She began, making him flit his eyes up to her before rising to be at the same level as her,  “You are well, correct? He did not lie about feeding you good food, did he?”

Mydei found himself huffing a little laugh over that, especially as Phainon only copied them both as well - standing and taking his place at Mydei’s side without uttering a word. 

“I’m fine, mother. He did not lie, he has been rather pampering towards me,” Mydei tried to reassure her, all before shaking his head and offering a deep sigh over his own thoughts on that white dragon, “Almost too much.”

Gorgo let out a rather hefty sigh over that, “Good good.. After all, there are some rumors about this kingdom..”

“Rumors?” Mydei asked, feeling as though the blood could easily drain out of his face when he considered what on earth she could be meaning.

Though, his mother only laughed a little - eyes twinkling as she seemed to be joking with him now, “That their crown prince eats fellow dragons!” 

“I’ve kissed Mydeimos plenty, if that’s what you mean!” Phainon chirped without missing a second, all while Mydei could feel his hands on his arm - possessively holding onto him as if Phainon was now so suddenly worried his mother may be trying to steal him from him.

“No, I’m well, mother. Those rumors seem baseless,” Mydei replied over that, opting to ignore the way he could almost sense the fear running rampant in Phainon - doing his best to keep both of them under control as he shook his head and gave her a weak smile. 

A smile that she quite blatantly studied him over - staring at him before nodding, waving her hand a little before she seemed to change her mind over questioning him any further on that topic. 

“I will see you tomorrow, dearest.. Stay well, do not tell your father but,” Gorgo lowered her voice a little before continuing onwards, “I’m quite excited to see how beautiful your children are, even if it’s considered forbidden. Strong and powerful like my Mydeimos.. I am simply happy that you are happy.”

Embarrassing and sappy.. And somehow they were words that made Mydei only smile fondly at her, “Thank you, mother..”

Gorgo moved silently at that - reaching up a little to press a kiss against Mydei’s forehead (he will never admit to leaning down a tiny bit to aid her either), all before she moved to the side of him. Clearly using that as a goodbye, all before she didn’t waste a moment approaching Phainon himself.

All to roughly yank on his shirt - pulling the much larger dragonic man down to her level and Mydei had expected her to growl or whisper something to him. Only.. She placed a kiss to the top of his head a bit gently, an action that made Phainon seem more than a little perplexed as he was released from her again. 

“.. She kissed my hair?” Phainon questioned as he turned to watch Gorgo leave, only making Mydei huff a little over that. 

“She likes you,” He mused quietly, though he was watching the way Phainon was patting at his own head a bit worriedly - not seeming to understand the fact he had been doted on like that. 

“What a wonderful mother you have,” King Kephale finally spoke again, making Mydei’s eyes slide away from Phainon to focus on him instead. Blinking at the way Kephale barely seemed phased that the royal Kremnoan family had barely said their farewells to him.

.. Though he wasn’t a fool, he could more than likely feel the tensions straining between the three of them. 

“I agree,” Mydei found himself saying - unsure of how else he was expected to react to that type of compliment towards his mother. Yet, it didn’t matter.

Not as King Kephale only continued to speak, still lazily sitting in his chair - though, he now had his head propped up on his hand. Appearing more and more like he was deep in his own thoughts; “Phainon, you should prepare yourself for whatever trials King Eurypon plans to place before you.”

“.. I do not believe he would be too cruel,” Mydei spoke before Phainon did, unable to help himself but to try to imagine exactly how his father would be going about things, “This was done to make a showing of Phainon and prove he can be my suitor and wed me, to make him go through difficult trials..”

.. Though, Mydei didn’t think he was convincing anyone; let alone himself as he sighed a little - glancing at the way Phainon seemed a bit.. More focused on something for once. Not nearly his bubbly and grinning self, looking as if he was actually deeply considering what he had signed himself up for. 

“He may, I take back my words,” Mydei mumbled, unable to stop the way he turned away from the sight of Phainon looking worryingly distracted, “Depending on what he tells the council of my pregnancy or not, adds a layer to it all.”

That seemed to be a foolish decision, instead hearing a little laugh leave Phainon all while something much too heavy immediately found its way against his back. Wandering hands slowly gripping onto Mydei’s chest all while that dragon only remained leaning over Mydei. 

“I do not fear it, the only person I have ever enjoyed fighting is Mydeimos, anyway!”

chapters.title: Chapter 20
chapters.html:
“A duel against Mydeimos’s suitors.. I still do not enjoy the way that’s plural, Phainon,” Kephale mumbled, all while Phainon was still adjusting his own gloves - slowly moving to glance over them again and again. 

They felt almost foreign to him with how little use they had been seeing of late, when they were once used so often to help lead into battle and fight on his own.. That war had stopped for now, and thus his usage of his gloves with his sword were not overly used. A good thing, sure, but it didn’t mean he didn’t miss them sometimes. 

.. He would really love to spar with Mydei more, once he wasn’t overly worried about putting any stress needlessly on Mydei’s body. 

“I do not fear it, I’ll do what I must for Mydei to be happy. And this earns his parent’s approval for our wedding, I’ll happily fight,” Phainon murmured as he only continued to work at his straps for his gloves - idly tightening them and untightening them again and again. 

An act his father most likely knew was out of sheer anxiety, even if he was fully confident in himself and his abilities, it didn’t mean he wasn’t still.. Worried. Phainon simply wanted to be and or become the best version of himself for Mydei, was that such a bad thing? He didn’t think so!

“It is not merely a duel, you heard what they claimed, you all are.. Fighting to the death,” Kephale sighed from behind Phainon, making him only scoff a little. 

“I won’t lose, so it does not matter,” Phainon pointed out, after all, he doubted any of them were really prepared for fighting a dragon.. 

“You are a giant target,” Kephale reasoned as if he could hear Phainon’s thoughts even as he conjured them up. Words that only served to make Phainon swish his tail a little as his eyes moved to look at his sword laying in wait. 

Phainon could only laugh over that though, “Then they would do well to land a blow on me, wouldn’t they?”

Kephale only made an odd noise at that - sounding as if he was doing his best to chuckle a little and failing with his high-strung mood, “And where is Mydeimos?”

“He is sitting up in the colosseum’s throne area to watch with his parents,” Phainon replied as he turned a little on his heels - blinking at Kephale as he considered the idea of Mydei being closer to watch the fight,  “I prefer that, he’s much too precious to be getting dirty.. Do not tell him I said that, he would attempt to thrash me.”

“And your children, Phainon,” Kephale added with a heavy sigh, but Phainon could only blink over those words - looking at the way Kephale seemed rather worried with his own words but that.. 

“Oh, no,” Phainon chuckled out a little, feeling a smile beaming on his own lips as he thought of how his bones had ached every time he blocked against Mydei’s rather angry gauntlets slamming against his sword,  “I’m not worried about Mydei’s ability to defend himself, just that he would need to bathe after and I would like to be there if he’s bathing.”

“.. I do not believe I like hearing that as your father,” Kephale sighed out in such an exasperated tone that Phainon couldn’t help but to keep his eyes away from that man - moving a little with a huff. 

“Do try to stay safe, will you?” Kephale added on over Phainon’s silence, and Phainon found his eyes quickly roaming right back to his father. Watching so keenly the way he was moving just a bit close to Phainon with their words being shared together..

“Hah.. I already asked Mydei for permission to be vicious and he muttered something about the ‘more vicious the better in front of my fellow Kremnoans’,” Phainon explained before moving to hand dismissively, “So I assume I’m allowed to claw people to declare my love for Mydeimos.”

“.. Claw them?” Kephale echoed out in a stunned way.

“Tearing out their organs and making a show of it all,” Phainon added on as if that made the most sense in the world to him, “Surely he will love the sight of me ripping their throats out.”

“Phainon,” Kephale spoke in a tired tone, making Phainon fully turn on his heels to look at him confusedly, “You are still a crown prince, do no-”

“I’m far from home, father,” Phainon reminded him with a little hum leaving his lips, “I’ll be marrying that prince who will become king once I marry, and his people value strength and ferocity.”

Kephale didn’t reply to that - instead he only seemed to inaudibly sigh as he allowed his shoulders to slump a little. Such a heavy expression of worry, but Phainon couldn’t relate to it at all.

If anything.. Phainon was excited.

The idea of getting to bloody his own hands and putting on a show for Mydei was thrilling - to know those golden eyes were going to be on him before anyone else. To have the ability to fully know that Mydei’s attention was already on him.. He only wanted to make sure Mydei had fun watching him, and for that.. Phainon found himself itching to be.. Barbaric. 

“I yearn to make his parents realize I’m his perfect fit, and if they want me to become bloodied and show my worth,” Phainon explained with a smile on his lips - already feeling a bit fond towards the idea of having Mydei’s family watching him,  “I will smile while looking at them with blood dripping from my weapon.”

“Take care of yourself, that’s my main worry, Phainon,” Kephale huffed out after a moment, and that was enough to make Phainon move and grasp his own sword - smiling as he looked at his father a bit warmly. 

“If I die, my only request is that you do your best to make sure Mydeimos is safe with our children,” Phainon mused as he smiled at his father - hoping that he was making himself clear that this was not a joke to him. He merely wanted Mydei to be well taken care of one way or another. 

“.. I will dully note that,” Kephale mumbled, but the way Phainon was immediately pulled into a soft hug made him feel a little bit stiff - rigid, and yet he couldn’t help but to lean into his touch, “But do come back safely, won’t you? I’m sure he would be much happier to have you instead.”

Phainon huffed over that, leaning his head down onto Kephale’s shoulder before giving a breathy laugh, “Yes, father..”

────────────── 

Phainon couldn’t help the way he moved his hand to shield his eyes as that large gate holding him lowered - allowing his feet to move into that sandy arena just a tiny bit, enough to where he could glance to his sides and see the other people all so very energetic to be here. Too energetic, really, and Phainon had to assume it had to do with Kremnoans having no shame in dying for honor.

.. What could be more honorable than competing to become the next ruler of Kremnos with Mydeimos, he had to wonder? For him, nothing. But for Kremnoans.. Surely there were other things, right? Was he insane to think such a thing..?

More importantly, Phainon found himself taking note of those weapons his competitors were carrying - too many, really. They were all varying in sorts of ways that only made him click his tongue over it. When fighting wars against Castrum Kremnos, the biggest issue of training had always been the fact that they picked such a high range of weapons and today was no different it seemed. 

Phainon couldn’t help but also note the way they were all looking towards the voice speaking and addressing them all - one he was growing oddly familiar with yet the words he was speaking.. Phainon couldn’t make out any of them as he stared at Eurypon, blinking over the roar of the crowd and laughter of his fellow competitors. Only finally registering that he couldn’t.

He couldn’t understand.

It wasn’t possible; Eurypon was speaking Kremnoan. 

Something about that felt ironic coupled with the glares he kept earning from people in the colosseum - as if they were talking badly about him but that was even more ironic considering he already had put such a deep claim on their crown prince.

Their glares to him could never actually matter to him for that reason, even as he stood there and flexed his wrist a little while gripping onto his sword - eyes only moving to continue to gauge just how in danger he was while Eurypon spoke but it.. Was odd. He had expected most people in the arena to be aiming for him as an outsider, yet it seemed he had underestimated older conflicts between fellow Kremnoans who seemed to already be bristling towards each other.

Phainon really wasn’t sure what to make of it all as a gong rang out - such a deafening noise that instantly caused the arena’s spectators to break out in cheering and screams of excitement. Sounds that only let Phainon comprehend that it was undoubtedly the sign that it had begun as metal against metal immediately was in his ears so harshly. 

It wasn’t like he had much time to himself to even spend time debating who to go for anyway; the first person to want to fight him was already lunging at him as he dipped a step back effortlessly. Just to block with his own sword and find his mind almost amused over how light their sword felt against Phainon’s own in comparison to Mydei’s gauntlets slamming into it. 

“A cocky crown prince showing up to conquer our kingdom by way of our own prince?” The man began, making Phainon take a moment to cock his head to the side - noting just how large this person was and yet.. He still didn’t come close to Mydei in that field, either. 

It was a little bit humorous to Phainon how he had to actively look down at his own attacker, but they only continued speaking regardless of it, “You don’t think you have any allies here, do you?”

.. That felt ironic to Phainon considering the way he could hear other people fighting to his side - already fighting amongst each other angrily over past feuds that now had a reason to end in bloodshed for a winner. An excuse to be able to murder each other with Mydeimos used as the bypass.. It was ironic in a way how he felt like an outsider, and yet he was the one who only deeply cared for their crown prince. 

At least, that was how this all was making him feel already as his eyes dipped away towards that sandy arena that was already being painted with a fresh layer of blood from people. 

“I don’t need any,” Phainon mused as he only watched the way people seemed more intent on slaughtering each other than himself - eyes slowly rolling back to the man whose face he couldn’t even make out through their helmet obscuring it, “Only one of us can win anyway.”

“And it won’t be a spoiled formally trained crown prince, I promise you that much!” That man growled at him before pulling his own sword back to try once more to land a blow on Phainon.

An action that he only found himself scoffing over as he barely moved to spend much energy blocking it - though.. Something in his mind was haunting him. And that was the simple fact that Mydei had already given him permission to be feral, to put on some type of show and judging by the roars of the spectators.. They wanted that, didn’t they?

A show of blood and glory? Something that they could respect from a future king..?

.. For some reason that was a little bit amusing to Phainon as he moved to block another hit from that man - his eyes only staring at the way they all seemed to fight so loosely. Messily yet so practiced, a way of fighting Phainon was used to due to growing up in a world where they were always at war with the Kremnoans but now.. Now he found himself wondering if he should match them. 

To find himself battling just as they would, and to let himself let go of his own rigid practices that were drilled into his head in Aedes Elysiae, after all.. He wasn’t there right now, and no Elysians were here. He rather liked the looser fighting style being displayed in this arena, anyway; it was different from how the Kremnoans were in war and listening to orders.

It wasn’t like Phainon had time to really think twice about it as the fight became a little unfair as a third person decided to join in. A movement that made him take a step back to dodge a polearm aimed at his chest all while he clicked his tongue a little over it. He supposed he should have expected to be ganged up on eventually, but even now he was finding himself a bit too prim and perfect.

Too white and untouched, it didn’t fit the scenario he was in; nor did his mind like it when he looked at the other people who were already becoming so very cut up in their battles with blood on their weapons.

Phainon had to huff over it, this was fine. Even if he was taking his time here, that was just to reserve his energy as people seemed to be more keen on fighting each other and whittling down the numbers one by one. That wasn’t a bad thing for Phainon, anyway. 

Instead he was merely blocking this man’s advances, never once finding himself worried as his eyes were more focused on the fighting around them. The crowd was roaring and deafening to him, though he could see why considering the amount of bodies that were already laying motionless on the floor.

Not a single one due to his own blade, but he had to consider he.. Probably had killed more Kremnoans in his time alive than anyone else here. 

Phainon clicked his tongue once more as that sword met against his own sword ruthlessly, such a sloppy movement that Phainon didn’t waste a single moment before lashing out. An attempt to retaliate against his pesky attacker that only was met with them blocking as well - not nearly strong enough however as Phainon pushed against that metal. Huffing a little as his blade slid downwards to slice into the man’s arm who only reeled backwards over that as blood splattered messily against the sand.

Though, Phainon had to growl a little over a polearm now came into view - so desperate to meet its mark against Phainon’s chest that it was more than merely an annoyance. A thing that instead made Phainon grit his teeth roughly before dipping a little to the side as he watched that swordbearing man ready his own blade again but..

He was willing to take a few slices if it meant one of his annoyances were gone. 

Phainon didn’t even have a thought in his mind as he ignored the idea of stopping the cut that was doomed to happen against his back and shoulder - instead he favored his chances of lunging forward to attack the polearm user. Claws outstretched in a way that felt so very.. Freeing as they found his mark - not caring at all for how easily that sank into that man’s chest without a moment’s delay.

Phainon was well trained in ripping people apart, anyway, and that was why the gasps from the crowd meant nothing to him as he sank his fingers in deeper. Feeling the burn of a sword against his back from the slash he had ignored all while he quickly grasped at anything in the shocked Kremnoan’s chest before yanking whatever organs his fingers were touching.

Gruesome, was a word to describe the sight - he was sure of that much as he watched that man crumble as Phainon tossed his guts to the floor. 

Considering he didn’t have a sword through his own chest for ignoring the man behind him - he had to imagine the crowd were not the only shocked and dazed ones as he spun back effortlessly. His ears ignoring the gasps of a dying man sputtering out with blood to instead return back to focusing on the one original man.

One who didn’t seem like he was very thrilled over the sight, and Phainon had to at least applaud him for being able to ignore what Phainon had just done. Though.. Kremnoans were more than a little used to seeing sights like that on the battlefield, he was sure of it. 

Though now Phainon had a moment to adapt to the pain he felt searing against his own back and arm, clearly where that man standing in front of him had slashed him so cleanly. A piece of him was thankful that the man had not chosen to stab him brutally, but another piece of him found it almost.. Amusing. 

As if the man hadn’t even the strength to stab a dragon, or feared claiming the life of a foreign crown prince with his own hands. Whatever the answer, Phainon couldn’t help but laugh a little sharply over it before lunging once more - easily swinging his greatsword while watching the way that man seemed to move so rigidly. 

That was fine.

Phainon didn’t care if he was supposed to put on a show or not - he didn’t care if he was supposed to make sure those cheers and yells aimed towards him were good. Instead, all he cared for was feeling the way that man’s throat felt in between his own fingers in an instant that was too fast. A blur that made Phainon only cock his head to the side and stare at the way he seemed to be grasping at Phainon’s hand to stop it. 

Only blinking to look at how that man had dropped his sword at some point in favor of clawing at Phainon’s wrist with dented finger nails. 

Crushing someone’s throat was too easy and boring for Phainon, an act that always made him sigh and shake his head a little over how boring all of it was. There was no thrill of chasing or hunting, no fight that was memorable to him. Just.. The end of someone’s life that he never would have cared enough about to learn the name of, anyway. 

Phainon wasn’t even sure what to think of it all as he stood there a bit numbly, staring downwards at the man who had been so deadset on fighting with him that was now.. A useless corpse on the floor waiting to rot due to Phainon’s claws and sword. Though, that wasn’t the thing that made him feel odd.

His eyes only raised to look at the sight around him to stare in confusion over how many people were dead from their own fights as well. Dying from wounds and bleeding out later, only to make Phainon return to that feeling again and again.

The feeling that only Mydei was worth fighting; that only Mydei was interesting because why..?

Why was Phainon the only person standing in that arena now? Why was he the only one still alive? He felt like nothing had happened at all, and yet.. 

“You have won, Phainon of Aedes Elysiae,” Eurypon spoke to interrupt Phainon’s thoughts as Phainon tilted his head to look at that man, who remained merely looking down upon Phainon in a way that made his blood feel more than a little cold in his veins, “Though, I can only wonder why you presume that killing my people earns you the right to wed my son?”

.. Ah, so that was it?

Phainon himself couldn’t even fathom an answer that would satisfy that kind - instead merely blinking as he looked down at his own hands a little. Staring at the blood that was dripping from them so freely, the grime and gore under his own claws - all before he tilted his head to the side a little. His eyes creeping back up to that man to stare at him. To wait, and to watch.

Was he actually going to be executed or something here? That was a bit worrying.. Only because Phainon couldn’t help but to flicker his eyes to Mydei who was staring at his own father. The dragon that he desired so deeply to keep safe.. If he wasn’t here, how could he be certain Mydei lived a good life..? 

Eurypon didn’t seem to mind at all that Phainon’s attention was barely on him, however, “To come to our kingdom and slay those who call it home? To so bo-”

“Forgive my husband, for a man who seems focused on traditions, he is forgetting how he and I wedded,” A familiar voice spoke up - making Phainon’s eyes dip to the woman who was wearing red on her lips, a smile dancing on them as she walked more into the sunlight and to the side of her husband.

Much more dazzling in her own beauty to where Phainon was pretty sure he could tell which parent Mydei took after with her hair appearing to sparkle as the sun hit it.

Only she continued to speak with that smile on her lips never seeming to fade, “Winning a duel for the crown prince’s hand is a hard feat in itself, and not one that commonly earns ire from the king.”

.. Phainon didn’t know what to make of this at all as he stared upwards at the king and queen - doing his best not to give away too many emotions all while he.. Only felt himself yearning to have this done with already. 

Whatever the crowd was yelling over, whatever they were saying or discussing, he just wanted to have Mydei back in his arms during it. 

“Even if he is a foreigner crown prince, has he not proven his own strength to adore Mydeimos above the others who wished to?” Gorgo only asked as she continued, sighing so wistfully as she leaned on the balcony’s stony wall - looking down at Phainon with such a heavy layer of mischief lurking in her eyes that at least it gave him a bit of confidence that someone was on his side in this situation. 

“I’ll not stand for ridiculing my now soon-to-be-husband, father,” Mydei spoke, though he didn’t stand - instead he looked to still be lazing in his chest. Staring at Phainon with the shadows covering his face - but that was fine. 

Phainon preferred Mydei to rest anyway, and regardless.. He rather liked how beautiful his mate looked when he was lounging around like a king truly deserved. 

That was enough to make the crowd even more riled up, yelling in Kremnoan mixed with their common tongue so Phainon himself could understand - yet he refused to. He didn’t want to listen to whatever was being said, not when the beady gaze of Eurypon mattered more. 

Whatever that dragon decided would be his fate, and he couldn’t deny it - not when he was trapped here like a rat to be toyed with. Not when they were all staring at him and Phainon highly doubted anyone but Mydeimos would do their best to fight at his side in this situation. 

“.. Congratulations, Phainon Elysiae of Aedes Elysiae,” Eurypon sighed out, but he himself was already turning away - sounding more and more unhappy with every word he spoke and every step he took back into the darkness, “We will see you shortly.”

Phainon wasn’t sure how to take that, only staring at the back of that king all while Gorgo offered a smile - a more reassuring one that made him a little aware it.. Was fine, wasn’t it? That was a good thing? That’s why she had given him such a look before turning away as well and following Eurypon?

Phainon only felt his hand tightening on his sword as he moved his gaze to Mydei - staring at the way he had his head propped up on his hand, elbow on the armrest of his stone chair all while those golden eyes didn’t seem to waver at all under Phainon’s own stare.

Scary.

It was almost scary how different Mydeimos seemed currently, but that made sense, didn’t it? It wasn’t as if the Kremnoan people knew the truth that had already been between them both, and they.. Just thought this to be a normal competition to pick out Mydei’s suitor, nothing more. It was natural that he was showing no warmth and had returned to such a rigid gaze.

“This way,” Those words growled at him were enough to shock Phainon out of his staring at Mydeimos however, darting his eyes to stare at a Kremnoan guard that was now leading him away in such a hurry. 

.. Everyone here always seemed to be in a hurry, really. 

This wasn’t any different as he was dragged back into the colosseum halls, forced into the darkness and the hallowed out walls that were lit only by flames on the walls that made his anxieties spiral just a tiny bit. This was a horrible place for him to fight, it was stuffy and cramped, not big enough at all for him to fight freely - and his bones only were aching from his fight already.

Not that it mattered as that guard paused by a door - staring at Phainon as he moved to the side, clearly wanting Phainon to open it and not himself but that.. Something about it all was making Phainon feel more and more stressed, at least.

Until he heard the sound of rushing waters.

A sound that only beckoned him forward into opening it and staring at the room he had been led to. This area was.. Much different.

An outdoors area, yet it was walled off - allowing for some privacy in the marble laid out area lined with gold and red. A running theme of decorations here, but Phainon didn’t mind them at all considering they only reminded him of Mydei. He only found himself jerking a little over that door closing behind him - a clear sign that he.. Was supposed to bathe here.

A thought that made him sigh heavily before moving to place his sword down slowly - near the bath, but not too close. He could defend himself without it, but it still.. Brought him comfort, at the very least.

Phainon found himself sighing as his fingers slowly worked to shed his clothes as well - shaking a little as he just allowed them to pile onto the floor behind him. Not that it mattered - they were messy and covered in blood, he doubted he would be permitted to wear them out. Besides.. Phainon was more in a hurry to move himself into that steaming hot waters.

Sinking into it and huffing out a slow and relieved sigh over the burn of how hot it was against his skin - and against his cuts and gashes on his body. A piece of him was surprised no medics tended to him, but that was fine, if anything, he preferred it.

To just.. Close his eyes and relax a bit in the silence of the waters around him. 

Not like his peace lasted long however, instead he found him jerking away from a touch on his arm - head yanking to look at whoever had snuck up on him. Only to huff quietly as he now felt silly.

Of course.. There was only one person whose presence would never bother him.. 

“When I told you they would prefer you to be vicious, I didn’t know you would succumb to your instincts that much,” Mydei’s voice was much softer than normal, not sounding as commanding or bold - but as if he didn’t want to bother a clearly tired Phainon as he settled behind him, “You let yourself get rather roughed up.”

.. The idea of Mydei trying not to bother Phainon was more than a little amusing to him, considering the person he always wanted to see was Mydei anyway. 

“.. I would allow myself to go through hell and back for you,” Phainon mused as he tried his best to look at Mydei - feeling a bit desperate to see more of the man he adored more than anything. 

“Mm,”  Mydei only hummed over that, “There’s no real need for that now. Lean forward.”

Phainon felt himself sighing over that - he wanted nothing more than to lean back and look at the dragon who wasn’t bathing with him. To admire him and look at the flickers of his sweet emotions, to take note of them all.. That was what would quell the struggle in Phainon’s mind.. 

Yet he was powerless to deny Mydei, leaning forward with a quiet tut falling out of his lips. 

.. Though he couldn’t complain - not really, not when he felt Mydei’s hand on his back plainly, splaying against his shoulder all before a cloth rubbed at his back. Not soothing, a burning pain was brought with it due to whatever Mydei was using to wash him down having soap in it, but Phainon would never complain over Mydei tending to him either..

“You’re cut up everywhere,” Mydei muttered, and Phainon only flickered his eyes to the waters, staring at the way it had already ceased being dyed a crimson color and returned to clear. But he wasn’t sure if the same could be said to the cloth Mydei was dipping in and out of the bath waters. 

“Everywhere but my face, which is my most important asset as a crown prince,” Phainon hummed out, feeling a smile on his lips as he only stared into those waters some more. 

Kremnos was beautiful, but he wanted to get home as fast as possible. 

“You fool.”

To return to Aedes Elysiae with that man who was calling him a fool in specific, of course. 

Phainon found himself leaning back over that - moving to lay more against the side of the bath’s walls to look upwards at the man who was now hovering over him and staring down at him. A hand still occupied by a cloth, but Phainon didn’t mind that at all. Not when he could so easily move his soaked hands upwards and around Mydei’s neck.

He was a fool, but now.. Mydei was his.

Phainon tugged on Mydei a little at that - just enough to force him closer to him all before leaning upwards to press his lips against Mydei’s. Such a chaste and gentle movement that he couldn’t help but laugh over how warm Mydei’s lips were as he released him again and leaned forward once more. 

“I suppose I should hurry so we can go to your parents, then?” Phainon asked in the quiet silence of Mydei over that kiss - tilting his head to beam a smile at Mydei who was.. Merely sitting there, staring at him with an odd expression on his face.

“No,” Mydei replied in a tone that was.. Odd. Much too weird to Phainon as he quirked his brows upwards. 

“No?”

“My father has no desire to eat with us, he’s rather angry with us. I believe it will be a quiet night for us alone,” Mydei sighed, moving a little to grasp at Phainon’s arm - an action Phainon didn’t shy away from at all as he blinked over those words, watching as Mydei began to clean one of his wounds there. “My mother may check in, but I fear my father wishes to disown me even if he cannot.”

.. Right. Phainon couldn’t help but to drop his eyes more - taking a moment to watch Mydei’s soothingly (albeit a little harsh, not seeming nearly gentle enough) movements against his arm before looking at that golden dragon. 

“I’m sorry,” Phainon managed to say, though Mydei didn’t even look up from his current work - huffing out a breath of laughter over that. 

“Don’t be. He has always been a fool who listens to his council much too much,” Mydei mumbled in a voice that sounded more and more tired - one that only made Phainon watch him keenly,  “My mother is the only one who can get through to him anymore.”

.. That sounded.. Sad? Almost as if Mydei had thought of this long ago and was only now finally coming to terms with it all. 

Phainon found himself flexing his fingers a little - trying his best to figure out how he fully felt about such a heavy feeling topic, “But I won, didn’t I? That’s all that matters?”

“That’s all that matters,” Mydei agreed, though he still didn’t look directly at Phainon. 

Phainon had to huff over that, “You’ll marry me?”

“I’ll marry you,” Mydei confirmed without a single second wasted - only continuing to work away at Phainon’s wounds and Phainon..

.. He had to huff over that, Mydei’s attention was more important to him than any scratch he could have ever gotten.

“Even if your father hates me?” Phainon asked blankly. 

And that seemed to work well enough - making Mydei slowly slide his eyes upwards to meet Phainon’s own. Blinking a few times all before he seemed to sigh heavily, shoulders sagging as he offered a little smile towards Phainon. 

“Yes, Phainon Elysiae, I will marry you even if my father hates you.” 

────────────── 

“It’s beautiful here,” Phainon mused over the way Mydei was a bit lazily standing to the side of his own bedroom balcony - his eyes only continued to stare at the city below them however. Arms crossed over his chest as he appeared lost in thought, not even batting his eyes or glancing to Phainon before he sighed quite deeply; shoulders sagging just a tiny bit as he shook his head. 

“.. For some reason I fear you do not mean the view,” Mydei mumbled out, and Phainon found that humorous considering he did mean the view. It was especially beautiful in Castrum Kremnos now that the sun had fallen - a nice background against Mydei’s golden fiery hair that only seemed to be working to glow against the steady light of the city below.

“I do mean the view, you’re simply a part of that right now,” Phainon mused as he sat a little to the side of Mydei’s bed - watching keenly how Mydei only seemed to turn more to him at those words, a quiet huff of laughter on his lips over that. 

“Sappy,” Mydei hummed but he was moving towards Phainon regardless of his own word on the matter. And Phainon found his eyes glued to that dragon, ignoring the other half of the open balcony window in favor of watching Mydei move closer to him instead. 

Phainon couldn’t help but to give a quiet little laugh over that as he watched Mydei sit a bit too far from him - as if he was leaving room for Oronyx or well, Nikador between them, “And cheesy, but isn’t that good every now and again?”

Mydei didn’t reply to that, he only moved his eyes to focus on Phainon more - seeming as if he had something to say on that topic, and yet he chose not to. Only shaking his head once again over those words. 

“King Kephale left during the duel,” Mydei began after a few moments of silence between them - picking a new topic it seemed as Phainon found himself biting into his lips over that. “Is he not worried that my father may string you up and execute you?”

“There was much too much publicity for that to happen,” Phainon murmured in reply to the idea of it - shaking his head slowly over how silly it sounded and how foolish it would be for Eurypon to do that, even if he did dislike Phainon so deeply,  “That would certainly start another war and upset the queen and crown prince who defended me, would it not?”

“Mm, be that as it may, you’re still a foreign prince in an unknown kingdom,” Mydei reminded him, but Phainon couldn’t help the laugh that left his own lips as he moved towards Mydei - leaning towards him a little to be more on eye level with him. Staring into those amber eyes flaked in gold as he smiled so easily towards the man of all his affections, admiring the way Mydei only blinked and stared right back at him.

No flickers of fear and panic like other people, just a blank little stare of someone that.. Trusted Phainon, didn’t he? That was what it was, Mydei trusted him now..

“Curious,” Phainon murmured as he moved his hand towards Mydei’s cheek - cupping it a little before looking to his hair that was still unmade and a bit wet from their bathing, “That was how I finally got to sink my claws into you, Mydeimos.”

Mydei made a quiet noise at that - one that sounded as if he was amused all before Phainon chose to move away. Never wanting to spend too much time apart from Mydei, but he was a bit eager as he moved to acquire a comb that had been left of Mydei’s dresser. Clearly with intentions of brushing Mydei’s hair but..

Phainon wanted to.

That was why he couldn’t help himself but to walk back to Mydei - staring at the dragon who was merely twitching his tail on the bed before Phainon rounded the red and golden sewn bed. Not wasting a moment before moving behind Mydei with a quiet hum.

“May I try braiding your hair tonight, beloved?” Phainon asked as he already began to comb through red and golden strands of hair - feeling himself more and more enamored over how soft and silken they felt between his fingers. 

Mydei was quiet for a moment, all before he shifted a little with his position on the bed, “Have you ever braided hair before?”

“Never!” Phainon chirped, feeling more and more excited that Mydei hadn’t outright refused him yet on this matter. 

“.. Fine, but if it’s too tragic I will rebraid it in the morning.”

“I’m hearing you’ll wear it to bed though!”

“Hmph.”
