chapters.title: Chapter 21
chapters.html:
“Phainon,” Mydei found himself huffing out as he followed after that dragon - staring at the way Phainon spun on his heels over that. So clearly and blatantly becoming more than a little excited upon his realization that Mydei was stalking behind him, “What’s going on?”

Phainon only made a slight movement to question that - an action that Mydei snarled over a little as he tilted his head to the side. A curt nod to the man who was still kneeling on the floor, his hands cupped together in a silent prayer and that.. Somehow it wasn't too odd in this kingdom. But the fact he was wearing the attire of Phainon’s personal guards was more than a little bizarre.

Mydei had never seen them randomly break into prayers, and now they seemed to be fawning over the two crown princes. Phainon’s eyes did follow his gaze, looking to the man who was kneeling all before he huffed out a little laugh - quiet and soothing, more than enough to get Mydei to focus his attention back onto him.

“Hmm? People are just excited for our marriage! Isn’t it sweet?” Phainon asked with a little laugh - cocking his head to the side as he put his hands behind his back. A smile danced on his lips as he tried his best to look as innocent as possible - but Mydei was more than a little used to that act by now. 

“They’re kneeling to me,” Mydei pointed out with a slow and painful shake of his head while he moved to cross his arms over his chest,  “They didn’t even kneel to you before.”

Phainon’s eyes went a little wide over that, all before he laughed and waved a hand to him playfully, “You’re so cute! Of course they’re kneeling to you! You’re pregnant!”

.. What kind of nonsense was that man sputtering? Mydei had no idea as his eyes only narrowed towards Phainon, watching the way he seemed to be trying to play so innocently in this matter.  Phainon would be cute, if everyone else crumbling to their knees to pray to Mydei wasn’t just a little offputting to him. 

“.. That does not offer much insight into why they’re..” Mydei paused for a moment, taking a second to look at that man who was still kneeling before the both of them, “Falling to their knees and praying to me.”

“Mm,” Phainon hummed as he moved a little - crossing his arms over his chest before nodding and pointed a little, appearing as if he was so very amused by it.  “They’re praying for our children as well, isn’t that sweet?”

“And that’s.. Just normal?” Mydei asked as he cocked his head to the side, staring at that man who was still merely praying. As if he was going to keep praying until the very moment Mydei left his sight of something foolish like that. It sounded insane to him..

“Well, probably not..” Phainon admitted in a tone that made Mydei snap his head back to stare at that man - feeling the way he couldn’t quite believe whatever the hell he was talking about all before..

“Probably not?” Mydei echoed out, unable to stop himself from languidly blinking at Phainon who kept only shallowly taking baby steps closer towards Mydei like he was trying to be sneaky.

A foolish thought considering the way Phainon was.. Anything but small, not easy to miss, and very much an eyecatcher. 

“Well.. I mean.. Probably not? I don’t know! I’ve never seen how they normally react around pregnancies! Especially not royal ones,” Phainon mumbled as if he was doing his best to fix what he was saying, all before chuckling a little as his arm now brushed against Mydei’s,  “It’s not like Kephale ever bred, you know?”

That.. That was a thing Mydei found himself questioning quite a bit - always finding his mind puzzling over how nothing he had heard about Aedes Elysiae really added up. Well, one main thing. 

“.. Did.. The queen never exist?” Mydei found himself asking a bit quietly, and that was enough for Phainon to hum over it. 

“No,” Phainon admitted in a voice that dropped just as low, clearly not desiring that person kneeling before them to hear - or well.. Mydei wasn’t sure how much of Aedes Elysiae was an open secret in their kingdom. Things that seemed farfetched and bizarre to him were just viewed as normal here.

Maybe even the fact their queen wasn’t real was one of those things as well.

“There was no queen, Kephale never had a partner in all of his life, and when I was born he still didn’t find any interest,” Phainon mused, before he slowly pressed out a tired sounding sigh. A sound that made Mydei cock his head to look at him - brows furrowing together as he tried to fully understand how that dragon was currently thinking as pointed ears seemed to flick a little. 

“Truthfully, he did adopt me as if I truly was his son, so I..” Phainon trailed off, and Mydei was more than a little aware that he was simply staring at the kneeling man. Appearing as if he were doing his best to ignore Mydei in favor of looking anywhere else, a rarity, but also a habit he seemed to have when he was nervous towards certain topics.

Mydei didn’t mind it however, he was a little bit growing used to it - Phainon was honest enough, even if he struggled to say it.

“Maybe I filled some sort of void in him, even if I’m not truly his child.”

Those words were enough to make Mydei feel his own smile droop a little, the idea of adopting a child was nothing to be ashamed of, but the way Phainon sounded almost.. Saddened over it was something that made Mydei feel like his heart was being pulled at a little. It felt as if Phainon had thought this over for years, as if he spent his own time wondering how Kephale felt about him really.

And Mydei couldn’t even blame him, not when he always found himself stopping and wondering what those emotions buried in Eurypon’s eyes truly were.

Though, it was as if Phainon could hear his thoughts anyway as blue eyes jerked to meet Mydei’s own; “Don’t look at me like that, Mydei! Your father is the same, anyway.”

“My.. Father?” Mydei echoed out, trying to understand what on earth that man was now rambling about as Phainon moved to cross his arms - sighing as he shook his head while acting like Mydei’s confusion was more than a little baffling to himself. 

“I don’t know if you noticed it, but.. He does adore you,” Phainon spoke in a tone that only served to make Mydei feel more and more baffled over how he seemed so deadset in this opinion, “Probably in his own way, maybe much more quietly than he should. But I noticed it. Those short glances he gives you that are so very prideful in you, a happy dragon eager to look at their hatchingling..”

That.. That did not sound like Mydei’s father, not at all. 

If anything, he was more than a little aware that he had so effortlessly become Eurypon’s greatest failure in life; not a war god prince, but instead someone who had mated and broken traditions. Shattered years upon years of kingdoms agreeing not to breed draconic blood together, and now he was dead center of it.

It was foolish to assume he was anything but something that brought his father shame, really. 

“Don’t speak about things you do not know,” Mydei growled out after a few moments, dipping his own eyes away from Phainon to focus on that praying man. A little bit concerned over how he hadn’t run out of words to whisper about all while they stood in the halls gossiping. 

Though, Phainon at his side only laughed a little - quiet and not sounding like it was out of sheer joy, “It’s a good thing I’m not, then!” 

Mydei didn’t even have a single word to say to him - not when his own mind was still puzzling over how Phainon could read his father’s emotions as pride and not the more obvious answer. Perhaps it was due to the fact Phainon just didn’t know Eurypon well enough to have a decent say in it.. Mydei didn’t know, not really. 

“Ah well, since you found me today.. What if we take today off and relax together, Mydei?” Phainon asked, leaning down a little to get into Mydei’s view just enough to grab his attention. Making Mydei snap his head to the side and leer at that man as his crossed arms only squeezed at the rolled up paper in his hands he had completely ignored. 

“Relax? We have a wedding to plan,” Mydei reminded him, though Phainon only cocked his head cutely to the side of that. A sweet expression of innocence sprawling over his features before he let out a little whistle. 

“Hmm,” Phainon hummed before pointing to Mydei’s hand, “Is that what that parchment is for?”

“Yes.”

Phainon only hummed again, “Were you hunting me down for that?”

“Yes.”

Phainon moved a little at that, a hand raising to his lips as he seemed to take his sweet time studying Mydei - looking him up and down oddly and that only made Mydei narrow his eyes over whatever nonsense could be swirling in that white scaled dragon’s mind. Staring at the way Phainon was tilting his head from side to side all while just looking at Mydei repeatedly.

.. Weird, this was beyond weird to where Mydei could feel his own tail twitching to make the jewelry wrapped around him jingle just a little. Enough to where Phainon seemed to snap out of it and bark out such a loud laugh over it all. 

“I should start hiding better.. I like the idea of you hunting for me.. Would you start with my neck for a quick kill, or would you make me suffer? I would love to feel your lips on my neck before you snap down!” Phainon chirped in a tone that was beyond odd to Mydei - sounding as if he was daydreaming about just that very thing all while Mydei felt that dragon had to be just a little insane as he pushed himself into Mydei’s arm more. 

More and more clingy, all while acting as if he wanted Mydei to bite and devour him - it was insanity.

Yet somehow it was a level of insanity that Mydei was growing used to as he breathed out a sigh.

“.. Asking you about color themes for our wedding feels as if it’s going to be more painful than expected,” Mydei muttered almost inaudibly as he uncrossed his arms to comb his free empty hand through his hair with such a heavy sigh. 

But Phainon only laughed again over that, “Then don’t say stuff to excite me!”

“You get excited over every word I say,” Mydei said as he pressed such a heavy sigh out of his chest - already shaking his head a little as he felt Phainon hooking their arms together. So blatantly intending on dragging Mydei off that he knew he was already destined to whatever antics Phainon was deciding they do today.

“Yes! Come on, come with me,” Phainon purred out as he started to walk away - all while tossing his head back to make sure he wasn’t tugging Mydei along too hard or something.

Though, Mydei’s own mind continued to return back to that man on the floor, giving a worried glance to watch as he stood now while they walked away. 

It felt odd that people were.. Kneeling for him as soon as he walked near them. Baffling, but he couldn’t really voice that to them - instead he only walked with Phainon.

“Where are we going?”

Phainon hummed over that - a smile on his lips all while he gave a little glance to Mydei. One that looked like he was up to literally nothing good as his smile seemed to be feigning such a level of innocence that Mydei could tell he was being brought into some type of foolish nonsense. 

“Somewhere alone to talk..”

“I don’t trust you,” Mydei huffed out immediately, though that only worked to make Phainon laugh so easily. 

“Yes you do! You immediately started following me!” Phainon argued against that, but Mydei had no idea how to even say ‘you’re dragging me along with our arms tangled together’ to him. Instead, all he could do was sigh over how rather.. Silly and unserious Phainon seemed at times. It was a breath of fresh air compared to how Mydei was used to people speaking to him.. 

“I need your input on these things, that doesn’t mean I trust whatever situation you’re leading me into,” Mydei explained with a heavy sigh leaving him yet again - an action he seemed to be doing so very much today as he followed that man though..

Now he knew his own way around the castle rather easily (at least, the basic areas) to where he could feel himself growing older with every step they took together as the realization of where they were going was dawning on him. 

“Why are you taking me to the baths? I do not need a bath, and neither do you,” Mydei hissed out - cocking his head to cast such a harsh glare towards Phainon that he could only hope and pray that Phainon could feel the burn of it. 

But Phainon only gave him such a smug smile as he looked at him - eyes sparkling and twinkling in a way that told Mydei he absolutely knew he was up to nothing good. 

“Mydei, Mydei, Mydei.. My beloved, there’s much more magic that happens in the baths than just bathing!”

.. Magic happens in the bath?

Mydei could only feel his shoulders sag as he tried to puzzle out whatever the hell Phainon wanted to do in the baths, and that.. Well, there was one obvious answer that Mydei was more than a little obvious that lovers liked to do in the baths. 

“.. I’m not being intimate with you here, either. This is a horrible place for my paperwork..” Mydei grumbled as Phainon paused outside of the private bathing door - blinking a little as he seemed stunned for once over Mydei’s words. 

“We’re not doing sodomy! No, but we will be intimate..” Phainon purred as he opened the door, pushing it open to allow Mydei inside first but that..

That only made Mydei have more and more questions as his eyes landed on the table in the middle of the steam filled room, “.. What is this?”

Mydei asked that, but his own feet were already moving towards it to inspect it. It was some type of bed from what he could tell with pillows laid out and that.. That made Mydei blink over it as the realization of it hit him. 

They had many of these in Castrum Kremnos for soothing each other’s joints, but he had never once seen one as fancy as this one. Though, maybe it was because none of the royal family sought out such a thing.. If Mydei had aches in his bones, he preferred to do stretches and spar even more to limber them up - not.. 

“A massage table, I was scheduled to have one, but ah.. It feels like it would be so much more fun for me to give you one instead!” Phainon explained as he moved into the room after shutting it behind the both of them - his tail wagging so loudly that Mydei could feel a sigh dancing on his own lips again over that.

Phainon wanted to give him a massage? Such a thing only sounded like Phainon wanted to touch him and that..

.. That sounded nice to Mydei, actually. 

“Do you have any practice in such a thing?” Mydei asked as he moved to cross his arms over his chest - still holding that paper in his hands so tightly and feeling his desire to ask Phainon about them growing more and more as he considered how.. Endearing his to-be-husband really was.

“No,” Phainon said.

Mydei couldn’t help but scowl over that, “.. So you’re just going to be cluelessly rubbing my body?”

“Yes,” Phainon nodded.

.. Right, so Mydei wasn’t getting much more out of that man, then? 

“I will only agree if you answer wedding questions during it,” Mydei huffed over the lackluster replies he was getting out of Phainon - biting a little at his own lips as he tried to focus on the way Phainon seemed so.. Desperate towards this.

Even if he wasn’t saying it vocally, Mydei could tell he was a bit more antsy right now. His body seemed twitchy and anxious, moving and shifting his weight as he tried to think of what to even say on topics and it was somehow enamoring to Mydei. To know how much that man always wanted him and to be around him, to watch the way he was so obvious about how deeply he wanted Mydei just in general.

It was nice, really, even if it did seem to make Phainon go a little bit insane in his own mind under Mydei’s gaze. 

“Deal! Undress and then lay down, Mydeimos! Ah.. On your back,” Phainon sputtered out those words so quickly that they felt messy even while Mydei scoffed over it - a laugh leaving his lips immediately after before he turned to begin undressing languidly. 

Somehow he had expected something like this from Phainon; not a massage in specific, but.. Some antics like this where they would be alone together. 

“.. Naturally,” Mydei replied as he rather lazily removed his own clothes - a little surprised as he found a towel offered to him as his pants hit the floor. 

An oddity only due to the fact it was Phainon of all people offering it to him that made Mydei scoff as he accepted it before removing his underwear at all. Understanding that the towel was that dragon sneakily telling him to fully remove his clothes, anyway. Mydei moved onto that table slowly - taking his time as he felt a bit.. Exposed from this angle with just a towel on and that paper still rolled up and clutched in his hand.

But he supposed that it didn't matter much with how Phainon had already seen every intimate part of Mydei.

“Tell me if I hurt you, won’t you?” Phainon murmured, but Mydei found himself just attempting to get comfortable as he stared at that ceiling now. Adjusting himself a little on those soft cushions all while he pressed out a quiet laugh over those words.

“I imagine you would assume I’m hurt before I even say anything,” Mydei argued, shaking his head as he only listened to whatever Phainon was doing off to his side with some bottle noises pricking against his ears.

Phainon only hummed softly over that; “That’s true..”

Mydei didn’t know what to say in reply to that - so instead, he merely listened to whatever Phainon was up to. Ears straining to listen to the soft clinks of bottles and the rubbing of hands together, soothing noises that were equally matched by the way Phainon was humming under his own breath.

A song he had hummed many times around Mydei, and every single time Mydei found himself entranced by it. Not to say that thought lasted long as wet warm hands instead clamped down around his right leg, a sensation that jolted a shiver down Mydei’s spine as Phainon had begun to.. Silently rub him. Not deep enough to rub out his stress, but still somehow comforting in the way of letting Mydei know Phainon cared.

Sharp deadly claws against his skin that were so very gentle in their nature towards Mydei; sweet and kind, doting just like Phainon was and it.. Was enough to make Mydei huff out a sigh as he moved to unroll that paper finally. His eyes only stared at the text they had been polite enough to translate for him (a fact he didn’t care to mention to Phainon). 

“Wedding colors, what did you imagine?” Mydei asked after a few moments of feeling the tips of Phainon’s fingers digging into his thigh - not enough to break skin but dancing such a thin line that Mydei had to find it a little impressive regardless. 

Phainon let out a quiet little tutting noise as he seemed to try to figure out what he should say to that; “Ah.. Well.. It’s a royal wedding, so it only makes sense it’s our kingdom’s colors, correct?”

“Yes,” Mydei confirmed blankly, but something about that made Mydei feel a bit bizarre. 

Royal weddings were rare, even more so when they were between two kingdoms; he should have expected such a.. Politically correct answer and yet.. It still felt a bit odd to him.

“Then.. Blue and red, right? Both of our kingdoms do love gold, at least.. Not as much as the Kremnoan crown prince, but enough, I’m sure.”

.. It was a reasonable idea, and one that made the most sense to Mydei as well. But.. Blue actually made him think of Phainon nowadays. Sometimes he had found himself staring at the crisp blue of the castle and had to wonder if it had always been the color of Phainon’s eyes, or had they repainted it to match him later on..?

Regardless, Mydei huffed a little in acknowledgement, keeping that paper in front of himself as he felt Phainon’s hands slowly sliding up his hips, “Wedding cake flavors?”

“Ah, I don’t mind.. Whatever you want is fine with me, I would much rather just feed it to you and watch you enjoy it..” Phainon explained, all while Mydei couldn’t help but feel his own mind dragging over the way Phainon’s fingers were so very delicately trailing up and around his stomach. Fingers that were not pushing down enough to move those eggs buried in Mydei’s abdomen around, but enough to feel them. Mydei was sure of that.

Especially as Phainon laughed a little, “I’m excited even thinking about it..”

“Are you sure you’re not excited from touching my stomach this much?” Mydei countered without missing a second, lowering that paper a little to try to crane his head upwards to look at Phainon who..

Only continued to press onto his stomach in miniscule amounts - softly massaging Mydei’s stomach that assuredly did not need that right now. Phainon did, on the other hand, laugh a little over that. 

“You caught me. With you laying down like this.. I can easily feel them..” 

Phainon’s voice sounded so soft - fond, even, as if he was in some type of dazed dream as he spoke those words that Mydei couldn’t help but to let himself relax again. His head lowering back down to the pillow under him to stare at the ceiling. His mind only stalling again and again over how Phainon seemed to be so distracted with feeling his stomach and their children.

“Not hard to catch you when you’re spending so much time touching my stomach, Haikas,” Mydei mumbled out without any real venom behind his words - instead feeling himself much too enamored with the dragon who was being so sweet over their clutch. 

.. It almost made Mydei feel like a fool towards how he had been when he had first been impregnated, but now he fully knew these weren’t the actions of a man who only was doing this for power or politics. 

“H.. Haikas?” Phainon echoed out as his fingers stalled on Mydei’s stomach, seeming as if that word had completely tripped him up, but Mydei could only huff a laugh over it.

“Be quiet.”

Phainon made his own laughing noise as that all while dragging his fingers south again, “Goodness me..”

Mydei didn’t waste a moment after that, instead moving to look at that paper again with a heavy sigh escaping him, “Aedes Elysiae flowers, or Castrum Kremnos?”

Phainon’s fingers only seemed to dip against Mydei’s thigh - pressing into him just a tiny bit before moving more south to Mydei’s lower leg, “Wouldn’t.. It be easier to split them apart?”

Mydei had thought about that before as well, “Yes, but it would give the wrong ideas about unity and distance between our kingdoms. We want them to understand its true unity, not to split them apart.”

They were just flowers - and yet it meant so much more due to the fact their marriage was going to be watched so painfully keenly. 

Phainon once again hummed quietly over that, “Then the answer is to mix both of them, right?”

“Yes.”

Phainon didn’t reply to that, not immediately at least as he seemed to take a moment to process the question and answers hanging in the air.

All before he clicked his tongue a little - a noise that made Mydei blink his eyes at the fancy black writing on the paper dully, “Mydei, why are you even in charge of this? There are official planners?”

That..

Mydei almost felt a bit embarrassed when he took a moment to think about that himself, though it wasn’t as if he would tell Phainon that. 

“I wanted to have a say in it,” Mydei mused instead with a quiet little sigh escaping him as he rolled up that parchment once more to relax down onto that table. His mind was only wandering towards the way Phainon was still tracing his fingers against something slowly. An odd sensation that almost tickled, only serving to make Mydei slap his tail against the wood a little as he realized what it was. 

“So I asked for their planning sheets, and they were.. A bit eager considering they were already on the floor speaking to me,” Mydei explained as he tried to ignore the way he could now tell Phainon was tracing his tattoos lovingly - as if he were doing his best to memorise them all..

“You know, I don’t mind whatever you decide but I do adore the fact you care enough to ask me,” Phainon trailed off a little - all before Mydei heard quiet laughing following after, “It makes me think that we should get married even sooner, you’re too sweet, what if someone steals you?!”

“I’m sure most people have heard of your display in Castrum Kremnos,” Mydei argued with a little huff of his own laughter over how silly that sounded to his own ears.

He wasn’t sure honestly if the people of Aedes Elysiae had heard of their prince ripping organs and guts from a man’s chest with his bare hands, but he could assume it was floating in the air. Whether or not people believed such a thing was another story entirely, Mydei supposed.. 

“Your legs are so tense Mydei, are you that worried?” Phainon asked and Mydei could only feel himself stiffen up over that - mainly due to how idiotic he felt Phainon was being. 

“.. That is just my calf muscle, you fool,” Mydei growled as he felt such gentle fingers pressing into muscle that didn't need to be rubbed yet.. Phainon only laughed over that. 

“I know that, I just want to rub it for a while.. Can you work with me here, Mydeimos?” Phainon asked softly, and Mydei had half a mind to bite and gnaw over whatever that dragon was thinking right now. 

Instead, Mydei only sighed over that; “I already am, I wasn’t telling you to stop, was I?”

“My husband is so nice to me..” 

Phainon’s voice was soft now, as if he were a bit distracted and honestly Mydei didn’t mind. This had barely been a massage considering Phainon refused to dig into Mydei’s skin to help relieve his muscles, most likely due to his claws running the risk of clawing into Mydei and making him bleed but at least talking was comforting. The sound of the running waters and steam in the air were enough to make Mydei relax anyway, fully knowing he didn’t need to be on edge.

Not when Phainon was there himself to stand guard and just idly rub at Mydei’s body in such a teasing way. 

Though, there were a few things still on Mydei’s mind as he flitted his eyes back to that paper he had. No longer feeling the need to ask the questions they had for them, but instead.. His own questions; “Are there.. Any traditions of Aedes Elysiae we need to abide by?”

“Ah, is that what you’re so nervous over?” Phainon questioned right back, though he seemed a bit distracted still in a way that Mydei didn’t care to try to figure out as that man hummed again and again. 

“.. It is only natural of me to not want to offend,” Mydei reasoned easily, feeling as though he was perfectly in the right to want to make sure he did his best to keep the Elysians nice and happy with him.

He had.. No desire of angering anyone that he would be most likely spending most of his life around one way or another; even if he was permitted to travel between the two kingdoms he wanted to ensure both were pleased with him. He had to admit currently that Kremnos was in the back of his mind, at the least, he knew the Kremnoans respected him enough as it stood.

But the Elysians.. He still needed to make sure he was not looked at with scorn due to his own actions, he needed to make sure he made all of them happy and accepting of this marriage. 

“Not to worry! Our traditions will only take place behind closed doors where I have you to myself,” Phainon replied, however, making Mydei’s thoughts absolutely slam the breaks on his train of thought so easily.

.. Closed doors and where Phainon had Mydei to himself..?

Those words were more than enough to make Mydei’s eyes lower into a slight glare as he stared at the ceiling still, “.. Sex?”

Phainon was a bit quiet over that - as if he hadn’t expected that line of thought all before he chuckled a little lowly, “Well, no, but we can if you want. That helps induce labor, doesn’t it?”

“I do not need help with that, it will be much too early,” Mydei growled out, though he had half a thought to also snap at him to stop talking to Hyacine about such things. That poor dragon didn’t need to have all of this information shared with her, even if she knew medical related practices..

“Ah.. Well, I’m hearing maybe later on you will want some help inducing labor, huh? I’m excited..” Phainon murmured in a tone that really did sound like he was way too happy over it - enough to where Mydei only slowly closed his eyes to huff out a quiet sigh. 

This man was going to be the death of him, he knew that much, and yet he hadn’t felt the desire to run away from him yet. 

“Mydei,” Phainon spoke out, making Mydei feel his hand twitching over how sweetly his name was being called out. 

“Hm?”

“You stopped asking me questions about our wedding,” Phainon pointed out in a relaxed manner, as if he was just trying to make idle chit chat, “Are you alright?”

.. Was he alright?

He was fine, at least, he was pretty sure he was fine in comparison to other things and topics that could be haunting him instead. Though.. 

“It’s hard to focus with you rubbing my legs so much,” Mydei growled as he took note of the way Phainon had slowly been moving up his legs - working silently closer and closer to Mydei’s inner thighs to rub him much too close to his intimates, “You’re too handsy.”

“Sorry, sorry. I’ll answer all your questions, don’t be shy to ask,” Phainon purred out, making Mydei more than a little aware that he absolutely was not sorry but at the very least that offer made Mydei ponder a new idea at hand. 

All of his questions..?

Mydei found his mind blank over that, his thoughts returning to one topic again and again no matter how much he tried to avoid it. A lurking emotion that was gnawing into him and threatening to swallow him whole when he ignored it for too long.

And that was why he couldn’t even stop himself from voicing it hollowly, “.. Do you think my father will attend?”

Phainon’s fingers froze at that - going rigid against Mydei’s skin to where he could feel the way he jerked a little. Seeming more than a little obvious about how that question about Eurypon had thrown off Phainon so badly and that..

That was enough to let Mydei have his answer, “My apologies, I shouldn’t have asked. It’s not as if you two don’t have your own iss-”

“I think he will,” Phainon interrupted, and Mydei could only feel himself resisting the urge to lean up a little - just enough to look at Phainon while he instead stared at the ceiling. Eyes dancing over the runes and swirls caved so delicately into the fancy wood that he could barely even process the fact Phainon was saying that. 

Mydei twitched his hands a little at his side over that - narrowing his eyes upwards to the ceiling as he tried to process it, “.. Do you?”

“He loves you,” Phainon replied very quickly, his hands tightening on Mydei’s leg just a little bit as he was doing his best to support and let Mydei know how deeply he meant it. It was sweet, even if Mydei felt a little bit foolish for even allowing himself to ask this question and be vulnerable. 

It didn’t help that Phainon sounded so gentle and caring currently - his voice low and quiet as if he were doing his best to comfort Mydei who.. Wasn’t even sure if he truly needed comfort. Something about this topic made him feel numb, almost a bit empty, but it was fine.

He was used to feeling like that towards his father, anyway.

“He loves his son, and he knows fully well you will never mate with someone else. He loves you, and that’s why he will want to attend your one and only wedding,” Phainon continued, regardless of Mydei’s own spiraling thoughts that were consuming his mind.

Effortlessly drawing him out of them so easily all while Mydei only felt Phainon’s claws pressing into his thigh tenderly. 

“Your father loves you dearly, and that’s why I’m certain that even if he is angry over the situation; he will still attend,” Phainon murmured sweetly, enough to where Mydei found himself snorting over that. 

“.. Are you sure he won’t just be attending so it looks good for Castrum Kremnos?”

“Your kingdom was at war for decades, I do not think your father actually deeply cares about looking good to Aedes Elysiae’s people,” Phainon argued with a little tutting noise following his words right after, “He will come because he loves his one and only son.”

Mydei couldn’t help the laugh that left his chest so unbridled - so easily that it almost gave him a headache as soon as he let it flutter out of his own lips. Such an easy thing that it made him only chuckle a little as he brought a hand up to his own head - pushing away his bangs before breathing out a deep sigh.

Right.

Phainon hadn’t meant it that way; but he was right. Their reputation as a kingdom mattered so much less than his father had pushed into his head for years - what reputation could he be trying to uphold when they were known for war? They were only just finally ending such a thing, and to not attend at least for unity.. Even if it was not about their kingdom’s reputation, such a thing was already in tatters from years of pain the other kingdoms brought upon each other, huh?

“Come here,” Mydei demanded, and the speed at which Phainon’s face appeared above his own was something to be admired. If anything, he didn’t feel himself questioning how Phainon felt - not anymore. Not when that dragon always moved so immediately to be at his side, so clingy and wanting towards Mydei that it made Mydei’s own instincts curl over it.

A sick and twisted feeling of delight that clung to him as he stared upwards at Phainon who was merely staring right back at him. Cobalt eyes so wide as he waited for Mydei to reply all while his hair messy framed around his face. It was cute, really. It almost made Mydei forget just how vicious this person that fawned over him actually was.

Not towards him, of course. Mydei had learned that much as well, and it was only proven further as Mydei reached up to press his hands against both of Phainon’s cheeks - smooshing his face together and watching the way Phainon seemed dazed.

“Thank you,” Mydei found himself saying as he blinked at Phainon - squeezing his cheeks together just a little bit more as he watched Mydei give him a rather bizarre and crooked smile. 

“‘S nuffin. Anyfing ‘or you.”

Mydei couldn’t help but to squint a little over that, “.. What?”

Phainon laughed quietly over that, all while his hands moved to lay on top of Mydei’s own -  threading their hands together before pulling Mydei’s away from his face, “It’s nothing, anything for you. And besides, I wasn’t lying to comfort you; I was telling the truth, that’s all.”

“.. Thank you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 22

Chapter Notes

warning a man is eaten in this .

“You seem stressed,” Phainon mused, though he never could get over the sight of that man today,  “You’re supposed to be more relaxed now that we’re married, you know?”

Phainon asked with a teasing lilt, a smile dancing on his lips as he stared at the man fully dressed in white. So clean and well dressed for this formal day that Phainon found his hands twitching constantly at his side to remain under control. 

He had never seen Mydei wear formal attire, let alone with his hair slicked back a little and gold fully covering every draconic piece of him. Looking more and more like a treasure for Phainon to hoard away than anything else, so beautiful and flawless that he felt almost angered that the rest of the world was able to see how perfect his mate was. 

Though, right now, his mate in question was wearing such a heavy scowl - appearing as if he was much too bothered by something as he stood a bit to the side of the refreshments table. An oddity, really, considering this was Mydei’s wedding just as much as it was Phainon’s, but he knew him very well at this point.

Only finding his own feet moving closer to Mydei with a hum in his throat, eyes watching the way Mydei continued to cut his cake into pieces as Phainon neared him. 

“My mind is quite busy today,” Mydei replied without any humor in his voice - eyes still staring at his plate in favor of looking up at Phainon. A clear sign that he was doing his best to avoid looking at anyone in general, really.

But that only made Phainon scoff a little over how silly Mydei truly was sometimes. 

“You should give me your burdens so you can rest, then,” Phainon reasoned as he felt his own tail swaying behind him amusedly - leering a bit towards Mydei as he stepped ever closer. Just simply.. Happy to be able to watch Mydei like this, even if Mydei didn’t care he was being watched by him, it was nice! 

“Easier said than done. I need to speak with my parents and act as if I’m..” Mydei trailed off, his fork no longer moving as his brows furrowed together and maybe, a few weeks ago, Phainon would have felt dread over that.

A worry that Mydei was forcing himself to be here and to be married to Phainon, that their vows had meant nothing and now he only felt a pit of regret inside of him. But Phainon now knew that man didn’t relate to that, not with how increasingly clingy Mydei had become towards him as well - every day only adding to his own instincts assuredly, and that.. 

That made Phainon swoon when he considered the way Mydei was slowly becoming more and more attached to him so sweetly.. 

Now Phainon merely had to offer a simper smile - doing his best to console him, “As if you’re..?”

“Excited to see my father again,” Mydei muttered out, and Phainon had assumed that would be the issue today, “I feel dread more than anything..”

Phainon hummed over that, moving to take his spot to the side of Mydei as he looked at the crowd of royals and upper class people. Eyes staring at the way Elysians and Kremnoans were rather awkwardly talking amongst each other, but trying their best and truly Phainon wasn’t sure if he had expected much better anyway. 

He found it rather nice, regardless, even if as his eyes found their way to the table Kephale and Mydei’s parents were at it was so blatantly obvious the two kings still did not see eye to eye. 

Phainon had to wonder if anyone but Queen Gorgo saw eye to eye with King Eurypon, anyway. But he supposed that wasn’t really his place to speak as he sighed a little. 

“My poor Mydeimos.. It’s alright, should I accompany you?” Phainon cocked a smile to his side as he watched Mydei, staring at the way Mydei only seemed still so very distracted with his plate of cake. 

“Yes,” Mydei huffed out, his fork clacking a little as he smacked it into the porcelain plate in his hand - a sharp noise ringing out that was unlike Mydei, but Phainon didn’t mind it at all, “To appear as a doting husband to everyone.”

Phainon had to laugh at that, nodding his head a little over those words before clicking his tongue - feeling the warmth from his sweet mate radiating against his own silken white attire. 

“Of course, and not because you’re leaning into me and feeling clingy, right?” Phainon teased once more, fully aware of the way Mydei was pressing into him for comfort so cutely. An act that was more than a little enjoyable to Phainon, and one that he welcomed so very much. 

“.. Of course not,” Mydei sighed out, still not moving away from Phainon, “That would be absurd for me to do.”

‘Absurd’ was a humorous way to phrase it, considering they had both been advised to be as lovey-dovey as possible to make sure the kingdoms knew Mydeimos was not being held against his will and forced into a marriage. A funny task to complete where Phainon was concerned, considering he was ‘lovey-dovey’ always to Mydei anyway.. They were really requesting him to be more romantic in public for the joy of it. 

“Mm,” Phainon hummed over that, though his eyes were still watching the way Mydei wasn’t taking a single bite - still chopping it to bits and murdering the poor thing more than tasting it, “Is the cake to your liking, at least?”

“Yes, It’s precisely what I asked for.”

Phainon felt himself huffing out a small laugh as he moved behind Mydei, rather leisurely taking his time before wrapping his arms around Mydei’s chest to prop his head against Mydei’s own. Rubbing their heads together just a tiny bit before he sighed a little - head dropping so he could try his best to angle his whispers into Mydei’s ears around his horns. 

“Are you sure you’re not stress eating to avoid speaking to your own father, Mydeimos?” Phainon asked as his eyes only keenly watched the way Mydei seemed so focused on his own plate - head tilted down a little as his fork met with the plate again and again. Those acts didn’t seem like they were nearing the end, not even as Mydei scoffed over the question.

“I would never do such a thing.”

“.. No, I’m sure you wouldn’t. But I just have to wonder how small of bites you can chop your cake into..” Phainon mused as he stared at the bits and pieces that were messily on Mydei’s plate. A crime scene, really.. 

“Be quiet,” Mydei growled out, though he was lacking any real venom in his voice as he turned slightly - just enough to be able to look Phainon in the eyes as he immediately offered his fork. A sassy movement, but Phainon always found himself obeying Mydei as he opened his mouth to let that fork slip into his mouth.

That was an easy burst of flavor, one that was almost jarring but always accepted - mainly because it was so deeply rich in strawberries. Soaked in it in a way that made him feel the urge to happily purr over the way it almost matched how Mydei smelled. An addicting sensation that made his tail vibrate as he leaned into Mydei even more as that fork left his lips. 

“Do you like it?” Mydei asked after a moment, seeming as if he was still so very distracted as his head only turned to focus back onto his cake. An action that only made his hair seem so much prettier to Phainon as he watched those golden locks slowly frame around his face slowly with the hang of his head. 

“It’s tasty,” Phainon told him after a moment, licking his own lips before smiling more, “But I’m just happy you like it..”

Mydei made an odd noise at that - heavy and low as if he was sighing with his full chest before his head shook a little from side to side, “Do you ever say anything not merely sappy? What of your own wants and desires?”

That was a silly question though, one that only served to make Phainon chuckle a little as he watched the way Mydei was giving up on cutting his cake into pieces now. Seeming as if he was forfeiting it now that he had been pointed out to be piddling by Phainon.. 

“My wants and desires are all you, so I would say I’m doing quite well in that regard!” Phainon chirped out as he only dug his fingers into Mydei’s silken fabric a little. Clinging onto that white adorned man while rubbing his head into him a little, his tail always seemed to have a mind of its own however - always wrapping around Mydei’s own in a needy and rather greedy way.

Though, he supposed it wasn’t a very bad thing with how Mydei had never commented on it or tried to tug his tail away. Always working to let Phainon do as he pleased to him and Phainon was so.. Very greedy..

“Sappy yet again.. I should play a drinking game over it,” Mydei mumbled out in a way that only served to make Phainon bark out another laugh. 

“Let’s not get drunk before meeting with your father, beloved,” Phainon hummed, refusing to let Mydei avoid his own father in case he would regret it later, “And it’s bad for the babies.”

“They’re eggs, not actual fetuses, you fool,” Mydei pointed out in a growled out voice, probably becoming a little perturbed by Phainon’s antics, but he couldn’t help it!

He loved to make sure Mydei was happy, even if Mydei was going to be annoyed at him for the time being..!

Besides, Phainon found himself swooning over that, “I love when you’re snippy to me..”

Mydei sighed once more at that before moving to set his plate on the refreshments table - not caring enough to sort it out before he left or to waste food. Clearly thinking that he would be back for it all while he tugged himself free of Phainon’s arms around him in general.

“Come on, let us go meet with my father..”

“Mhm,” Phainon quietly agreed as he followed after his husband, his eyes only staring at the mess of gold that was draped over the back of Mydei’s head as well. It was beautiful, really, with how much it all added to him.. Mydei was always glittering and golden, and yet now it was so much more obvious. 

Bright and charming in a way Phainon felt his stomach twisting and churning over as he stared at Mydei. That feeling that had been always in his chest from the moment he met Mydei was only getting worse and worse with every day - an idle emotion that sometimes would be roused and claw into his throat to choke him as he watched Mydei navigate around people. Watching the way his mate so clearly did not want to speak to people.

.. And Phainon didn’t want him to speak to them either.

He didn’t want Mydei to speak to anyone but him, he felt so painfully jealous every time those stunning eyes were on someone that wasn’t him that it was drowning him almost. Horrible emotions that he barely knew how to process, let alone if he should even try. 

It felt more enticing to let himself listen to bury Mydei into his bedroom, to trap him there and have him all to himself, to not let anyone else see the person he treasured more than anything else and make sure he was safe.. And yet.. All he could do for now was offer fake little smile to the people who were congratulating them both, shaking his hand and shaking Mydei’s.. Touching Mydei..

It was enough to drive him insane. 

“Mother,” Mydei’s voice ripped his from his own thoughts, blinking his eyes upwards to look at the round little table that only housed the current royalties that were all merely staring at the both of them. 

Though, one did seem much more excited than the other two kings to see them, “Mydeimos! It’s lovely to see you again, I hope you’re quite happy with your wedding!”

“I am, it’s been a very nice day,” Mydei replied, all before moving a bit to the side - clearing Phainon’s view and allowing him to blink at the table of very important people, “Right, Phainon?”

“Of course! I cherish all of my time with Mydeimos regardless of the occasion!” Phainon happily stated, because that was the easiest thing for him to agree to. It wasn’t a lie, and if anything, he only wished he could cherish Mydei more and more.. 

“What a sweet man you are,” Queen Gorgo spoke with a heavy sigh, a smile on her red painted lips that only curved more as Phainon met her gaze, “Treat him well, or else you will have to face my wrath.”

“.. Yes ma’am,” Phainon nodded, even if it was silly to even consider him treating Mydeimos poorly.. 

“Mydeimos,” King Eurypon spoke for once, making Phainon snap his head to the side to stare at that man with such a blank mind that it almost felt more odd than anything, “Congratulations on your marriage.”

“Thank you father,” Mydei replied in a voice that was more rigid than Phainon had heard all day long. So obviously stressed and worried over his father that it was bleeding into his words now. It almost worked to make Phainon just as nervous when his eyes looked at Mydei, staring at the way he seemed so very stiff without showing emotion on his face. 

“Phainon Elysiae,” Eurypon snapped his thoughts away from him however, forcing him to look at him instead of taking in the sight of his rather worried husband,  “You are no king yet, but I do implore you to hold yourself to the standards of a king and treat your partner well.”

.. That felt almost idiotic of Eurypon of all people to be saying to Phainon when he wasn’t even sure how Eurypon had treated his own child.. But he couldn’t voice that either, instead forcing himself to give a political smile just as he had been taught to his entire life. 

“I would never do anything less than that, nor could I even imagine it,” Phainon mused with a wave of his hand, his eyes only watched as Eurypon stood to immediately walk away as if he was suddenly so very busy.

“Excuse me,” That man said with a small bow of his head, only before walking away so swiftly that Phainon almost found it to be a little amusing. To watch his husband’s father practically run from them.. 

“That was abrupt..” Mydei mumbled much too quietly, most likely only intending for Phainon to hear him, yet.. 

“He’s been rather busy this day speaking to his councilmen,” Gorgo sighed out instead,  “Please excuse him.”

Mydei only scoffed a little over that, “.. It’s for the best.”

Words that only served to make Gorgo flash an expression of worry - one that Phainon could relate to, but he had no idea how to help Mydei either with this issue, “Mydeimos..”

“Please excuse us as well, mother,” Mydei breathed in a tone that only made Phainon’s mind reel a little - he sounded as if he were doing his best to bury his own hurt beneath any layers he could manage to conjure up, “I fear I..”

And then he trailed off. 

It felt so out of character for Mydei that Phainon couldn’t help but feel an odd amount of pity for the man - his ears pricking to listen to the murmurs of people enjoying their wedding. All of them seem so blissfully unaware of the way one of the crown princes were struggling at their own wedding.. But Phainon had somewhat expected this - he had come to terms that Mydei’s greatest weakness was his own family and the people he treasured and desired to protect. 

And that was precisely why Phainon could only find himself grasping at Mydei’s hand, threading their fingers together tightly with a smile on his face, “Mydei has been having a few drinks! I want to take him to bed so he rests well, please pardon us!”

Phainon didn’t waste a single moment after that, instead immediately yanking Mydei away from that table without even sparing a word to his own father. Not that it mattered, Kephale was more than a little aware of their situation and had the ability to see them after their wedding. But for now, Phainon found himself humming as he tugged Mydei away. 

“I..” Mydei breathed out, “What a foolish lie, my mother knows what I am like when I drink.”

“Really? Are you that different?” Phainon asked as he still remained leading Mydei away, his eyes twinkling as he looked over his own shoulder to study the way Mydei seemed so focused on him. Golden eyes were studying him as if he was untrusting of Phainon for some reason, and that was a humorous thought considering Phainon could feel the way Mydei was squeezing his hand to hold onto him. 

“.. I do not hold my liquor well,” Mydei confessed, and Phainon had to keep his laugh in his throat over the way Mydei sounded as if this was such a grave thing for him to admit as Phainon walked across the grass now.

.. He would have personally preferred that their wedding venue was indoors instead of outside, but Mydei had muttered something about it being ‘too stuffy’ inside that made him fold in an instant and agree with him. 

Phainon had to laugh as he a bit eagerly led Mydei away, not caring at all about whatever their guests would have to attend to now that the two newlyweds were absconding rather swiftly.

“Now I’m curious.. I’ll get a few glasses of wine sent to our room, okay?” Phainon spoke as loudly as possible as they worked their way up the stairs and into the castle’s main halls once more. Making his desires more than a little known to the guards who were rather closely lurking around near the both of them. 

“Do as you please, I am.. Rather glad to be out of these,” Mydei muttered as he allowed himself to still be dragged along, his open hand already working to start untucking his shirt from his pants as he huffed loudly. 

“Not big on formal events?” Phainon asked as he was now welcoming the sweet sound of silence instead of the musical group that had been distantly in his ears the entire day. 

Phainon couldn’t deny the way he couldn’t look away from Mydei as they walked however - watching the way Mydei was hurriedly tugging off his tie and shrugging off his coat all before a finger moved to unbutton his top button on his white shirt. As if he was more than a little desperate to escape all of his clothes, and that..

That idea only sounded more and more likely as Mydei huffed over the question, “No, it’s much too stuffy and rigid.”

“You’re so cute,” Phainon mused with a quiet hum as he watched Mydei only continue to try to shed his clothes with a hand in Phainon’s own, “I agree though! I’ll be more than happy to just be in bed resting with you soon!”

Phainon chirped out those words and he fully meant them, even though he knew resting wasn’t.. Really going to be on their agenda for a bit while longer. He could only pray that Mydei would forgive him for that much, and had to think about how Mydei had asked about their traditions idly as well. 

“Ah, Mydei.. Before we go inside our bedroom.. I feel like I should prepare you..” Phainon began to spill his thoughts - feeling them mounting more and more in his own mind before he sighed a little as they turned into his bedroom’s hallway. 

It wasn’t as if he dreaded such a thing, he merely.. Wished Mydei could rest instead of having all these duties to attend to. Though, he wouldn’t call this one a very stressful duty and yet..

“Prepare me? For what?” Mydei asked in a voice that didn’t sound shocked at all, in fact, he sounded as if he had fully expected something like this.. Naturally, he had asked about it but Phainon still..

He had to sigh a little over his own thoughts; “Well.. Are you hungry?”

“.. Not particularly, why do you ask?”

“Could you eat?” Phainon asked as he let go of Mydei’s hand - instead placing it on his bedroom door before turning to look at Mydei with an innocent expression on his face. At least, he hoped he was coming off as innocent or charming.. Anything to make Mydei less willing to choke him to death at the very least.

Though, Mydei only cocked his head to the side a little, “Is this a part of your traditions?”

“.. Kind of, I suppose. Just one that they seem to be enforcing onto me in specific,” Phainon sheepishly explained, darting his eyes to that closed wooden door a bit nervously as he tried to riddle out how to even explain this to Mydei. 

Well, he had to assume Mydei was becoming more than a little used to things like this.. At least for his own sanity Phainon found himself hoping that Mydei was doing that.. 

“That’s worrying,” Mydei huffed out, still curling a finger into the tie that was so tight around his neck and pulling it to loosen it before sighing a little, “Though..”

“Hmm?”

“Are you implying there is.. A body in our bedroom?”

“Well..” Phainon found himself sighing a little as he pushed on the door of his own bedroom - opening it and moving into it without a single word further. His eyes only watched as Mydei copied, though, Mydei wasn’t looking at him, instead.. He was focused on the more obvious thing in the room.

“Yes,” Phainon mumbled as he shut the door behind them both before spinning a little to look at the deceased person on the floor. A mess of blankets beneath him, thought that most likely would not help the puddle of blood that would be forming on his bedroom’s floor eventually.

An issue that he himself didn’t care enough about to try to figure out, not as he instead found himself only staring and watching the way Mydei was studying them. That golden dragon moved languidly, his tail just barely twitching to show he was wholly focused all while he kept his brows knitted as he walked around the body as if he were a vulture circling his meal.

Ironic, really.. 

“They’re..?” Mydei questioned, and Phainon could only click his tongue a little in amusement as he moved a step closer behind Mydei as well - watching the way Mydei’s head cocked to the side as he studied him so very closely. 

“They’re dead, they were instructed to kill them when we left the venue,” Phainon explained as he watched the way Mydei only stepped away - though his eyes never actually moved away from the body as he instead began to pull off his jacket once again. 

“R..Right,” Mydei nodded in between throwing that spotless white jacket onto the bed without much effort, “And what are we..?”

“I am to feed him to you.” Phainon confirmed with a little nod, already aware that Mydei probably had not needed such a thing. 

“Ah,” Mydei mused in a tone that only seemed to agree with Phainon’s thoughts, “His blood?”

“No,” Phainon tutted a little over how he wished it was that simple - at least with blood Mydei didn’t seem.. Too adverse to it,  “For our children to grow up as strong as possible, doctors have instructed me to feed you my own diet to help aid your egg growth.”

Those words from Phainon were enough to earn an odd look from Mydei - almost a glare if not for the way he seemed to be almost defeated. As if he had been expecting such a reply, all while he pressed out a heavy sigh that was in his throat as well, “.. May I request that wine sooner than later? I do not believe I’ll enjoy the flavor of raw intestines..”

“My apologies.. I..” Phainon trailed off - unsure of how he could even make this situation any better as he swallowed a bit harshly. Feeling his own tail cling against his leg in his growing worry over how Mydei seemed less than thrilled over all of this.

But Mydei only waved his hand idly, “I’ll endure it, I just will not be overly pleased about it.”

“I can only be thankful to you..” Phainon breathed out, feeling his shoulders sag as he sighed inaudibly in relief, moving deeper into the room to glance at the nameless dead body. A thing he never cared much for, though, they did need to eat before he fully went cold.

Cold meals were always the worst, in Phainon’s experience.

The bizarre thing was how Mydei immediately turned away however, not wasting a single moment as he instead moved over to Phainon’s dresser with a hum in his throat, “.. I feel as though I need to change out of wearing all white.”

“You can be naked if you want!” Phainon chirped as he watched Mydei, trying his best to ignore the way he too was a bit stunned over the shirtless deceased man in their bedroom. 

Not the whole eating him thing, just that it was happening in his own bedroom.. That felt much too messy.. 

“I am not doing that either,” Mydei grumbled as he was already going through Phainon’s draws - but it wasn’t as if Phainon cared. Everything he owned belonged to Mydei, he had said that time and time again, and now it was just a bit more literal considering they were in fact married now. 

.. That was a thought that made his tail wag so much every time his eyes moved down to look at Mydei’s hand, eyes only staring at the glimmering gold band on his finger and fondly purring over it.

“My clothes are too big for you, aren’t they? Not that I mind, I would rather like seeing you wear them,” Phainon mused as he moved a bit closer, tilting his head to the side to watch Mydei still going through his things. 

“They’ll work regardless,” Mydei muttered out as he was dragging out some of Phainon’s night attire, loose and not firm fitting at all; perfect for dirtying and not ruining them, “I just do not want to drench our wedding attires with blood..”

‘Our’..?

“Ah, you’re dressing me as well?” Phainon asked as he moved his arms to cross politely behind his back, leaning forward a little as he cocked his head to stare at Mydei in a studying fashion. 

“Yes,” Mydei huffed out, though Phainon couldn’t help the smile on his lips over the way Mydei was digging out some dark royal blue clothes for the both of them. 

“You know, the sight of you in my baggy clothes just makes me want to hurry and crowd you into our bed..”

“Control yourself. I want to do your traditions, even if they’re just lies for our children,” Mydei growled out, lacking any true venom as usual and only serving to make Phainon chuckle a little quietly. 

“Mm, and then after I can crowd you into our bed..?”

“Yes,” Mydei mumbled, not even seeming phased by the question at all as he instead moved to undress himself. An act Phainon found himself copying a little bit more eagerly now that he knew he was going to be allowed to at the very least cuddle nicely with Mydei in bed for a while soon.. That made everything worth it today. 

“Yay,” Phainon hummed out as he immediately went to work undoing his own buttons with a renewed burst of energy, desperately tugging his wedding attire off before moving to set them onto his dresser. Out of reach of any blood, and safe.. All before Phainon tugged on his normal pajamas and instead moved to that man on the floor - huffing a little before wasting no time at all as he shoved his right hand into the ribcage there. 

Humming quietly over how easily skin and bones gave way for his own strength, only to hear a clicking noise from Mydei who was now moving to sit down beside him. 

“.. You are so messy, we’re going to need to bathe first if you keep that up,” Mydei told him in a teasing tone, light and gentle, and Phainon felt his mind freezing up regardless as he clenched his claws just a tiny amount inside that person’s chest.

Phainon licked his own lips before turning more to Mydei, furrowing his brows as he tried to figure out how he was supposed to ask for this when he wanted quality time with Mydei so badly..

“Mydei, can I.. Can I feed you in a way I really want to?”

“Yes.”

“You’re not going to ask how?”

“I trust you.”

Those were words that always made Phainon’s heart beat a little bit faster in his own ribcage, thudding so easily as he tried to figure out how he was so painfully lucky all before he laughed a little.

His mate really was much too sweet to him, he knew that much.

“Good, lay down,” Mydei huffed at his words, but Phainon only felt more and more pleased over the way Mydei obeyed and had rather lazily laid down on the floor. A place unfitting for Mydei, but Phainon was making do with what he had currently. Only moving so instantly to straddle Mydei against the floor as he wrapped his tail against Mydei’s leg, moving so precisely to avoid putting any weight on their children buried inside of him all while he smiled down at Mydei.

That sight was something he truly couldn’t get over with that fiery hair skewed everywhere, so beautiful and eye-catching that Phainon always found himself at a loss for words. Especially when he stared at the way Mydei’s eyes were so soft right now, gentle and kind, the eyes of a dragon who was content to just stare right back at his own husband with all the trust in the world placed in him.

Phainon couldn’t help the quiet trill that left his throat over it, “Good boy.. You’re so good for me.”

“Keep speaking like this and I will get up,” Mydei growled out - though those words were only just as sweet as the rest of Mydei right now. His body not moving at all to completely betray the threat he was making, clearly enjoying his new position beneath Phainon. 

“No, don’t,” Phainon whined out a little, moving already to feel his hand making a purchase on something so soft and squishy in his hand as he kept it leaning to his side and inside that man’s chest, “Stay down.. You’re so pretty like this.”

Phainon didn’t hesitate even more a moment as he ripped it out with his claws - his ears long since used to the tearing of veins and tendons in his ears. Noises that were almost sickeningly comforting when he thought of them for too long, though he didn’t care to think of how he was still feeling hungry.

As if normal food really couldn’t satisfy him anymore, only leaving a bit of a void in his stomach as he licked his lips before dragging that bloody hand to them. One that was now so obviously holding up a specific organ that should be beating, one that only made him chuckle a little as he brought it closer to the both of them. 

His eyes were mainly only watching Mydei, though - staring at the way his own eyes widened so innocently. He obviously had never imagined he would be fed a human heart, and yet, Phainon couldn’t help but move to lick a stripe up that heart. Tasting that familiar blood and metal, enjoying the way Mydei seemed to squirm just a little bit over the blood dripping onto him.

Phainon couldn’t find it in himself to care though, not as he bit down onto that heart and ripped into it so easily with his teeth. Enjoying the way Mydei only seemed to wince a little over it, all before Phainon dragged that heart away from his own mouth - instead leaning more and more over Mydei with a smile on his bloodied lips.

And that was all it took before he lowered himself to crash his lips and full mouth into Mydei’s own - drinking in the way Mydei gave a noise of muffled shock yet his mouth opened so obediently to be fed by Phainon. 

Phainon could sense it; the way Mydei wasn’t thrilled about this, the way his head was moving a little to avoid Phainon shoving more food into his mouth and past his lips. But Phainon couldn’t stop himself, hand only jerking up a little as he remained crouched there to grip Mydei’s jaw, wrenching it open further to hear such a sweet and cute noise of annoyance from Mydei over it.

Weak and hushed, as if he was just upset that Phainon was pushing claws harshly against his face and not the deep taste of blood and guts swirling into his mouth messily. Phainon felt almost guilty over the way it always riled him up even more - to hear noises from Mydei of his own struggle all while his eyes still remained closed as if he was enjoying the kiss and forced feeding. Yet Phainon could never bring himself to match Mydei, instead much too eager to stare and watch that man whimpering into their bloody kiss.

He couldn’t help it - he adored the sight of Mydei too much to ever close his eyes and bask in the feelings of it all. Feeling couldn’t compare to watching Mydei enjoy it or hearing him whimper into their kisses. Not even as Phainon pulled away to watch Mydei try to gasp for air, golden eyes fluttering open as Phainon only messily bit more of that lukewarm heart and let the blood continue to drip onto Mydei’s body.

It didn’t matter, not as Phainon only pushed their lips back together and made his beloved eat all of it, desperate to hear those sweet whines more and more. Phainon couldn’t help but to stroke at Mydei’s face with his hand as he released his hold on his chin. 

This was simply a repeated act, only that made Phainon feel his tail tightening more and more as Mydei seemed just to give up and wait for his food to be delivered to his own mouth. And that was so painfully sweet for Phainon - watching the way Mydei merely sprawled out a little there. Appearing as if he was completely surrendering himself to Phainon and Phainon..

Phainon had never wanted someone more and more, “You’re so beautiful, Mydeimos,”

That was all he could find himself breathing out as he watched golden eyes blink open once more - taking a moment before registering fully and staring at Phainon. Looking upwards at him with a mess of red on his lips and down his chin, cascading down the sides of his jaw as well in such an awe-inspiring fashion that it only made Phainon want to lick him clean.

Yet he wanted to stare at that sight as well, taking in the way Mydei wasn’t even trying to clean himself either - fully aware it was useless when Phainon would only continue to feed him more and more.

Though, Mydei did give him a strange look - one that was more than simply intoxicating the longer Phainon studied it, unable to hold his excitement back as Mydei slowly opened his lips. 

“.. We need a bath.”
