“Mydei.. Are you alright? It’s been days..”

That voice was more than simply grating to Mydei’s ears, spoken so softly and gently that Mydei could do nothing but curl up a little bit more. Tucking his head down against the bed as he tutted his tongue a little and did his best to close his eyes as he willed that man to leave him alone. 

“Leave me alone,” Mydei growled out as he tried to ignore the way he could hear Phainon approaching him in the silence, every step seeming heavier than normal as if he were doing his best to make sure Mydei was aware of where he currently was.

“You need to get up and walk some,” Phainon argued against that, and Mydei found his tail twitching over the way the bed sank a bit behind him. A clear that Phainon was crawling into bed with him as they spoke, and a thought that only irked Mydei more and more.

His annoyance wasn’t to be understated either as a hand touched him finally - soothing and as sweet as ever as he moved to comb through Mydei’s hair with his fingers. 

“Don’t touch me,” Mydei snapped, but he didn’t make an attempt to escape that hand - only trying to curl more in towards himself,  “Don’t come near me.”

“Mydei.. I am your mate..” Phainon reasoned just as softly, but Mydei had been doing his best to ignore how much he actually wanted Phainon there and how insufferable it was that Phainon himself seemed aware of that.

Always moving closer to him even if Mydei hissed and demanded the opposite to happen, it was almost like Phainon understood Mydei even if no one else did. 

“You can get up and take a break from protecting them.. I’ll watch our eggs for you, okay?”

Mydei didn’t want that either. He didn’t want to leave Phainon if he was getting up, he would want to take Phainon with him. 

There was no winning.. 

“Your voice is like sandpaper to my ears,” Mydei huffed instead over the idea of that, feeling himself only move to curl around his eggs that were pressed against his chest on their bed protectively. 

“Mean, but I forgive you,” Phainon mused without missing a single second, as if he had been fully prepared for Mydei’s antics and refusals hissed at him, “Here..”

Mydei didn’t dare question what ‘here’ meant as he instead felt Phainon taking his place behind him like normal. Always spooning him and wrapping himself around Mydei as if he belonged there (he did), a comforting feeling that Mydei.. Did not quite feel like he deserved as he only kept his eyes closed with his fingers gently brushing against one of those smooth little eggs. 

“I told you to stay away from me,” Mydei grumbled out as he felt that dragon nosing against his head - so blatantly sniffing him as a hand only crept against Mydei’s waist. An action that was so very practiced now as Mydei growled a little over feeling Phainon’s fingers on his stomach against his clothes, all before they dipped lower.

“They’re my babies too, Mydeimos..” Phainon reminded him, but it wasn’t as if Mydei actually needed to be reminded of such a thing - only clicking his tongue and leaning forward a bit more into a ball as he knew fully well Phainon was inspecting their eggs. Even if he was trying to do his best to hide it with kisses planted onto Mydei’s nape, Mydei knew fully well those fingers were slowly feeling all of their children to make sure they were safe.

It should be sweet, but something about it only made Mydei feel a bit bitter. Not towards Phainon, but towards himself every time Phainon checked on their eggs..

 “I’m just checking on my beautiful mate..”

That was something that was worthy of shame in itself. To need to be ‘checked on’ and pampered as if he were some type of child who was having a tantrum. A piece of him wanted to argue that he almost was just that.. That he was throwing a tantrum and trying his best to hide away from everyone and his own feelings, but even he was allowed to feel a bit of sorrow as a prince, wasn’t he?

“You laid them almost a week ago, they won’t hatch for quite some time. You can leave them for a bit, Mydei,” Phainon hummed into his ear, only pressing more kisses to his neck. Soft and sweet in a way that only made Mydei feel his fingers twitching over the ticklish sensation driving shivers down his spine, “No one would dare come in here, let alone harm them..”

“I..” 

Mydei trailed off again as he blinked his eyes open, looking down at the way Phainon’s hand was in fact leisurely rolling over their eggs. Timidly checking them all and being just as equally protective as their clutch mother - an act that was so very tender, yet practiced in a way that made Mydei want to curl into himself more.

To think he was a man that had his mate worried so much like this.. It was uncharacteristic of him, yet he..

“I know, Mydei. I’m the person who understands you the most,” Phainon began with a hum leaving his throat, sounding as if he was growing more and more worried, “Moping in bed forever will not change anything, and it was only natural that not all six survive.. Having a clutch above one or two was already a feat.”

Only natural?

Mydei didn’t know if he agreed with that or not, but the fact two had not lived being laid were more than enough to depress him. Four were fine, that should be a perfectly good clutch and bring joy to him; yet the fact two had already perished only worked to make him into an overprotective mess, he supposed.

“Getting some sunlight and fresh air will be good for you, Mydei,” Phainon added after a few seconds of Mydei’s ongoing silence - as if he hanging lull in the air had been more than enough to make him try to conjure up more words to distract Mydei.

Not that he needed it or that it would work, Mydei was doomed to continue fretting over this considering it wasn’t something to easily forget. 

“I know,” Mydei grumbled anyway, very aware of the way Phainon was pressing his nose to the back of Mydei’s neck - every breath and word that he spoke only fanned over Mydei’s skin hotly. 

Something about those two words only served to make Phainon sigh a little from behind Mydei, as if he was doing his best to figure out what next to say all while his fingers moved from their children to instead press on Mydei’s stomach idly. 

“Come with me.. When have I ever wanted anything but the best for you, my heart?”

Even if Mydei wanted to snarl and growl at him, he couldn’t. He absolutely had learned that Phainon had really only ever wanted Mydei, and had that more than a little obvious with how he acted around him as well. 

“But they..” Mydei trailed off, unsure of how to fully voice his concerns with his eggs. 

They were just so.. Defenseless and vulnerable now, Mydei felt like he had to watch and coil around them every single moment he was alive to make sure they would be fine.. Even if they were buried under layers of blankets - Mydei still only wanted to feel them against his own chest.

To know they were still nice and warm.. Alive even, against him..

“No one will come in here. You think I haven’t been threatening people that so much as look down this hallway while you were resting?” Phainon purred out so cloyingly sweet, every word intoxicating to Mydei’s ears as he felt himself pressing against Phainon’s chest a little. A piece of him savored that warm feeling of Phainon against him so deeply..

“Up and at them, Mydeimos,” Phainon only continued speaking when Mydei didn’t reply, and Mydei could swear he felt that dragon’s tongue on his neck after those words as Phainon’s hand only rested on his hip heavily. 

“My eggs..” Mydei reinstated once more, not wanting to get up at all to leave them. If anything, he would prefer to stay like this and have Phainon just dote on him in bed.. Why did he have to get up and leave their soft nest where their children were safe and sound in his arms?

“Our eggs.. I would not allow anything to happen to them, alright? Come on..” Phainon was pulling away from him at that, moving to instead try to roll Mydei out of bed and he felt himself sighing over that.

This was the most Phainon had tried to get him out of bed, usually he mumbled something about preferring Mydei to stay in their bed where only he could enjoy him. But today.. This was obviously Phainon wanting him for something specific, and that was why Mydei was allowing himself to be pulled out of bed. Huffing a little as he sat up and was dragged fully out of bed by his much too large mate. 

“Where are we going?” Mydei asked as he idly watched Phainon fetching a pair of shoes for Mydei as he kneeled at the side of the bed instantly to put them on Mydei’s feet as they hung over the side. 

“Just to the garden, some fresh air really will be good for you,” Phainon replied as he offered a smile and his hand immediately, giving such a feigned air of innocence as he watched Mydei accept it. 

“You’re plotting something,” Mydei mumbled as he rose to his feet to follow after Phainon, feeling himself stiffen a little as they left Phainon’s bedroom but he supposed he couldn’t be that worried.

Not as Phainon turned to close the door after them both, a thing that wasn’t odd - but the way Phainon pulled out a key to lock the door with a click was.. More than a little bizarre to him.

.. Mydei didn’t recall the fact that the door could be locked from the outside?

Though, Phainon didn’t even comment as he immediately turned away with his hand still gripping onto Mydei’s so tightly to force him to follow him. Mydei’s eyes however were so very entranced in watching where that key went however, staring at the way Phainon slipped it back into his pocket without a word on the matter.

“Yes, yes I am! But you’re the one letting me drag you along, huh?”

“There’s still time for me to turn around and go back to bed,” Mydei argued right back - feeling his eyes narrow as he followed after that dragon and it was always just.. A little odd to Mydei to take a moment to truly take in just how giant Phainon actually was.

It was a feat he never thought too much over, such a giant man that Mydei really wasn’t sure how their eggs had barely been the size of just a bit larger than chicken eggs, but he was thankful for the mercy. But now as he followed after Phainon it felt so painfully obvious that he was really much too big.. Especially with his tail almost smacking into Mydei as they walked. 

“Please have mercy with my heart, Mydei. I’m so very vulnerable,” Phainon said anyway, turning to give Mydei such a happy little smile that Mydei found his mind stuck on that as well. Staring at the way Phainon’s teeth were so sharp and dangerous, yet were never used against him.. Only for other people and something about it made Mydei’s stomach churn as he dipped his eyes away - focusing instead on walking instead of at that overly large lizard constantly glancing over his shoulder at him.

Not that it mattered as Mydei raised his eyes a little to the guard who was moving from the side towards them both. Phainon had said something about them being more outgoing and protective over them both as of late, but Mydei hadn’t slinked out of bed enough besides to bathe himself to see it really.

Mydei opened his mouth to greet them a little, only to find his voice lacking - instead, Phainon yanked him forward just a tiny bit. Enough to where he almost found himself pressed against that man, and he wanted to chastise him, truly, he did. But instead he remained silent as Phainon spoke.

“Don’t bother us, I said that, didn’t I?” Phainon immediately snapped in a tone that made Mydei feel like he was more than a little confused over why that man was suddenly so angry, “That if he leaves our nest, he’s not to be bothered, and you still just can’t learn to listen?”

This was an odd voice to hear from Phainon - one that was so clipped and hurt sounding that it almost made Mydei feel like he wanted to comfort Phainon. To tell him it was alright and to soothe that man, his ears only keening to listen to the heavy sway of Phainon’s tail lashing so angrily. 

Phainon only continued in the prolonged silence, “Why? Why are you all trying so hard to anger me?”

That seemed to be more than enough to make that man scurry away, fearing for his life assuredly and Mydei had to hum a little over the situation and how annoyed his mate was so swiftly over someone coming around Mydei. 

“Phainon,” Mydei began as he took his hand from Phainon’s - not missing the flicker of hurt in Phainon’s eyes as he immediately snapped his head to look at Mydei. Everything about his expression only looked worried, so full of dread and blatantly praying that Mydei wasn’t upset at him or something like that.

“Hmm? Yes, darling? I’m sorry,” Phainon swiftly said, and that was enough to make Mydei sigh a little over how quick that dragon was to apologize to Mydei. To feel as if he needed to try his best to keep Mydei nice and pliant for him..

“You.. Nothing, it’s nothing.”

Mydei didn’t waste a single moment as he instead raised his hands up to grasp at Phainon’s checks - his thumbs gently grazing against those scales on Phainon’s cheekbones before he sighed a little once more. Pulling Phainon downwards to his level just a tiny bit enough to press a chaste kiss to those white scales on his cheek as well, finding himself so painfully fond of Phainon’s dragon features more and more as time went on.

And the effect of that kiss was hard to ignore as Mydei heard that thunderous tail began swaying and swishing so very happily over such a gentle showing of affection. 

“Mydei, Mydei.. We should get married again but alone this time,” Phainon hummed in that hallway, his hands moving to cup over Mydei’s own on his face as he looked so pleased with the situation. 

Mydei couldn’t help but chuckle a little over that, tilting his head as he raised a brow towards that eager sweet giant, “.. What kind of nonsense are you saying? We got married only a few weeks ago.”

“Come on, I have some things for you,” Phainon chirped out as he gripped Mydei’s hands a bit tighter now, pulling him with a renewed sense of happiness it seemed as he practically was dragging Mydei along.

Though, Mydei found himself only squinting a little as the sight of the garden came into view now - a thing he usually found a bit of solace in considering it was his and Phainon’s safe place. And yet, now he could only find himself pressing out a sigh.

“The amount of flowers on the ground.. What is this? Were you just going to refuse to take no as an answer?” Mydei asked as Phainon only continued to drag him forward - but that was fine. At least with Phainon leading the way he could spend his precious moments blinking at the red and white mixed petals on the floor.

“Well.. Yes?”  Phainon said with a little chuckle, not even looking back at Mydei over that.

“You are utterly incorrigible,” Mydei huffed out, only to find Phainon’s feet pausing to yank his hand again - so roughly pulling him to make Mydei blink his eyes in confusion as Phainon only laughed more.

His hand moved to be beside Mydei’s own as if he was displaying them both; “And yet, you’re still wearing that golden band around your finger that matches my own! Meaning your heart is still mine!”

“.. Of course,” Mydei scoffed over that display - shaking his head a little as he watched that giddy dragon only beam even more. 

“You’re so sweet to me.. Just agreeing to that..”

“Why would I not? It is just how you say, isn’t it?” Mydei questioned over the way Phainon seemed almost sheepish over his own words - and that really hadn’t made sense to him.

They were married and had a clutch together. It was only natural that his heart belonged to Phainon.

“Yes, I guess so!”

Phainon spun around at his own words, immediately moving to continue leading Mydei deeper into that garden that he had been to so many times before now. His feet stalling only a little as Phainon randomly dropped his hand and moved to the side, clearly wanting Mydei to take in the sight but he.. Didn’t know what to make out of it.

Those petals continued to lead up to it at their sides, making a false pathway up to a cloth on the ground. A white stainless knitted cloth with blue embroidery stitched along the edges - but the basket in the middle was what was making Mydei cock his head to the side a little over the sight of it. 

“What is this?”

“A picnic,” Phainon answered as he leaned forward a little, hands behind his back neatly as was habit with him as he smiled at Mydei,  “I spent a long time on it, you know?”

“.. You did?” Mydei found himself questioning that almost rudely, namely due to the fact he didn’t even know Phainon knew how to cook or anything in general. He was .. a rather pampered prince, considering the amount of deep religious ties his kingdom seemed to have towards him being from the clutch of Oronyx..

“Yes! I made all of the food, come on, come on..” Phainon spoke in a hushed way that made Mydei bite back a little laugh over how genuine he seemed but that was all the more reason why he had to give in always to Phainon. Finding his feet moving on their own to follow him over to that knitted quilt and making himself at home on a side of it.

A little bit amused as he watched Phainon quickly sit on the other side, all while his tail thudded against the grass behind him as if he was nervous. 

“Alright,” Phainon began with a little nod as he flicked the basket open, “First things first, I made an arrangement of food with help from some of the staff.”

“Help?”

“Well, I wanted to make sure it's tasty and I have little skill in cooking.. So they did help me, yes!” Phainon explained with a little nod as his hands were already digging out some of the contents, “But I promise it all was lovingly crafted by me.”

All before he perked up so much more.

“This one is yours, this one is mine!”

Phainon spoke those words in such a happy tone that Mydei almost felt guilty as he accepted that wrapped up sandwich. A thing he slowly unraveled and found his eyes only staring at the bread and contents of it in a baffled sort of way. Pointed ears.. A round face.. 

.. That was really all he could make out of it - it clearly had been cut to look like something, yet Mydei’s mind was absolutely blank over what animal he had been trying to make. 

Though, now as Mydei had it in his hands he couldn’t help but squint a little over how quiet Phainon was. Acting as if he was simply a needy little dog always waiting to hear what Mydei had to say about things or to approve of it. But Mydei really wasn’t sure how to approve of this.. Not when he was so confused over what little animal he was holding in the first place.

That was why he could only leisurely turn his head a little, making eye contact with those sharp blue eyes that always seemed to be on the prowl or hunting for something when it involved Mydei.

“.. What is this?”

“A cat. I tried to cut it into a lion at first since Castrum Kremnos seems to love putting lions into their architecture, but when I left the mane it just looked like a ball..” Phainon explained with a wave of his hand as he remained sitting to the side of Mydei, and he almost seemed well contained and proper.

Almost.

The thumping of his tail wagging and being so very happy was more than enough to give away his good mood and excitement towards Mydei inspecting his hard work. 

“It’s cute,” Mydei mused, though he himself wasn’t sure if he actually meant the attempt at cutting his sandwich into the shape of a cat, or the way Phainon was acting over it all. It was sweet, really.. Mydei did enjoy the way Phainon seemed to be so earnest in everything he did, unabashedly honest in his feelings towards Mydei that was reassuring.

Not to say that Mydei felt like he normally needed that reassurance, but.. Maybe right now he did, just for a little while he desperately did want to be reassured that Phainon still wanted to spend time with him and be around him.

.. To be reassured that he wasn’t a complete failure for having two of their eggs perish.

“Really? I tried so hard! You should praise me more for it,” Phainon purred out, and Mydei had half the mind to call him greedy - but he enjoyed it; why would he be upset by something he found himself liking about Phainon?

“.. You did a good job,” Mydei hummed out as he continued to look at that rather cute little sandwich - feeling more and more fond of it the longer he looked at it. 

The fact it was something Phainon himself had made for him only made it that much better and enticing to Mydei, a sweet show of affection through Phainon’s own efforts. 

“More,” Phainon replied over that though, and it was enough to make Mydei throw a strange look towards him - narrowing his eyes a little at him at the same time. 

“How about I try how it tastes first before you keep begging for praise?”

Phainon sighed so painfully dramatically at that, leaning back a little from his criss-crossed position to close his eyes and fully look as if that was the worst news he could have gotten. 

“That makes me nervous, maybe I should practice my carving skills so I can keep distracting you from the taste..”

“It’s a sandwich, Phainon. I do not believe you could be that tragic at putting the correct ingredients together to make it work,” Mydei mumbled out with a shake of his head, he didn’t think Phainon would have horrible tastebuds but he really had no idea. Considering Phainon had a taste for blood and gore, Mydei really had no earthly idea. 

“If it does taste bad, make sure to praise me again for how cute the cat is instead, alright?” Phainon worriedly and a bit jokingly said, but Mydei wasn’t sure where the line of worry and jokes bled or blurred - instead shaking his own head a little as he instead moved that bread to his lips to sniff at it a little.

A testing sniff, mainly because he himself hadn’t been overly sure that Phainon wasn’t trying to feed him blood or guts again. 

That had become rather.. Common practice while their eggs were in his womb that Phainon would worryly try to feed him some rather unsavory items and Mydei.. Well, he would sigh but he always found himself giving in and allowing Phainon to do as he pleased. After all, he too was just as worried about their children and if Phainon was right.. Then it was all for the better he listened.

It didn’t seem to be the case today as Mydei took a rather sheepish and meager bite of that poor cat, instead finding himself tilting his head over the flavors that greeted him there.

Tuna and mayo with some celery, it seemed. A light little meal that really was an odd choice from Phainon to be presenting to him, but it wasn’t anything bad. Just unexpected, really. 

“It tastes fine,” Mydei murmured as he swallowed his small first portion mouthful - humming a little as he licked at his lips to clean whatever wetness there was there. 

But Phainon only leaned forward towards Mydei a little, looking as if he was growing so very distressed with that review on his food; “Fine? Not great? Not perfect?”

“It is a sandwich,” Mydei pointed out as he lifted his head more to look at Phainon - unsure of what other glowing reviews he could put for the thing because really.. This was just a meal of mashing ingredients together and hoping they work together, not just that, but with a rather mundane recipe as well.

Phainon however clicked his tongue a bit loudly as that, immediately moving to dig through that basket again and Mydei found himself powerless but to watch with a brow raised to his hairline. Watching the way Phainon seemed to be searching for something in particular.

All before his expression lightened again, a small perking its way on his lips as he now had a second thing wrapped up to show Mydei, “Alright, I see. Here..”

“What is this?” Mydei asked so instantly but he already was accepting whatever Phainon was giving to him, and that was enough to make his own cheeks flush a little when he paid any mind to the way Phainon seemed to be smitten by that as well. The man so obviously showed such a soft smile on his lips in a pleased way that Mydei could only curse himself for accepting everything from him so easily.

“Strawberries and cream shoved into bread. A sweet sandwich for your dessert,” Phainon explained as Mydei unwrapped that little sandwich - cut into a fancy looking square that only made Mydei furrow his brows a little over how precise it was. 

Yet there was another thing haunting him as well; “.. I have only taken a bite out of the cat.”

“Yessir, and I tried to carve this into an animal but it became much too messy. Even when I carved it before filling the bread up..” Phainon sighed out, clearly not actually caring that Mydei hadn’t finished the tuna sandwich and blatantly wanting him to hurry up and move on to his  dessert.

“Am I supposed to eat my dessert first?”

“Why not? I’m going to,” Phainon mused a bit lazily, shaking his head as he leisurely seemed to lean back a little while unraveling his own matching strawberry sandwich. A thing that only made Mydei click his tongue over the sight of his mate sprawling out like this. 

“Your diet as of late has been horrid,” Mydei grumbled over it. 

That only served to earn him a baffled expression from Phainon as that man already swallowed down a bite of his ‘sandwich’, “I’m merely eating what you eat!”

“My diet as of late has been horrid,” Mydei agreed with a heavy sigh escaping him as that was pointed out, “We both need to exercise more..”

“Oh? Are you willing to help me with that, then? I’d love to help you stretch,” Phainon purred out in a way that made Mydei feel his brows knitting in the abrupt realization that he absolutely did not mean stretching in a normal way - even if Mydei had no idea which way he meant he just knew that it wasn’t good. 

“.. That’s a worrying statement from you,” Mydei found himself sighing out as he forced himself to close his eyes; doing his best to ignore the way he could tell Phainon was getting excited over this topic with his tail happily slapping against the floor behind him. 

It was amazing how Phainon no longer felt any sense of shame with these topics, really. The topics, and his instincts seemed to be haywire constantly as well. Everyone by now had told him how Phainon had once been rather collected with his emotions and smiled a lot, but his tail never did.. That.

Never wagged or swayed, never happily made such a loud thudding noise when it hit things in his eagerness. Instead, he never moved it much at all; it sounded foreign to him, and yet everyone agreed it was a reality before him.

Strange how that just had never existed for him, and Phainon had completely given up on the idea of controlling himself around Mydei and any resemblance of being controlled and proper. 

“What?! You’ve always been rather flexible! I’m sure you could bend in really crazy ways if I helped you,” Phainon whined out, snapping Mydei out of his own thoughts with that heavy thumping continuing as he opened his eyes to look at that dragon. Watching the way he seemed so happy - not at all matching his voice that was pathetic and sopping wet in his pleading. 

Mydei could only breathe out such a deep sigh over it, “You’re not helping me to believe you’re not having odd thoughts about this.”

Phainon’s head tilted to the side, eyes blown wide before he gave a rather sheepish smile, “Oh, was I supposed to be convincing you otherwise?”

.. Right, Mydei supposed he should have expected something like that as he clicked his tongue and breathed out yet another sigh. Feeling his own shoulders sag with the exhale as his eyes moved back to the dessert in his hand, and the cat sandwich now neglected in his lap.

“Have you no shame?” Mydei asked, but he already knew the answer that he would obtain from this man with such a foolish question. 

“I wasn’t aware I was supposed to have shame still in regards to being fond of my husband! Should we start stretching you right now?” Phainon asked, seeming much too eager to where Mydei knew fully well whatever that man was asking him about was not normal exercise.

A piece of him found himself wanting to agree to it, to let Phainon relieve him of a bit of stress, but the more rational part of him had to tutt a little. 

“I would prefer to just eat my sandwich in peace, not to be.. ‘Stretched’,” Mydei pointed out as his eyes snapped back and forth between his meal he had been dragged away from his clutch to enjoy. 

Phainon hummed at that, “Sandwiches. There’s two. Plural.”

“You are beyond insufferable sometimes,” Mydei countered, shaking his head a little as he said those words. 

“I know,” Phainon admitted, and Mydei couldn’t even doubt him with that much.

Instead he only moved to ignore that dessert, instead opting to focus on the poor cat sandwich who was flavored like tuna ironically to idly begin eating it. A meal that should be easy and simple, yet Mydei couldn’t help the way he could feel those blue eyes watching his every move.

Two hunter’s pupils that always seemed transfixed on him in specific, as if they were always scared that Mydei would try to make a run for it and he had to be ready to pounce on him ruthlessly. It was bizarre to feel like he was constantly watched by a predator, and yet, somehow, Mydei had grown more than merely used to those stares from that man. 

“Mydei,” Phainon began as Mydei only took another bite, “Have you thought of names?”

Ah.

So that was what was on Phainon’s mind instead of eating? 

Mydei had to tilt his head a little to look at Phainon, studying the way there were no true deep emotions on his face. Rather he looked.. Too blank on that topic, as if he was testing the waters with Mydei before showing his own true emotions towards it.

.. Just another situation where Mydei had to write it off as the more dragon instinctive side of Phainon, and not his actual thoughts. 

“No, we don’t know their genders or how to tell them apart,” Mydei admitted as he only continued to eat his sandwich, looking away from Phainon to instead watch his little cat slowly disappear with every new bite he took. 

“This is true.. Imagine how cute they would have looked with golden speckles from you on their shells..” Phainon muttered in a tone of voice that really sounded like he had already put so much thought into it, all before he laughed a little and gave Mydei a beaming smile, “But are there no names you ever considered for your children?”

“No,” Mydei flatly replied, namely because he had never thought about it before Phainon.

Marrying and having children was something he wanted, but it also was something that he had treated as a duty more than anything else. A job he would have to do one day as their king and now..

.. Now it was just out of love. 

Phainon only continued on with a little hum escaping his throat, “Four names.. Two for both of us..”

“You say that, but you have a history of just agreeing to most things I say,” Mydei pointed out with a tired little sigh - moving his free hand to rub his bangs back a little before idly moving his hand to his braid. Grasping at that familiar golden cuff at the end of his hair before letting go of it - just a little self soothing habit, he supposed. 

“Well.. Naming our children should be a combined effort I believe,” Phainon mused as if it were something he had been deeply pondering even before now, “It’s only natural I want to make sure my husband is just as happy as I am with their names..”

“And that they enjoy them as well,” Mydei added with a little huff. 

“Naturally.. Naturally..”

Mydei didn’t know what to say after those words from Phainon; instead he found himself falling into quietness as he tried his best to merely enjoy his meal. 

An impossible feat considering who he had married, he had to admit that much as he moved to bite into his sandwich once more.

“It’s quiet today,” Phainon murmured after a few moments, and that was enough to make Mydei pause his bites - instead glancing up at the trees that were around them in Phainon’s garden. His eyes only working to study the silence of the world, between the rustling of the leaves and the quietness of some water distantly nearby. 

There was nothing else for once, just the breeze and the both of them sitting there. It was almost jarring, if not for the way Mydei had already witnessed Phainon growling towards people and being rather unhappy with them coming near Mydei in general.

That was enough of a reason to tell him this silence was more than a little planned ahead, but Mydei found himself enjoying it either way. Even if he now found himself learning back to look upwards at the sky and how comforting just being around Phainon was for him, especially when Phainon gave him these quiet moments..

“Thank you,” Mydei mumbled after a moment, feeling his mind lacking any other words that felt correct at the moment as he instead moved to focus on eating his sandwich again while trying to ignore the way he could feel Phainon staring at him.

Not in a harsh way, just.. The average Phainon look that was always focused so squarely on him; focusing on him almost all of the time and seeming like he didn’t want to look away. Always acting as if Mydei was the most interesting thing in the world to him, and that.. That was something Mydei found his mind struggling with even now. 

“Mm,” Phainon hummed after a moment, shaking his head as he flicked his eyes to his own sandwich - looking at it for a moment before laughing quietly, “Nothing to thank me for, Mydei.”

‘Nothing to thank him for’ felt so bizarre to Mydei when he felt as though he almost owed Phainon for many things, only finding himself able to sit here and blink at the garden around them. Perhaps he only said that due to the fact they were married and mates, that they didn’t have to thank each other for these silly moments together due to their own love binding them together.

Whatever it was, Mydei only knew he was thankful to Phainon regardless of it all.

“.. I want to go back to my eggs now,” Mydei admitted as he finished up eating that little cat sandwich with a little huff.

“As you wish, dearest,” Phainon replied instantly, already moving a little to where Mydei had to scowl at that man - throwing such a harsh look to him to make Phainon instantly freeze under his eye contact.

“With my dessert sandwich, mind you.”

Phainon only laughed at that, such a genuine sound of joy that Mydei couldn’t help the way his cheek immediately started to burn over just how much he realized he was truly fond of that dragon who smiled warmly at him.

“As you wish, dearest!”

Chapter End Notes

Phainon’s fingers only rubbed into the palm of his own hands - nervously feeling his scales and claws there with an idle tapping of his tail against the floor. This had been a day he was looking forward to so very eagerly, and now he found himself looking back and forth from the doors they had been shut out of and his most beloved person in existence.

“Are you worried?” Phainon found himself asking as he tilted his head a little to the side, staring at the dragon with flaming red horns that were still so sweetly adorned with gold. Jewelry Phainon had gifted to him, and the amount of said jewelry only grew with the days that passed.

He couldn’t help it, his beautiful mate reminded him of the blazing sun, and all he wished to do was to gift him things he enjoyed. Besides, it made Mydei happy, and that was more than enough for Phainon as he watched him hoard his own riches in their bed.

Ironic, considering the only riches Phainon had ever wanted was that dragon who looked like he had been forged from melted down gold himself. 

“Not at all,” Mydei smoothly replied as his tail swayed just a miniscule amount - enough to draw Phainon’s attention to it with the sway of jewelry ringing against his ears, but not enough to be seen as more than Mydei shuffling his weight between his feet,  “If anything, I’m thrilled that they’re finally formally signing the treaty and ending the war. The idea of us going to war while we’re married was foolishly haunting.”

Phainon couldn’t agree with that more, feeling himself clicking his tongue over the idea of war over Mydei. He would happily go to those lengths, but he had seen how that man loved his mother; there was no reality in which that ended happily for Mydei. 

“I’m glad,” Phainon hummed in agreement, curtly nodding his head a little as his eyes returned back to those chamber doors that were hiding those royalties behind it, “I wouldn’t let you leave me due to a war anyway, I would actually make you my own personal prisoner and lock you in our bedroom.”

Mydei scoffed rather loudly over that, so obviously amused by that in some sort of fashion that Phainon wasn’t quite privy to, “You think a door could stop me?”

Of course not, he knew fully well that Mydei was a strong man - if anything, the door being locked was a warning to other people, not to Mydei himself. 

That was why Phainon had considered other options, chuckling a little as he shook his head slowly, “No, but enough chains may be able to!”

“Hmph. I find it hard to find that threatening when I would not be adverse to spending my time doting on our eggs,” Mydei mumbled a little bit quietly, still sounding like his mind was completely focused on Phainon.

It wasn’t hard to figure out why though, not when behind that door held both of his parents and Queen Polyxia once again discussing the matters of their kingdoms’ peace. 

.. Though Phainon was quite sure Mydei was only worried about one of his parents and the talk he may have to have with him after. 

That was precisely why Phainon couldn’t help but to continue with a distant little dreamy sigh, “Really? Can I get a custom made collar for you as well, then? A nice golden leash.. Gold cuffs for your ankles and wrists to bind you to our bed..”

There was silence with those words in a way that made Phainon only smile more - watching the way Mydei seemed to squint at the door idly before fixing his expression to be one of stoicness. Hiding away his own emotions beneath his sleeve as he instead continued to wait.

“.. I do not enjoy how much thought you’ve already put into this.”

Phainon couldn’t even deny the fact he had considered it so many times when he saw Mydei relaxed in their bed - enjoying himself and lounging around for hours at a time to where Phainon.. Found himself staring. Watching Mydei and looking at his body up and down, admiring every well-toned muscle that he had all while finding himself more and more desperate to keep Mydei to himself.

“And yet your tail is swaying while you’re still leaning against me,” Phainon pointed out, not making a single move from no longer having Mydei leaning on him either way, “My idea can’t be that off putting.”

Mydei scoffed at that, for once cocking his head to the side to throw an odd little look at Phainon's way with a raised brow, “I will not deny my enjoyment of gold; I am quite.. Basic in that field for a dragon, thus the idea of cuffs does not bother me.”

“Wow,” Phainon breathed out just a little bit smugly, unable to help the smile dancing on his lips as he looked at Mydei studyingly, “Just the collar upsets you, then?”

Mydei made a clicking noise with his tongue over Phainon’s words, “I am no animal to be collared.”

Phainon agreed with that, sure.. There.. Was just one issue.

“Mydei..” Phainon began with a heavy sigh as he felt his brows knitting together - trying his best to focus on the way his husband was still pressing his arm against him softly, “I wear a choker, remember?”

“I have not forgotten, you simply.. Are a dog. It suits you,” Mydei spoke as if that were the easiest thing in the world for him to say. As if he didn’t even think twice on how he was calling Phainon such a  thing.

It was more than enough to make Phainon feel his eyes blown wide - staring at his sweet partner who meant the entire world to him. And now he was calling him a dog.

“Huh?”

“They’re coming,” Mydei muttered, sounding a bit more worried as that door did in fact creak open with whispering and mumbles from the royalties leaving, but.. Phainon was busy. 

He couldn’t just let it slide; “Ignoring that. What do you mean I’m a dog?”

“You’re my puppy,” Mydei mindlessly told him, his tone not wilting at all to make Phainon blink so many times at those words..

.. Somehow they were nice to Phainon. His puppy. Mydei’s puppy..?

He was probably more than a little okay with that, or well, more fine with it than he really should be..

“W.. When you say it like that, I kind of like it a lot..” Phainon conceded as he instead faced towards the front as well, unable to help the way his tail was wagging behind him as he watched two very familiar people striding to them. 

“I know,” Mydei flatly said, and something about that made Phainon feel a little bit embarrassed; red in the face as he smiled towards Mydei’s parents coming over to them both. 

“Mydeimos..” Was the quiet greeting his mother instantly gave as they neared, not wanting to bother the other royalties who had instead gone off to speak to their own guards and advisors. 

.. Phainon couldn’t help but to glance at Eurypon at that, idly wondering just how angry he was that he had to speak to his son and his mate instead of that council he had heard so much about. It wasn’t too shocking at all to find Eurypon standing to the side of his wife either, not even looking at Phainon at all - merely staring almost hauntingly at Mydei instead.

“Mother,” Mydei replied regardless of it, and Phainon couldn’t help but to watch silently as Gorgo moved closer to him. Immediately getting to work at tucking a few of his bangs here and there incessantly - a caring and doting mother, he supposed. 

“Will you be coming home, Mydeimos?”

That was a question from Gorgo that made Phainon feel his entire body go rigid - stiff and aching as he heard those words. That was something he had never actually considered, and a piece of him was a little happy to hear he wasn’t the only one confused. 

“Coming.. Home?” Mydei echoed out in a quiet voice - hushed as if he couldn’t quite comprehend what his mother was asking of him, and Phainon..

Phainon hated this conversation, but the thing he hated more was the way he could feel Eurypon’s eyes studying him. Watching his every single move as if he were being crowded into a maze like a rat seeking cheese. It was annoying, solely because Phainon only cared to look at Mydei. To watch his own mate and his reactions to this offer..

.. And now he had to act as if this wasn’t the worst idea he had ever been privy to in front of his husband’s father.

How joyful.

“To Castrum Kremnos, beloved. You’re no longer a prisoner,” Queen Gorgo only told him in such a sweet voice - and Phainon didn’t even have to look away from Mydei to be able to tell she was giving him a look of pity.

An invitation to come home, that was something Phainon had never heard Mydei speak of or even seem to desire; and now.. 

“.. Mother, I have not been a prisoner here for quite a long while. The idea of me returning home instead of staying with my husband is..” Mydei trailed off for just a few beats, seeming as if he didn’t know how to word his own feelings before he pressed out a sigh,  “I never even considered it to be an option in my mind, to be honest.”

“That’s splendid to hear,” Gorgo nodded, sounding like she had actually expected some type of reply along those lines from him, “It lets me know  you’re doing well, even without asking..”

Mydei huffed quietly over that, “Mother..”

Gorgo didn’t seem bothered however, only smiling before she seemed to desire a new topic; “How are your eggs, anyway?”

“They’re well,” Mydei hummed out with a little nod, though he was so very stressed.

It wasn’t hard to understand why, not as Eurypon finally spoke; “It’s only natural for his eggs to be well, he is of Kremnoan blood.”

And that was a statement that made Phainon grit his teeth as hard as possible, not out of the fact he disagreed about Kremnoans being strong or whatnot, but the way Eurypon sounded almost.. Smug. As if he was gloating over something all while he continued to now ignore Phainon - instead staring down his son as if Mydei actually owed him something.

Gorgo sighed at that, “Your son is staying here, surely you have more to say than just that?”

And those were the words that brought such a heavy silence to the discussion - a silence that Phainon found himself tilting his head to the side over as his eyes only roamed around the trio of family members. A family by all accounts he was.. Apart of, technically, and yet he didn’t have a single word to say on this matter.

Not when Eurypon looked to be seething already over how this was unfolding, and Phainon.. 

Phainon couldn’t deny the way he found it a little amusing..

“Very well, may I speak to my son alone?” Eurypon spoke after a few seconds - his eyes only sliding to look at Phainon once again with such a heavy scowl that Phainon couldn’t help but raise his eyebrows over it.

If Mydei asked, he would obey and leave, but he had no thoughts nor a bone in his body to obey Eurypon of all people. Only cocking his head to the side a little at the same time Mydei had snatched his hand with such abrupt speeds. 

“No, we’ve discussed that before.”

Mydei raised his hand at that - turning it to show off that golden band around his ring finger that symbolized their relationship more concretely than anything else in the world. Well, better than most things, their eggs were also a testament but it wasn’t as if they particularly wanted to show off their children to everyone while they were still defenseless. 

“This is my husband, a title you’re more than idly aware of that he has now. You can speak in front of him freely,” Mydei mused in a voice that sounded more annoyed than welcoming - tired, as if he was at his wits ends with his father who was being so cold towards his partner consistently. 

Eurypon only stared at their hands however, appearing as if he was heavily debating something for a long few seconds before he sighed.

“Your husband has taught you t-”

“Eurypon,” Gorgo growled out, clearly giving the tone that she was scolding Eurypon before he could even fully finish his thoughts and.. Miraculously, it seemed to work as he closed his eyes for a mere moment to breathe out a heavy sigh as well.

There was a familiar silence that followed however, deafening in the way that Phainon still wasn’t sure if he should speak or if this was some.. Odd closure Mydei was going to obtain from his father finally. He could only hope it was the latter, though.. 

“Mydeimos, I am.. Glad to hear your marriage is out of love, and not merely necessity,” Eurypon spoke so rigidly, awkwardly moving to even be standing more properly - as if he was scared he would be scolded on his posture at any moment, “I wish you well.”

.. That didn’t sound convincing at all to Phainon, but he supposed it wasn’t for him to actually decide anyway. Instead he could only huff a little inaudibly and wait for Mydei’s reply. To listen and find out if his beloved mate accepted his father’s.. Rehearsed sounding well wishes. 

Though, Gorgo only spoke once more with a sharp gaze being thrown to Eurypon anyway, “And that you will be sending us plenty of letters, correct, Eurypon?”

“.. Yes,” Eurypon agreed. 

Thus, Gorgo waved her hand a little, “And that we will visit the children when they hatch, correct, Eurypon?”

“.. Yes,” Eurypon agreed once more, sounding a bit more defeated. 

There was that aching silence again as Gorgo pursed her lips - staring at her husband with a level of jaggedness that Phainon couldn’t really manage to read into too much. Instead finding himself watching as Eurypon shuffled his weight between his feet, for once seeming nervous over the way his wife seemed less than happy about everything.

All before Gorgo’s head snapped to the front again, a soft smile on her lips as she looked to Mydei, “And Mydeimos.. You’re happy here, correct?”

“Yes, I am happy here and have no intentions of leaving Phainon while you both are well,” Mydei, thankfully for Phainon’s own sanity, answered rather quickly with a curt nod. 

That appeared to work numbers on his mother, making a rather fond smile appear on her lips as he nodded just a tiny bit in reply to that as well, “I am glad, Mydeimos.. Truly..”

“Thank you..” Mydei mumbled softly, and Phainon found himself still so painfully adoring the way Mydei seemed to soften up around those he loved.. 

Even if Phainon found himself sucking in a heavy breath as Gorgo’s eyes snapped to him once more, narrowing as if she wanted to strangle him just a tiny bit. 

“And you,” She began, and Phainon had to resist the way he felt his hand twitch against Mydei’s who was still holding his hand - no longer showing off their matching rings, but still gripping onto him so tightly. “Take care of him, understand?”

“Yes ma’am, always,” Phainon agreed without a second thought, for that was the most logical thing in the world to him even under the gaze of a protective mother who was clicking her tongue at him and looking already furious. 

.. He could only pray she was angry at her husband, and not angry at her son’s husband.

She shook her head however, as if she was doing her best to wash away those emotions before turning on her heel quite swiftly, “Take care, both of you. Someone seems to wish to speak with you both as well so I will not delay you any longer, see you soon, Mydeimos.”

“Farewell, mother,” Mydei spoke in his hushed tone he normally had with his parents - calm and trying to appear as collected as he possibly could all while Phainon found himself in awe over it. That, and the way Eurypon had already begun to stalk away without even giving his own son a farewell, it felt.. Painful. But who was he to bite and gnaw on that man? 

Not that he had much time to give it any deep thought - instead he felt himself jerking a little over his own name so happily sang out, “Phainon!”

That was more than enough to make Phainon turn on his feet to look at the speaker of that familiar voice - feeling more than a little flabbergasted over the fact she had gotten behind them, “Cas?”

“Hello, hello! It’s nice to see you again,” That lilac themed princess spoke to him with a smile on her face - as sweet as possible and just as welcoming to where Phainon found it to be a breath of fresh air from Mydei’s parents. 

“You as well, I hope you’ve been well?” Phainon found himself asking with a smile on his lips, a much easier thing than facing Mydei’s parents who always seemed as though they dreamed of boiling him alive as if he were a lobster and ready to turn as red as a cherry.. 

“Absolutely! How are my grandchildren?”

That was a question that made Phainon wince a little, jerking his head back as he tried to process what exactly he had just been asked all while he felt Mydei grasping for his other hand. Seeking to replace the one Phainon had accidentally ripped away from him in his turn - and Phainon was always more than a little eager to give him whatever he desired as he felt soft fingers threading against his own. 

“P.. Pardon me?” Phainon choked out however, trying his best to understand that question. 

Though, Castorice only moved a little - putting her hands beneath her waist in such a prim and proper fashion that it almost made Phainon’s head hurt when he watched her head tilt to clarify; “Your eggs? How are they?”

That, however, only served to make Phainon feel more and more baffled as his mouth fell a little agape over that, “They’re your grandchildren?”

“Hyacine and I like to assume we are their grandmothers eagerly waiting to see them,” Castorice explained with a shake of her head as if it was the most logical thing in the world and not one of the more confusing things Phainon had ever been told. 

Mydei spoke up at that, “Ah, Where is Hyacine?”

Castorice’s eyes slid to Mydei to look at him instead, an innocent look that made Phainon still feel odd as he cocked his head to the side a bit, “Apologies, Prince Mydeimos.. But she did not come up to where the royal families are..”

“She is royalty, is she not? I would have allowed it,” Mydei mumbled softly, sounding defeated as he most likely was missing his friend, but Phainon found that odd to himself as well. 

“I told her as much, but she mumbled something about ah..” Castorice trailed off - her eyes dipping a little before she glanced at Phainon, a blatant plea for aid that Phainon could only raise his eyes over.

He knew fully well Mydei wouldn’t bite or snap at Castorice, but he supposed it was only natural the small dragon was still unsure of him. No matter how many letters, surely Hyacine couldn’t completely convey that Mydei was harmless through paper alone.. 

“Go on,” Mydei told her, and that made Castorice appear as if she was being fully scolded - wilting a little as she looked back at him. 

“Eurypon being fussy..” Castorice’s words were sputtered so quickly out that Phainon almost felt like he hadn’t correctly heard her, and well.. Maybe that was the goal as she only immediately carried on and tried to swerve the conversation, “Sorry, sorry! How are the eggs, Mydeimos?”

“They’re well,” Mydei mused with an odd lilt to his voice - one that Phainon knew fully well to be amusement as he threw a glance to his husband. Blinking at the way Mydei wasn’t bothered by the comment at all, probably due to the fact everyone agreed with Hyacine’s thoughts, anyway.. 

“They’re as round and shiny as ever! Mydeimos is so caring towards them, I love when he falls asleep curled up around them and his tail wrapped around his own legs..” Phainon chirped out as he moved a little bit closer to Mydei, practically humming out every single word and thought he had towards that golden dragon, “If you have a longer tail, I’m sure you would use that to care for them as well.. It’s so cute..”

Phainon couldn’t help the way his own tail was immediately coiling around Mydei’s - feeling the sharpness of his golden jewelry on his tail rubbing against Phainon’s sensitive underside, but he didn’t mind. He adored making a show out of how much he loved Mydei, no matter who it was watching them.

Mydei, on the other hand, only huffed out such a loud sigh over it, “.. Can you stop gushing over me in front of Princess Castorice?”

“It’s quite alright, Mydeimos! I was used to it from the very moment I was stuck in between the both of you..” Castorice chirped out much too happily,  “His affection towards you was so blatant that I worried he would maul me like a savage dog to get to you.”

Phainon couldn’t help but to lean forward a little, widening his eyes as he blinked at her over that, “You think I’m like a dog too?”

Though, her head only so painfully slowly turned to Phainon - so leisurely and languidly with unblinking eyes that Phainon couldn’t help but to swallow nervously,  “‘Too’?”

Phainon didn’t need to look at Mydei.

He could hear the way Mydei was closing his eyes over that singular word - an action screaming louder than any other words than anything else ever could. The more shocking thing was the way Mydei lashed his tail a little, snapping it out of Phainon’s own tail, but that wasn’t offensive to Phainon, not when he could tell Mydei was amused by it. 

“Ignore him,” Mydei huffed out regardless,  “Are you pleased with the outcome of the treaty?”

“Yes! I believe we are just happiest that the war has come to an end. Though, I do suppose it would have been hard for it not to when you’re both married and have a clutch..” Castorice sighed a little, and Phainon had half of his mind to assume she was also a little bit thankful that Mydei was taking the topic away from Phainon being Mydei’s dog.. 

Mydei didn’t seem to care about Phainon’s thoughts anyway, “How do you feel about that?”

“About your marriage or your eggs?”

“Our eggs,” Mydei clarified, and Phainon.. Did find himself tilting his head over that. Doing his best to fully listen into this conversation because truly..

He didn’t know what to think of it if people actually didn’t approve of it. He was more than a little willing to go to war over Mydei, but would people actually go to those lengths? Let alone considering both of their statuses? Even if Eurypon was unhappy, surely he couldn’t wage war against his one and only son.

“Oh,” Castorice said, “Polyxia and I discussed that before. We both agree that we do not care.”

Mydei visibly seemed to wince over that, “.. You don’t care?”

“I understand why you are asking me this, Prince Mydeimos. And our kingdom does not care that two different draconic bloods have mixed together,” Castorice explained in a tone that sounded.. More formal than normal, as if this was a matter that required her concentration to voice her true thoughts on it,  “I fully know Phainon would never do such a thing for power, and the way he has been acting towards you in letters from Hyacine leads me to only be absolutely sure of it.”

“So I reassure you, as much as your father has made it clear that he himself did not approve of your children or give you permission,” Castorice continued with a shake of her head, “Styxia does not care.”

“.. I see,” Mydei spoke after a few moments, and Phainon could tell that was a 

“My dearest is truly such a worrier, I told you before that no one would desire war with our two kingdoms,” Phainon waved his hand dismissively a little, “Even if your father talks all of that nonsense, it’s not as if he would wage war on his own son.”

“His wife would not allow it,” Castorice agreed, nodding immediately as if she too had already come to an understanding about how those two royal people’s relationship. 

“Yes, exactly, Queen Gorgo would never stand for it,” Phainon nodded along with her, whatever the case of her already understanding those two married people; Phainon still agreed!

Though, Mydei on the other hand sighed at that, “That is not overly reassuring.”

“It’s alright, Mydeimos..” Phainon didn’t even try to stop his affections as he leaned forward a slight amount - enough to sniff at Mydei a bit obviously as he pressed into Mydei with a smile on his lips, “I’ll be with you, always.”

The way Mydei’s jaw seemed to clench tightly couldn’t be understated as his eyes narrowed so dangerously at Phainon. A look from his most loved person that he was absolutely on to him and able to read through his emotions so instantly.

“Phainon, are you jeal-”

“Please excuse me! It’s about time I take my leave, I am wishing the best for both of you and I look forward to your children!” Castorice’s words were spoken so quickly and loudly that Phainon couldn’t help but cock his head to the side, watching her tail sway a little as she hurried and ran off.

That was enough to make Phainon bark out a laugh, “She left rather quickly!” 

“Curious, surely it has nothing to do with how you’re rubbing on me and lashing your tail,” Mydei muttered a bit quietly, clearly meant for Phainon’s ears and his alone as his tail ceased now. Humming a little as he thought about that more. 

Phainon couldn’t help the way his tail was wrapping around Mydei’s leg - now finding his tail around Mydei to be almost.. Self-soothing to himself as he hummed a little, “Surely not.”

“That doesn’t mean to coil around me more, you snake,” Mydei chastised, but Phainon could never help himself but to lean more against Mydei - taking in everything he possibly could from him.

Besides, it wasn’t like Mydei was actually trying to move or escape him, anyway.

“Hmph.”

────────────── 

Phainon couldn’t help himself as he turned a little in their bed - staring at the back of Mydei’s hair as his mind was so unbelievably empty. His precious mate was now curled around their eggs protectively, always cupping them as close as he could to himself when they laid down to sleep and that was fine.

Phainon loved the way Mydei seemed so very fond of their children, doting on them and spending so much time with them. Treating them as if they were priceless items that only he was allowed to touch and that only made Phainon more and more ecstatic that he had picked out the perfect mate.

.. But he just couldn’t shake his mind from the day, sighing instead; “Mydei..”

A test to see if his mate was even still awake or if he had already slipped into a slumber, and Phainon almost felt nervous as that deep rumbling voice replied to him. 

“Hmm?”

“You.. Said something earlier,” Phainon began, unsure of where else to pick up his mind’s pieces from as he tried to bring this topic up.

Yet Mydei didn’t move, he remained coiled around their children as he made an odd noise - one that clearly gave away the fact he was a little bit confused by those words; “Did I? What did I say?”

Phainon found himself sitting a little bit more upwards, still watching Mydei so keenly to see if that man would stir from his protective position around their children as he cocked his head to the side, “You.. Said you have no intentions of leaving me while your parents are well.”

“Yes? What of it?” 

.. What of it?

Was it such a nonissue that Mydei didn’t even comprehend why Phainon was upset over it? 

“I don’t like it..” Phainon confessed further, feeling himself knitting his brows together as he tried to figure out why Mydei didn’t seem bothered at all.

But his words only brought on a bit of prolonged silence, seeming like he couldn’t figure out what to say at all about it. 

“Don’t.. Like it? What are you prattling about?” Mydei asked, but he still wasn’t turning around to look at Phainon; he still was laying there and merely allowing Phainon to talk in his ears and say what he pleased.

But Phainon found that only working to fray the edges of his mind more and more. 

“That implies.. You’ll leave one day, you know?”

“I am to be the king of Kremnos, my marriage to you isn’t something that changes that. You seemed aware of that originally,” Mydei replied as if it was something that was making so much sense and Phainon didn’t need to question it at all,  “Are you not anymore?”

“Can you not govern your people from here? You don’t need to leave me, Mydeimos,” Phainon told him in a tired voice, desperate and feeling it snapping as it left his throat as he tried to comprehend his own emotions.

But he couldn’t.

He just didn’t want Mydei to leave, not now, not ever. Never again.

“Phain-” 

Whatever Mydei was going to say, Phainon had already chosen a different route of dialogue for him. Instead moving at such a rapid speed that he couldn’t even blame Mydei’s words for cutting off - instead moving to straddle Mydei beneath him and pin that dragon down to see those fierce golden eyes wide with his confusion.

Cute.

As cute as he always was, and yet Phainon only found his heart twisting so deliciously as he slammed the skin of his hand from his thumb to his index into Mydei’s mouth. Effortlessly gagging Mydei and finding himself smiling down at that man who had barely even moved to fight back.
