.. It had to be more than mere stargazing if Mydei had left their clutch at night time, after all. 

“Oh, I see,” Phainon hummed as he moved his head again to blink at the clusters of stars above, “Well.. What if we were to name some of the constellations?”

“It feels a bit late for that,” Mydei’s tone hadn’t changed still even with those words, quiet and solemn sounding to Phainon in a way that only made Phainon feel as if he could undo time for this man. To be able to redo all of it again and again until Mydei got to name them all whatever he wanted.. 

“Does it? I don’t know.. Look at those seven,” Phainon pointed with his hand upwards with his words, beaming a little as he motioned at some of them before glancing at Mydei, “That could easily be named after our family..”

“That is the Plough,” Mydei spoke, as if that meant a single thing to Phainon.

It didn’t, mind you. He had no idea what the hell the ‘Plough’ was. 

“.. And what is that?”

“The name of those stars,” Mydei matter-of-factly told him as if it were the most logical thing in the world, but Phainon..

He couldn’t stop the way his mouth fell open just a tiny bit, “I thought you said they couldn’t agree on naming them?”

“They agreed with that one.”

“You..”

“Also there are only six in our family, not seven,” Mydei pointed out with a little devilish grin on his lips - one that made Phainon feel as if he was more at home as he moved to bump their shoulders together with a little laugh escaping him. 

“We could easily make it seven,” Phainon mused just as well, throwing a lop-sided smile towards that dragon who only slowly raised a brow over that idea - appearing as if he was finding that quite entertaining if anything.

“Knowing you, it would not only be one new addition to our family,” Mydei huffed out with a shake of his head, but Phainon couldn’t stop the chuckle that left him over that sort of reaction either. 

“Is that such a bad thing? My poor, worrying husband!”

“I’m the worrying one? You’re leaving bloody footprints where you walk,” Mydei pointed out, and that was enough to make Phainon blink at him all before throwing a glance over his shoulder. His eyes only stared at the crimson footsteps from the soles of his own shoes leading up to where they were now sitting, making it quite obvious just how bloody he actually was today.

It.. Made more sense why Mydei could smell it, now. 

“.. I’ve been quite busy recently,” Phainon murmured as he moved his head to focus on the front again - his own teeth biting into his cheek as he did his best to ignore the pit that had formed in his stomach over the sight of it.

Normally he didn’t care about making a mess, but today.. Mydei seemed bothered by it, irked for once over it all and not just in shock, but as if he.. As if he was genuinely upset over it for some reason and Phainon wasn’t privy to it at all. 

“Your hobbies are worrying me more than anything,” Mydei heavily and audibly sighed between his own words at that, “I get lonely at night without you in my bed.”

Ah..

That was such a sweet confession that Phainon could barely even swallow down that hollow feeling in his stomach as he thought more and more of how kind his mate was. Kind, and forgiving.. 

“Wow.. You’re being so honest with me right now, Mydei..” Phainon tried to force himself to say, coming out more strangled than intended with his own guilt now gnawing and gnashing into his stomach over making his partner and husband worried for him and missing him.

“Yes,” Mydei muttered without much fanfare, merely sounding more than a little annoyed as he sighed again, “Precisely why it would be best if you listened well.”

Phainon was absolutely not prepared for the way Mydei grabbed his cheeks at that - roughly forcing him to look at Mydei without a different choice to even be considered. A feat that made him raise his brows a little, but he wasn’t one to ever complain about being permitted to look at the grace that was his husband, anyway. 

“It’s enough, Phainon.”

Those words were soft, spoken as if Mydei didn’t want to spook Phainon away - all while being rigid around the edges. Rough and not seeming like he wanted Phainon to take that quietness and gentleness for weakness, but instead that he was making a plea to Phainon. Begging for him to understand and Phainon.. Didn’t.

“.. Enough?” He echoed out, feeling his mind blanking just a tad as he did his best to process what exactly Mydei was asking of him. 

“Start resting more,” Mydei told him, and Phainon could barely process that as he felt Mydei’s clawed fingers pressing into his skin such a tiny amount, “You’re running yourself ragged for nothing.”

That simply wasn’t true, and it was enough to make Phainon frown over Mydei’s accusation as well. 

“It is not for nothing, you and ou-”

“They’re perfectly safe with the both of us on guard, do you truly believe with our hearing we would not hear someone trying to get into our room?” Mydei’s question was snapped towards Phainon before he could really even think twice about it.

Only serving to blink at Mydei with wide eyes over how he had to agree that they were not really the two people to fight with randomly.. But also there was something about the idea of someone breaking into their room that was haunting Phainon just a tiny amount. 

“.. Speaking of that, Mydei,” Phainon murmured as he raised his hand up to put it over Mydei’s own on his cheek - soothingly rubbing his thumb against Mydei’s hand as he offered a nervous little smile,  “Didn’t I lock the door before I left?”

Mydei, on the other hand, didn’t even change his expression; he instead remained staring at Phainon with such sharp eyes that it was almost dizzying for Phainon as they sat there, “Of course, I told you once before the door would be no match for me.”

“Right, no no, yeah. But does that.. Mean our eggs are in there alone without even a door?” Phainon asked as he leaned his head a little to the side, pressing his cheek into one of Mydei’s hands as he tried to not betray how worried he actually felt the more he thought on that matter.

“What nonsense are you accusing me of? Hyacine is with them,” Mydei growled, his fingers clawing into Phainon’s cheek a bit more - clearly irked by the question as if it was idiotic.

.. But Phainon barely understood why he wasn’t a bit worried by it. Did Hyacine have some practice in fighting that Mydei was aware of? 

Or was Mydei just insane?

“H-Hyacine? Like, the tiny little dragon?” Phainon found himself asking as Mydei.. Only raised a brow, as if he couldn’t understand he was being asked about this. 

“Yes.”

‘Yes’, his husband says. ‘Yes’ Mydeimos Kremnos says to Phainon Elysiae like it was the simplest thing in the world and not leaving a little pink girl to defend their children..

“W.. Surely you do not believe they’re safe with just her?”

“Of course I do, she is their grandmother allegedly. She reassured me she would handle it, or else she would scream as loud as Nikador did in his final battle,” Mydei explained as he snapped his hands away from Phainon’s face - apparently giving up on forcing him to look at Mydei in favor of focusing at the yard again before sighing. 

.. Phainon really didn’t know how loud Nikador screamed in his last battle, but something about being told Hyacine was going to copy that dragon made his head hurt a little. Maybe a lot. 

Phainon couldn’t even resist moving to put a hand on his own head, rubbing at his temple mindlessly, “That.. Mydei we really need to talk about the kinds of people you trust with our children..”

“Why is that? She is most trustworthy,” Mydei huffed out with a rolling shrug of his shoulder, “Besides, I have little fears considering how bloody you are today.”

Phainon dared to look over his own shoulder at those words, staring at the clear footsteps that led to where they were. His own walking in which he hadn’t cared at all for what he stepped in, if anything, it made a loud statement next to those who had already lost their lives to him. He could barely fathom how it was bothersome to Mydei. 

“If anything, you keep me up at night wondering why my bed is cold and empty without you,” Mydei muttered out, and that served to make Phainon snap his head to his side again. Staring at the way Mydei’s eyes were trained on the sky, focused and dark looking.

And that..

That was it, wasn’t it? The actual topic that had been haunting Mydei for so long and the one he was dancing around.. 

Phainon could only bite his tongue over it a little with his shame heavy in his gut now, “Mydei..”

Mydei didn’t even seem to react to that however, instead breathing a little heavy breath that sounded like a sigh - or something deeper that was more haunting for Mydei, “I’m very fond of how warm you are, the fact you’ve been depriving me of such a thing is more than enough reason for me to be angry with you.”

‘Depriving’ was a word with heavy meanings behind it and Phainon felt his mind shaky when he even tried to comprehend how he had been upsetting Mydei.

But he supposed it was one emotion at a time; “Angry?”

“My husband is a moron, yes, it’s infuriating,” Mydei snapped in a way that made Phainon jolt a little as those golden eyes jerked towards him. Narrow and beyond angry to the point of being furious with Phainon at the drop of a coin.

It was unlike Mydei, or perhaps Phainon had just angered him to this point; he really couldn’t say as he blinked a little and waited for what else that dragon had to say to him. Trying his best not to note the quiver in Mydei’s lip, such a raging little twitch that seemed to be Mydei holding back his desire to snarl at Phainon. 

“To be treated as if I cannot defend myself and my eggs.. I know it’s due to you caring for me, but it gets to a point where it’s insulting,” Mydei huffed after a few moments of barely controlling his rage before moving his head back to looking at the stars - acting as if that was something to help quell his own anger instead,  “Sleep with me more.”

That..

That was an easy request, at least, Phainon thought it should be as he bit down onto his lower lip - unable to fully process his own feelings about it because he felt as though he had to do this. That he needed to take care of Mydei, and it wasn’t due to him being weak or any nonsense like that.

He didn’t doubt Mydei’s own strength, that had never once even been an option for his mind to doubt; not when he was the perfect mate for Phainon physically and had proved himself in battle before.. But he just.. 

He wanted to protect Mydei, that was all.. 

“I am your mate, and all this does is show me how little you trust in my own abilities to keep our eggs safe as well,” Mydei sighed a little with his own words, moving to put his own elbows on his legs before he gave Phainon a rather blank stare. One that seemed robbed of all emotion as he put on that familiar charade of stoicness to Phainon. 

All before he asked something that made Phainon jerk a little,  “Is it due to two passing from birth with me?”

“Mydeimos, no,” That was said as flatly as possible - stressed and high-strung as he tried to figure out what to even say to such a thing,  “No.. I’m sorry.. I just..”

It wasn’t Mydei.

He had never once blamed Mydei for such an unfortunate thing, nor did he know that Mydei seemed to blame himself for it as well. But.. They were not made to have that many eggs in a clutch, not anymore, not in this day and age. The fact that even four survived was a miracle in itself he just.. Felt a bit foolish for never thinking about it before now; never wondering if Mydei blamed himself for it when Phainon.. He could never blame Mydei for that, nor had he even considered it.

“I.. I just get worried.. I want to be useful to you,” Phainon mumbled a little bit hushedly, unsure of how to even properly convey just how much he adored Mydei.

“It’s fine,” Mydei sighed out after a moment, only before moving his tail and readjusting himself, “I have something for you, anyway.”

“Huh?”

Phainon spoke that without much thought in his mind, eyes going wide as Mydei only pulled out a sleek amount of leather from under where he had been sitting with his chubby tail coiled around himself protective. An item that was stark blue, dyed in such a rich color that Phainon found himself in a bit of awe over it.

Namely because that color implied Mydei had it made himself, and.. Phainon found himself almost flinching away from Mydei’s fingers as they neared his neck. Tugging at his choker until he heard such an odd clicking noise - a sound that made him feel as if he was going utterly insane as such a smug smile formed on Mydei’s lips as he straightened the leather out idly. 

“M-Mydei? What is this?”

Phainon asked that, but he didn’t need to.

He knew the answer as Mydei said it, anyway; 

“A leash.”

A leash.

Mydei had just put a leash on him..?

“Right, but.. Why..?”

“You would be more useful to me as a husband who is doting towards me in bed, and not up into the late hours obsessing over people who may or may not want to hurt me,” Mydei explained as if it was the simplest explanation in the world. Going as far to tut a little as well as his eyes blatantly inspecting how snug it was locked onto Phainon’s choker, “The leash is to make sure you understand it fully.”

.. Phainon could think of a hundred arguments against that, most notably the amount of people he had killed tonight that plotted against them. The amount of people he had killed in the past as well.. The list went on, but he couldn’t deny the heat in his own stomach that was clawing into him so deliciously over Mydei being demanding like this.

That was why Phainon could only lick his lips - desperately trying to keep himself sane as he attempted to think rationally; “But.. Mydei I don’t think that-”

“Exactly, you don’t think,”Mydei growled out in a deep sultry voice, one that made Phainon’s fraying mental state threaten to snap more and more. And the way Mydei yanked that leash to jerk Phainon closer to him didn’t help that at all as Mydei stared at him as if he was a mere toy for him to play with now, “That’s why I’ll be thinking for you for now on, isn’t that nice?”

It sounded too nice.

To let Mydei decide everything for him and to constantly be around Mydei.. It was way more enticing than he could ever put into words. A statement that was making Phainon clench his hands into fists as he sat there, digging into his own palms as he sweated to try to stay focused and not.. On how badly he wanted that man to control him. 

“Mydei, I’m just.. Worried about you,” Phainon forced himself to choke out, barely able to keep his mind straight. His eyes only dropped down so many times to focus on that leash around his neck, staring at the grip Mydei had on it in such a demanding way to keep it taut and pulled - forcing Phainon closer to him and making him swallow every time he thought about it for too long. 

“And I’m telling you not to be, come on,” Mydei huffed out, not even hesitating as he immediately yanked Phainon forward and off that wall - pulling both of them off of it and making Phainon find his footing as his husband didn’t seem keen on waiting on him at all. Instead walking away and expecting Phainon to follow after him.

Of course he would do just that, he would be insane not to with how excited he was - feeling his tail wagging behind him as he walked a little bit faster to follow after Mydei, eyes still trained on that leash held in his hand.

“Where are we going?”

“To bed,” Mydei replied without even looking back before he sighed so utterly dramatically, “With my husband this time. Where he will stay with me nightly and sleep with me.”

Phainon didn’t know what to say to that, his own mouth falling open and floundering before he snapped it closed again. Not that it mattered anyway considering how Mydei shook his head, sighing a little as he moved his hand holding that leash to wave it a little dismissively. 

“And if I am truly to die in bed, then allow it to be in the arms of my husband,” Mydei glanced over his shoulder at Phainon with an unreadable emotion lurking in his eyes, “I would much rather that fate than the one where I have an absent lover.”

“Mydei..” Phainon whined out, unable to help himself as he watched Mydei’s eyes move back to focusing on walking. 

Not that Phainon minded him looking away, not when his mind was still so very distracted by that leash that was lightly being tugged as if it was a quiet little threat towards him. 

“You’ll behave, won’t you? Or do you have intentions of killing me through neglect?” Mydei asked without even looking at him, something about it felt like it was a jest; and yet, Phainon found himself whimpering a little over it.

“Mydei, I’m sorry I never wanted t-”

“Bark.”

B.. Bark?

“P.. Pardon me? I see I’ve.. Angered you and I d-”

“You talk too much for being my pet dog,” Nothing prepared Phainon for the way Mydei paused his steps - turning on his heel to immediately yank Phainon forward and draw such an embarrassing yelp to tumble out of his lips as he tried not to trip over the force his choker was pulled, “So I’m telling you to bark.”

.. What was Phainon supposed to do in this situation besides think Mydeimos was beautiful?! His own mind felt as though it was stalling and stuttering as he stared at those angry golden eyes that were tilted just a little bit - enough to glare at Phainon and steal his breath away.

How could he do anything but obey him? 

“.. I.. Woof?”

“Good, but we’ll work on it,” Mydei mumbled as he turned away again to walk as if nothing had even happened just now, “You are not the only dragon here, Phainon. You would do well to not continue angering me, and to instead behave.”

Phainon couldn’t help but to chuckle a little over that - his eyes only watching the way Mydei’s tail was swaying a little as he walked, “I rather like how aggressively greedy you’re being towards me though, Mydei..”

Mydei paused his steps at that - much more gentle this time as he slowly turned, looking at Phainon with a brow arched over those words.

“Then I assume you have no qualms if I use this leash while you give me another clutch, do you?”

.. Another clutch?

That.. He wanted to but he..

“T.. Tonight?” Phainon asked, unable to help the way he could tell his tail had begun to wag behind him - betraying any and all thoughts he could possibly ever have about denying giving Mydei more children. 

“Why not? Are you busy?” Mydei asked with such a coy and knowing smile on his lips, head tilting to the side as he only gave Phainon the fondest look of amusement, “So long as you keep barking, I’ll reward you, Phainon.”

Phainon was pretty sure he couldn’t respond in any other way to that man than to give him what he wanted - staring at golden flaked eyes that were so keenly watching his every move with a tight grip on a leash connected to Phainon’s neck.

And Phainon couldn’t help but to feel like he was exactly where he belonged, so long as Mydei was the one holding onto him.

“Woof!”
